name: PP Neue Montreal
idea: A typeface specimen dressed as a vintage city travel guide: the font named after Montreal is sold through guidebook titling, postcards and old tourist footage.
hero: Grainy coral-red field. Top row: a monogram in a pale pill at left, a pale-grey pill nav with seven links centred, a black pill button at right. Below at the left margin, a two-line white bold title at about 4.5vw; opposite it, a ring of repeated monograms set around a circle like a stamp. Three full-width black hairlines cut the field into bands: a two-line intro sentence at ~1.6vw sits in the second, and the typeface name fills the third in black bold at ~17vw, two lines, tight leading, 60% of the width. A 4:3 clip of 1960s street footage is inset bottom-right, 29% wide, bottom-aligned with the name.
type: PP Neue Montreal only: Bold for display with -0.01em tracking and leading near 0.9, Text Regular 16px for body and lists. Sizes leap from 16px to 144px headings to a ~240px name; one section enlarges a single lowercase letter to viewport height.
colour: #ed4b44 #1a1a1a #f0e7d4 #18bc42 #b5b5b5 #f2c21a — Each chapter takes a flat field (coral red, near-black, cream, green) with black or cream type; one headline colours every word differently. Warm, print-poster feel with visible grain.
imagery: Archive 1960s city footage, saturated vintage postcards, a handwritten postcard back, and rotated specimen posters and stamp sheets scattered around a headline. All square-cornered and inset, never full-bleed.
layout: 24px side margins and full-width hairlines marking bands. Content is left-anchored in three or four columns split by vertical hairlines; chapters alternate between tabular lists, a scattered collage, a centred statement and a giant glyph comparison. A pill nav stays pinned.

sections.description: Near-black screen split by a vertical hairline at about 75% width. Left: a three-line small heading at the top margin, then a five-line bold oblique headline at ~6vw in which each line is indented further right like a staircase and each word takes its own colour (green, cream, grey, yellow, blue, orange). Right narrow column: two stacked postcards, one saturated photo card and one cream handwritten card with a stamp. A tiny section label sits bottom-left.

A dark band of pure tabular type. A body paragraph occupies column one; weight names stack as tight single-line lists in two further columns divided by vertical hairlines. Below, a small label over a full-width rule introduces a two-column timeline: years stacked at the left margin, release notes stacked from the centre line behind a short vertical rule. One text size, leading near 1.0, no decoration at all.

Dark full-viewport stage with a three-line cream headline at ~4vw placed dead centre. Around it eight or nine specimen artefacts (a stamp sheet, a green poster with a blue numeral, a grey flag chart, a rainbow ticket grid, concentric colour squares) are each rotated 10 to 30 degrees and arranged on a loose ring, several cropped by the viewport edge, as if tossed on a table.

Cream field. A caption row at the top: a two-line label at the left margin and a five-line paragraph starting at about 55% width. Then a full-width rule carrying a tiny label at each end naming the two cuts. Below it, two black lowercase letters, each roughly half the viewport wide and cropped by the bottom edge, one from each cut, so the reader compares shapes at poster scale.

steal: Give a product page a borrowed genre (here a tourist guidebook) and let that genre dictate titles, imagery and chapter names.
Cut a flat colour hero into bands with full-width hairlines and set the name at ~17vw in the bottom band beside a small inset film clip.
Scatter rotated print artefacts on a loose ring around a centred headline and let several crop off the viewport.
media: The hero is a red printed cover with paper grain; the real media is small, a 418x316 looping 1960s street clip at the bottom right (about 10% of the viewport) beside a wordmark filling about 60% of the width. Later: a postcard pair in the right half of a split, rotated ephemera orbiting a centred statement, full-bleed photo panels that slide up over the previous chapter, a spine accordion, and a full-bleed vintage photograph overscanned 72px each side; square corners, one video.
motion: Black, then a turning seal of logo letters, then the cover by 4.5s; four hero groups rise 25px and fade over 400ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.56,1) at 200ms steps, settling at about 5.5s though the page loaded in 2.5s. Lenis drives a chain of sticky full-screen chapters: ephemera fly off as a photo panel slides up, a headline steps through weights of the variable cut on scroll, and a single glyph rotates and zooms for about 5 screens; about 390 appear fades run over 400ms on a spring-shaped linear() curve, with no reduced-motion rule.

name: Seasats
idea: Calm, dusk-lit seascapes sell autonomous boats as serene instruments, and the navigation is a column of stacked colour swatches taken from that sea-and-sand palette.
hero: A 10px white frame surrounds everything. The left 84% is one rounded media panel: a dusk scene of a low, solar-decked vessel centred on mirror-flat water, with two larger hulls cropped by the panel's left and right edges. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third, two lines of white light-weight flared serif at 124px (8.6vw). A wordmark in custom wide techno lettering sits top-left; a white rounded button with mono caps and a dark-green square arrow sits bottom-centre. The right 14% is the menu: a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks (blush, sage, then four darkening olives), each holding left-aligned 15px links, sub-items numbered 01 to 04.
type: seasonMix, a low-contrast serif-sans hybrid, light weight, sentence case, near-zero tracking, at 124px for the headline and about 40px for statements; seasonSans 16px for body and menu; supplyMono uppercase at 9 to 12px for buttons, tags and footer data.
colour: #a6b3bc #232323 #b7c8be #d6c4b8 #2c3620 #e2832a — Slate blues and lilac greys from the seascapes dominate; the menu adds blush, sage and olive blocks; the footer flips to a burnt-orange and rust scene. Text stays white.
imagery: Photoreal rendered footage of autonomous boats on glassy water at dusk: symmetrical, low horizon, lots of sky, full-bleed after the hero. Small square-cornered inset stills with mono tag labels float over the scene.
layout: Mostly full-viewport scenes with one centred text block each, at top or bottom, and the wordmark fixed top-left. Only the hero uses the framed panel-plus-menu split. A thin vertical progress line runs down the right edge.

sections.description: A pinned full-bleed scene shot from the boat's deck: the hull forms a dark symmetrical wedge rising from the bottom edge to a mast at centre, horizon at one-third. At top-centre six short statements are stacked, centred, at 16px; one is white and the others half opacity, and the highlight steps down the list on scroll. For each, small photo cards (150 to 220px wide, square corners, mono tag on the top edge) appear left and right of the mast.

A full-bleed aerial view of dark teal water with several small vessels scattered across the lower half and a faint horizon near the top. A single two-line statement in the light serif at about 40px sits centred near the bottom edge. Nothing else is on screen except the wordmark top-left and the thin progress line at right.

Colour inverts to a burnt-orange haze over rust-red terrain, with black silhouettes of hulls and a keel hanging from the top edge as if seen from below the surface. Mid-height: mono readouts at left reporting distance scrolled in metres and scroll speed in knots with a one-line quip; a link list at 16px in the centre; mono contact details at right. The wordmark fills the full width at the bottom, white, about 130px tall.

steal: Build the menu as a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks sampled from the imagery, grouping links by block colour instead of by rules or headings.
List every claim at once, centred and dimmed, and move a single full-opacity highlight through the list on scroll while supporting images appear around a fixed subject.
Give the footer its own opposite-temperature scene and a live readout of how far and how fast the visitor scrolled, in the product's own units.
media: A dusk render of the vessel on still water, as a still, a 3s muted loop and a canvas layered together, fills an inset card at about 84% of the width beside a colour-band nav panel and goes full bleed once scrolled. Then a scroll-scrubbed frame sequence on a sticky stage with labelled photo cards floating at depth, small video thumbnails that grow into full-bleed chapter loops, a WebGL globe rising as a half-sphere from the bottom edge, and sticky product renders that turn with the scroll; 18 images, 6 videos, 8px corners on the hero frame and cards.
motion: The preloader wordmark's seven letters slide up out of their masks at 50ms steps, the framed hero arrives at 1.2s and the title fades in softly, settling after about 5s, and smooth scroll then runs 34 sticky elements with no pins: the flythrough is a scrubbed image sequence, a fixed background layer changes the ground per chapter, and the nav collapses to a slim right-edge rail. Title characters rise on cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) (the house ease, 17 uses) with durations that shorten by 12ms per character, so the end of a word catches up with its start.

name: Ai in Design Report 2026
idea: A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.
hero: The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.
type: Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.
imagery: Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.
layout: 1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.

sections.description: A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.

A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.

Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.

Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.

steal: Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.
Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.
Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.
media: A video collage covers 100% of the screen at load and lifts to the top ~53% to uncover the title on white. Below, a documentary photograph two thirds wide in a sticky frame beside stacked colour stat blocks, a pinned deck of colour cards each with a 10s clip docked bottom-left, and a carousel of equal stills running off the right edge: 12 images and 6 muted videos, all square-cornered.
motion: No preloader, but the collage re-cuts itself for about 4s before the title lands. Framer drives the sticky stacking (a 1350px photo frame and three 900px chapter cards that peel away to uncover the next); there is no split text, links change colour over .2s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), and one panel slides 610px in over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.37,1).

name: House of Honey
idea: A block-heavy wordmark pierced by a hairline script: the bold-against-delicate contrast is repeated at every scale, with giant pink script behind quiet serif statements.
hero: Top 42% is a flat blush-pink band; the bottom 58% is a full-bleed photograph of a bright living room, arched window on the centre axis, butting against the band with no margin. A tiny nav row sits at the very top with 8px side margins: block logo glyph and five links left, contact link with a small square arrow box far right. The wordmark fills the width edge to edge: two words in ultra-black extended caps, about 120px cap height, dark aubergine, with a hairline script 'of' 230px tall between them, overshooting above and below. Directly beneath, two two-line serif uppercase taglines at 31px, one flush left, one flush right.
type: Wordmark in ultra-black extended caps; statements in noeText serif, uppercase, 31–40px, tight tracking; nav and captions in neueHaasGrotesk around 14px; 'canora' hairline script for the connecting word and for cropped background words at 37vw. Three contrasting voices, each with one job.
colour: #edccbe #331917 #0e0e0e #f26fcb #ffffff — Blush pink and dark aubergine-brown alternate as full fields and as each other's text colour. Hot pink appears only in the oversized script and a 2px divider. Photographs bring saturated colour.
imagery: Editorial interior photography, saturated and daylight-lit. Hero is a full-bleed landscape crop; projects are portrait crops about 5:6 in a three-column grid with 4px gutters and square corners.
layout: Edge-to-edge with 8px outer margins. Typographic sections (small centred label, serif statement, cropped giant script) alternate with a three-column image grid. Blush and brown fields swap each section; hairline link rows close blocks. The footer is a full-width logo glyph.

sections.description: Dark aubergine field under the hero photo, separated by a 2px hot-pink line. A small sans label centred, then a three-line centred serif uppercase statement at about 31px in blush, 45% of the width. Behind it a hot-pink script phrase set near 37vw runs off both sides and is cut by the section's bottom edge, its ascenders rising into the statement. A smaller serif line follows.

Title card before the project grid. Blush field, nearly empty screen. A small label and a one-line serif uppercase heading about 40px sit centred at 55% height. The giant pink script returns, cropped by the bottom edge so only its top half shows and running off both sides.

Three columns edge to edge with 4px gutters and 8px outer margins. Portrait photos about 500×580px, square corners. Under each: an uppercase sans title at 14px and a grey line of GPS coordinates. Two rows, then a full-width hairline row with a text link left and a small square arrow box at the far right.

Brown field. The logo glyph is enlarged to full width and about a third of the screen: blush rectangles and quarter-circle arcs with 4px gaps, forming an abstract monogram. Below: four columns of small links, a hairline, two addresses in the first two columns, another hairline, then copyright left and a small blush button right.

steal: Set a wordmark edge to edge in ultra-heavy extended caps and thread a hairline script connecting word through it that overshoots the cap height both ways.
Use an oversized script word in one hot accent colour as a cropped background layer behind small, calm serif statements.
Split a tagline into two halves, flush left and flush right on the same baseline under the wordmark, instead of centring it.
media: The lower 58% of the fold is a full-bleed interior photograph that continues for one full viewport as a five-image crossfading slideshow with a pink progress line on its bottom edge. Below: a three-up grid of 4:5 project tiles with 8px gutters sliding over a giant script marquee, a full-bleed tinted feature photograph with its title docked bottom-left, a full-bleed photograph with an inset colour card, and one giant cropped letterform as the footer's picture, the photographs oversized to 110-170% of their frames for drift and no video anywhere.
motion: There is no visible preloader and the page is whole at 400ms; under Lenis, blocks rise 8px and fade in over 800ms ease-out at 0-260ms staggers (39 WAAPI calls), slideshow crossfades take 600ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.25,1), the oversized photographs drift, and script marquees run on CSS time (90-122s per pair). Page changes use a 1s view transition on the same curve; nothing pins, and there is one reduced-motion rule.

name: White Desert
idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.
media: An 18s muted aerial and ice-cave clip covers the whole first screen under a scrim, with the title docked along the bottom edge. Later pictures dissolve into the white page through fog-like fades, a horizontal accordion opens one trip panel at half width beside blurred slivers, vertical ice strips wipe across the previous photograph, and a long pinned track of inset cards floats on a full-bleed texture ground before a closing photo panel carrying a quotation; 20 images, one video, square corners and a high-key cold grade.
motion: There is no entrance choreography and footage plays from the first frame; under Lenis the hero title blurs and is swallowed by a sticky fog layer growing from 390 to 900px tall, statement lines fill from grey to navy, the camps heading scrubs from 140px down to 60px, and a pinned horizontal track moves the cards at about 0.56px per scrolled pixel over an 8,328px runway. Blocks rise 20rem with opacity over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), and hovers run .3s cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1).

name: Applied Imagination
idea: An essay conceived on a flight is read as a descent: an altimeter ticks from 30,000 ft to zero while you scroll down through halftone clouds to mountains at ground level.
hero: A pale blue sky fading to warm cream fills the viewport, with white clouds shaded in halftone dots. A tiny serif logotype sits top-centre; no nav. The title, two centred lines of black wedge-serif at 8.9vw, occupies the middle half of the screen and about 73% of its width; a cloud layer passes in front of the second line's baseline so the feet of the letters dissolve into dots. A two-line centred deck at 24px sits beneath. A mono byline strip is centred on the bottom edge with a scroll cue bottom-right. On the left edge at mid-height, a short vertical rule carries a two-line mono altitude readout.
type: fsKim, a sturdy wedge-serif display face, regular weight at 128px with -0.01em tracking for the title and pull quotes; gtAmerica at 24px for the deck and about 16px for essay body; gtAmericaMono uppercase around 11px with wide tracking for byline, altitude and tape labels.
colour: #cbe4f2 #f1e3b5 #0a0a0a #ffc013 #8e2f8f #f04e23 — Sky blue melting into sand yellow is the constant ground and text is black. Saturated magenta, orange and yellow arrive only in collage objects, tape labels and the footer contact card.
imagery: Photo-collage cut-outs (parachutes carrying a treasure chest and a burning dumpster, a pair of legs, mountains) given a coarse halftone dot screen, layered in front of and behind the type against painted clouds.
layout: A narrow text column about 38% wide for essay passages, interrupted by full-width display pull quotes and collage objects floating at the edges. One continuous sky instead of sections, with a fixed left-edge altimeter. Nearly 23 screens, ending on a ground-level landscape.

sections.description: Sky background, no container. A three-line pull quote in black wedge-serif at about 7vw is centred and tightly leaded. Two cut-out parachutes hang over it: a magenta one from the top-left carrying a chest spilling coins, an orange one at lower right carrying a burning dumpster, each overlapping letterforms. Small mono labels on tilted strips of coloured tape are stuck to the objects. Words in the quote turn from grey to black as they are reached.

Running essay text in about 16px grotesk, black, in a single column roughly 38% of the viewport wide, positioned left of centre with large sky margins on both sides. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line; serif sub-statements at about 28px introduce passages. The next display quote is seen rising from below, its letters partly hidden behind cloud and blurred.

Ground level: halftone-screened mountains in green and brown rise from both sides, and the title returns at huge scale, cropped by the top edge and tucked behind the peaks. Centred below is a square-cornered two-panel card: a cream left panel with a short form of two fields and a small orange button, and a magenta right panel with a round portrait, name and a yellow subscribe button. Yellow tape-strip credits sit on the bottom edge.

steal: Tie a persistent numeric readout to scroll position (altitude falling to zero) so the reader's progress becomes part of the story.
Layer an illustration element in front of the bottom of a giant title so the letters sink into the scene instead of sitting on top.
Apply one coarse halftone dot screen to every photo cut-out so collage pieces from different sources read as one illustration set.

name: Cursor Compile
idea: The event name drawn as seven looping one-line curves in seven colours, more signature than logotype, on an otherwise whisper-quiet off-white page whose images are re-rendered as rows of coloured characters.
hero: Warm off-white field with no header or navigation. Starting about 23% down, a line-drawn wordmark spans from 8% to 92% of the width and about 29% of the height: each letter is a single 2px stroke looping like a Lissajous figure, each in a different colour (orange, green, olive, lilac, black, brown, blue), overlapping its neighbours. Directly beneath, two 14px captions, one flush left in ink and one flush right in grey. After a gap of about 20% of the viewport, three equal columns sit at the bottom, each topped by a hairline: an 18px statement, a grey 14px paragraph, and an email field over a full-width near-black rectangular button.
type: The only large lettering is the drawn wordmark. All real text is CursorGothic regular in two sizes, 18px and 14px (the largest text on the page is 1.8vw), sentence case, with hierarchy made by ink versus mid-grey rather than by size or weight.
colour: #edece8 #26251e #f07a1f #2e9e3a #2f6bf0 #9b8ff0 — Warm paper ground with near-black and grey text. The wordmark's colours return one at a time as the single ink of each character-rendered image (lilac, teal, green, orange). Event photos are dark and warm.
imagery: Two kinds: landmarks and speaker portraits redrawn as rows of tiny characters in one saturated colour on a tint of the same colour; and dark, warm documentary event photos. All are square-cornered rectangles in strict rows.
layout: About 7% side margins on a three-column grid. Each section has a small two-line heading at left (title in ink, subtitle in grey), then a row or carousel of equal tiles with one-line captions beneath. Very large vertical gaps between sections; a denser photo grid near the end.

sections.description: Tour dates as a three-column grid of 3:2 tiles. Each tile is a city landmark rendered entirely in rows of small characters in one colour on a pale tint of that colour: lilac, teal, green, orange. Under each tile, one caption line: city name in ink, date in grey straight after it, and a status word flush right. A fourth tile wraps alone to the left of a second row, leaving two columns empty.

Session recordings as stacked carousels. A small heading and grey subtitle, then per stage a tiny label at left with two arrow glyphs at far right and a row of 16:9 dark photo tiles, two full tiles visible and a third cropped by the margin. Each tile has a small white event tag in its bottom-left corner. Caption beneath: speaker name in ink followed by the talk title in grey on the same line.

Speaker row: one-line heading at left, arrows at right, then four near-square portrait tiles with 8px gaps, each a face drawn in horizontal rows of characters in one colour on its tint (orange, green, lilac, teal). Some tiles show only plain stripes with the face barely emerging, so portraits appear to resolve from lines as they load or on hover.

After a three-column photo grid with mixed landscape and portrait crops and 8px gaps, the page ends on an empty off-white screen holding one centred sentence at 18px and a small dark pill button beneath it. There are no footer columns, links or legal rows.

steal: Draw the name as one continuous thin looping stroke per letter, each in a different colour, and let it be the only large element on the page.
Keep all text at two small sizes and build hierarchy from ink versus grey on the same line (name in ink, detail in grey right after it).
Re-render photographs as rows of tiny characters in a single saturated colour on a tint of that colour, one colour per tile.

name: The New Industrials
idea: A long-read essay laid out inside a visible drafting grid, where colour fields shift as you read and 3D machine parts drift through the margins and finally assemble into the publisher's initials.
hero: A saturated orange page framed by black hairlines 24px from each edge. Top strip: a monogram logo left, a black pill with orange monospaced title centred, a boxed year right. Under it a row of eight empty outlined cells, 62px tall, like a ruler. A cream panel then fills the remaining width and height. Inside, a WebGL scene of pastel low-poly machine parts with visible wireframes sits behind a two-line uppercase title in a tall condensed slab serif, glyphs about 210px high, spanning 83% of the width. Small monospaced uppercase credits flank it at mid-height; reading time is centred below, with two boxed share links on the bottom edge.
type: Title in a tall condensed slab serif at roughly 14vw cap height, black, uppercase. Essay in Albra Book serif: 34px lead paragraph, 18px running text with generous leading. Supply Mono in tiny uppercase for credits and box labels; a narrow typewriter-like face for the pull quote.
colour: #ff8126 #f1ead8 #161615 #4db3ff #c5f53d #ff5fc0 — The page background changes as you read: orange, then a gradient through lilac into sky blue, then acid lime at the end. Type and hairlines stay black; the 3D parts carry rainbow gradients.
imagery: Real-time 3D machine components (cylinders, gears, polyhedra) in matte pastel with coloured wireframe edges and neon gradient caps; they overlap the title, float into text margins and form letters in the footer.
layout: Black hairlines divide the whole page into cells: one wide text cell flanked by narrow empty ones, each chapter tagged with a small numbered box at its corner. The lead paragraph spans the cell, running text is indented into a narrower column, and full-width quote screens interrupt.

sections.description: On orange, a ruled cell with a small numbered square at its top-right corner. The opening paragraph is set in serif at about 34px, seven lines, filling the cell with 60px padding. A horizontal hairline closes the cell; the next one indents its text by about 180px and drops to 18px, with a vertical rule marking the indent. The side cells stay empty, so the grid reads as margin furniture.

Pull quote: a full-viewport interruption where the grid lines stop. The background becomes a vertical gradient from orange through dusty lilac to sky blue. Centred, five lines of a narrow, widely tracked typewriter-style face at about 48px in dark olive-brown, each letter trailing a soft red vertical smear downward like wet ink. The next cell resumes on the blue that the gradient ended on.

Body screens: a single serif column about 960px wide between two vertical hairlines, paragraphs separated by a blank line. One 3D object per screen (a grey-green polyhedron with green edges, an orange hexagonal nut) sits half outside the column, crossing the vertical rule and the page edge at a different height each time, so every screen of text has one sculptural interruption.

Acid-lime field. The publisher's three initials are built as a sculpture from the 3D parts seen earlier, about 60% of the viewport tall and spanning nearly the full width, each letter a different assembly of pipes, gears and blocks in clashing gradients. Below, hairlines form two cells holding monospaced uppercase credits at 10px, aligned to the cells' left padding.

steal: Draw the layout grid as visible black hairlines, including a row of empty cells, and tag each text block with a small numbered box.
Change the page background colour between chapters of a long read so progress is felt as a shift of colour.
Let one family of 3D objects recur at three scales: behind the title, in the margins, and assembled into a monogram at the end.

name: wild
idea: A studio essay on craft versus AI in which everything decorative is drawn on one square-pixel grid: the hero heatmap, the icons, the diagrams, the marquee lettering and the footer equaliser.
hero: White page with a barely visible graph-paper grid. The top 22% is a masthead band split by a vertical hairline at 60%: at left, a two-line uppercase headline in a light grotesk at 5.2vw, tight leading, starting 9% from the left and nearly touching the top edge; at right, a two-line uppercase tagline with words spread to justify the column, then a pixel logo and a small right-aligned description. Below, a full-bleed canvas about 45% of the viewport tall: thousands of small squares in yellow, red, lime, cobalt and navy form a heatmap that erodes into white along its lower edge. A 3vw intro paragraph begins at the fold.
type: Sneak in one regular-to-light weight does everything: uppercase 75px headline at -0.035em, a 44px sentence-case intro, section headings near 30px, 13px body. Tiny SF Mono uppercase captions with wide tracking sit under headings. A bitmap pixel face appears once, in the closing marquee. No bold anywhere.
colour: #ffffff #0a0a0a #f2b90f #3b55d9 #1e2340 #e8452c — White page, black type, black buttons. Colour lives only inside the pixel graphics, in a fixed set of yellow, cobalt, navy, red and lime, so every illustration looks related. No section changes background.
imagery: Canvas-drawn square-pixel fields: a heatmap band, particle streams that tighten from scattered dots into a dense ribbon, pixel smiley faces, an equaliser strip. Client work appears once, as three plain square-cornered photo cards.
layout: Content runs from 9% to 91% with a constant split: heading in the left third, body in the right two-thirds, a tiny mono caption under the heading. Full-bleed pixel canvases interrupt the text. A small fixed mono link sits top-right; the ending is centred.

sections.description: Three equal cards in one row, each a 6:5 image with square corners (laptop mock-up, product photo, flat illustration) followed by a centred project name at about 20px and a centred two-line description in small text. No borders, shadows or tags; a small round black arrow button overlaps the right edge of the third image to advance the row. Large white space above and below.

Essay rows: a two- or three-line heading at about 2.2vw in the left third with a tiny wide-tracked mono caption below it; in the right two-thirds, two short justified paragraphs at 13px. Under one row, two pixel-art faces built from black squares (a smile and a frown, about 30px) sit side by side, each over a mono label and a three-line centred caption, forming a two-column comparison.

A four-word heading on two lines and a short paragraph at the left, then a wide canvas diagram: scattered pale-blue and navy squares at the left converge into a tight horizontal ribbon in the middle and fan out again in yellow at the right, a pixel funnel. Below it four narrow columns, each with a small round dark marker, a bold one-word label and two lines of small text.

A single line of bitmap lettering scrolls across the full width, each glyph assembled from yellow squares flecked with red, navy and lime. Centred beneath: a black button with stepped pixel corners, two short grey centred paragraphs and an email line. The page ends with a full-width strip of coloured pixel bars like an audio equaliser, a small black play button centred above it.

steal: Pick one drawing primitive, a square on a fixed grid, and render every non-text element with it (hero art, icons, diagrams, display lettering, footer) in one five-colour set.
Split a masthead band 60/40 with a vertical hairline: oversized light-weight uppercase headline at left, a word-spaced justified tagline and tiny descriptor at right.
Lay out long copy as rows with the heading in the left third and body in the right two-thirds, and put the tiny mono caption under each heading instead of an eyebrow above it.

name: Hildén & Kaira
idea: The agency name is cast in liquid chrome across the full width, and the same chrome becomes emoji that float through the page, tying a social-media pitch to one material.
hero: Warm light-grey field. The lowercase serif wordmark, rendered as polished chrome 3D letters with a molten ampersand, runs edge to edge across the top quarter (about 220px tall, 16px side margins). A tilted portrait video roughly 180 by 220px covers two of its letters. Directly under the wordmark, four small nav links centred. Then 300px of nothing, with one chrome flame emoji floating at the far left. The headline sits in the bottom third: three centred lines of narrow display serif at 4.4vw, leading so tight that descenders touch ascenders, a two-line 15px sans sub, and two square-cornered buttons, black and pale lime.
type: PP Editorial New 400 for headlines at 63px, -0.02em tracking and leading near 0.9; PP Neue Montreal 13px for nav, body and buttons. The jump is roughly 5:1 with nothing in between. Stat numerals use the sans at about 60px.
colour: #eae9e6 #181818 #ecfdad #b5b5b5 #ffffff #3aa57a — Warm grey and near-black alternate by section. Pale lime is the single accent: secondary buttons, headline text on dark, stat tiles and service cards. Chrome silver recurs as a material.
imagery: Chrome 3D-rendered lettering and emoji objects (flame, heart, dove, microphone, wink) floating free; vertical phone videos of client content shown as fanned, slightly rotated stacks with white borders. Square corners throughout.
layout: Centred statements with large voids, alternating light and dark full-width bands. Content arrives as square-cornered slabs: a white case card on grey, lime service cards stacking over each other on black. Chrome objects break the grid at the edges.

sections.description: Full-viewport near-black band. A two-line centred serif statement in pale lime at about 4vw sits in the upper third with nothing near it. Two small testimonials are pushed to the bottom-left and bottom-right corners: five tiny stars, two lines of 11px sans, name and title, each centred in its own narrow block. The centre bottom is left empty.

Horizontal carousel of wide white slabs on the grey ground, the next slide peeking at the right edge. Left half: a two-line serif title top-left, then far below a red-dot label over a thin rule and two flat tiles side by side, a wide lime one and a narrower brushed-chrome one, each with a tiny caption and a 60px sans numeral. Right half: a grey panel with three vertical videos fanned like playing cards.

On black, a centred serif section title, then service cards that pin and stack: a lime slab about 55% wide with serif title top-left, grey serif index number top-right, a small paragraph and black button bottom-left and a vertical video inset bottom-right. White and green slabs peek out beneath it, offset downward, and the top card tilts a degree or two as it scrolls.

A full brushed-silver gradient field. The chrome wordmark repeats at full width across the top. Bottom-left, a small serif label over two short link columns; bottom-right, two square translucent tiles each holding a chrome object (microphone, heart) with a serif label above and three tiny square social buttons below. A hairline and a legal row close it.

steal: Render the wordmark in one physical material and reuse that material for small floating objects, so decoration and logo are the same thing.
Leave a third of the hero empty between a top-edge wordmark and a bottom-third headline; the gap makes both read.
Set a display serif with leading under 1.0 so lines interlock, and pair it with 13px sans for everything else.

name: PX PUSH
idea: A design subscription presented as a retro broadcast: the entire site is seen through a CRT screen, with a chrome logo token floating in the sky as its mascot.
hero: Full-bleed photograph of deep-blue sky over a cloud bank, the whole viewport under a CRT treatment: horizontal scanlines, slight blur, dark vignette with rounded corners. Top row with 43px margins: thin techno wordmark left; three links and a start link with a green dot right, split by a vertical hairline; full-width hairline beneath. Then one marquee line at 12vw (173px) in off-white grotesk, cropped at both edges, words separated by a solid dot, closed by a second hairline. Dead centre: a chrome 3D ring token about 400px wide. Bottom-left: a 216×144px royal-blue rounded thumbnail with a two-line mono caption. Bottom-right: a four-line mono uppercase paragraph 450px wide.
type: A semi-condensed grotesk (digest name 'SemiSqueezed') at regular weight carries the 173px marquee, 28px paragraphs and 5vw statements; an uppercase monospace at 11–17px handles tags, captions and link rows. Ten-to-one jump between display and labels; no bold anywhere.
colour: #03049c #71737d #1a1a1a #788ca4 #d9dde6 #c8f31d — Each section is a full colour field: sky photo, mid grey, near-black, then saturated royal blue. Text is off-white or pale lavender; acid lime appears only in small thumbnails, green only as a status dot.
imagery: Sky photograph, a chrome 3D logo token, and client work shown as phone UIs on a blue ground and a poster photographed in a street lightbox. Everything sits under the same scanline filter; tiles have small radii.
layout: A narrow left rail (about 17% wide) carries a bullet, a mono section tag and a small pinned thumbnail; copy starts at 35% and runs to the right margin. Hairline rules and arrow link rows divide content. Each section switches the full background colour.

sections.description: Mid-grey field. In the left rail: a bullet and mono tag at the top, and a 115×75px acid-lime thumbnail with a black glyph pinned lower-left that swaps as you scroll. The right 60% holds one long paragraph at about 28px with tight leading, opened by an arrow and a deep first-line indent; words go from white to grey with scroll progress. It ends with two full-width hairline rows in mono, arrow at the far right.

Near-black field. A horizontal strip of large tiles about 500px tall with narrow gaps, bleeding off the left edge: a royal-blue tile with three phone screens in a row, then a photograph of a poster in a street lightbox. Below, the left rail shows a bullet and tag while a four-line mono caption sits in the content column.

Saturated royal-blue field. A three-line statement in pale lavender at roughly 5vw sits left-aligned at the 35% column, vertically centred in an otherwise empty screen. Below a full-width hairline, each benefit is a row: mono number in the rail, a 3vw title, a narrow mono paragraph under it, and a small photo (a windsock against sky) pinned to the right margin.

Same blue. The wordmark is enlarged to 95% of the width in pale lavender with a slit-scan echo: horizontal slices of the letter tops repeat upward in fading bands. Underneath, a mono address block sits in the rail, and two columns of hairline link rows with corner arrows fill the content area.

steal: Apply one global post-effect (scanlines plus a rounded vignette) over the whole viewport so photos, UI mocks and type all belong to the same screen.
Run the headline as a single cropped marquee line boxed between two hairlines under the nav, leaving the rest of the hero for one object.
Keep a narrow left rail for a mono section tag and a small pinned thumbnail that swaps per section, with copy confined to the right 60%.
media: A full-bleed sky photograph covers the whole first screen with a chrome 3D token about 20% of the width at the centre and a small 216x144 video card docked bottom-left that changes clip and shape per chapter. Then a looping strip of mixed-width work images at a fixed 576px height, sticky rows each with a 4:5 portrait docked right, and a split with a fixed 3D floppy disk in the left half as price sheets scroll in the right; everything passes under fixed CRT layers: scanlines, a sweeping bright bar and a vignette.
motion: No preloader was captured (load 15.2s): between 400 and 2500ms the token turns from face-on to side-on and the marquee drifts, and under Lenis paragraphs split into characters (2001 elements) brighten word by word with the scroll from about 25% to full opacity, benefit rows stack as 90px sticky tabs, and the disk turns from edge-on to face-on. No cubic-beziers anywhere, only ease, linear and steps: a 0.5s stepped grain, an 8s scanline sweep and opacity 0.3s ease on hover, with no reduced-motion rule.

name: Illoca
idea: Software for architects sold as a drafting table: a two-colour illustrated studio on graph paper that the scroll camera pushes into until the drawing fills the screen.
hero: Captured on the preloader: a beige graph-paper field (12px grid) with a small cobalt logo tile dead centre, handwritten X/Y cursor coordinates top-left and an email in architect's hand lettering top-right. Loaded, a centred grotesk headline at 7.7vw in near-black sits at the top, breaking over two lines in the capture, with a tiny hand-lettered margin note and arrow beside its last word. Directly beneath, inset 12px from each side, a huge wide cel-shaded scene in only cobalt and beige: an architect at a drafting desk beside a window with a skyline. A small white nav capsule floats top-centre with logo, three mono links and a navy button.
type: F37 Analog medium at 111px for the headline, a warm grotesk with tight default spacing. Graphik for body at 15px, Geist Mono for nav links, and Architect Pro, a hand-lettered drafting face in caps, for coordinates, email and margin notes. Four faces, one job each.
colour: #e6dbc7 #0b3db8 #283f7d #cfc6b4 #2a2a2a #f25c1c — Paper beige and one cobalt blue do everything, including the whole illustration. Navy for the button, near-black for type, and a single small orange square inside the button as the only warm accent.
imagery: A real-time 3D interior flattened to two inks with a fine grain: light surfaces in beige, shadow in solid cobalt, thin pencil linework on the drawings. One square-cornered frame, inset 12px, containing the entire page's imagery.
layout: A single pinned viewport over graph paper. Centred headline, then one inset image frame with 12px margins taking 75% of the height; small persistent items at three top positions (left, centre capsule, right). The frame occasionally narrows to open a text gutter.

sections.description: The page is one pinned scene. The inset illustration frame stays fixed while scroll moves a camera: a wide shot of the studio, a push-in over the architect's shoulder, then a top-down close-up where a translucent blueprint sheet and a pencil perspective sketch lying on the desk fill the frame. In one frame the image narrows to the right 70%, leaving a graph-paper gutter at left for text.

Navigation is a compact white capsule about 280px wide, centred at the top with square corners: icon tile and wordmark, three mono links, and a navy button with a small orange square inside. Two corner items in hand lettering (live cursor coordinates top-left, email top-right) stay on screen over the graph paper throughout, like notes in a drawing's title block.

steal: Restrict a detailed 3D scene to two flat colours (one ink, one paper) so it reads as a printed illustration rather than a render.
Use scroll as a camera push from an establishing shot down to the object on the desk that the product actually makes.
Reserve a handwritten drafting face for marginalia only (coordinates, arrows, a correction beside the headline) over a graph-paper ground.
media: One fixed Three.js scene carries all the imagery, seen through a window cut by four animated paper masks: a letterbox under the title on about 56% of the fold, then 87-97% of the viewport from the first scroll step, then a two-thirds window docked right or left with text in the remaining third. A flat two-ink render (cobalt against greige, ink outlines, paper grain); no img and no video.
motion: A logo-on-graph-paper preloader holds past 4.5s with no progress, then headings fill character by character from outline to solid (406 split characters) and handwritten labels write on. Lenis drives a keyframed camera from a wide studio onto the sketch, the plan and an extruding massing model, while the masks morph between letterbox, immersive and split states; the only CSS easing is the default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) on 0.1s opacity changes, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

name: Aspen Search
idea: The page is a ruled tile system with no margins: the two-word name is split across cells that alternate type, dithered canvas, black and one mint green.
hero: A 60px top bar ruled into cells: black logo square, local time, nav links starting at the centre line, a theme toggle and a black contact cell flush right. Below, the viewport is a two-by-two grid divided by 1px black lines, no outer margin. Top-left is white with the first word of the name at 12.5vw, weight 450, sitting bottom-left. Top-right and bottom-left cells hold a black-and-white dithered canvas crossed by large pale-grey blade shapes that ignore cell borders. The bottom-right quadrant splits into a black cell (24px white summary, mono caps action row at its base) and a mint cell (second statement, client-logo marquee along the bottom).
type: Suisse Intl at weight 450 for everything, tracking about -0.02em; Suisse Intl Mono in small caps for actions, bullet lists and footer. Wordmark 180px against 24px statements and 16px body. Later headings switch to all caps at about 9vw with leading near 0.9.
colour: #ffffff #232323 #d9d9d9 #a1ffcb #969797 — White, near-black and two greys fill the cells; a single mint green floods whole tiles (a statement, a stat, the closing call to action) as the only colour. Cool and flat.
imagery: A canvas of 1-bit ordered-dither dots with soft tonal blobs, overlaid with flat pale-grey shards taken from the logo; services get white wireframe line drawings of spheres. No photography anywhere.
layout: Zero page margin: everything is edge-to-edge cells on a two-column grid with halves subdivided, separated by 1px rules. Sections differ only by cell fill and cell height. Type always sits top-left or bottom-left in its cell with about 20px padding; some cells are left deliberately empty.

sections.description: The second screen continues the hero grid: a black cell carries a two-line all-caps slogan at about 9vw set hard against its left edge; a light grey cell top-right holds the second word of the name at the same giant size as the first, bottom-aligned; dither canvas fills the rest. Then a white row where the left half is empty and a 24px long-form text runs only in the right column.

Stair-stepped tiles instead of a row. A tall mint cell fills the left half with one figure at about 5vw in its top-left corner and nothing else. On the right, a shorter black tile starts higher with a white figure top-left and a small caption at its bottom edge; a grey tile sits to its right, stepped down, same internal layout. The tiles' unequal heights leave white notches.

Left half: a light grey cell with a three-line all-caps heading whose middle line is pushed to the right edge, a small paragraph low in the cell and a black mono-caps button bottom-right. Right half: black, split by hairlines into stacked rows; each row has a tiny mono index, a 28px title, a short paragraph in a second column, a white wireframe drawing and a mono caps list with small mint square bullets.

A grid of cells: white cell with a short statement top-left; a cell with a plain nav list; a cell with two small analogue clock icons and city times; a hairline row with email left and a social link right. Below, a black cell with the logo and lowercase wordmark centred large, beside a mint cell with a heading top-left and a thin diagonal arrow drawn into its bottom-right corner.

steal: Rule the whole viewport into cells with 1px lines and no page margin, then give the nav, the headline, the summary and the proof each its own cell with a flat fill.
Split a two-word brand name across two cells on consecutive screens at the same giant size, so scrolling completes the name.
Use a 1-bit ordered-dither texture as the picture in otherwise empty cells and let large flat logo fragments cross the cell borders to tie the grid together.
media: One halftone canvas of the brand mark is seen only through chosen cells of the tile grid, about half the hero area, and returns in sticky half panels and as a full-bleed canvas behind knockout words. Portraits are high-key black and white in a staggered row with offset heights, client logos keep their brand colours inside their own tiles, and there is no video and no rounded corner anywhere.
motion: A dark screen gives way at about 1.2s to a small mark on a 20s coin spin, the white grid arrives by 2.5s with the name rising through a mask, and the dither resolves by 4.5s. Lenis drives CSS sticky stacking (12 sticky elements, no pins): hero rows slide over each other and stat tiles lock under the header one by one; text fades in by line over 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) in 100ms steps (193 WAAPI calls), and a theme toggle wipes the page with a 1.2s clip-path sweep.

name: Dragonfly Redux
idea: A crypto fund presented as a terminal artefact: every picture is rendered in ASCII characters, framed by four letters of the name pinned to the viewport corners.
hero: Pure black viewport. A live canvas draws a dragonfly and foliage out of grey ASCII glyphs, running diagonally across the whole screen and fading toward the bottom. Dead centre, the fund's name in orange uppercase grotesk at about 11vw spans the middle 65% of the width on one line, overlapping the insect's body. A small dark-grey bar, 380px wide, is centred at the top holding a logo glyph, a five-dot orange progress indicator and a mono menu label. One white serif capital sits in each viewport corner (one mirrored), with tiny plus-shaped crop marks just inside them. No tagline and no button.
type: NON Natural Grotesk, regular, uppercase, tracking −0.04em for the wordmark and section titles; FK Roman Standard serif for 16px body and for 14vw scroll words; NON Natural Mono at 8–9px for tags and labels. The scale jumps straight from 16px to 160px and beyond.
colour: #000000 #8c8c8c #f2f2f2 #ff4d17 #2a2a2a — Black throughout with grey ASCII texture and white text; one hot orange marks the wordmark, section numerals, the active filter and tiny arrow glyphs. No section changes background.
imagery: 3D forms (dragonfly, branches, abstract meshes) rendered live as grey ASCII characters; article thumbnails get the same dithered-glyph treatment in wide strips. No photographs anywhere.
layout: A fixed frame (corner letters, top bar, bottom bar, crop marks) surrounds everything. Inside: 8px side margins, full-width hairline tables, centred numbered section titles and staggered serif paragraphs. Long black pauses holding one giant word alternate with dense list rows.

sections.description: An orange numeral is stacked directly over a white uppercase grotesk title, both centred, with a hairline running the full width beneath and a tiny mono section code at far left. Two serif paragraphs follow in a stagger: the first starts at the left edge and is about 35% wide; the second starts a quarter of the way in and runs wider. Below, the ASCII insect returns and single serif words at 14vw blur into focus, one per line, centred.

Writing section: a two-up carousel, each item a wide ASCII-textured strip, an uppercase grotesk title and two lines of grey serif excerpt, with orange square pagination centred below. Then a centred title, a row of small square mono filter chips (active one filled orange), and a table of hairline-divided rows: title in a 30% column at left, grey excerpt in the middle, mono category at 75%, an orange dotted arrow at far right.

Three equal columns of uppercase links, each headed by a grey mono label centred above and divided row by row with hairlines; the columns occupy only the top third. A small ASCII asterisk floats alone in the middle of the black. A two-line serif statement sits bottom-left at about 22px, the copyright runs vertically up the right edge, and a small bar mirrors the top navigation at bottom centre.

steal: Pin one letter of the brand in each viewport corner as a permanent frame, so even an empty black screen feels composed.
Run every image through one filter (here ASCII glyphs) so hero 3D art and article thumbnails belong to the same world.
Pair an uppercase grotesk for titles with a bookish serif used for both small body text and the very largest words, skipping all the middle sizes.
media: One fixed WebGL point-cloud scene covers 100% of every frame and draws every illustrative object in grey dots on black, its subject changing as you scroll (the dragonfly in several poses, an orb, a sculpture, card objects, a world map, the logo); the insect takes 60-70% of the first screen as sparse points behind the orange wordmark. Photographs are only low-key portraits in quarter-column cards and 88px staff thumbnails; no video.
motion: Black until about 2.5s, then the wordmark and the top bar, then the dot dragonfly fades in by 4.5s. Lenis drives the fixed scene like a scrubbed camera move with no pins; manifesto characters resolve from blur to sharp, headings near the bottom edge blur and fade in, reveals use opacity and transform .85s ease-out-quint, and 178 links fade over 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1).

name: MONOLOG
idea: A studio pitch run as an asymmetric sheet: a narrow left column carries the sales talk while a wide right column stacks a very heavy headline and the proof, all on grainy paper-grey.
hero: Grainy warm-grey ground with a giant tone-on-tone logo shape ghosted behind the left third. Columns split at 34% of the width. Left column: logo top-left, a six-line 22px paragraph, a black rectangular button with an arrow tile, and a short parenthetical line at the very bottom. Right column: four small nav links aligned to the column's left edge, a mute tile and a black button at far right; then the headline in four lines of very heavy grotesk at 140px (nearly 10% of viewport width), line pitch about 0.8, filling the column. A square-cornered photo starts at 71% height with two overlapping result cards on its top-left corner.
type: Khteka bold with -0.03em tracking and very tight leading for the 140px headline; the same face at medium for 22px lead text and 18px body. Suisse Mono in small grey uppercase captions. A condensed heavy caps face appears once for a slogan. Headline to body is roughly 8x.
colour: #e8e8e3 #181715 #d3d4ce #080807 #bfb21a — Warm paper-grey with near-black type, flipping to near-black sections with off-white type lower down. No brand accent; colour comes only from client photos and logo tiles. Film grain over everything.
imagery: Client-work photography: an architecture exterior, a laptop on olive velvet, a portrait, a mural. Square corners, warm grade, visible grain. Photos fill the right column or appear as one small centred tile, with flat translucent result cards overlaid.
layout: 24px outer margins. A fixed 34/66 split recurs: small labels, stats and captions in the narrow left column, large statements and media in the wide right one. Sections alternate light and dark; one centred full-width slogan breaks the grid.

sections.description: Inside the wide right column, under a full-column photo: a small dot-and-label line, then client logos in a 4x2 grid with no cell borders. Each logo is rendered black and large, roughly 80px tall, far bigger than a usual logo strip, with a tiny mono uppercase caption centred beneath. The narrow left column stays empty apart from the ghosted logo shape and the pinned parenthetical line.

Near-black section on the same split. Left column: tiny previous and next arrows with a mono counter, a large numeral with a plus sign and three lines of small grey caption. Right column: two paragraphs set as one continuous statement at about 34px bold with tight leading in off-white, followed by a small round avatar with name and role in grey. The lower half of the screen is left empty.

Full-viewport black panel with a four-word slogan in condensed heavy off-white capitals about 110px tall on one centred line. The line is split in the middle by a small portrait-format photo tile roughly 170px wide; a frame later the two halves have closed together over a different, larger image so the letters overlap the picture. A four-line centred caption in small text sits near the bottom.

Dark footer in two columns: left, section names as a list at about 36px bold, each row closed by a hairline; right, a small bracketed mono label above a row of five square icon tiles. A three-part baseline row carries local time and date, a back-to-top link with booking status, and copyright. Beneath, a full-width band of black-and-white halftone waves holds the small logo and a one-line sign-off.

steal: Split the hero at one third: paragraph and button in the narrow column, a four-line heavy headline filling the wide one, with nav links aligned to the headline's left edge.
Show client logos large (around 80px tall) in a borderless 4x2 grid with tiny mono captions instead of a small grey strip.
Lay two stacked client-result cards over the top-left corner of the hero photo so proof arrives before the first scroll.

name: The Queue
idea: An essay on queueing where the queue is the ornament: a line of drawn figures stands along the bottom of the hero and returns between chapters in changing period dress.
hero: Pinkish warm-grey page. A 12px mono breadcrumb sits top-left; there is no other navigation. The two-word title is set in a light serif at 200px (14vw), centred, its middle slightly above the viewport centre, spanning about 60% of the width with tight tracking. One centred line of grey 20px serif sits 40px beneath. The lower third stays empty until a single row of about 25 small greyscale drawn figures, each around 110px tall, stands on a hairline rule 20px above the bottom edge and runs the full width like a frieze.
type: Newsreader does everything: Light at 200px with -0.05em tracking for the title, regular near 30px for chapter headings, 18px body with open leading, and pale ghost numerals around 22vw. A monospace appears only in the breadcrumb and footer labels.
colour: #ebe4e0 #2b2622 #6f6763 #d9d2ce #16a05a — One warm rosy-grey ground throughout, brown-black text, mid-grey secondary lines, greyscale drawings. A single green appears only in the breadcrumb and one footer button.
imagery: Hand-drawn greyscale figures with fine outlines, standing in single file on a hairline; each band changes era costume and spacing. No boxes or backgrounds: figures sit directly on the page colour, full width.
layout: After the centred hero, text runs in one narrow column about 40% of the viewport wide, starting 30% from the left; the right third holds only a huge pale chapter numeral. Chapters are separated by full-width bands of figures on hairlines.

sections.description: Chapter block. A 30px serif question heads a text column about 590px wide, offset 30% from the left. Behind it in the top-right corner sits a chapter numeral roughly 22vw tall in a tint barely darker than the page, cropped by the section's top edge. Body is 18px serif at about 1.8 leading; bold run-in phrases open key paragraphs in place of subheads. No pull quotes, side notes or images inside the text.

Divider band between chapters: a full-width strip about 180px tall in which 10 to 15 drawn figures stand at uneven intervals on a 1px rule, with 120px of empty page above. The number and spacing of figures follow the story (few and scattered early, an evenly spaced orderly line later), so the divider carries part of the argument instead of acting as a spacer.

The ending switches voice. A white rounded promo bar with a blue pill button, then a heavy sans heading with a short grey paragraph and one green button, then a hairline, a mono uppercase label, and four small white cards in a row (thumbnail, mono number, bold title). It is narrower than the page and sits on a different axis from the essay column, so it reads as site furniture attached afterwards.

steal: Turn the subject into the section divider: a frieze of small figures on a hairline, redrawn for each chapter, in place of rules or spacers.
Set one serif family at three far-apart sizes (200px title, 30px heading, 18px body) and mark chapters with a pale 22vw numeral cropped off the corner.
Hold body text to a narrow column offset left of centre and leave the right third empty instead of filling it with sidebars.

name: Paul Kalkbrenner
idea: Swiss poster typography for a techno artist: the name as one black line with a photo set inside it like a glyph, then every chapter gets its own flat colour and visible grid.
hero: Pure white viewport. The artist's name sits on one line at exact vertical centre in bold black neo-grotesk, about 10.4vw, spanning roughly 78% of the width with equal side margins. The space between first and last name is replaced by a small landscape black-and-white photo, x-height tall and resting on the baseline. Top-left is a tiny circular monogram; eight nav links in 13px bold are spread at even intervals across the right half of the top edge. Bottom edge: equaliser bars with a grey label over a track title at left, a three-line bold blurb starting just left of centre, a sound toggle hard right. About 85% is empty.
type: ABC Diatype Plus Variable only: bold at -0.05em tracking for display and 13.5px bold for everything functional. Display runs from 150px in the hero to about 44vw elsewhere per the digest. Tiny uppercase labels inside boxed cells; no second face, no italics.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #c5c5c5 #a7ff9c #ff6831 — Black on white to start, then whole sections flood with flat mid-grey, acid mint and orange. Photos inside coloured sections are tinted to the section hue or kept black-and-white.
imagery: Portraits and live shots of the artist: full-bleed colour images between sections, a grainy monochrome portrait marked up as a vinyl disc, a green duotone car portrait, and a strip of small mixed-ratio thumbnails. Square corners throughout.
layout: Outer margins of only 4-8px; content hangs on a visible column grid with hairlines and boxed cells. Sections alternate between full-bleed photographs and flat colour fields, each arranged differently, so the rhythm is one poster after another.

sections.description: Two words stacked in bold grotesk at roughly 8vw, each preceded by a solid black circle about the height of the lowercase, the second line indented further right than the first. Thin horizontal and vertical hairlines cross the white field at baselines and column edges like a construction grid. Directly beneath is a single row of streaming-service logos spaced evenly edge to edge, then a full-bleed photograph.

Flat mid-grey field split in two. Left half: a square grainy monochrome portrait with a large thin circle drawn on it and a small grey dot at the centre, so the photo reads as a record. Right half: a row of three year tabs and a small link above a hairline, the album title in small bold caps, a short description lower down, and along the bottom two wide outlined cells side by side acting as buttons.

Acid-mint field introducing the tour list. A large photograph, recoloured as a green-and-black duotone, occupies only the top-right quadrant; the left half is left empty. Along the bottom a table header with three tiny uppercase column labels sits on a hairline spanning the full width, where the list of dates begins.

Orange field. A horizontally scrolling strip of small photographs of differing widths runs across the top, cropped by both edges. Below it one outlined rectangle spans the width, divided into three equal cells: two inputs and a submit action, each identified only by tiny centred uppercase text. Small-print lines sit under the left and right cells.

steal: Replace the space between the two words of a giant name with a small photo cropped to x-height.
Flood each chapter with one flat colour and tint its photograph to match as a duotone.
Build forms and button pairs as adjoining outlined cells with tiny uppercase labels instead of filled buttons.
media: The hero is almost pure type: the only picture is a 113x75 chip set inside the name, under 1% of the fold, that changes photo every 1-1.5s. Later, full-bleed bands with scrubbed parallax between sections, a square cover in one half beside an info column, a green duotone portrait docked right, a full-bleed photograph that exits through a pixel-block mask, a receding stack of square photos, and an auto marquee of small thumbnails; one YouTube embed, no native video, square corners and an 8s grain overlay.
motion: There is no preloader, only the name chip cycling and the equaliser bars bouncing, and Lenis and Barba run 12 ScrollTriggers with no pins: media wrappers parallax by yPercent, a ruled statement drifts sideways, full-bleed photo sections scrub at 0.3 to drive the pixel-block dissolve, and year digits roll like an odometer. Link characters roll over 0.5s with a per-character delay on the house curve cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1) (.7s and .35s tokens).

name: Vero New-York
idea: Treat a keepsake like couture: a slow close-up film opens, then a white 3D sculpture of a dress stays pinned at centre while one sentence in mixed capitals and italics passes over it.
hero: Full-bleed video with no scrim: an extreme close-up of a woman's profile against a burnt-orange wall, a blurred pale sculpture occupying the right 40% of the frame in the foreground. Exactly at centre sits the four-letter wordmark in white serif capitals, about 240px wide; 25px beneath it a one-line tagline at 20px alternates italic lowercase connectives with roman capitals. Two translucent frosted rectangles with square corners float 30px from the top corners: a 130px menu button left, a 250px commission button right, both in small capitals. A tiny chevron marks the bottom centre. Nothing else; the image carries the screen.
type: Louize Display at 120px (8.3vw), centred: nouns in roman capitals, connective words in lowercase italic at the same size within the same line. Beausite Classic grotesk appears only for a bold 17px lead and footer links. Serif body runs 11–16px; the footer wordmark fills the width.
colour: #f3f0ed #181615 #b4521f #c6a788 #ffffff #97775a — Burnt orange and skin tones in the opening film, then warm off-white pages with near-black type and a plaster-white sculpture; orange returns only inside one small photograph.
imagery: Shallow-focus warm video up top; a real-time 3D plaster-white bust and lace dress on off-white, cropped at neck and hem and fading into the page; one small square-cornered photo of the dress on a plinth against orange.
layout: Everything sits on one centre axis with wide empty flanks. Two fixed corner buttons persist as soft-shadowed white tiles. Headlines take two lines each and share the screen with the pinned 3D object; body text is confined to a 240px centred column.

sections.description: Off-white screen. The sentence is delivered in halves: first two centred lines at 8.3vw in the upper third, with a small diamond glyph beside the italic word, while a white 3D bust rises from the bottom centre at about 30% of the width. Scrolling turns the sculpture to show the laced back, now filling the full height of the centre column, and the second half of the sentence lands over the skirt in the lower third.

The skirt's hem dissolves into the off-white at the top of the screen. Beneath it is a centred text stack only about 240px wide: a three-line lead in bold grotesk at 17px, four lines of serif body at 11px, and a small white rectangular button with a diffuse shadow carrying the same italic-plus-capitals label as the header button. The lower half of the viewport is left empty.

A tiny centred eyebrow in the italic-plus-capitals style, then a two-line headline at about 8vw where each line begins with a lowercase italic word and ends in capitals, the lines offset so the block reads as a stagger. Under it, centred, one small photo about 330×290px with square corners: saturated orange backdrop, white dress on a plinth. The image is deliberately much smaller than the type.

Off-white. Top-left, a five-item vertical link list in small grotesk; under it a newsletter field drawn as a single underline with an arrow; three social links right-aligned at the same level. Then the wordmark in near-black serif capitals stretches across the full width, about 45% of the viewport tall. A final row of tiny grey legal links sits beneath.

steal: Within one serif headline, set the nouns in roman capitals and the small connective words in lowercase italic at the same size.
Pin a single white 3D object on an off-white page and deliver one sentence in two halves over its front and back as it turns.
Follow a huge two-line headline with one deliberately small, saturated photograph centred beneath it instead of a full-width image.
media: A full-bleed 10s studio film covers the whole first screen with no scrim, the wordmark centred on it. Then a fixed render of the dress sculpture that the camera travels down while headlines rise over it, an inset window under a headline that grows to full bleed, a pinned full-bleed stepper with right-to-left wipes, a sticky picture beside parallax pictures, a grid of 4:5 thumbnails in columns at different speeds, and a 3D coin passing through a typographic wall; 0px corners and two strict photo families, brides on burnt orange and white resin on grey.
motion: A preloader of about 3.5-4s: a centred serif statement with a small photo window between its lines that opens by clip-path into the hero film over 1.4s cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1), then the wordmark fades in. Native scroll driven by script: the beige page slides up over the fixed hero, a 3840px sticky stepper advances three photographs, and headline words rise out of line masks over 1.2-1.4s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) at 0.1s steps; images clip in over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1).

name: Depo Luxe
idea: A film production roster shown as a full-screen reel in which every step is one film with only a quoted italic title, a director and a client, set like credits at body size.
hero: Video fills the viewport edge to edge with no scrim beyond the footage's own darkness. All text is white serif at near-body size. A 305px-wide header block sits top-centre: the two words of the name pushed to its left and right edges, an italic one-line descriptor beneath, then five nav links spread across the same width with the current one underlined. Dead centre: the film title in italic with quotation marks at 40px (under 3% of viewport width), the director's name 60px below. The client name stands alone at the right edge on the title's line. A roman numeral above a thin vertical line marks the left edge.
type: EB Garamond only, regular and italic, always white. The largest text on the page is the 40px italic title; names and nav are about 17px. Two sizes, no capitals, no bold, slight negative tracking; the wordmark is simply two words set far apart.
colour: #070c0b #081514 #16120d #1f3fd6 #f0f0f0 — Black ground; all colour comes from the footage: teal-black interiors, blue-tinted lenses, one saturated cobalt frame. Type stays white throughout, with no accent colour or UI tint.
imagery: Full-bleed commercial film footage: tight faces, extreme close-ups, underwater shots, heavy cinema grade and grain. One per screen, never framed or rounded, with text laid directly on top.
layout: One screen equals one project: no margins, cards or grid. Three fixed text anchors repeat on every screen (centre title, right-edge client, left-edge numeral) so only the footage changes. The page is a single viewport that swaps its contents.

sections.description: Each project is a full-viewport slide that keeps the hero's three anchors: quoted italic title dead centre with the director beneath, client name hard against the right edge at the same height, and a roman numeral on the left edge that moves down a thin vertical track as you advance, doubling as progress indicator. Between slides the frame goes fully black with the next title already in place before its footage fades in.

The header is a compact credit block rather than a bar: a fixed column about a fifth of the viewport wide, centred at the top, holding three justified lines (name split to both ends, italic descriptor, five links). It has no background and stays over the footage on every slide. On mobile the same block widens to the text column and the client name moves above the title.

steal: Keep every piece of text at body size over full-bleed footage and let position alone (dead centre, right edge, left edge) create the hierarchy.
Build the header as a narrow centred block of three justified lines, with the two-word name pushed to opposite ends of the first line.
Use a roman numeral sliding along a thin vertical edge line as both project index and scroll progress.

name: longbow
