idea: The page is built on a visible four-column construction grid with square handles at every intersection, and cars, glass cards and a giant condensed marquee are slotted into its cells like objects on a designer's artboard.
hero: Mid-grey studio video of two roadsters fills the viewport inside a thin outer frame. White hairlines split it into four equal columns and two rows, with small white square nodes at each crossing. A frosted-glass nav bar sits top centre spanning the two middle columns: hamburger left, condensed wordmark centre, a mono models link right. Bottom left, a white condensed marquee of the brand name at 21vw, a third of viewport height, runs off the left edge and stops at the centre line. The bottom-right cell holds a small glass tag, a two-line serif headline with the second line italic, and a six-line uppercase mono paragraph.
type: Bebas Neue at 21vw with -0.06em tracking for marquee words; EB Garamond near 28px, light, with italic second lines for headings; Geist Mono 13px uppercase for all body and labels. Three faces with strict roles and a roughly 23-times jump from body to display.
colour: #888c8f #a8a7a9 #ffffff #1b1b1c #1f5c49 #b5552e — One mid grey for both page and studio backdrop with white type throughout; colour comes only from the product: racing-green paint, tan leather, red tail lamps. One black video band late in the page.
imagery: Studio renders and video of cars on a seamless grey backdrop that matches the page colour, cropped tight to noses, tails and badges; images are square-cornered and sized exactly to grid cells or run full bleed.
layout: Four equal columns with visible hairlines and node markers persist down the whole 18-screen page. Content occupies one or two cells at a time and leaves the others as flat grey; giant marquee words and full-bleed car frames alternate with small serif-plus-mono text cells.

sections.description: A full-bleed close-up of one car fills the viewport. A dark frosted-glass card exactly one column wide and about half the viewport tall sits over the image in the second column: centred serif model name with an italic edition line, a mono price line, a small landscape thumbnail of the car and a white square-cornered button. The next model repeats the layout with the card shifted to the third column.

Flat grey screen. A giant white condensed marquee line runs across the top, partly behind the nav. In the first column: a tiny rounded index tag, a two-line serif heading with italic second line, then after a gap a ten-line uppercase mono paragraph. In the third column a tall portrait crop of bodywork and badge fills one cell from the marquee down. The other two columns stay empty.

Between sections, three condensed white words about a third of the viewport high are distributed across the grid columns with wide gaps between them and cropped by the viewport bottom, acting as a divider between a full-bleed car frame and the next text block. Grid lines and nodes run over the letters.

A black band holds a wide video frame inset from left and right by black bars, showing a motion-blurred car head-on on a road in a cool teal grade; the grid lines and nodes continue over it and the grey page resumes below. A single-line uppercase mono legal ticker runs along the very bottom edge of the page.

steal: Draw the layout grid as visible hairlines with small square nodes at intersections and size every image and card to exact cells.
Match the page background to the photo backdrop colour so product shots merge with the page and only the product carries colour.
Give three faces fixed jobs: a condensed sans only at 20vw for marquees, a light serif with an italic second line for headings, uppercase mono for all body text.
media: A full-bleed studio film of two cars covers the whole first screen with a slow push-in, shot on a grey cyclorama tuned to the page grey so pictures melt into the ground. Then a single-cell product card with a looping thumbnail over a full-bleed render, a checkerboard of image and text cells snapped to a 4-column grid, a driving film that grows from a 710px inset to full bleed, and portrait cells beside signature cells; 38 images and 14 videos, all square-cornered.
motion: No preloader: the page is alive at 400ms with the wordmark marquee moving and the hero film dollying in about 10% by 4.5s. Lenis with Webflow Interactions scrubs a sticky stage for the whole page: giant split words and their copies slide sideways at different rates, the inset film grows to full bleed, the ground switches grey, black, grey, black, and images reveal by mask-size and opacity over 1.25s ease-in-out while marquees loop at 9-90s.

name: Mosby’s Files
idea: An archive of architects presented as a physical stack of coloured index-tab file folders that you flip through.
hero: Charcoal background. A slim top bar over a hairline holds the condensed wordmark dead centre and one mono link far right. The headline is one centred line of heavy condensed uppercase at 10vw, about 71% of the width, in the upper quarter. Beneath it, a three-line centred serif paragraph in mid-grey, about 42% wide. From 51% down sits a stack of file folders 86% of the viewport wide: each is a flat colour band with one to three trapezoid tabs rising from its top-left edge, each tab a different colour holding a serif name. Mono category labels sit right-aligned. The front red folder is open, running off the bottom.
type: Founders Grotesk bold condensed uppercase at 144px for the title and wordmark; Signifier serif at about 22px for the intro and 28px for tab names; IBM Plex Mono 12px for labels and body. Three unrelated faces, each with one job, and a twelve-to-one size jump.
colour: #191919 #d71e1e #1e4bd7 #0c7866 #581e70 #ffe927 — Charcoal ground with five flat poster primaries assigned to folders and tabs; each tab deliberately differs from the folder behind it. No tints, gradients or photos; white type except black on yellow.
imagery: No photographs on the index. The folder shapes are the imagery, plus a row of seven small white line-drawn north-arrow and compass symbols and a drawing scale bar borrowed from architectural plans.
layout: Centred title block over an 86%-wide folder stack with equal dark margins. Folders overlap at a fixed 60px step so only the tab rows show; the open folder expands into a tall single-colour panel with mono text top-left and plan symbols near the bottom. Under two screens.

sections.description: Four full-width colour bands stacked with a 60px reveal, each with trapezoid tabs growing from its top-left edge. Tabs are about 44px tall with S-curved shoulders, sit side by side with small gaps, and each takes a contrasting flat colour: yellow and black tabs on a green folder, red and blue on purple. Names are white serif at 28px inside the tabs. A mono category label with a small chevron is right-aligned in each band's visible strip.

The front folder opens into a solid red panel nearly two viewports tall. Top-right: its mono category label with a down chevron. Top-left, inset about 60px: a four-line mono paragraph in white, at most half the panel wide. The middle is left empty. Near the bottom, a centred row of seven small white plan symbols evenly spaced; beneath, a baseline row with a drawing scale bar left, year centre, credit and round logo right.

steal: Build navigation as stacked full-width colour bands with trapezoid tabs, each tab coloured to clash with the folder behind it.
Pair a heavy condensed grotesk title with a bookish serif for names and a mono for metadata, giving each face exactly one role.
Borrow notation from the subject's own documents (scale bars, north arrows) as footer ornament instead of generic icons.
media: The hero has no picture: its visual weight is a CSS stack of overlapping flat colour folders with sloped tabs covering the lower half of the fold (about 42% of the area), which doubles as the index; an open folder expands to 80vh as the content panel. The only drawings are seven small white plan symbols and a scale bar; no photographs or video on the index.
motion: A short entrance: readable at about 1.2s, with 17 title letter spans already in place, and settled by 2.5s as the stack rises about 13px into place and the subline fades up. Lenis on a page only 1.6 screens tall; the header slides away on scroll, and folders and tabs move on one house curve, cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1), at 0.65s, with the quicker moves at exactly half that, 0.325s.

name: Sarah & Matt Wedding
idea: The site is the invitation: a letterpress-style card rendered as a physical object opens the page, and its ornaments, rules and small typographic parts become the components for everything after it.
hero: A flat blush-pink field fills the viewport. Top-left sits a gold filigree monogram about 120px square; three plain nav links are centred on the same line; a solid gold rectangular RSVP button sits top-right. Below, centred, a portrait invitation card half the viewport wide starts 200px down and is cropped by the bottom edge, with a soft halo shadow and a debossed border with scalloped inner corners. On the card: the two names in a large italic swash serif, staggered left and right against two ornamental roundels, separated by hairline rules carrying tiny wide-tracked caps for date and time.
type: Card names in a high-contrast italic serif with swash capitals (drawn in canvas); section titles in a light roman serif around 5vw; Instrument Sans 18px for body and nav; Spezia Extended in tiny tracked caps for dates and addresses. Three clear tiers.
colour: #e9c4be #faf7f5 #0d0b0a #241c22 #9b7948 #4f5660 — Each section takes its own field: blush pink hero, warm cream story, dark plum venue details, black footer. Gold is reserved for ornament and the RSVP button; a coral button appears once on dark.
imagery: A canvas-rendered paper card with emboss and grain; a warm, grainy golden-field landscape as a full-bleed band behind it; candid couple snapshots in equal portrait cards with rounded corners; night venue photos overlapping at two sizes.
layout: Outer margins of about 50px. The hero is centred; the story is a horizontally scrolling row of text-above-photo columns; the details section splits roughly 45/55 between text and overlapping photos. Large vertical gaps separate sections, each on its own colour field.

sections.description: A story timeline. A small sans heading sits at the left margin with two outlined circular arrow buttons at the right. Under it runs a full-width ruler of fine vertical tick marks acting as a scrubber. Below, a horizontally scrolling row of columns about 280px wide: each has a one-line bold caption, three lines of small grey text, a large gap, then a portrait photo with 12px rounded corners. Columns bleed off both edges; one photo is black and white.

A cream field with a single light serif title at roughly 5vw on the left margin and a three-line small sans paragraph pushed to the far-right column on the same baseline, leaving the middle empty. Below, the date in medium sans introduces a row of large light-serif times divided by vertical hairlines, with a dark rounded image card starting in the right half.

On a dark plum field, split in two. Left 45%: small sans labels for arrival and ceremony, an outlined box holding venue, street and city in tiny tracked extended caps separated by slashes, then a five-row accordion with hairline dividers and chevrons, then a coral button beside a text link. Right 55%: a tall night photo of the venue facade bleeding off the top, with a smaller square photo overlapping its lower-right corner.

A band of grainy rose-brown texture, then black. A dim monogram at left, a four-link column at centre, and at right the date, boxed address and time lines repeated from the invitation in tracked extended caps with hairlines. The couple's names run across the full width at about 22vw in the italic swash serif, filled with a blue-gold glitter texture and cropped by the bottom edge.

steal: Make a real-world object (an invitation, a ticket, a label) the hero and reuse its small typographic parts, such as a boxed address line with slashes, as recurring components down the page.
Repeat the hero lettering in the footer at full-bleed scale with a material texture fill, cropped by the bottom edge.
Place a section title at the left margin and its short paragraph in the far-right column on the same baseline, leaving the centre empty.

name: Zara Webb
idea: A one-woman newborn-care practice presented like a hand-made keepsake: a mascot rabbit, scalloped and flower-shaped cut-outs, candid film photographs.
hero: Split exactly in half. Left, on cream: two-line mono caps nav stacks sit at the column's top-left and top-right with a handwritten script logo centred between them. Centred below, a five-line headline in a condensed serif, each line broken to one to three words so the block forms a ragged lozenge; then a three-line 16px sans paragraph and an outlined pill button in mono caps. A line-drawn rabbit on a skateboard rides a hairline at the column's bottom-right. Right: a candid flash photograph bleeds off the top and right edges and stops at 92% height; a lilac pill button and a round chat icon overlay its top-right corner.
type: Instrument Serif Regular for headings (52 to 57px, plus a 9.4vw footer wordmark), its italic for subheads and service names; Inter Tight for small body copy; PT Mono uppercase for nav, buttons and tiny captions; a script logo. Parenthesised italic numerals number the services.
colour: #fffdf1 #403630 #ece4d2 #e2c9f7 #cfe195 #f6e7e4 — Warm cream page with cocoa-brown text and two brown panels. Lilac marks the main pill button and footer wordmark; a sage-green pill marks a secondary action. Warm throughout.
imagery: Candid flash and film photos of babies and carers, some grainy black-and-white, cropped into non-rectangular masks (four-petal flower, scalloped egg) or small rounded portraits; plus black line doodles with halftone-dot fills: a recurring rabbit, flowers, a rattle, a bottle.
layout: 20px margins. Centred serif statements with small centred paragraphs alternate with split or inset blocks: a brown rounded panel, a half-photo half-beige block. Services run as a two-column hairline list. Doodles are tucked beside headlines; the footer's top edge is scalloped.

sections.description: A dark brown panel with about 11px radius, inset 20px from the page. Left half: a three-line cream serif statement at about 56px and below it a photograph masked into a four-lobed flower about 540px across, cropped by the panel's bottom, with two tiny mono captions floating beside its lobes. Right, from 63%: two blocks, each an italic serif subhead over a four-line small paragraph, then two flower doodles, a caps line and a lilac pill button.

A centred two-line serif heading and a four-line centred paragraph. Below, a two-column list inset to the middle 72% of the width; each item opens with a hairline, then a parenthesised italic numeral, the service name in italic serif at about 32px and a three-line small description. Rows are tall with generous empty space; the final cell swaps to a faded question prompt with the rabbit doodle.

A half-and-half block. Left: a grainy black-and-white extreme close-up of a baby's eye and cheek, full-bleed, overlapped from the bottom by a cream cut-out shaped like an egg with a scalloped top; it holds an italic serif subhead, a five-line centred paragraph, a caps line and a sage pill button. Right: a flat beige field with a centred two-line serif heading and a small rounded portrait about 230px wide flanked by two tiny mono captions.

Dark brown, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops about 120px wide. A centred three-line serif statement in cream with bottle and flower doodles at its shoulders and a waving rabbit beneath; two small centred text blocks at far left and right; contact lines and four social icons; then the name in lilac serif at 9.4vw, cropped by the bottom edge, with tiny mono legal text in both corners.

steal: Mask photographs into soft custom shapes (a four-petal flower, a scalloped egg) and let their container crop them.
Cut a section's top edge into a row of semicircles so a plain colour change becomes a motif.
Break a centred serif headline into very short lines so it forms a deliberate ragged shape, and anchor it with one small line drawing sitting on a hairline.

name: Noho
idea: Furniture sold through people misusing it (wearing, balancing on, hiding behind chairs on flat colour backdrops) while the interface stays quiet beige.
hero: The viewport splits exactly 50/50 by tone alone: left half warm off-white, right half a slightly darker greige, no rule. Left: a small lowercase logo top-left at 30px margin, then a four-line bold headline at 60px (4.2vw), tracking -0.04em and leading near 1.0, top-left aligned and filling the upper 40%; the lower half is empty except for a one-line 18px tagline pinned bottom-left. Right: a staggered mosaic of seven portrait photos, each about 175 by 230px with 15px gaps, on a four-column, three-row grid with several cells left empty and the rightmost image cropped by the viewport edge. A white square menu button sits top-right.
type: Switzer only. Headlines weight 600, tracking -0.04em, sentence case, charcoal rather than black; statements at 60px, body 13.5px, meta labels about 11px grey. The digest records one element at 15.6vw. Roughly four sizes, one family, no caps.
colour: #f1eee9 #e7e2dc #cdc0b0 #3c3c3c #b4a5db #f2e05a — The interface is three close warm beiges with charcoal type; saturated colour (lilac, yellow, olive, terracotta, sand) exists only in photo backdrops and the products themselves.
imagery: Studio shots of people interacting oddly with chairs on seamless single-colour backdrops, portrait 3:4, square corners; plus very large cut-out product shots on beige with a soft radial glow and contact shadow, cropped by the panel edge.
layout: Outer margins of 16-30px. Sections alternate between split halves, centred statements and left-aligned headings over card rows. Cards are flat rectangles one tone darker than the page with 8px gaps, content pinned to the top-left and bottom edges. Wide empty bands separate sections.

sections.description: A centred four-line statement at about 60px bold with tiny square photo thumbnails, roughly one cap-height tall, dropped inline between words like emoji. Directly beneath, the page splits into two full-width flat colour halves (light greige and tan), each with a small circled plus button in its top inner corner; these are the tops of the two product panels.

Two side-by-side panels in different beiges, each dominated by one enormous cut-out chair (one yellow, one black) cropped at the top so mostly seat and legs show, with a soft radial highlight behind. Along the bottom of each panel: a tiny label and price at left, a row of colour-swatch dots, then two small rectangular buttons at right, one white and one charcoal.

Three equal flat tiles in a row with 8px gaps, each about 210px tall. One short claim is centred in each at roughly 18px, and an index number sits alone in the bottom-left corner in 11px. A small bulleted label hangs above each tile. After a large empty gap, another centred bold statement begins.

A horizontal strip of colour-backdrop photos bleeds off both edges at the top of the section. Below, a left-aligned bold heading at about 40px, then a row of beige cards overflowing to the right: each has an @name at top-left, a short paragraph in 11px, and a bottom row with star glyphs left and a small text link right.

steal: Split the hero 50/50 by background tone alone, park the headline top-left and one tagline bottom-left, and fill the other half with a staggered photo mosaic that leaves grid cells empty.
Keep the interface in three close beige tones and confine all saturated colour to photo backdrops and products, so the photography becomes the palette.
Drop cap-height photo thumbnails inline between the words of a large centred statement.
media: A stepped mosaic of seven 175x231 studio photographs (people doing odd things with a chair against one saturated backdrop each) covers about 22% of the fold on the darker right half, bleeding off the right edge; the left half is type. Below come photo chips between the words of a statement, two product halves each with a live 3D chair on its own tone, an auto-scrolling row of portrait tiles, a pinned card deck, and a sticky 3D chair card beside an accordion; square corners everywhere, no video.
motion: About 1s of entrance with no preloader: headline lines rise through masks while the mosaic tiles arrive one by one. Lenis holds sticky product halves and pins a story deck for +=400% (3600px), each step bringing the next card in from the right and compressing earlier ones into slivers, and the footer is uncovered by a scrubbed mask over a 728px runway as its slogan letters rise over 1.04s at a 0.04s stagger; micro-interactions are GSAP nudges of 0.2-0.4s on custom eases, and the 3D chairs turn on drag.

name: Juggle
idea: The headline literally drowns: a flat blue field rises to half height and the lines below the waterline turn from red to submerged navy.
hero: Two flat fields: white above, saturated blue below, meeting at exactly half height. A three-line all-caps headline in a black-weight grotesque at 8.4vw is centred across the seam, about 65% of the width, lines nearly touching. The first line sits on white in red-orange; the second is cut by the seam, and its lower half plus the whole third line render dark navy as if under water. Small red logo top-left, a rectangular red button with tracked caps top-right. Near the bottom, one line of white condensed caps names the audience. No image, no sub-paragraph.
type: Acme Gothic Black 900 caps at 122px, -0.03em, for the hero only. Section heads use Helvetica Now Display Condensed bold caps around 48 to 70px; body is Helvetica Now 17px; labels are small tracked caps. Roughly a 7:1 headline-to-body jump.
colour: #2e2eff #ffffff #ff3b1f #0a0a0a #f5f3ef #020156 — Three flat poster colours each own whole sections: electric blue, red-orange and black, with white and warm off-white for product areas. No tints, no gradients.
imagery: Simplified product UI on a cream rounded panel over black with a small video-call window; otherwise flat vector graphics: a pair of blinking eyes, a smiley cut into shuffled square tiles.
layout: Full-bleed colour blocks with one message each, mostly centred. Product sections switch to a two-column split on off-white with about 90px margins. Marquee strips separate blocks and a slim sticky bar carrying the CTA rides the bottom edge.

sections.description: Full-screen electric blue. Centred stack: a tiny tracked caps label, three lines of white condensed bold caps at about 5vw, a gap, then a single heavier, wider word at a larger size as the punchline, a faint blurred line of text beneath it and an outlined rectangular button. Wide empty margins left and right.

Problem check on full-screen red-orange, under a white marquee strip of condensed caps with small red buttons repeating inside it. Centre: a two-line white condensed caps heading at about 5vw; below, a flat illustration of two white almond eyes with black pupils; a tracked caps instruction line; then three evenly spaced white outlined checkboxes, each with a two-line caption, one already ticked.

Black section. A small tracked caps title centred, under it three numbered text tabs in a row with the active one underlined. Below, a cream rounded app window about 55% wide fills the rest of the viewport: mostly blank note area, a floating status chip, and a small dark video-call window with three faces overlapping its lower edge.

White. Left: a narrow column of small body text, two founder names with roles, then three link columns under tracked caps labels. Right: a blue square about 280px holding a white smiley face sliced into a three-by-three grid of tiles that are rotated and shuffled like a sliding puzzle. Tiny logo and copyright bottom-left.

steal: Split the hero into two flat colour fields and recolour the headline where it crosses the seam, so the layout acts out the copy.
Give each section one saturated flat colour and one sentence, and separate them with a thin marquee strip.
Turn a pain-point list into a mock checklist with real checkboxes under a blunt question heading.

name: Serotoninn
idea: A torn-paper seam splits the page in two, colour on white against greyscale on grey paper, to stage the brand's glam-versus-grunge line, with ultra-condensed heavy type straddling the tear.
hero: The viewport is split by a vertical torn-paper edge at 50%: left half pure white, right half a grey paper texture. A cut-out model stands dead centre, about 28% wide, running from 15% down off the bottom edge; her left half is full colour, her right half greyscale, the tear passing through her. Type is ultra-condensed heavy uppercase: the brand name at about 5.5vw top-left beneath a three-line mono menu; a two-line tagline right-aligned at mid-height on the right; and at bottom centre a two-word line at 8.2vw, first word red and second white, overlapping the dress, with a bracketed link beneath. Small centred logo at top, three mono links top-right.
type: Thunder extra-bold in uppercase, set tight, for all display lines (118px in the hero, similar for category words, sometimes rotated 90 degrees). PP Fraktion Mono uppercase at about 11px for nav, labels and prices; Inter for small body. Square brackets and parentheses wrap secondary words and counts.
colour: #fdfdfd #d8d8d8 #0a0a0a #e8352b #fff9f7 #2a2fb0 — White, paper grey and black with red as the single interface accent (one headline word, section labels). Garment colour (cobalt, yellow, satin tan) supplies the rest. One full black campaign band.
imagery: Studio fashion photography of models, cut out or on white seamless, in tall portrait crops. The hero splits one image into colour and greyscale along a torn-paper edge, and the torn edge returns as a divider over the footer video.
layout: About 2.5% margins. Sections carry red numbered mono labels at top-left. The layout changes every time: a label column with a product trio; a full-bleed black video; a horizontal row of tall category cards; a two-up split with a torn seam; a footer laid over video.

sections.description: New arrivals. The left 25% is a nearly empty column holding only a red numbered mono label at top, a bracketed link, and two tiny parenthesised notes further down. The right 60% holds three product images side by side with 4px gaps, each about 3:4, the middle one a tight crop of the same garment. Two carry a black brush-stroke tag with white condensed text in the top-left corner. Name and price sit under each in mono.

Categories as a horizontally scrolling row of five tall white cards, about 2:3 with 8px gaps, each showing a full-length cut-out model. The category name is set in the heavy condensed face rotated 90 degrees, running up the card's left edge from the bottom; a bracketed item count sits bottom-right in mono. The fifth card is cropped by the viewport edge.

Two-up split filling the viewport: two half-width photos of models on pale grounds, divided by a vertical torn-paper edge instead of a straight line. Each half has a category word in heavy condensed type at about 3.5vw bottom-left with a smaller parenthesised word attached like a suffix, and a bracketed count bottom-right.

A dark campaign video is cut off by a horizontal torn-paper edge, below which a taupe-grey ground holds the footer. Mono link clusters sit top-left and top-right. A cut-out model stands about 40% across, overlapping a very large condensed wordmark in darker grey so that letters pass behind her. Bottom-left, a subscribe line in white condensed type with a bracketed suffix; an underlined email field at right.

steal: Split one photograph along a torn-paper edge into a colour half and a greyscale half on different grounds, and let a two-word headline change colour across the same seam.
Run category names in heavy condensed type rotated 90 degrees up the edge of tall product cards, with a bracketed item count in mono at the opposite corner.
Reuse a torn-paper edge as the divider between sections and over the footer instead of straight lines.

name: Alethia
idea: Nature as measured data: photoreal moss-covered rocks and terrain float in a dark field, annotated with instrument-style reticles and mono readouts.
hero: Dark forest-green field. A photoreal 3D boulder covered in moss and small plants floats at centre, about 45% of the viewport wide, with three smaller rocks drifting at lower left, upper right and lower right, the last cropped by the edge. A three-line white headline at about 5vw, medium weight with tight tracking, is flush to a 30px left margin near the top and overlaps the rock's left side. Under it, an outlined button in mono caps with a lime arrow square. A hairline square reticle sits on the rock with a small mono data tag and three lines of readout. Bottom-left: a three-line 24px statement. Bottom-right: a scroll hint.
type: Geist Medium for headlines at about 70px with -0.05em tracking; Geist Regular at 24 to 40px for statements, also tight; Geist Mono in bold uppercase for navigation, buttons, tags, bracketed card labels and data readouts at 10 to 14px. The footer wordmark is drawn about 330px tall.
colour: #0f1f10 #ffffff #000000 #c6f19d #6d8b3a #9a9d9a — Forest green, black and white sections with a pale lime accent on arrow squares, tags, hotspots and the footer wordmark. Renders stay in moss greens and stone browns under grey fog.
imagery: Photoreal CG of mossy rocks, seedlings, soil and a weather-station mast, shown floating on flat colour or as full-bleed foggy macro landscapes; two nature photographs in rounded cards. Hairline reticles, lime hotspots and mono captions are laid over them.
layout: 30px margins, with text habitually docked in the corners of full-viewport scenes: headline top-left, statement bottom-left or top-right. Full-bleed 3D scenes alternate with a white card section and a black centred statement; the page ends on a full-width wordmark.

sections.description: A full-bleed macro landscape of moss mounds, bare soil and one seedling under grey fog. A five-line statement at about 40px occupies the top-right, from 35% to 84% of the width, with a three-line mono micro-label at the far top-left. Four lime circular markers with a dotted glyph are pinned across the terrain, each followed by a three-line mono caption in white.

A full-bleed foggy render of a weather-station mast among rocks and shrubs. Upper left, a three-line heading preceded by a small diagonal arrow. At left, a frosted-glass rounded card about 310px wide holds a small line chart under a large figure. Right of the mast, a stack of five translucent rows about 420px wide, each a mono index number, an uppercase mono label and a plus sign, works as an accordion over the image.

White section. A lime rectangular mono tag sits above a two-line heading at about 53px, both flush left with the right half empty. Below, two image cards share the full width with a 20px gap and roughly 19px radius: a dewy leaf macro and an aerial of terraced fields. Each carries a bracketed mono label top-left, a lime circular arrow button top-right and a two-line white title over the image at bottom-left.

A blurred dark foliage photograph as background. The wordmark in pale lime spans the full width, letters about 330px tall and touching both margins. Then a hairline, office cities in lime at about 36px on the left and four columns of mono uppercase links on the right; a thin legal row with a back-to-top link at the very bottom.

steal: Overlay hairline reticles and mono data tags on an organic 3D object so that measurement becomes the visual subject.
Dock text in the corners of a full-viewport scene (headline top-left, statement bottom-left, hint bottom-right) and let the object own the centre.
Confine one pale accent colour to small squares and tags, then spend it once at full scale on a footer wordmark.
media: Cut-out specimen objects float on a flat green ground in the hero, about 35-40% of the area. Then oversized fixed footage scenes (150-160% of the viewport, so slow movement never shows an edge) crossfade under scroll for about 1.5 viewports with hotspots and cards over them before a white sheet rises over the pinned scene, and later come two-up rounded photo cards, product renders on black alternating sides and a scattered collage of small tiles round a centred heading, from 33 images and five muted ambient loops of 7-15s.
motion: A hexagon preloader is still up at 4.5s with scrolling locked, then fades over 600ms; the rock fades up from black and the headline rises 50px while fading in over 600ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.33,1) after a 2.2s delay. Lenis with Framer scroll effects holds a pinned opening for about 1352px; blocks reveal whole with a fade and a 50px rise, with no split text and no reduced-motion rule.

name: Made With Gsap
idea: The hero is the product: a draggable vertical reel of effect demos runs through the middle of the headline, which is split and pushed to both edges to make room.
hero: White viewport. A one-line headline at 3.3vw is broken in two: the first half flush to the left margin, the second flush to the right, both on the vertical centre line. Between them a black rounded video card, 35% of the width and 16:9, sits dead centre with a mono catalogue number under its left corner; the cards before and after it peek in from the top and bottom edges. Wordmark top-left; top-right a grey capsule of mono uppercase links with a count chip, a round account button and a lime capsule button. Bottom-left a two-line 18px statement; bottom-right a grey mono drag hint.
type: LayGrotesk medium, tracking −0.02em, sentence case, for headlines (47px in the hero, about 5.5vw mid-page, 17vw in the closing banner) and 22px body; PP Neue Montreal Mono uppercase at 12px for nav, buttons and labels. Statements emphasise by grey-versus-white words.
colour: #ffffff #0a0a0b #c9fe6e #f1f1f1 #8a8a8a #1f6bff — White hero and footer bracket a long near-black middle; acid lime is reserved for join buttons and a tiny arrow, with one blue button inside the product UI. Demo thumbnails add saturated orange and teal.
imagery: Looping recordings of the effects: black 16:9 cards with 4px corners holding clusters of small saturated photo tiles (portraits on orange, water, flowers, architecture). Product UI appears inside a large white rounded panel.
layout: 24px margins, with text pinned to edges and centre rather than a column grid. White hero, then black full-viewport screens each holding one idea (statement, UI panel, logo strip, big number line), then a white rounded sheet rising over black as the footer.

sections.description: Black section. A mono eyebrow with a bullet dot is centred at the top; under it a three-line centred statement at about 2.6vw where most words are mid-grey and three key phrases are white. A two-line grey caption at 14px follows. Below, a white panel with 16px radius, 80% of the width, slides up from the bottom and contains a dark app window: effect preview at left, a methods list sidebar at right.

A row of seven overlapping circular avatars is centred, with a two-line mono uppercase caption beneath, then 60px lower a single line of white client logos runs edge to edge and is cropped at both sides as a marquee. Nothing else shares the black screen; the block sits in the lower half with a large empty area above it.

A full black viewport with one two-line statement centred at roughly 5.5vw, medium weight, tight leading: the count of effects, then the release cadence. Letters arrive individually, so mid-scroll the words are missing characters. A small dark capsule in the bottom-right corner shows which demo number is on screen, with a lime dot.

A white sheet with rounded top corners, inset 4px in the black page. The closing line is set at 17vw, centred, so large its first row is cut by the top edge; two capsule buttons (lime primary, grey secondary) sit centred beneath. The footer proper is one row: a newsletter heading and capsule input with inline submit on the left 40%, three small mono link columns on the right, and a legal line at the very bottom.

steal: Split a single-line headline in two and pin the halves to the left and right edges so the media sits inside the sentence.
Make the hero media a reel whose previous and next items peek from the top and bottom edges, signalling drag without arrows.
End on a white rounded sheet rising over a black page, with the final call set so large it is cropped by the sheet's top edge.
media: One live 16:9 demo card holds the centre at 35% of the width between the two halves of the headline, with neighbours of a vertical reel peeking at the top and bottom edges, so about 20% of the fold is picture. Later, a product screenshot in a white rounded panel, card rows and a carousel bleeding off the right edge, and portrait cards dealt into a fan on a pinned stage; 23 muted 5-8s loops started by script, 4px corners on the preview frames.
motion: No preloader: by 1.2s the one-line headline has split and slid to the two edges while the demo card opens between the halves, and Lenis then runs 48 ScrollTriggers with 4 pins: a 2700px pin switches a giant statement on character by character, a 3600px pin deals four cards into a fan, and a 3608px pin slides one line of huge letters sideways while each letter rotates and bounces. Headings rise from a mask over 1.2-1.31s expo.inOut at a 0.034 stagger and UI uses cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1) at .2-.4s; the elastic letters are a move the house layer does not use.

name: DialKit
idea: The headline is the demo: three floating dial controls from the product sit on top of the sentence and change its weight, spacing and effects live.
hero: Near-black viewport with no logo and no nav beyond a two-word audience toggle (active white, inactive grey) in 13px at top-left. A three-line sentence, centred, white, about 9vw with leading near 1.0, occupies the middle 60% of the width and sits optically centred. Three dark glass control chips, each roughly 300 by 80px with large-radius corners, a label on a lighter tab and a monospace value, float over the text at different tilts: one above the first line, one overlapping the start of the last line at lower left, one a segmented off/on switch at lower right. The chips blur the letters beneath them. The bottom third is empty.
type: Mluvka at weight 450 for the 128px headline (-0.02em) and 16px body; system monospace for control values, code and prompts. Section headings are only ~18px semibold, so the scale is one giant sentence followed by documentation-size type.
colour: #111111 #0b0b0b #262626 #ffffff #8a8a8a — Almost pure greyscale: #111 ground, #262626 code panels, white text, grey secondary. Colour arrives only inside demo recordings and syntax highlighting; a faint warm glow rims the control chips.
imagery: Screen recordings of interfaces being tuned with the control panel, shown as rounded tiles bent around a 3D cylinder; plus one large embedded demo card pairing a photo stack with its control panel.
layout: A full-viewport centred hero and a full-width curved carousel, then everything collapses into one centred ~680px documentation column with left-aligned text: small headings, tab rows, code panels, prompt blocks. It reads like a well-set README.

sections.description: A band of six or seven screen-recording tiles mapped onto the inside of a wide horizontal cylinder. Tiles in the centre face the viewer at full size; tiles toward the edges shrink, skew in perspective and fade into black, so the row reads as a curved cinema strip about 95% of the viewport wide and 150px tall, floating in empty black with nothing above or below it.

A single rounded dark card, about 680px wide and 650px tall, split in two. Left: a live demo with a title, a date and two overlapping photographs. Right: a narrow control panel of stacked slider rows, a spring-curve graph and toggles. A text link sits in the card's bottom-left corner. Directly below, a small heading with a tab row of package managers and a one-line code strip.

A docs-style stack in the same narrow column: a small semibold heading, a framework tab row (active white, others grey), one paragraph, then a rounded #262626 code panel with syntax colouring. A list of ready-made prompts follows, each a bold one-line label above a monospace prompt set in its own rounded panel, with about 30px between items.

steal: Place the product's real controls on the headline and let them alter the headline's own type settings.
Reduce navigation to a single audience toggle (human or agent) that swaps the page's content mode.
Wrap a row of screen recordings around a 3D cylinder so the strip skews and fades at the edges instead of running as a flat marquee.

name: heyclicky
idea: The landing page is a messy Mac desktop: the nav is a menu bar with clock and battery, demo clips are open .mov windows, and stickers, folders and kaomoji lie scattered around a plain lowercase wordmark.
hero: Off-white page with a faint dot grid. A thin top bar imitates a Mac menu bar: product name and five lowercase links at left, a glyph logo in the centre, status icons, a clock and a blue download link at right. The lowercase wordmark sits dead centre at 6.1vw in medium grotesk, with a one-line tagline and two glossy pill buttons (blue primary, grey secondary) beneath. Scattered around it: five small video windows with traffic-light title bars and filename captions, name-tag stickers, folder icons, a phone cut-out, a trash can and kaomoji. A large rounded video with a play pill rises from the bottom, cropped by the fold.
type: Inter at weight 500 with -0.03em tracking for the 88px wordmark; everything else is small lowercase Inter (16px body, 12-13px captions) with Geist Mono for a few tiny labels. All lowercase, including buttons and nav. Feature headings are barely larger than body.
colour: #f5f5f5 #111111 #3b8cf5 #6ec1f0 #e8e8e8 #f24fd0 — Light grey desktop with black text; folder blue is the recurring accent in the primary button, links, speech bubbles and footer. Rainbow appears once in 3D block arcs and softly in tweet title bars.
imagery: Lo-fi founder videos inside fake window chrome with traffic lights and filename captions; cut-out desktop ephemera (folders, trash can, old phone, name tags, memes); voxel-block arcs. Windows have small radii and soft shadows and are scattered rather than gridded.
layout: A centred content column about 60% wide with loose objects in the outer margins. Features pair a narrow text column with a large video window. Later come a centred letter card, a marquee line, a three-column tweet wall and a centred FAQ. Backgrounds never change.

sections.description: Two-column feature block in the centred container. The left column, about 30% wide, stacks a row of dots and bars resembling a voice waveform, a chat-style blue speech bubble containing the spoken prompt with a typing cursor, then a small bold lowercase heading and three lines of grey text. The right column is a large video in a window frame with traffic lights, a thick dark outer border and rounded corners. The next feature shows faded below.

A white card one-third of the viewport wide, centred, with a soft shadow, holds a short founder letter in grey 15px text with one phrase highlighted in marker yellow, a tiny avatar with name and role at bottom-left and a handwritten signature at bottom-right. Behind it two arcs built from stacked 3D blocks sweep in from both sides, pink-to-lilac on the left and green-to-yellow on the right, with small pixel-art objects perched on them.

A marquee line repeats one phrase at about 2.3vw, the centre instance black and its neighbours grey, with a glossy rainbow sticker overlapping it at an angle and a tiny pill label above. Below, a three-column masonry of tweets, each styled as a mini window: pastel title bar with traffic lights, avatar, handle, lowercase text, tiny metrics. The wall fades to white at the bottom, where a floating bar states the user count with a link.

Four small lowercase link columns in grey, then the product name spelled across the full container width using rows of blue folder icons as pixels, with a trash-can icon at the left end and a single stray folder at the right. A tiny copyright line sits centred beneath.

steal: Borrow an operating-system skin as the page's whole grammar: menu-bar nav with a live clock, media in title-bar windows with filename captions, icons as scattered decoration.
Show the product's input as the feature headline: a chat speech bubble holding the spoken prompt with a blinking cursor, above a two-line explanation.
Build the footer wordmark out of a repeated product-relevant icon used as pixels.

name: The Content Architecture
idea: The product name becomes a rotating vortex of concentric text rings that you scroll into, and the sales argument is a ticking hours-lost counter beside an itemised receipt.
hero: Exact 50/50 vertical split. The left half is warm cream with a left-aligned stack starting a third of the way down at an 80px margin: one-line mono caps label, a two-line medium-weight sans headline at only 3vw, a four-line grey paragraph capped near 510px, then a black button notched into two joined halves beside a pale grey secondary. A mono scroll cue with a target glyph sits bottom-left. The right half is a charcoal canvas filled with concentric rings of white mono caps spiralling round a centre and cropped by the viewport. A dark boxed nav with a marquee strip floats top-centre across the seam; a minimap thumbnail sits top-right.
type: GeistMono carries two thirds of the page: caps labels, nav, buttons and receipt rows with dot leaders. GeistSans 500 sets quiet 43px sentence-case headlines with zero tracking. The only loud size is a counter numeral near 18vw, so three sizes in total.
colour: #f1eee7 #232323 #dedede #f28a1c #000000 — Warm cream and charcoal trade places section by section. A single small orange dot marks the paid action on the button and nav; no other hue appears.
imagery: No photographs. Canvas-drawn concentric rings of the product name in white mono over a faint dotted grid, later dissolving into scattered glyphs and inverted text fragments. Full-bleed and cropped by the viewport.
layout: An 80px left margin holds every text block. Headlines stay small at the top-left of tall cream sections while one oversized element (vortex, numeral, receipt) takes the opposite side. Floating nav, minimap and a help tab stay pinned throughout.

sections.description: Scroll transition between hero and first section: the camera pushes into the text vortex, rings scaling until letters are hundreds of pixels tall and cropped at every edge, the dotted grid showing between them. A solid cream disc opens at the centre and grows until it becomes the next section's background. A full-screen wipe built from the hero's own artwork, with the nav still floating above.

Pinned cream section. Top-left, a three-line 43px headline with a two-line grey note. Bottom-left, a tilde-prefixed numeral about 18vw tall counts from 00 to 24 as you scroll, with a mono caption and small chip beneath. On the right a receipt column framed by dashed rules fills line by line: mono caps rows grouped by day, dot leaders running to right-aligned hour values, the newest row inverted white on black.

The cream page ends in a band where the vortex returns as debris: tiny mono fragments, some inverted in black boxes, scattered sparsely and thickening upward into the dark ring pattern. Below it a plain footer: logo mark with a stacked two-line name on the left, two short mono caps link columns on the right, and a builder credit bottom-right.

steal: Split the primary button into two notched halves so a two-word action reads like a physical ticket, with one orange dot as the page's only accent.
Argue the cost of doing nothing with a pinned counter: a huge numeral ticks up while itemised mono rows with dot leaders append beside it.
Build the hero graphic from the brand name set on concentric rotating rings, then reuse it as the scroll transition and as footer debris.

name: Trevor Noah
idea: The comedian as a paper cut-out sticker: his head is torn open and the things he makes (stand-up, books, video) spill out and become the navigation.
hero: The desktop capture caught a blank navy frame before the canvas painted; the next frame and the mobile shot show the scene. A deep navy field. The name runs across the top in bold pink grotesk on one line, sized to nearly touch both edges. Centred below is a photographic cut-out of the face with a thick white sticker outline and a torn top edge, from which glossy 3D objects (microphone, book, video player, brain, heart) erupt. Circular arrow buttons sit at the left and right edges; a torn-paper white label beneath the face names the current category. A hairline, a text ticker and a pink pill close the bottom.
type: Die Grotesk D bold for the wordmark (361px in the digest), Die Grotesk C for everything else with body near 19px. Tight tracking, title case. Statements run at about 4vw and emphasise words by switching them to pink, never by changing weight or face.
colour: #1d2440 #f78fb3 #f6f7ee #2b2b2b — One navy field for the entire page. Pink marks the wordmark, emphasised words and one pill; cream-white fills buttons and paper shapes. Photos bring the only other colour.
imagery: Photo cut-outs of the face with thick white die-cut outlines and torn edges, toy-like 3D objects, and small stage photos shaped as peeling stickers or rounded tiles, tilted a few degrees and loosely clustered.
layout: Centred, one idea per screen on an unbroken navy ground: statement, section title with drifting objects, a lone pill button. The fixed header has the pink name left and two cream pills right. Elements enter from the edges and overlap instead of sitting in columns.

sections.description: A centred four-line statement in white at about 4vw, the lines stepped and ragged instead of squared off, with one long word in pink on the first line. It occupies the lower half of the viewport while the upper half stays empty navy, and appears to build line by line.

A two-line centred title, first line white and second pink, at about 2.5vw. Beneath it a loose cluster of tilted objects rises from the bottom edge: a 3D video-player tile in the middle, small rounded photo tiles and a 3D microphone to its left, all overlapping. On the next screen the objects have drifted upward past a single cream pill button centred in empty space.

Split footer. Left half: a second, larger cut-out of the face, tilted and cropped by the left and bottom edges, with a small white speech bubble above it. Right half: a five-row menu, each row a tiny index number at left and a bold label at about 2.5vw, separated by hairlines. Legal text is tiny along the bottom.

steal: Cut the subject out of a photo with a thick white sticker border and a torn edge so photography behaves like illustration.
Emphasise words in a statement by colour alone (pink within white) while keeping one face and one weight.
Turn the footer into a large numbered menu beside a cropped portrait whose speech bubble addresses the departing visitor.
media: Media covers essentially the whole first screen: a fixed WebGL layer behind everything, a photographic cut-out of the face with a torn top taking about a third of the width and the bottom two thirds of the height, props bursting out of it over the wordmark. Later the props re-form into a collage of tilted sticker photos round a 3D object and a stack of books, torn-paper strips mark the colour changes, and a giant cropped portrait peeks from the footer corner, every photo an alpha cut-out with an 8-10px white sticker outline and no video anywhere.
motion: A load of about 7.3s plays as a large counter to 100, the intact face sticker, the crown tearing away, props spilling out and the name last, and Lenis then drives the fixed WebGL stage as the props fly down and re-form per chapter, the ground changing navy, charcoal, navy at torn-paper dividers. Headline lines rise from translateY(120%) through a clip-path over 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1) and stickers pop in from scale 0 on an overshoot curve the house layer does not use, while 11 reduced-motion rules zero every duration.

name: Select26
idea: A database conference dressed as terminal output: pixel-mono lettering in highlighted cells, a live band of ASCII glyph animation, and one-bit dithered speaker portraits.
hero: Near-black page with 96px side margins and about 125px of empty space at the top. Three columns start on one line: at left the event name stacked in three rows of pixel-mono caps, each letter in its own filled cell (green, mint, white); at 36% a two-line description, a small green down-arrow, then date and address in grey; at 66% the ticket terms and an outlined mono-caps button. Below, a full-bleed band about 320px tall of animated glyphs: four rows of large mint and cream hex characters, a block of ASCII shading, a small symbol cluster. A plain section label and the tops of six portraits close the viewport.
type: departureMono (pixel mono) at only 34px for the wordmark and for button and table labels; Inter 14-18px with tight tracking for everything else; Manrope minor. Largest live text is 2.8vw: scale comes from the canvas glyphs, not from headings.
colour: #0b0e0d #95e5b8 #3ecf8e #e6fbd0 #ffffff #8b908d — One near-black field for the entire page. Three greens (brand green, mint, pale lime-cream) appear only in the wordmark cells, canvas glyphs, links and outlined buttons; all copy is white or grey.
imagery: Canvas-drawn ASCII and hex glyph fields in green tints; speaker headshots converted to coarse black-and-white dither, square-cornered, about 4:5, in a strict six-column grid with small name and role captions beneath.
layout: Fixed 96px side margins and one six-column grid: info columns, portraits, agenda table and sponsor tiles all snap to it. Sections are separated by space only, with small plain-sans headings; glyph bands at top and bottom bracket the page.

sections.description: A plain 22px sans label, then a six-column grid of portrait tiles with 18px gutters running more than six rows. Every photo has the same 4:5 crop and is rendered as a black-and-white bitmap dither, so mixed-quality headshots look uniform. Beneath each: name in small white sans and role in grey, two or three lines, left-aligned. A leftover final tile sits alone at the left rather than being centred.

The agenda heading reads as a sentence: the section word, a green arrow, then two text tabs, the active one underlined in green. Below, a three-column table: time ranges in small grey mono, session title in white sans, speakers in smaller white on two lines. Column headers are tiny mono caps over one hairline; rows are separated by space, with a single dotted line marking lunch.

The cell-highlighted wordmark repeats at small size above three grey lines and a three-state theme switch made of tiny square icons; an outlined mono button sits far right. Beneath, a full-width band of bracketed hex strings in mixed green fills, some characters inverted in solid cells, with a ticker line of digits running off both edges.

steal: Set each letter of a wordmark in its own filled monospace cell, varying the fill tint per row.
Dither all headshots to one-bit black and white so a mixed set of speaker photos becomes one consistent texture.
Skip the big headline: put the practical facts in three quiet columns and let a full-bleed generative band carry the scale.

name: Le Petit Bleu
idea: The cafe's teal-and-white stripes become the whole system: one teal ink on cream, everything boxed in thin double outlines like printed menu cards, beside a permanently visible photo of the room.
hero: Viewport split 50/50 with 12px gaps. Left: a cream panel with a thin pale-teal outline and rounded corners. Inside, a second outlined box is the nav bar: two-line hamburger left, teal brush-script logo about 300px wide centred, a caps order link right. Below, a two-line light serif headline at about 3.5vw, centred, in teal, then two centred stacks, each a bold caps label, a serif line and a solid teal button wrapped in a second thin outline. Right: a full-height rounded photo of a striped booth, with an outlined hours bar across its top, three slide dots bottom-left and a white address card bottom-right.
type: Self Modern, a light bookish serif, for headline and 15px body; Matter SQ bold caps for labels and buttons; Archive Mono Pro typewriter caps for menu rows; a brush-script logo. Section titles are tall condensed serif caps sized so four to seven letters fill the column.
colour: #fcfbf7 #13a7b2 #058599 #cfe5e7 #e9b81f — Cream paper and a single teal used for every word, rule, outline and button; no black anywhere. Yellow, floral reds and marble enter only through the interior photographs.
imagery: Bright, saturated interior and food photographs; the right-hand panel is a full-height slideshow with rounded corners. Small food shots sit in a horizontal strip, and a fine line drawing of the shopfront with one teal awning fills a card.
layout: The left half scrolls as a stack of outlined cream cards (full-width or two-up) with 12px gaps while the right half stays fixed. Card contents are centred. A sticky nav card rides over the stack. On mobile the photo becomes the hero card's background.

sections.description: A card containing only the section word in tall condensed serif caps, teal, sized so its four letters fill the column edge to edge. Below it, a stack of full-width outlined rows about 36px high, each with a category name in typewriter mono caps at left and a thin plus sign at right, separated by 6px gaps. Above the title: a ticker row of tiny caps and a strip of four small food photos with rounded corners.

The same giant condensed title treatment, then centred serif paragraphs in teal with underlined links in a narrow measure of about 280px. Further down, a landscape photo of the two proprietors with a centred two-line caption in tiny sans, followed by more centred paragraphs. All of it lives in the left half while the right photo panel has advanced to a shelf-wall image.

A header row with a tiny bold caps label at left and a script follow-us link with arrow at right, then three portrait images (about 3:5) with 12px rounded corners in a row, the third cropped by the column edge to imply a carousel. Directly below, the next giant section title begins and is cropped by the viewport.

steal: Print everything in one brand ink on cream, including body text, rules and buttons, and let photographs supply the other colours.
Wrap buttons and panels in a second thin outline offset by a few pixels to get a printed-ticket feel.
Keep a tall photo panel fixed on one half and scroll a stack of cards on the other, swapping the photo as sections change.

name: Dabbit
idea: The colour picker demonstrates itself on the page: its loupe sits in the hero reading the site's own background hex, and every feature is shown as a real fragment of the app.
hero: Near-black viewport split exactly in half by a one-pixel vertical hairline. Left half: a small chrome four-petal logo top-left at a 40px margin, then two thirds of empty dark, then everything else anchored bottom-left: a one-line 30px medium-weight headline, three lines of grey 18px copy, a light pill button beside an outlined pill, and a tiny note. Right half: a 450px rounded square with a thin iridescent border, the app's loupe, empty except for a centre crosshair dot and a small chip reading the hex of the page's own background. Eight pastel dots and lozenges drift across the top-right like spilled swatches.
type: InterVariable only. Headline a modest 30px medium with -0.025em tracking; section heads about 22px; cell titles 15px; body 16px grey. Largest text is 3.3vw. Hierarchy comes from white against grey rather than size; hex values use tabular figures.
colour: #141416 #2b2b2e #f4f3f2 #9a9aa0 #f4a48c #d4c6e6 — Charcoal ground, off-white and grey text, no brand accent. All colour comes from the product: pastel swatches, tonal scales, and a thin prismatic edge on the loupe and logo. Neutral-cool.
imagery: Live-drawn UI fragments on canvas: swatch strips, eleven-step scales, contrast tables, a Figma plugin panel, each in a slightly lighter rounded panel. A chrome 3D logo and chrome price numerals are the only non-UI images.
layout: 40px outer margins; the hero's centre hairline becomes a three-column then four-column hairline grid. No section changes background; rhythm is small eyebrow, heading, grid, repeat. Text sits top-left in every cell.

sections.description: A three-column grid ruled by one-pixel hairlines with no card backgrounds. Each cell is over 400px tall: 15px white title and three lines of grey copy, plus a real UI fragment docked above or below (a swatch history strip, a tonal scale, a contrast table, a ten-by-ten colour matrix). Rows alternate text-over-mock and mock-over-text so the grid staggers. The loupe square from the hero reappears floating across cell boundaries.

A four-column, three-row grid of minor features divided by hairlines. Each item is a 14px title prefixed by a tiny coloured glyph (dot, square, triangle or dash, one shape per column, in the app's pastel colours) and two lines of grey text. No icons, no cards, no hover chrome.

Left third: small grey eyebrow, a 22px heading, one paragraph. Right: the price rendered as huge chrome 3D numerals about 150px tall with the loupe square overlapping them, a tiny qualifier beside, and a plain four-line checklist beneath. No pricing card, no border, no tiers.

Closing block centred on the same dark ground: the chrome four-petal logo enlarged to about 200px, pastel shapes scattered widely around it, a two-line 22px sentence, the same two pill buttons, then a one-line footer with copyright left and seven text links right.

steal: Make the hero demo sample the page itself: the tool reports the site's own background value, proving the product without a screenshot.
Build feature grids from hairlines and real UI fragments instead of bordered cards and icons, alternating text-above and mock-above per row.
Keep the headline small (30px) and anchored bottom-left so the product object, not the slogan, owns the first viewport.

name: Decathlon Yestalgia
idea: A full-commitment late-80s Memphis pastiche: sticker shapes with hard black shadows, ultra-condensed capitals and a glitching wordmark that flips nostalgia from no to yes.
hero: Pale grey page. A portrait video card, 35% of the width and 75% of the height with square corners, sits dead centre showing a hand on a boombox; across its middle a slanted, extruded gradient wordmark is caught mid-glitch and overhangs the card's left edge. Five flat sticker shapes with speckle patterns and solid black offset shadows are scattered in the empty flanks: pink arc upper-left, lime lightning bolt lower-left, orange disc upper-right, blue arch lower-right, a teal triangle cropped by the top edge. The header is inset 8%: a chunky lime menu button left, the retro logo centred, language selector and shop button right, all with hard black shadows.
type: Roboto Flex throughout, pushed to its narrowest, heaviest setting for uppercase headlines at about 14vw with tight leading; 12–16px medium uppercase for buttons. Campaign wordmarks are custom lettering: slanted, extruded and gradient-filled.
colour: #f4f4f4 #eaa0cd #e9dae6 #d9e13f #0a0809 #f0923a — Starts neutral grey, shifts to pale pink then saturated bubblegum pink on scroll. Lime marks every control; orange, sky blue, green and purple appear in illustrations, always outlined in black.
imagery: Sun-drenched lifestyle video and photos (older skaters, a boombox) alongside thick-outlined cartoon illustration, palm trees, a striped sunset and speckled geometric stickers; photos appear as tilted white-bordered prints overlapping headlines.
layout: A centred axis for media and headlines with decoration scattered in the margins and cropped by viewport edges. Each scroll stage changes background colour and adds a pattern (grid paper, stripes, perspective grid). Headlines stay put while pictures and characters pass over them.

sections.description: Pale pink with faint grid-paper lines. A two-line ultra-condensed black headline, each line about 14vw tall, sits centre-left and takes 40% of the width. Decoration crowds the lower half: an orange half-sun with palm trees rising at the right, a pink speckled arc and a cartoon character peeking from the bottom-left, a four-point sparkle upper-left. White horizontal stripes of increasing thickness run across the bottom edge as the hand-off to the next colour.

Bubblegum pink. A cartoon skater riding a cassette tape, with chrome numerals and a lightning bolt behind, is placed centre-right at about 40% of the viewport height and overlaps the headline. The three-line condensed headline is distorted mid-scroll: its second and third lines sink and shear toward the lower right as if printed on a curling poster. Pink and white stripe bands cap the top.

Same pink field. A small condensed line is centred above the giant two-line headline. Two portrait photographs with thin white borders, each roughly 380×510px, are dropped on top of the headline's centre, tilted about −8 and +6 degrees and overlapping each other, hiding half the letters. One orange speckled disc sits alone at the right; a lime bolt is cropped by the top-left corner.

Pink field overlaid with a white wireframe grid plane tilted in perspective. A pennant-shaped campaign logo in purple, green, pink and yellow sits at centre; sticker shapes are pinned to the corners and cut off by the viewport; two 10px legal links are centred at the very bottom. There are no link columns at all.

steal: Give every control and sticker a solid black offset shadow instead of a blurred one so flat shapes feel like die-cut objects.
Start the hero video as a centred portrait card surrounded by scattered shapes, then scale it to full-bleed on first scroll.
Drop tilted, white-bordered photos directly on top of a giant condensed headline so the type becomes background.
media: A centred portrait video window of about 506x674 covers about 26% of the fold, with flat stickers in the corners, and opens to full bleed by clip-path over an 1800px runway, so by the second screen the video covers the whole screen. Later: an illustration scene rising over a statement, tilted photos rising over a headline, an edge-to-edge product grid of 3-up and 4-up rows mixing stills and 2-4s loops, a carousel of tilted portrait videos and a name index scrolling past a held square picture; 36 pictures and 16 muted looping videos, no radius.
motion: No preloader: the montage cuts through four shots in 4.5s while the half-ring stickers turn, and Lenis then runs two sticky frames, the first opening the hero inset from about 26% per side to 0, the second raising an illustration scene over the statement as the ground switches from lavender to hot pink. Images reveal by clip-path over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1) with an inner image move on the same ease, statement characters fade and move over 1s, and UI moves at 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1).

name: Vessa
idea: A brand-guidelines tool that frames its live demo inside an electric-blue dithered pixel field and marks the whole page with dashed artboard guides and corner handles.
hero: Pale cool-grey page with dashed vertical guides about 2% in from each edge. A soft blue halftone arc of pixels glows behind the top nav: logo left, four links centre, sign-in and a blue button right. Centred below: a two-line medium-weight headline at 3.9vw with very tight tracking, about 43% of viewport width; three lines of 18px grey text with one bold phrase; a small blue button with 6px corners; a pill counter. At 58% down a full-width electric-blue block begins, its fill breaking into checker dither at the top, with small square handles at its corners; inside, a pill tab bar and the top of a black demo page.
type: Switzer only: weight 500 at 56px with -0.045em tracking for the headline, about 18px regular for lead text, 15px body, 13px nav. Section headings drop to roughly 28px, so the hero is the single large moment. Emphasis by bold or blue text, never capitals.
colour: #eef0f3 #1f2de6 #010101 #f5f6f8 #ffffff — Cool pale grey with one electric blue used for buttons, one highlighted sentence and large dithered frames; the embedded demo brings black and warm photographic tones.
imagery: Live product demo pages (a fictional sports brand with a dramatic runner photo, logo lockups on white and black) sit as rounded panels inside blue ordered-dither pixel frames; small grey-and-blue schematic diagrams elsewhere.
layout: A container of about 1300px bounded by dashed guide lines that continue down the page and split into dashed grid cells for features. Centred text sections alternate with left-aligned split rows and full-width blue dithered blocks, separated by generous vertical gaps.

sections.description: Centred column about 55% of viewport width set in roughly 22px regular text as three or four short paragraphs with wide gaps and no heading. The final one-line paragraph switches to the accent blue as the turn of the argument. No images, cards or rules; only the dashed side guides frame it.

Two-column row. Left: a blue dithered rectangle about 45% of the width whose solid centre dissolves to pixels at the edges, containing a small white rounded card with a schematic of a URL turning into colour swatches and a font tag. Right: a pill stepper of three tabs with an arrow button, then a small bold title and four lines of 14px text placed mid-height. The section title sits far below at left in 28px.

A grid drawn only with dashed lines. First a full-width cell with a centred diagram of five small bordered chips hanging from a blue tag by dashed connectors, title and text at bottom left. Below it two cells side by side, each with a grey-and-blue schematic (scattered rounded squares; an input wired to a browser strip) in the upper two thirds and a bold one-line title plus three lines of small text at the bottom left.

Full-width blue dithered block with corner handles; in its middle a solid blue rectangle about half the width holds a centred two-line white heading at 28px and a small white button. Directly below sits the footer: brand blurb and a directory badge at left, five link columns separated by dashed vertical rules, and a one-line legal strip under a dashed horizontal rule.

steal: Replace gradient backgrounds with an ordered-dither pixel pattern in the accent colour that dissolves from solid to checkerboard at the edges.
Use dashed guide lines and small square corner handles as the page's structural ornament, including as dividers between feature cells and footer columns.
Embed the real product with its own tab bar directly under the hero copy instead of a static screenshot.

name: poetry camera
idea: A camera that prints poems is sold through its own output: copy arrives as thermal-paper slips, and a soft-focus bitmap wordmark lies over handheld footage.
hero: Full-bleed handheld video of two hands holding the white-and-red camera against out-of-focus blossom. The product name is centred over it in two lines of white lowercase bitmap lettering about 10vw tall, deliberately blurred so the pixels bloom into soft blobs; the block spans 70% of the width, from 25% to 70% of the height, directly on top of the camera. One text link sits top-left and two social icons top-right, all white. A yellow pill button about 165px wide with black lowercase text is centred near the bottom edge and stays fixed for the whole page. No tagline and no scrim.
type: BitMatrix A2, a dot-matrix face, blurred at 10vw for the wordmark and sharp at 12px on the paper slips; Exposure, a soft serif, in white lowercase near 32px for statements and about 10vw for the closing quote; DM Sans for links and button.
colour: #b7a590 #7a6f3e #f9fdf9 #ffde5b #c92a2a #1a1a1a — Colour comes from the footage: blossom pinks, moss greens, the camera's red base. White type and off-white paper slips sit over it; one yellow button repeats on every screen. The last screen turns plain white.
imagery: Soft, shallow-focus handheld video fills each screen: the camera outdoors, on a workbench, prototypes on a desk. Over it sit scanned-looking thermal slips with mono text and dithered halftone portraits, slightly rotated and overlapping.
layout: Each section is one full-height video with a block of large white serif text in a central column about 45% wide, left-aligned, and a row of paper slips rising from the bottom edge. The same yellow button floats bottom-centre throughout. The page ends on a type-only white screen.

sections.description: Full-bleed video of the camera hanging among blossom. Two short paragraphs of white lowercase serif near 32px sit in the upper centre, left-aligned in a column starting 18% in. Along the bottom, six off-white paper slips of differing heights stand side by side across the full width, each tilted a degree or two, each headed by a lowercase mono label and a typed divider of dashes or crosses, then a short poem in mono. The bottom edge crops them.

Same structure over a different clip. Three tall receipt-like slips fan out beneath a three-line serif statement, each tilted differently and overlapping slightly. A slip carries a name between rows of asterisks, a one-line role, a typed rule, a circular dithered black-and-white portrait, then the quote in 12px mono. The slips run off the bottom of the screen.

Plain off-white screen with no image. A quotation is set in black lowercase serif at about 10vw with the words of each line spread to the full width: one hard left, one centred, one hard right. Two lines are visible with 150px between them, and the attribution is spaced the same way. Beneath, four small sans links centred in a row, then the yellow button.

steal: Blur a bitmap wordmark until the pixels bloom, turning a hard retro face into something soft enough to sit on video without a scrim.
Present feature copy and testimonials as the product's own printed artefact (tilted receipt slips with typed dividers and dithered portraits) rather than cards.
Close on a type-only screen with a quote spread word by word across the full width, as a change of tempo after continuous video.

name: SSTR - Friction Reduction
idea: Drilling hardware treated like precision consumer tech: a chamfered octagon taken from the tool's cross-section drives the buttons, icons and loader.
hero: The captured first viewport is the preloader: a 2 by 2 grid with hairline dividers, top-left quadrant solid orange with the slash-prefixed name at 5.6vw in black bold grotesk; top-right dark with a plus-sign dot grid and an orange square beside a percentage; bottom quadrants hold wireframe octagon stacks under small labels. The real hero is a full-bleed grey 3D render of a steel downhole tool rising from bottom centre. A two-line uppercase headline at about 3.5vw in light grotesk sits left-anchored at mid-height, with a short paragraph and an orange chamfered-corner button below. A slim bar holds logo left, five small caps links, globe and contact right.
type: ABC Monument Grotesk: bold for the loader mark, but headlines are regular or light uppercase with tight tracking at roughly 36 to 50px over 14px body. Uppercase labels at 10 to 11px carry a square orange bullet. Statistic numerals jump to about 6.7vw in a thin weight.
colour: #18191b #eff0f1 #ff5a2a #2f3032 #c3c4c8 — Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate; one safety orange marks buttons, bullets, the loader block and the highlighted chart series. Renders are desaturated steel so orange never competes.
imagery: Desaturated 3D renders of drilling tools, full-bleed in the hero and as a long drill string bending along a well path; thin wireframe octagon line drawings as service icons; a chart drawn in dots.
layout: Content sits inside vertical hairline rails about 35px in from each edge, with sections subdivided into two or three bordered cells. Dark and light sections alternate. Text blocks are left-aligned and narrow; a pinned well-path sequence breaks the grid with a full-bleed scene.

sections.description: Light grey section inside vertical hairline rails. An uppercase two-line heading at about 2.4vw sits top-left with an orange chamfered button under it. Below, three equal columns divided by hairlines, each about 230px tall: a wireframe line drawing of stacked octagons in the upper half, then an uppercase title at 13px and three lines of small grey body. No fills, no icon circles, no shadows.

Graphite section split into two bordered cells. Left cell, vertically centred: a tiny bracketed before-and-after range in caps, a statistic at about 6.7vw in thin grotesk, a one-word label and an orange chamfered button. Right cell: a line chart drawn entirely in dots, white for the baseline and orange for the improved run, with faint axis labels and a two-item legend using short colour bars.

Pinned full-viewport dark scene. A 3D drill string enters at top-left, runs down, bends through ninety degrees and continues along the bottom to the right edge, with bright tool segments spaced along it. A text block right of centre holds a small orange-bulleted label, a four-line uppercase statement at about 2vw and two lines of body. Bottom edge: a back-to-start link left, a chevron scroll cue centre, a skip link right.

steal: Derive one shape from the product (here a chamfered octagon) and reuse it for button corners, icons and loader graphics.
Draw charts with dots rather than lines and reserve the accent colour for the one data series you want read.
Turn the preloader into a branded four-cell grid that previews the site's colour blocks and wireframe icons.
media: A full-bleed 13s monochrome loop of a drilling tool descending over grey sand covers the whole fold with the text straight on it at the left, oversized for parallax. Below: a full-bleed WebGL chapter with the caption right of centre and a depth gauge at the edge, line-drawn icons in three equal cells, dot-plot charts beside big figures zigzagging per row, a 4:1 product strip under a giant product-code heading, and 3:2 case photographs in a right-hand column; 33 images and 3 videos, 0px radius.
motion: On desktop the video plays from 400ms while every text line shows as a solid orange bar the size of the line, like redaction, and the type replaces the bars by 1.2s. Under Lenis the hero video parallaxes at scrub 2, heads rise as masked lines over 0.6-0.82s expo.out at a 0.04-0.06 stagger, chart dots switch on one by one (1004 rects at 0.15s), stats roll digit columns, the WebGL chapter is step-locked with skip controls, and buttons fill with a clip-path sweep over 0.375s; there are 10 reduced-motion rules.

name: No Art
idea: The page is a camera viewfinder: crop-mark brackets frame the viewport and the scrawled logo, and all text is typewriter-mono capitals like a caption burned onto footage.
hero: Aerial festival footage (crowd, trees, an iridescent gate structure) fills the screen. Dead centre sits a hand-scrawled logo about 280px wide in a lilac chrome texture, tilted upward, with four small white corner brackets marking its bounding box. Matching brackets sit in the viewport corners, with tick marks at the mid-left and mid-right edges. Top-left: a small white copy of the scrawl.
