Across the top right: four mono caps links, each led by a small white square. Bottom-left: a grey mono label and a five-line fully justified mono caps paragraph only 210px wide. Bottom-right: a small dark card with a poster thumbnail, event name and date.
type: Chivo Mono in bold capitals at 11-12px for nearly everything, fully justified so word gaps open up; Neue Haas Grotesk bold caps at about 48px (3.3vw), also justified, for the few section statements. The logo is handwriting. Two real sizes.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #1b240b #b9b4f0 #e23b1e #8b2a52 — Dark green footage up top, then stark white with black text. Colour comes only from event posters in flat primaries, maroon flight cases in the shop photos and red dots on the globe.
imagery: Aerial video; naive hand-drawn figure posters used as wide banners; a grey wireframe globe; full-length merchandise portraits shot against stacked flight cases in woodland, 3:4, square corners, five across.
layout: Wide white margins inside a persistent bracket frame. Content sits on a multi-column grid: headings in the left third, justified paragraphs in the right third, carousels spanning the full width. A small square-bulleted label heads each block.

sections.description: White screen inside the bracket frame. A tiny square-bulleted mono label, then a four-line statement in 48px bold grotesk caps, fully justified to a 430px measure so the words are pushed apart, starting 11% from the left. Opposite, starting at 58%, two justified mono caps paragraphs about 440px wide and a small text link. The middle third is left empty.

Events carousel. A label row with a text link at the far right, then a horizontal row of wide poster banners (about 2.2:1) showing hand-drawn dancing figures in flat primaries, 20px gaps, the fourth cut by the edge. Under each: a bracketed index number and event name in mono, date on a second line. Centred below, a prev and next control with a row of thin vertical tick marks between them as the progress indicator.

Globe locator. Left: a four-line justified bold caps heading with a two-option text filter under it. Centre: a pale-grey wireframe globe about 550px across, cropped by the section's bottom edge, with a few red location dots. Around it sit tiny mono readouts: latitude and longitude above left, local time and time zone to the right, each anchored by a small corner bracket.

Five equal 3:4 portraits edge to edge with 20px gaps, each a model standing square to camera in front of maroon flight cases among trees. Under each a plus sign, product name and price in mono. The same prev, tick-marks, next control sits centred beneath. The footer follows as a thin outlined box split into a logo cell and six link columns with bracketed mono headings.

steal: Put small corner brackets at the viewport corners and around the logo's bounding box so the whole page reads as a viewfinder.
Fully justify short bold caps headings to a narrow measure so the uneven word gaps become the texture.
Replace carousel dots with a row of thin vertical tick marks between plain-text prev and next.
media: A full-bleed 13s aerial festival video is meant to fill the first screen under a centred framed logo, with copy and a 107x80 next-up thumbnail docked in the bottom corners; it did not paint on desktop. Below, a swiper strip of illustrated event posters from the left margin bleeding off the right edge, a product strip of 2:3 portraits that swap to a second image on hover, and a WebGL globe between a heading and a live readout; fixed viewfinder corner marks sit over every section.
motion: A preloader of about 4.5s reads as an aperture opening from a point: a dot grows into a black square, then a 470x250 frame holding the logo, then full bleed. Lenis with a single scrubbed trigger on the hero and nothing pinned; product images scale over 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (the dominant curve, 14 uses) and swap in 0.3s, a custom cursor follows on 0.4s power3.out, and accordions open by grid-template-rows over 0.4-0.5s.

name: Cerebrium
idea: Infrastructure speed expressed as glossy magenta ribbons sweeping through a near-black field, with the technical proof delivered underneath on a white sheet of mono-labelled demo panels.
hero: Full-bleed near-black canvas with fine grain; thick glossy magenta-plum 3D ribbons arc up from the bottom and right, one edge catching a white highlight. Top bar: logo left; at right a dark rounded rectangle holding five uppercase mono links, then two squarish buttons (pale lavender log-in, hot-pink sign-up). The upper 60% of the left side is empty. The headline is three lines of light-weight grotesk at about 5.5vw, flush left on a 3% margin, ending about 10% above the bottom edge, with one word in a pink gradient. At two-thirds across, level with the headline's lower lines, a five-line paragraph and two mono-labelled buttons.
type: ABC Favorit in a light weight for large headlines, Suisse Intl for 18px body, Suisse Intl Mono in uppercase for every nav item, button and tag. Sentence case, default tracking. Hero headline to body is about 4.5:1; feature titles stay near 1.6vw. The digest's 144px line is not in the captured frames.
colour: #040102 #470c35 #ffffff #eef2f5 #ff488b #101421 — Near-black and plum hero and footer bracket a white middle with navy-ink text. Hot pink is reserved for primary buttons, one gradient headline word, benchmark bars and map markers.
imagery: WebGL ribbon sculpture in plum with glossy highlights behind hero, logo strip and footer; below, schematic product vignettes (benchmark bars on a frosted card, hex-dot world map, terminal output, line chart) inside pale-grey or navy panels with 8px corners.
layout: 3% side margins. Hero and footer are full-bleed dark; the middle is a white sheet with rounded top corners that slides up over the ribbons. Inside it, a pinned two-column layout: narrow list at left, a wide right column of stacked panels each followed by a short title and paragraph.

sections.description: Directly under the hero the ribbon canvas continues behind one row of white client logos running edge to edge, cut off at both sides, over a faint dot grid. A white panel with large rounded top corners rises over it and opens with a two-column row: a small two-line statement at the left margin, and from 50% across a two-line headline at about 2.8vw whose words fade from grey to navy, the second line in pink.

Pinned feature list. Left column, about 25% wide: a tiny mono label with a bullet, then four stacked feature names at about 1.6vw in light weight; the active one is navy and the other three pale grey, the active state stepping down as you scroll. Right column from 50% to the margin: a tall stack of roughly 4:3 demo panels, each followed by a one-line title and a four-line paragraph. Panel grounds alternate between ribbon render, pale grey and navy.

The footer returns to the dark ribbon canvas at full viewport height. Social icons sit top-left and two small link columns start about 75% across. In the lower right, a two-line closing statement at about 1.5vw with a pink and a dark button beneath; ribbons sweep in from the bottom-left to fill the empty half. A hairline and one row of legal links in mono capitals close the page.

steal: Pin a short list of feature names on the left and let only the active name hold full ink while the others drop to pale grey, as a stack of demo panels scrolls past on the right.
Set every interactive label (nav, buttons, tags) in uppercase mono and everything else in a light grotesk, so controls read as a separate system from the copy.
Make the light content area a sheet with rounded top corners that slides up over the dark hero art, then bring the same art back for the footer.
media: One fixed 3D canvas covers 100% of the first screen, its ribbon mass in the lower-right 55% with the text straight on the render, and stays behind every section, seen through windows between rounded sheets that slide over it; the scene changes by section (ribbons, an orb, ribbons). Product pictures are working mini interfaces (a chart, a map, a terminal) on cards; no photographs and no video on desktop.
motion: A small logo-bar preloader, then the headline words reveal out of reading order over about 2.5s and the 3D ribbon fades in last. Lenis with script-driven parallax on 54 data-scroll elements; a sticky feature list highlights the item whose card is in view, blocks reveal with a 14px rise over 0.8s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), and benchmark bars fill over 0.25 to 4s so each bar's fill time follows the value it shows; there is a reduced-motion rule.

name: Spatial
idea: Typography behaves like sound in a room: plain black statements swell, stretch and bend through an empty white viewport as you scroll.
hero: A white viewport holding only the festival dates: two centred lines in Neue Haas Grotesk Roman at roughly 6.7vw, black, tight leading, sitting at the exact vertical middle and spanning about half the width. Large empty fields above and below; no image, no button, no supporting copy. The header is the only other element: a light uppercase wordmark with tight tracking flush to the top-left corner at a 20px inset, and nine small bold uppercase links in a row across the top right. Mobile is the same poster at 40px with a two-line hamburger.
type: One face, Neue Haas Grotesk Display 55 Roman, for everything: statements from 56px up to about 10vw, 13px body, bold 13px uppercase navigation, a timetable at about 16px with tight leading. Statement lines are distorted per glyph, each letter scaled to a different width and height.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #e8a25c — Pure black on pure white; the programme section inverts to white on black. The only colour is the amber haze of a single photograph.
imagery: Almost none. The images are canvas-rendered text statements warped and magnified until letter fragments become abstract black shapes cropped by the viewport. One warm, hazy venue photograph sits inset at half width beside body copy, square-cornered.
layout: Full width with 10 to 20px margins. Opens with one centred statement per screen, then drops into left-aligned two-column copy and, further down, edge-to-edge four-column timetables. The swing between empty poster screens and tightly packed listings is the page's rhythm.

sections.description: A run of full-viewport white screens, each carrying one centred two-line sentence. The text is drawn on canvas and deformed: letters within a word have different widths and heights and baselines wobble. Between screens the type is magnified so far that only the strokes and counters of a few letters cross the frame, cropped on every side, while a small readable version of the next sentence appears inside the wreckage of the previous one.

A calm reset: a three-line centred statement at about 5vw in undistorted type fills the top half. At the bottom, a column of 16px body copy about 650px wide sits flush to the left margin, and an amber-toned photograph starts at the horizontal centre and runs to the right margin with square corners, cropped by the fold.

Black full-bleed section. Day headings are single small lines above a hairline; under each, a four-column table spans the full width: artist flush left, format at one third, room at two thirds, time range right-aligned at the far edge. Rows are about 35px high with a hairline between each, all in the same 30px grotesk with no bold; changeovers are marked by rows in capitals.

steal: Open with a single factual line (the dates) centred on an otherwise empty white screen instead of a branded hero.
Scale each letter of a statement independently in width and height so plain grotesk type looks as if it is resonating.
Set a programme as a full-width four-column hairline table in one size and weight, times right-aligned, on an inverted background.

name: Aardvark Book Club
idea: A book club dressed as a sweet shop: fat black type, tumbling 3D books and boxes on wavy colour fields, annotated with handwritten asides.
hero: A saturated yellow field with two large wavy blobs, pale yellow then orange, rising from the bottom. A three-line headline in Champ Bold, black, at about 8.3vw with leading under 0.85, is flush to a 15px left margin and reaches 60% across. Beneath it: a four-line paragraph 310px wide and a magenta split button (label plus arrow square). Right of centre a 3D hardback in navy and pink tilts 20 degrees, 600px tall; another book is cropped by the top-left corner, a third by the bottom edge. A purple handwritten note sits rotated at far right. Nav: pale-yellow pill links centred, an orange login button, black round social icons.
type: Champ Bold, an ultra-heavy wide sans with a looped g, for headings at 120px with tight tracking and leading; Degular for 18px body and pill labels; a purple handwritten script (Hello Organichand) for rotated margin notes and step labels. Three distinct voices.
colour: #ffd249 #faed8f #f9a21f #ffdbfd #a4f6f8 #fd48f2 — Each section owns one flat candy colour: yellow hero, white shelf, pink steps, cyan unboxing, deep violet footer. Type stays black; buttons are magenta.
imagery: 3D-rendered hardbacks and a patterned shipping box, cut out and tilted, floating over flat wavy vector shapes; real book covers on tilted coloured cards; black line drawings of figures on step cards. Nothing sits square to the grid.
layout: Sections are full-width panels with roughly 80px corner radius inset about 20px from the viewport, each a different colour. Headings alternate left and centre; cards overlap and rotate a few degrees; handwritten notes are tucked beside headings at an angle.

sections.description: White band. A centred black heading at 5.5vw over a two-line subline, with a rotated handwritten note at its upper left. Below, a horizontal row of book covers, each on a rounded colour-matched card with a small tag pill at top-left; cards tilt alternately by 3 degrees at staggered heights, the last cropped by the right edge, with two round arrow buttons above at right. Later, covers give way to same-coloured info cards with genre pills, heavy title and blurb.

A pale-pink rounded panel with lighter wavy shapes inside. Heavy black heading at left with a handwritten aside beside it; a small round logo stamp and a magenta split button at right. Along the bottom, four portrait cards about 250px wide in cyan, magenta, yellow and violet overlap like a fanned hand, each rotated a few degrees, with a handwritten step label at top, a black line drawing in the middle and a heavy caption at the foot.

A full-viewport cyan rounded panel containing only a 3D shipping box wrapped in a wavy magenta, violet and black pattern, centred. Across the scroll it goes from closed and tilted to lid open, growing to about 57% of the viewport width, with a single handwritten note at its right. No heading and no button.

The preceding white section ends in large rounded bottom corners over a deep violet footer. Left: white logo, two store badges, two magenta round social icons. Centre: the patterned box again, cropped by the bottom edge. Right: a small heavy heading, a white rounded email field and a magenta split button. A black legal strip closes the page.

steal: Give each section one flat saturated colour inside a large-radius inset panel and keep the type black across all of them.
Add rotated handwritten margin notes beside headings to carry secondary facts in a second voice.
Fan step cards so they overlap and tilt instead of sitting in an even grid.
media: About 60% of the first screen is picture: a 3D book and cropped book corners over a full-bleed illustrated wave field. Below come a sticky image-sequence of a box opening inside a rounded panel, a slider of tilted cards bleeding off the right edge, covers fanned like a hand of cards, a sticker collage round a circular badge and a cut-out box rising out of the footer: 37 images and two scroll-scrubbed canvases, no video.
motion: An indigo transition panel wipes away by 1.2s while the headline arrives word by word (515 split characters), and Lenis then drives the scrubbed scenes: the hero book turns through an image sequence, a sticky stage scrubs the box opening over 2745px, a headline slides along a curved path at scrub 0.5, and the footer is uncovered from under the rounded page. Buttons squash to 0.955 by 0.925 in 0.15s on press, the main ease is cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), and the bounce overshoots are ones the house motion layer does not use, though the site ships 32 reduced-motion rules.

name: Rendez-vous Francéclat
idea: A hot gradient sliced into three glass panes that double as the column grid for navigation and content.
hero: A full-viewport gradient runs from white at the far left through orange to crimson on the right, sliced into three equal vertical panes that each restart the gradient, like fluted glass. There is no nav bar: mono uppercase links sit as plain stacks (3, 3, 2) at the top-left of each pane, 24px in; an outlined language select top-right. At 37–63% height on the left: a stacked light-caps programme logo, then the event name in heavy lowercase grotesk on two lines, about 7vw, with two mono metadata blocks above aligned to column starts and a sponsor logo below. The right half is empty colour. A black rectangular CTA sits bottom-right.
type: ABC Diatype throughout: heavy, tightly tracked lowercase for the event name and 68px section heads (-0.03em), medium 22–28px for statements and paragraphs. A monospaced cut in uppercase 14px handles nav, dates and numbered labels. A stacked light-caps logo adds a third voice.
colour: #f8652b #de194b #ffffff #000000 #fcd9c8 #6f7478 — Orange-to-crimson gradient for hero and footer, fading out to pure white for the informational middle; one desaturated grey photo section. Text black on gradient and white, pale peach in the footer. Warm throughout.
imagery: The paned gradient is the main image. One full-bleed grey architectural photo with a blurred figure; a pale isometric line drawing of the venue; logos. No product photography visible.
layout: Built on thirds and a visible column grid: nav stacks, metadata and text blocks all start on column lines, and white sections expose the vertical hairlines. Left-anchored; large empty areas on the right. Gradient, photo and white sections alternate over 20 screens.

sections.description: As the hero scrolls, the gradient pales to white at the bottom and a two-line bold 28px statement sits in the right third, aligned to the third pane's edge. Next, a full-bleed grey architectural photo carries two paragraphs of white 22px text across the full width with 16px margins, the second at reduced opacity. The event lockup reappears ghosted at the bottom with mono practical details and a white rectangular CTA.

White field with the column grid exposed as vertical hairlines. A bold 40px heading resolves from blur at lower-left. Then a pale isometric line drawing of the venue spans the left four columns, a narrow paragraph about 230px wide sits mid-page, and along the bottom numbered items step down column by column: mono index above an underlined mono uppercase link.

Footer. The paned gradient returns. A partner name top-left; a two-line bold 36px sign-off in pale peach; a newsletter heading with a white input joined to a black button and a consent checkbox. The right two panes hold small bold link lists under mono labels. A hairline and a mono legal row close it.

steal: Slice a full-bleed gradient into three vertical panes that each restart the gradient to get a fluted-glass look from colour alone.
Distribute the navigation as plain mono text stacks at the top of each pane instead of a nav bar, so the grid is the header.
Leave the layout grid's vertical hairlines visible in white sections and step numbered items down along the columns.

name: starboy
idea: A tiny gadget shown enormous: product renders so large the screen crops them, wrapped around a nursery-rhyme headline in fat lowercase.
hero: No nav, logo or button. Off-white ground. The right half holds the headline: five stacked lines of very bold rounded lowercase at 13vw (187px), right-aligned and almost touching the right edge, with tight negative tracking and leading under 0.9, so the stack runs from 5% below the top to past the fold and the last line's descenders are cut off. The left 60% is one transparent-shelled, star-shaped device rendered at huge scale (yellow circuit board, round black screen), rotated and cropped by the top, left and bottom edges, its right-hand points tucking behind the letters. A chrome keyring loop peeks in at bottom-right.
type: Milling Triplex 1mm, bold, for the headline at 187px in lowercase with -0.055em tracking, one or two words per line over eleven lines; the same family at about 13px for body copy, product names and footer links, all lowercase. Two sizes only, a 14:1 jump.
colour: #f9f9f9 #2a2b2d #f5d900 #8d8e96 #b8a45c #2f6fe0 — Off-white page with charcoal type. Colour lives in the objects: circuit-board yellow, chrome, matte black, brass. A small blue logo in the footer is the only interface colour.
imagery: Photoreal renders of star-shaped devices in four materials, cut out with no background or cast shadow, scaled well beyond the viewport, each rotated differently and cropped by the edges. Accessories are shown small and centred in grid cells.
layout: Three acts: three screens of oversized renders tumbling diagonally with the headline set right, then left; one screen holding a single narrow text column and nothing else; then a three-column hairline-divided product grid running edge to edge with no outer margin.

sections.description: The second and third screens are only renders: a matte-black star and a chrome star overlap on a diagonal, each wider than half the viewport and cropped by two edges. The second half of the headline then appears left-aligned at the same 13vw, left of centre, while a brass star fills the right half and bleeds off the top and right. No captions or interface.

A single column of 13px lowercase text about 290px wide, placed roughly 15% from the left and starting at the top of the viewport: five short paragraphs, the first in medium weight. The remaining three-quarters of the screen is blank off-white. No heading, image or button accompanies it.

Three equal columns span the full viewport width, separated by faint 1px vertical and horizontal lines. Each cell holds one cut-out render centred with generous air and a caption row along its bottom edge: product name at left, price with stock count or a coming-soon note in grey at right, all 13px lowercase. The footer is one row: small blue logo left, five text links right.

steal: Scale the product until two or three viewport edges crop it, and let its silhouette tuck behind the headline letters.
Break a sentence into one or two words per line at 13vw, right-aligned for the first half and left-aligned for the second, so the headline spans several screens.
Follow a loud hero with one tiny text column on an otherwise empty screen; the drop in scale does the pacing.

name: Warm & Fuzzy
idea: A showreel-first studio site in which every section takes one flat, loud colour (blue, black, yellow) under heavy grotesk type and a chunky custom wordmark.
hero: The showreel plays full-bleed with a visible film-grain overlay and no scrim. A chunky hand-cut wordmark sits top left, 16px from the edges; the same top line continues with a one-sentence status link, a tiny thumbnail beside the latest project's name, and three caps links at the far right, all white over the footage. A small green caps play label floats at dead centre. The tagline is anchored bottom left, 16px from both edges, in white grotesk caps at 47px (3.3vw) on one line spanning 56% of the width. A tiny square pause control sits bottom right.
type: SuisseIntl throughout, rendering heavy, tracked -0.027em: a 47px caps tagline, a caps section title at 9.4vw, statement paragraphs around 5vw with tight leading, and 10 to 11px caps captions. The logo is custom chunky lettering with wobbly cut-paper counters.
colour: #000000 #190bb6 #f7dd47 #ffffff #e9479f #1fc27a — Each section is a flat field: ultramarine blue, black, yellow, then blue again. White type on blue and black, black on yellow; a green play label is the only small accent.
imagery: Commercial stills and video (candy-coloured CG worlds, product renders, live-action frames) in square-cornered thumbnails of mixed aspect ratios, with a grain layer over the whole page and floating glossy 3D sticker objects.
layout: Tight 16px outer margins and edge-to-edge type. Sections are told apart by background colour rather than spacing: a blue statement set in the right two-thirds, a black packed work wall, a yellow full-width paragraph, a blue footer.

sections.description: On black, a tiny caps motto sits top left, then a caps section title at about 9vw flush left with a small underlined link at the far right on its baseline. Beneath, thumbnails pack into an uneven wall: widths vary from one-sixth to one-half of the page, heights differ, gaps are about 8px and rows do not align. Under each image a 10px caps line gives the project name left and the year in grey right.

A yellow field filled edge to edge by one paragraph in black heavy grotesk at roughly 5vw with very tight leading, left-aligned at the 16px margin. Several lines contain deliberate word-sized gaps, as if the text flowed around something, and a small tilted image chip floats over the first lines, covering parts of words.

A full-screen blue field. A top row of tiny caps, email left and three links right, sits above a hairline. A glossy 3D sticker object hangs near the top centre. The chunky wordmark runs the full page width at the bottom in white, about a fifth of the viewport tall, above a bar of tiny caps links divided by vertical hairlines.

steal: Give every section one flat saturated background and change it at each section break, keeping type strictly black or white.
Pack work thumbnails at mixed widths and heights with 8px gaps and a two-part micro caption (name left, year right) under each.
End with the wordmark at full page width on a colour field, with all utility links reduced to a tiny caps bar split by vertical hairlines.
media: A 6s muted showreel covers the whole first screen with the nav and title on it and no scrim. Below: an asymmetric top-aligned mosaic of three tile widths (5, 7 and 12 of 24 columns) reshuffled each row with captions under, small inline thumbnails between words of a large paragraph, clips cut into geometric clip-path shapes, a full-bleed photo band with a marquee across its lower edge, and a glossy 3D cube drifting over text and the footer, all at 0px radius under a grain layer that steps every second.
motion: A brief ultramarine preloader with a tilted card, then the header and title slide and scale in over 0.5s after a 0.75s delay while the reel carries the motion. Lenis with CSS scroll-driven animations reveals blocks on the scroll timeline, parallaxes figures by 5 to 25svh, translates stacked assets in over 0.75s with a per-item delay and slides a giant sentence left with the scroll, all on one house ease, cubic-bezier(.26,1,.48,1), at 0.5s, with 29 reduced-motion rules.

name: The Sapphic Bar Index
idea: A nightlife guide dressed as a mock research dossier: taped snapshots, field notes, sticker stamps and a big numeric score for every bar.
hero: The desktop capture caught the hero before it animated in (only an empty two-cell box and a black bar show); the mobile capture, which is the desktop layout scaled down, reveals it. On cream: a two-cell outlined masthead box top-left, then the title in black ultra-condensed caps on three lines filling the left 45%, with a pink boarding-pass ticket and a round stamp overlapping it at angles. Small text and a black rounded button sit beneath. The right half holds a tall torn-edge photograph of a hand raising a cocktail, taped at the top, tilted about 8 degrees and running off the top edge, a paper-clipped note on its corner.
type: Three custom faces per the digest: a tall heavy condensed grotesque for the 119px title, a typewriter-style mono (61% of text) for bar names in bold caps, labels and notes, and a small sans for intro copy at 12px. Scores are heavy rounded numerals near 48px.
colour: #f4efe9 #000000 #f5a3b7 #2f62d6 #f2622a #f2b632 — Cream paper and black ink carry the page. Saturated colour arrives only as sticker badges (pink, orange, yellow, blue, sage) and neon-lit photos, then a pink form card, black about panel and cobalt footer strip.
imagery: Flash-lit nightlife snapshots with magenta and red neon casts, cropped near-square with torn or deckled edges and a strip of masking tape, each tilted a few degrees; plus die-cut sticker illustrations (stamps, tickets, lips, scissors) with thick outlines.
layout: Cream page with roughly 6% side margins. After the collage hero, a row of five stickers, then a ruled table where each entry is a four-column row between full-width hairlines. It ends with a coupon-style form, a black rounded about panel and a marquee strip.

sections.description: Full-width rows separated by 1px rules, each about 210px tall. Column one: a tilted taped snapshot about 150px square. Column two: a small index number, the bar name in bold mono caps, a pin icon with underlined district and a social handle, three lines of small mono description, then one or two small coloured sticker tags. Column three: a bold label over five bullet lines. Column four: a small label above a two-digit score in heavy numerals inside a thin circle.

A legend row of five die-cut badges spaced evenly across the column directly under the hero, each a different silhouette and colour: pink oval, orange rounded rectangle with notched corners, yellow ticket, blue star, sage triangle. Each has a thick dark outline, a slight rotation and two lines of condensed caps inside. Smaller rectangular versions are reused as category tags in the list rows.

Submission form as a clip-out coupon: a pink rounded card inside a thin outlined frame, with a large beige paper cut-out of scissors overlapping the top-left corner. Left half holds a three-line mono caps heading and one line of text; a vertical dashed line divides it from the right half, which has four underline-only inputs with grey placeholders and a full-width black submit bar.

Black full-width panel with a large top radius. The left third holds a small bold mono label and four short white mono paragraphs with an icon link. The right half shows a selfie photograph with torn paper edges and tape, tilted clockwise, a pink lips sticker overlapping its top-left corner. A cobalt strip beneath repeats a one-line credit across the full width.

steal: Give every list row a large circled numeric score in its own right-hand column so a directory reads as a ranking.
Present photos as taped, torn-edge snapshots rotated a few degrees, repeating the same tape detail on every image for consistency.
Define a small set of die-cut sticker badges once as a legend, then reuse them in miniature as category tags in the rows.

name: Textmode Overlay
idea: The whole site is rendered in the product's medium: one bitmap face and live character-art fields, laid out like a terminal instrument panel with a numbered rail.
hero: Black viewport framed like an instrument panel. A 60px top bar with a hairline beneath: wordmark and version left, four small caps links right, a cream block button filling the bar's right end. A narrow right-edge rail lists 01 to 10 vertically; the active number extends leftward as an outlined label tab. The main area is a canvas of dim grey character marks with a few red ones, small caps captions in its top corners. The headline, two lines of cream pixel caps at 11vw, is left-aligned at mid-height, its last word in a slanted variant. Below a hairline, a bottom strip holds a short description left and two wide rectangular buttons.
type: Monogram Extended, a bitmap face, for 96% of text: 160px headline caps, 24px body, small caps labels, one weight, with a slanted variant for the accent word. Inter appears only in the cookie dialog. Hierarchy comes from size and case alone.
colour: #0a0a0a #f2f2ec #3b3b3b #b11226 #9a9a95 — Black with cream text and mid-grey glyph texture. Deep crimson appears as scattered characters, soft radial glows behind panels and slider fills. The last two sections invert to cream with black type.
imagery: Live canvas renderings: a swirling white, grey and red brush-stroke animation shown beside its character-art conversion, plus ambient character fields as backgrounds. Square corners, hairline frames, no photographs.
layout: Full-width panel grid drawn with 1px lines: 32px margins, a persistent right rail, sections built from bordered cells (three equal columns, a two-by-three spec table beside a wide panel, control strips). Each section starts with a small slash-separated caption and a large caps heading.

sections.description: A wide bordered frame split vertically by a draggable handle: the left half shows the source animation (thick white, grey and crimson swirls on black), the right half the same frame converted to scattered characters, with small outlined tags in the top corners naming each side. Beneath, a control strip of bordered cells offers segmented options (cell size in four steps with the active one filled cream, glyph set, invert, motion), like a hardware panel.

Three equal tall columns divided by hairlines inside one outer frame, each about 300px high. A single caps word sits at mid-left of each column in roughly 36px pixel type and two lines of small text sit at the bottom-left. A soft crimson radial glow is centred behind the middle column and fades into the outer two, the only shading in the section.

Left 40%: a two-by-three table of bordered cells, each with a tiny index number top-left, a caps feature name at mid-left and a small grey quantity bottom-right. Right 60%: one large cell with a two-line caps heading upper-left, a crimson glow in the top-right corner and two lines of description along the bottom. The rail tab at the right edge names the section.

The close inverts to cream: a pale character field with a faint red cluster at upper right, a slash-separated caption, then a two-line black pixel-caps headline at about 8vw that echoes the hero and reuses the slanted last word, and one small outlined rectangular button. Footer links follow in three small columns on the same cream ground.

steal: Add a fixed right-edge rail of section numbers where the active number sprouts a labelled tab into the content area.
Draw the page as bordered cells with 1px lines and put a tiny index top-left and a small quantity bottom-right in each feature cell.
End on an inverted, light-ground repeat of the hero headline so the close mirrors the opening in the opposite palette.

name: Hebbia
idea: An AI-finance company's in-house design team presents itself as a luxury print house: inscriptional serif capitals on near-black, a ledger-ruled specimen table of its output, and a paper invitation card to recruit.
hero: Near-black viewport, roughly 90% empty. A tiny sans wordmark sits top-centre and one text link top-right; there is no other navigation. The statement is three centred lines of white serif capitals stacked in the middle of the screen: a seven-letter word, a two-letter word, then a long word in italic with a full stop, giving a wide, narrow, wider silhouette about 55% of the viewport across at its widest. Capital height is roughly a tenth of the viewport height with tight leading. Along the bottom edge a full-width framed strip shows the top 60px of a chrome 3D render, announcing the next section.
type: Edict carries nearly everything: roman capitals for statements, a swash italic with flourished terminals for the second half of the section title, small caps for credits. Selecta, a grotesk, only for the wordmark, nav link and tiny tracked uppercase labels. Body copy is small, centred and sparse.
colour: #0a0a0a #ffffff #1c1818 #efebe2 #2a35c9 #b0703c — Near-black field with pure white type. Colour arrives only through thumbnails (electric blue, copper, amber sunsets) and one cream paper card; the footer warms to a brown-black.
imagery: Chrome and copper 3D 'ingot' renders, line-screen and ASCII portraits, dark product-UI crops, warm cinematic photographs and a film-still video. All are small square-cornered tiles floating in ruled cells; only the hero render strip runs full width.
layout: One centred axis with thin full-width frames a few pixels inside the viewport edge. Sequence: type poster, letterboxed video, centred title ringed by tiny labels, four-column ruled table of tiles, tilted paper card, sparse credits footer. Large empty gaps separate every section.

sections.description: Section title set as four centred lines at one size: two in roman capitals, two in swash italic, with a small inline image chip tucked between two words and a red wax-seal-like dot beside the colon. Six tiny tracked uppercase labels sit in a 3x2 arrangement above and below the block at left, centre and right, like plate captions. A two-line sans paragraph is centred well below, after a gap as tall as the title.

A four-column table bounded by hairlines. Each column is headed by a serif label in a cell with a soft coloured glow behind it (grey-blue, neutral, warm, bronze). Under each header runs a vertical stack of one tile per row, centred in its cell with generous padding; tile sizes and aspect ratios vary (portrait, landscape, square) so the grid reads as a specimen sheet. The header row appears to stay pinned while rows scroll beneath it.

A cream textured-paper card about 70% of the page width, rotated a degree or two, with a thin inset keyline border. Inside: an underlined serif small-caps heading centred at the top, a group photograph, and a list of names in small caps separated by middots. It sits on the black field like a printed invitation and is cropped by the fold rather than framed whole.

A mostly empty warm-black screen: a small folder icon centred at 60% height, three lines of tiny serif caps credit beneath it, and at the very bottom a one-line ticker of small-caps facts separated by dots, with an oversized italic two-word phrase overlapping the ticker's centre.

steal: Set a three-line statement in serif capitals and italicise only the last word, so emphasis comes from slant rather than colour or weight.
Present mixed work as a ruled table: named columns divided by hairlines, one tile per cell at varying aspect ratios, header row pinned.
Break a dark page with one physical object, a slightly rotated textured-paper card with an inset keyline, and put the call to action on it.

name: Revelatio Studio
idea: The team photograph is the hero: it starts as a small CRT-curved mosaic of typographic glyphs and resolves into a full-bleed group portrait as you scroll.
hero: Pure black viewport. Centred, about 58% of the width and 57% of the height, is a canvas showing a group photo rebuilt from tiny coloured glyphs, its edges barrel-distorted like a CRT tube; it is dim, so black dominates. The headline is modest: two lines at 2.5vw in regular-weight grotesk, flush to the bottom-left corner with a 30px margin. Navigation is split into two small dark-grey rounded rectangles: logo mark plus four links top-left, language switch and contact top-right. Nothing else; roughly 80% of the screen is black.
type: Neue Haas Grotesk Text 55 Roman is the only face and weight. Headline just 36px with -0.03em tracking against 15px body; hierarchy comes from position and grey value. The footer city list jumps to roughly 5vw; the digest records a 12.5vw maximum.
colour: #000000 #ffffff #2b2b2b #8a8a8a — Black intro and footer, white work and capabilities sections. The interface has no accent; all colour comes from project thumbnails and the faint tints inside the glyph mosaic.
imagery: A studio group portrait rendered as a glyph mosaic on canvas, then as a dim near-full-bleed photograph; project tiles are square-cornered brand visuals in saturated flat colours, set on white with caption rows beneath.
layout: About 30px side margins throughout. Black full-screen opening, then a white work grid mixing one large tile with a narrow companion and a three-up row, a three-column plain-text capabilities list, and a black footer of oversized dim text. Captions sit under images, tags right-aligned.

sections.description: Pinned for about two viewports: the hero canvas grows with scroll from a centred 58%-wide mosaic to a near full-bleed image with a thin black margin, while the glyph cells shrink until the picture reads as a dim photograph of about twenty people. The headline scrolls away and only the two nav boxes remain in the top corners.

White background. First row: one large landscape tile spanning roughly two-thirds of the width beside a narrower tile about one-third wide and half as tall, top-aligned. Second row: three equal tiles. All square-cornered with about 16px gutters. Beneath each: project name at left, two tiny grey tags right-aligned on the same line, then a two-line grey description at about 11px. A small underlined see-all link with an arrow sits below the grid at left.

White section opened by a hairline and a tiny label. Three text columns, each with a small grey category title and beneath it a tight stack of eight to ten service names in 15px regular grotesk at about 1.2 line-height, with no bullets, icons or cards. Columns share the work grid's left edges, leaving the right third partly empty.

Black full-viewport block filled with a run-on, comma-separated list of client cities set at about 5vw in very dark grey, barely visible against black, wrapping over seven flush-left lines. Exactly one city, the last, is lit white, which implies a cycling highlight. The nav boxes stay fixed at the top corners.

steal: Render a photograph as a grid of small coloured glyphs on canvas and let scroll increase its size and resolution until it becomes the real photo.
Hold the hero headline at 2.5vw in a bottom corner and let a dim central image and empty black carry the scale.
Set a long list in near-invisible dark grey at display size and light one item at a time.
media: A centred 16:10 canvas covering 60% of the width and height plays the team film as a dot matrix with a curved, tube-like outline, and grows to cover the whole screen over three screens of scroll. Below: an asymmetric two-plus-one then three-up grid of 16:9 work cards (video players scaled to 133% of the card so the letterboxing is cropped), a cursor image trail over a pinned city list, a draggable marquee of result cards, and a slider of cards with staggered image heights bleeding off the right edge; square corners.
motion: No preloader was seen and the hero is composed at 400ms (load 23s); Lenis then holds two sticky 900px stages, the hero screen scaling from 60% to full bleed over 2700px and one city at a time lighting up over 3600px. The ground flips black, white, black by section with a 0.35s ease on colour across about 11,000 nodes, stat numerals roll like an odometer, and transforms run 0.4s on cubic-bezier(0.625,0.05,0,1) with 0.8s exits on (0.625,0,0.875,0).

name: HAOQI.DESIGN
idea: A design engineer's page built like an instrumented canvas: visible construction grid with crosshairs, live coordinates and clock, and a glossy 3D greeting that plays with the cursor.
hero: Deep cobalt field with soft darker diagonal blurs. Faint guide lines divide the screen into three columns and three rows, with small plus marks at intersections. Top row: wordmark left, four mono nav items right. Second row: a two-line role title left, a two-line mono motto centre, a four-line mono bio right. Centre: glossy inflated 3D script reading hello, about 60% of viewport width, with a 3D cursor arrow lower right. The headline, three uppercase lines of wide bold sans at 5.6vw, is flush left in the lower third and tucks under the lettering. Bottom edge: mono time and weather left, cursor coordinates centre, globe icon right.
type: A wide bold sans (digest name 'tiktok') in uppercase for the 80px headline and closing statement; a regular cut at about 34px for the about text; tronica-mono and a system mono at 12 to 16px for nav, bio, captions and readouts. Three clear sizes; mono does half the talking.
colour: #0f1111 #07144a #ffffff #2a3fe0 #c6f432 — The hero is a saturated cobalt field with tone-on-tone blue 3D; everything after sits on blue-black with white text. Lime appears only as tiny tags and scramble glyphs; project tiles bring their own colours.
imagery: Glossy tone-on-tone 3D lettering and cursor in the hero; a square portrait with teal rim light; project thumbnails as square-cornered tiles of UI shots, icon sheets and posters; a neon radial line burst in the footer.
layout: A fixed frame of hairline columns with crosshair ticks persists behind every section, as do the corner readouts. Content snaps to those columns: about text spans the right two-thirds, work tiles occupy one or two columns at irregular heights with deliberately empty cells.

sections.description: Blue-black background with the guide grid showing. A square portrait about 12% of viewport width sits at the top of the first column, with a handwritten lime signature scrawled across its top-left corner. Starting at the second column line, a paragraph at about 2.4vw in regular sans runs four lines in white, followed by a second paragraph in mid-grey where only linked product names are white and underlined. No heading or label.

Tiles snap to the guide grid but vary in span and height: one wide tile covering two columns, then pairs of single-column tiles, with whole cells left empty so rows stagger. Tiles are square-cornered images on black or pastel grounds. Under each, a mono caption row at about 10px: project name left, year and a category with arrow right. Some tiles carry a small lime tag flush to the top-right corner.

Full-viewport black panel filled with a radial burst of thin neon lines in cyan, violet and magenta streaking outward from centre like a warp tunnel. Centred on top, a three-line uppercase statement in the wide bold sans at about 5.5vw, white, tightly leaded. The grid lines, nav and corner readouts remain overlaid at the edges.

steal: Leave the layout grid visible as hairlines with plus marks at intersections and snap every block to it, so the scaffolding becomes the ornament.
Put live readouts (local time, temperature, cursor x and y) in the corners in mono to make a static page feel instrumented.
Render the hero object in the same hue as the background so it reads through gloss and shadow rather than colour contrast.
media: One fixed Three.js canvas covers 100% of the fold and stays behind the whole page, its scene changing by chapter: blue silk with an inflated 3D word about 60% of the width and a 3D pointer, a near-black ground under the work, a warp-speed tunnel for the manifesto. The pictures are a square portrait with a signature drawn over its corner and about twelve project images in a staggered mosaic of 315, 537 and 870px cards hung from either side of a grid column; no video.
motion: After a 6.6s load the claim decodes line by line from random lime glyphs into white letters, still unfinished at 4.5s, and the bio types in at 0.23s per character behind a blinking caret. Lenis moves the DOM over the fixed canvas: the pointer moves to a new place per chapter, the signature draws stroke by stroke on cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1), work cards fade up from a grey placeholder over 0.5s, and the manifesto title holds while its last line swaps; 4 reduced-motion rules.

name: Pensatori Irrazionali
idea: The client roster becomes the hero object, a 3D sheaf of logo-printed fabric ribbons, and classical Italian ornament (copperplate script, engravings, tricolour) is collided with plain Helvetica.
archetype: other: offset 3d object with bottom-left statement
hero: Flat pale-grey field (#f5f5f5). A 3D-rendered bundle of woven fabric ribbons, each a different saturated colour and printed with a client logo, streams diagonally from beyond the top-right corner down to about centre-left, covering roughly the right two-thirds and bleeding off the top and right edges. Top-left: a small engraved lion crest with serif wordmark and a green-white-red bar. Top-right: two dark square icon buttons with chamfered corners. Bottom-left, in the lowest fifth: a tiny '+ (Atelier)' label above a three-line grey intro paragraph at about 36px, half the viewport wide. No headline and no call to action; the left third is empty.
type: Helvetica Now at regular weight does nearly everything, tracking -0.025em, sentence case, from 14px body to 60px menu links. Section titles pair it with huge hairline copperplate script words, and the footer wordmark is a heavy high-contrast serif at about 18vw.
colour: #f5f5f5 #434343 #292828 #e9e9e9 #e3342a #2bd92b — One pale grey ground throughout with charcoal rather than black text. Saturated colour is confined to the ribbon render and project images, plus a green and red flag underline and one neon-green dot.
imagery: Hero 3D render of logo-printed textile ribbons; black engraved illustrations (angel, Pegasus, lion) cut out and placed inside headings; dark-grey map silhouettes; square-cornered project stills in a horizontal row.
layout: Narrow 48px side margins with content hung on a loose two-column split at 50%. Sections alternate between oversized title bands that bleed off both edges and small hairline-ruled tabular lists, with generous blank grey between blocks.

sections.description: A title band runs edge to edge as one line: a hairline copperplate script word about 250px tall cropped by the left edge, a tiny superscript '(01)', a black engraving of an angel dropped in like an inline glyph, then a grotesk phrase at 90px running off the right edge. Beneath, two columns of client rows: name at about 40px, a tiny grey category label, the client's logo mark, a small arrow, each row closed by a hairline.

A grid of five columns by two rows of equal cells with faint 1px borders, each holding one small monochrome client logo, centred. Directly below, a wide empty band works as a map: a dark-grey country silhouette crops in at each side edge, with a two-line place name at 32px bottom-left and another bottom-right, each with tiny coordinates in parentheses underneath.

The same script-plus-engraving title band, now with a Pegasus and '(02)'. Below, a two-column table headed by tiny 'Number' and 'Service' labels over a hairline: the left column shows a giant hairline script numeral about 200px tall; the right holds a small '+ (Branding)' label, a service name with a neon-green dot, and ruled rows pairing a term at left with a grey descriptor right-aligned.

The first word of the name in a heavy high-contrast serif spans the full width and crops at the right edge (about 18vw), with a green underline under its left half and red under its right. Behind and below, the second word in giant pale-grey gradient script overlaps the serif letters. Under that, small columns: menu links at 18px, contact details at 11px, legal links at right.

steal: Turn the client-logo list into one physical object (logos printed on a rendered bundle of ribbons) so proof becomes the hero image instead of a logo strip.
Build section titles as one edge-to-edge line mixing a hairline script word, an inline engraved illustration and a plain grotesk phrase at similar height.
Keep the page on one pale grey with charcoal text and let colour enter only through imagery and a single flag-coloured underline on the footer wordmark.
media: A 3D cluster of logo-printed fabric ribbons covers about 60% of the first screen, bleeding off the top and right with the statement docked bottom-left. Below: engravings inserted between the words of a title marquee, hidden 16:9 previews behind a client index, three-up 16:9 tile rows overflowing the right edge as carousels, a single centred 16:9 video with wide ground either side, a staggered two-row collage bleeding off both edges, and map silhouettes cropped at the page edges; 39 images and 9 muted 16:9 videos, never under text.
motion: About 3-4s of intro after a 13.3s load: an inset crest card where a 2.25s fill keyframe runs, a white flash, the ribbons, then the copy de-blurring. Lenis with no pins: titles run as endless marquees, media rows are carousels, and content fades back in over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) after each scroll step; coordinates roll digit by digit over 900ms on a spring-shaped linear() curve (157 WAAPI calls), and the manifesto letters roll up from doubled glyphs.

name: Architecture of Socialist-Era Belgrade
idea: A two-colour printed guidebook on screen: signal-red type over greyscale concrete, with one modular display face as the only ornament.
hero: Full-bleed greyscale photograph of brutalist housing towers; pale sky fills the top half, concrete the bottom. The title is set over the sky, flush left at a 32px margin, three lines in a wide modular display face at 102px (7.1vw) in flat red, the longest line reaching 92% of the width, leading so tight that the lines almost touch. Under it, one row at 24px: a red one-line descriptor at left, and two paler-red facts right-aligned (an object count and a date range). Top-right, the word 'Index' with a diagonal arrow. No logo, no button, nothing else. Red and grey only.
type: IntraNet, a wide modular display face with rounded, notched corners, used only for the title and its footer repeat. Funnel Sans carries the rest: about 50px for the long intro, 40px bold uppercase entry titles, 24px meta, 13px credits. Four sizes, two faces.
colour: #f53843 #d1d1d1 #c7c7c7 #777777 #f1a7ab — Strictly red and grey: red text on grey photo or grey paper, then pale grey text on a solid red field for the essay and footer. Photographs are desaturated so nothing breaks the pair.
imagery: Contemporary black-and-white architectural photographs of concrete towers and complexes, frontal or looking up, with big skies and visible grain; full-bleed in the hero, full column width and square-cornered in entries.
layout: 16 to 32px margins, everything flush left. A long red essay block in very large text, then twenty repeated entry blocks on grey: a two-column header split by a vertical red hairline, a meta row, then a wide photo. 81 screens of the same rhythm.

sections.description: Immediately under the hero photo a solid red field begins with no gap. The essay runs as one full-width column in pale grey sans at roughly 50px with tight leading, about 50 characters per line, paragraphs separated by one blank line, with no headings, pull-quotes or images for several screens. The photo's bottom edge butts straight against the red.

Each building entry sits on light grey paper: a thin red rule across the top, then two columns divided by a vertical red hairline at the 50% mark. Left: the building's name in red bold uppercase at 40px over two lines. Right: its dates in pale red at the same size. Below, a small meta row with 'Credits' and 'Address' labels and values in 13px red, then a full-width greyscale photograph.

Solid red. At the top, two short 13px notes side by side in pale grey occupy the left 60%, a back-to-top link sits far right, and a third note runs beneath. A tall empty red gap follows. Then the full title is repeated in the display face at hero size but in pale grey, flush left, above a single row of small meta: sources link left, font credits centre, city and year right.

steal: Limit the page to one saturated colour and one grey, desaturate all photos, and invert the pair (grey on red) for long reading blocks.
Set the title in a distinctive modular display face directly on the sky area of a photo and repeat it in the footer in the inverse colour.
Put facts in the hero as a right-aligned row of paler-tint figures (count, date range) on the same baseline as the subtitle.

name: Tengile Malamala Collection
idea: Let the land and animals carry everything: one staggered hairline-serif headline over aerial footage, then cream pages of olive-green serif text with photographs placed at uneven sizes.
hero: Aerial river footage fills the viewport, slightly darkened. Three small white caps items sit on the top edge: an enquiry link hard left, a stacked three-line wordmark centred, 'menu' hard right. The headline is two words on two lines in thin serif capitals about 8.3vw tall: the first line starts 10% from the left, the second is indented to 40% and ends near 90%, so the pair steps diagonally across the middle third. Below, starting at the 50% line, a three-line serif sentence at about 20px and a small white square-cornered button with a separate arrow square beside it. The lower third is left to the water.
type: PP Fragment at hairline weight (220): capitals for the 120px headline, sentence case for 28-36px olive statements. Inter at 11-16px for labels, nav and small paragraphs. Three serif sizes, two sans sizes; the serif never goes bold.
colour: #f5eee9 #5c6e21 #181608 #e3e1d4 #ffffff — Warm cream page with every word, large or small, in one olive green; the footer inverts to a solid olive field with cream text. Photography supplies all other colour.
imagery: Wildlife and lodge photography, natural and saturated, square corners, no overlays. Mixed aspect ratios placed at different widths and vertical offsets; lodge listings use equal landscape triplets; hero and closing band are full-bleed aerials.
layout: Narrow 16px outer margins and a twelve-column grid used asymmetrically: label and small paragraph in the left columns, the large statement starting at the midpoint. Sections alternate between loosely scattered image pairs and tidy three-up rows.

sections.description: Cream field. A tiny sans caps label top-left. A 28px olive serif paragraph of eight lines occupies only the right half, starting at the midpoint. Far below on the left, a five-line 12px sans paragraph about 180px wide. Images are placed loose: a landscape elephant photo under the right text, a tall leopard portrait lower at the left margin, a wide crop of elephant legs upper right of the next screen. No two share a top edge or width.

A tiny caps label, then an olive serif statement at about 36px running the full width for four lines. Beneath: a sub-label, a 12px paragraph held to a third of the width, then three equal landscape photos with 8px gutters spanning margin to margin, each captioned below in small serif. The same block repeats for a second category; one tile is dimmed with a short caps line laid over it to mark it as not yet open.

A full-bleed aerial of an elephant crossing a sandbank with a short serif statement, a small sans paragraph and the white button-plus-arrow pair set in the right half only. It butts directly against a solid olive footer: five columns of small cream links under tiny caps headings in the top third, a large empty green area beneath, and a legal line along the bottom edge.

steal: Stagger a two-line headline: first line from the left margin, second indented by 30% so the pair steps diagonally across the image.
Set every piece of text in a single brand colour on cream and make the footer that same colour as a solid field.
Split the button into two adjacent squares, label and arrow, with a 4px gap, small and square-cornered, instead of one pill.
media: A 10s muted aerial montage covers the whole first screen with type set on it and no visible scrim. Below: a split with an image and paragraph in the right half from the centre line, staggered image pairs with uneven heights and offsets, a three-up card row with captions, an inset full-width slider, a constellation of thumbnails round a centred heading, a slow portrait marquee, and a sticky full-bleed landscape with the closing call scrolling over it; 33 images, pictures oversized about 110% in their masks for drift.
motion: There is no preloader and only the montage cuts after 400ms, but under Lenis content stays hidden until each reveal fires: blocks rise and sharpen from a blur over 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), others fade with a filter over 1s cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1), pictures drift inside their masks, and the closing landscape holds on a sticky root. The ground steps from cream to sage-beige to olive, and the marquee loops on 120s.

name: Boc.Studio
idea: A strip of orange tape: the logo ticker crosses a 3D glass-sphere film as a mid-screen band, then moves to the top edge and becomes the header of a filmstrip work index.
hero: A full-bleed 3D-rendered film: two large frosted-glass spheres with pink and lilac refractions on a dusty rose backdrop, one cropped by the left edge, the other filling most of the right half. The only overlay is a flat orange-red band, 60px tall, spanning the full width exactly at mid-height. Inside it a marquee repeats in black: the wordmark at about 34px, then two tiny two-line captions (what the studio is; coordinates and city), about two and a half repeats across the screen. No navigation, headline or button on desktop; mobile adds a small outlined 'click to enter' pill near the bottom.
type: PP Mori only, regular weight, -0.02em. The largest text on the site is 28px (2vw): the wordmark and the sidebar words. Captions run 11-12px. The scale is deliberately tiny; images, not type, carry size.
colour: #181d21 #f04a23 #b48c85 #ffffff #6b7278 — Dark blue-slate page with one hot orange-red used only as a solid bar: the ticker band in the intro, then a 20px header strip. Project imagery supplies all other colour.
imagery: The intro is a glossy 3D glass render. Work appears as rows of same-height, mixed-width thumbnails (posters, photos, packaging, type specimens) butted with 8px gaps, square corners, the last one cut by the right edge.
layout: A fixed left sidebar about 190px wide holds the section name and filter; the remaining width is a stack of horizontal filmstrips, one per project, each about 190px tall and separated only by a one-line caption. No section breaks.

sections.description: Dark slate page. The left 13% is a fixed column: the section name at 28px, under it 'All' in white and 'Filter +' in grey. To the right each project is one horizontal strip of four to six images, all 190px tall at their own widths, 8px apart, the last cut by the right edge. Under each strip one 11px line: project name flush left, a short descriptor at centre, a link flush right. About 45px separates strips, so four projects fit per screen.

Header strip. After the intro the orange band shrinks to a 20px bar fixed to the top edge: wordmark at the left, an 'info' link with a circled plus a quarter of the way across, and local time plus a one-word status at the far right, all at 10px in black. It is the page's only chrome and the only flat colour that is not an image.

steal: Run the logo and descriptor as a marquee inside one solid-colour band across the middle of a full-bleed video, then reuse that band as the fixed header.
Show each project as a filmstrip: several images at one fixed height and natural widths in a single row, with a three-part caption line (name left, descriptor centre, link right) beneath.
Cap all type at 28px and let image rows carry the scale; a small fixed filter sidebar removes the need for any heading.
media: A gate of one full-bleed project key visual (the whole viewport) crossed by a 60px orange marquee band, then one horizontal film strip per project: same-height, mixed-width stills at 189px with 15px gutters, drifting on time-based loops and masked to the content column beside a sticky rail. 406 img elements from duplicated tracks; no video or canvas.
motion: A flat orange screen for about 4.5s, then the gate; on entry the band thins to a stripe, traces the frame edge and settles as the 38px sticky nav, and the rows fade in over 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). The movement is time-based rather than scroll-based: each strip is a CSS marquee of a duplicated track at its own speed, from 18s to 123s per loop; 9 reduced-motion rules.

name: Gil Huybrecht
idea: A portfolio as a contact sheet: every project is a numbered run of miniature page screenshots on black, and all text is set at one small size.
hero: Black field on a seven-column grid with 14px margins. The top band is plain white text at one size, about 16px: name in column one, availability in column two, a services list from column three, a longer awards list from column five, then 'Profile' and 'Email me' at the right. List items are indented one step under their label. Below the lists roughly 300px of black is left empty. At mid-height the thumbnail grid begins: one small website screenshot per column, about 190px wide, each topped by a number at its right corner, with the project name over the first of each run. Two tiny toggle chips sit in the bottom corners.
type: One neo-grotesk at a single size, about 16px (1.1vw), medium-bold with tight tracking, white on black, for everything: name, lists, labels, numbers, footer. There is no headline; hierarchy comes only from column position and indentation.
colour: #000000 #fcfcfc #272727 #8a8a8a — Pure black with white text; the only colour is whatever appears inside the screenshot thumbnails. Inactive toggle words drop to mid-grey on a dark grey chip.
imagery: Miniature full-page captures of the designer's client sites, uncropped at natural aspect ratios, square corners, no frames or shadows, about 190px wide, sitting directly on black.
layout: Seven equal columns with 14px gutters and margins for the whole page. Thumbnails align to columns but not to rows: each hangs from its own label at its own height, so bottoms are ragged. Projects flow continuously and wrap across rows.

sections.description: A seven-column field of screenshot thumbnails on black. Each project is a consecutive run of four to six thumbnails; the project name sits above the first, and every thumbnail carries its sequence number right-aligned above it in the same 16px white. Thumbnails keep their real proportions, so a row mixes 100px-tall and 280px-tall items with ragged bottoms and about 90px of black between rows. Runs break mid-row and continue on the next line with no divider.

View toggles. Two fixed chip pairs sit in the viewport's bottom corners: the left switches between a grid and a gallery view, the right between a normal and a novelty perspective mode. Each pair is a small dark-grey rounded rectangle containing two words, the active one white and the inactive grey, at the same 16px as all other text.

After about a screen of empty black, one band of text on the same seven columns: year and privacy link stacked at the left, then two columns of stacked social links, then two single links toward the right edge. Same size and weight as the header, no rule, no logo.

steal: Set every piece of text on the page at one size and weight and build hierarchy only from column position and a one-step indent under labels.
Show projects as numbered runs of uncropped page screenshots at natural heights on a strict column grid, leaving the bottoms ragged.
Leave a deliberate 300px void between the text header and the first row of work so the lists read as a letterhead.
media: A contact-sheet wall: one fixed WebGL canvas draws about 84 full-page screenshots of client sites at a single 190px width and their native ratios, every page of each project in reading order. Once scrolled, every screen is about three rows, roughly 48% picture and 52% black, with text under 1% and the labels above each frame, never on it; there is no video.
motion: The preloader counts at about 13% a second for some 7-8s while the screenshot textures load, although the document loaded in 1.66s; then the first-row thumbnails rise into their slots in random order and a dark veil lifts. Lenis over a 4440px scroll proxy redraws the fixed wall with no pins or reveals; panel and hover moves use transform .75s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), and pictures fade over 1s ease-out on the phone.

name: City of Angels
idea: A fixed poster: the book title stays pinned across the viewport while portraits and press quotes swap underneath it, so every scroll step is a new cover.
hero: Pale icy-blue page. The title runs as one line of extra-bold uppercase grotesk at 10vw, centred, spanning about 82% of the width in saturated cyan, 120px from the top. A single portrait photograph, 37% of the viewport wide and nearly full height, is centred beneath; the title crosses over its upper quarter, so the middle letters sit on the image. The author name sits top-centre in small bold caps, a two-bar menu icon top-right. Bottom-left, a 13-line bold paragraph in a narrow 340px column; bottom-right, a solid black five-point star about 70px wide.
type: ABC Diatype throughout: weight 800 uppercase for the 144px title, bold copy around 20-24px with leading near 1.0; Founders Grotesk Mono in tiny caps for quote attributions. Two sizes plus a label. The final frame catches title letters slanting to oblique.
colour: #e4f8fd #06aeef #0a0a0a #c8b59d — The page colour is a pale tint of the title's cyan; cyan appears only on the title, the opening words and quotation marks. Text and star are black. The digest records one solid cyan section.
imagery: Full-length street-style portraits, all vertical at about 2:3, saturated natural light, subject standing centre. One image at a time, square corners, centred on the page with the title overprinting it.
layout: One pinned composition repeated for seven screens: central image column, fixed title, and a single text block that alternates between the left and right gutters and shifts height each step. Margins about 46px; nothing else on screen.

sections.description: Each scroll step keeps the pinned title and swaps the central portrait. One press quote sits in a column 180-340px wide in an outer gutter, alternating right, left, right, and placed at a different height each time (upper, middle, lower). Quotes are bold black with tight leading and cyan quotation marks; the source follows in tiny underlined or mono caps. The black star stays bottom-right and is caught at different rotation angles.

Not captured in the shots, but the digest records four stacked, centred, uppercase links at 144px (10vw) in the same extra-bold grotesk, plus a solid cyan section: navigation reuses the title's exact type size, one link per line, so the menu is another poster rather than a small list.

steal: Pin one giant title across the viewport and let a single centred image change beneath it, with the type overprinting the photo's top quarter.
Use a pale tint of the accent colour as the page background so the saturated title and the background read as one hue.
Give each scroll step one text block and move it between left and right gutters at varying heights instead of stacking sections.

name: ERA Residence
idea: One continuous 3D render of the estate that the scroll flies through, titled like a perfume label with condensed didone capitals and an overlapping script signature.
hero: The captured first viewport is an intro curtain: a deep aubergine field with a hairline frame inset 22px and chamfered corners. At centre, a two-line title in tall condensed didone caps at about 6vw, with a thin script place-name overlapping its lower edge at an upward angle. On the same line, two wide-letterspaced caps words sit a third of the way in from each side. A ghost script word, barely lighter than the field, spans the full width behind. Flower mark top-centre; a 90px vertical hairline and two lines of tiny extended caps bottom-centre. It opens onto a full-bleed render with the same lockup at 12vw across the sky.
type: ambroise-francois, a tall condensed didone, in uppercase from 6vw to 12vw with slightly negative tracking; a thin flourished script overlapping it for the place-name; Maison Neue Extended in tiny bold caps for labels and nav. Extreme jump: 170px titles against 9-10px labels.
colour: #340c24 #1e4fa3 #f3f3ec #b5cedb #58b5c2 #ffffff — Aubergine bookends the page (intro and footer); in between, the render's saturated sky blue is the field and all type is white. The digest also records pale blue and off-white sections.
imagery: Full-bleed architectural visualisation of white terraced houses, bougainvillea, palms and a pool with staged figures, heavily saturated. Small circular hotspots sit on buildings; a strip of render appears as an inset crop above the footer.
layout: Stage-like: fixed corner furniture (rotating-text seal top-left, three-line text menu top-right, vertical progress line with a number at the left edge, scroll cue bottom-left) surrounds a centred title while the picture moves for many screens.

sections.description: The scroll pushes the camera forward through the same scene: the title lockup slides up and off the top edge, the terrace row grows, and a turquoise pool with figures enters the foreground, ending with sun loungers cropped by the bottom edge. Thin circular hotspot rings mark buildings. A two-line tiny-caps call to action sits centred near the bottom inside a large hairline circle, about 250px wide on mobile.

Back on aubergine. The flower mark is centred, and under it the sales phone number is set as the headline in condensed didone figures at about 9vw, centred. Three lines of tiny extended caps give the address beneath. Legal lines sit lower left of centre and a credit at lower right, all at label size; the fixed seal, text menu and a vertical line with a back-to-top label stay at the edges.

steal: Overlap a thin script word across the bottom edge of condensed didone capitals, angled upward, like a signature on a label.
Split a tagline into two halves and place them left and right of the centred title on one baseline.
Set the phone number as the footer's headline in the display face instead of a slogan.
media: A photoreal render of the development covers the whole first screen once an arched window, rising from the preloader, has opened to full bleed. Below, a pinned full-bleed render with a slow drift, a flat-colour arch panel rising over it, cut-out bougainvillea video sprays bleeding off the corners of text screens, a portrait in a horizontal track, a cloud band that parts into an aerial photograph and a staggered two-column mosaic; 27 images and 8 square muted loops, 0px radius.
motion: The intro runs about 6-7s: an aubergine curtain, an arched window rising at 4.5s and widening, title letters dropping in with a stagger and a script word writing itself. Lenis with sticky pins: the hero holds for 4320px while the render travels from sky to pool, statement paragraphs fill from grey to navy word by word, the location chapter is a pinned horizontal track of about 3400px at scrub 0.25, and colour changes run 0.4s on cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); 986 split characters.

name: Sharplink
idea: A crypto treasury presented as precision hardware: chrome machined parts and glass capsules rendered in 3D on deep blue, overlaid with dashed machine-vision tracking boxes.
hero: Full-bleed video of exploded brushed-metal components floating on a navy-to-cobalt gradient, covered by a web of thin white dashed lines and small square tracking markers. Logo top-left on a 2% margin; top-right a segmented strip of five dark rectangular tabs in narrow uppercase plus an arrow square. The headline is top-left, two lines at 6.1vw in regular weight with -0.03em tracking, starting 18% down. Under it two stacked rectangular buttons: white with a blue arrow square attached, then a translucent dark one. Bottom row: a stock-exchange badge at left, a three-line lead paragraph at about 1.3vw starting 26% across, and bottom-right a translucent dark news card about 30% wide.
type: Archivo regular for headlines (88px in the hero, about 3vw in sections) and 16px body; Archivo Narrow in bold uppercase with wide tracking for nav, buttons and tiny labels. Headlines never go bold: hierarchy comes from size and from fading inactive items to grey.
colour: #050c17 #0e3f97 #e6edf7 #a7a8ab #1f6bff #ffffff — One blue family from near-black navy through cobalt to icy white; sections are vertical blue gradients, light or dark. Bright blue appears only as tiny square markers and arrow buttons; chrome grey from the renders.
imagery: Chrome and glass 3D objects (exploded device parts, a spike-tipped capsule holding icons) lit coolly, often with dashed annotation lines or shown as dotted wireframes; full-bleed in the hero, floating free at the right in later sections.
layout: 2% margins and square corners everywhere. Sections are full-viewport gradient fields with a headline at left and a 3D object or data card at right; lists run as label, title and paragraph in two columns. Tiny blue square bullets mark section starts.

sections.description: Light icy-gradient section. A two-line headline in grey-blue at about 3vw at the left, with a small paragraph far below it at bottom-left. Centre: a tall 3:4 card with a navy-to-cobalt vertical gradient, a tiny uppercase label, a rising line chart over a faint dotted grid, and a full-width dark button at its base. Right third: three faint, nearly transparent rows, each with a small numbered tag, one line of text and a ghosted line drawing.

Pinned list beside a 3D object. Left 60%: stacked rows, each with a tiny uppercase label, a two-line title at about 1.3vw in a first column and a short paragraph in a second column starting 26% across. Only the active row is at full contrast; the rest are dimmed to roughly 40%. Right 40%: a chrome-and-glass capsule about 80% of the viewport tall whose interior icon changes per row. The ground shifts from icy white to deep cobalt partway through.

A black panel inset by 2% on a navy ground with small blue square markers at its corners. Logo mark top-left; a two-line statement at about 2vw at the left, first line white and second line grey; two rectangular buttons below. A dotted wireframe version of the capsule fills the right half. Under the panel, a tiny uppercase label at left and a small button at right.

Cobalt gradient footer: a newsletter line with an underlined email field at left, three small link columns across the middle and right, exchange badge and legal microtext below. The wordmark closes the page in letters spanning the full width, cropped by the bottom edge and fading from white at the top to transparent.

steal: Overlay a 3D render with thin dashed lines and tiny square markers linking its parts, as if a vision system were tracking the object.
Build buttons as square-cornered rectangles with a separate coloured arrow square attached to the right edge.
In a pinned list beside a 3D object, dim every row except the active one and change what sits inside the object for each row.
media: A full-bleed 12s loop of 3D chrome and glass objects covers the whole fold, with text docked in the four corners straight on it. Below: a 3D capsule pinned in the right third while a list of claims scrolls on the left, its inner emblem swapping per row, a dark card sliding over it that turns the covered part into a dashed wireframe, a sticky portrait video of chrome pipes at the right edge, and a full-width wordmark canvas cropped by the bottom of the viewport; square corners throughout.
motion: The hero is composed at 400ms with the video playing and no preloader (load 21.3s), and Lenis runs four pins over fixed layers: one fixed gradient layer behind everything crossfades the grounds, the capsule stays pinned across three sections as each claim brightens from about 40% to full, and the manifesto fills character by character (423 split characters). The workhorse ease is cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955), on 57 observed opacity, background and colour transitions at .25-.3s.

name: Léo Parpeix - Portfolio 2026
