idea: A soft clay-rendered 3D world, a smiling flower in a sunlit gallery and a bee you can feed, carries the designer's personality while the type stays blunt and heavy.
hero: Opens on an empty off-white field with one object: a nearly square card about 28% of the viewport wide, centred, with rounded corners and tilted in 3D perspective, showing a grainy beige render of a smiling clay flower in front of a gridded window. There is no text at all. The card then scales up and flattens into a full-bleed 3D gallery room (flower on a plinth, pale wood floor, sky through tall windows) with a one-line 14px nav laid over it: name far left, role about one-eighth across, three links and a dots menu far right.
type: One family (digest name 'text') does everything: 14px regular for nav, captions and metadata, about 24px for intro sentences, and a bold geometric uppercase at 6 to 11vw with leading near 0.9 for centred three-line statements. Almost nothing sits between caption size and display size.
colour: #f7f7f7 #0d2a1c #e3d9ca #babeb7 #f6e016 #000000 — Off-white ground with display type in a near-black bottle green rather than black. The 3D scenes are beige and sky blue; the bee's yellow is the only saturated note; one later section turns fully yellow.
imagery: Custom clay-like 3D renders with film grain (flower, plinths, bee) and case-study mock-ups of laptops shot on stone or steel. Project images are square-cornered and laid edge to edge in a horizontal strip, with neighbours cut off by the viewport.
layout: Alternates full-bleed 3D, centred giant type on blank off-white, and an editorial block where intro text starts past the midpoint and the left half stays empty. The project strip bleeds off both edges; metadata sits beneath in widely spaced small columns.

sections.description: Blank off-white screen with three centred lines of bold uppercase in bottle green, each about 6vw tall with tight leading, the block about 60% of the viewport wide. A small glossy 3D bee hovers over the first line, overlapping the letters, with a soft grey shadow blob cast onto the second line. A tiny parenthesised instruction at 10px sits centred under the block. Nothing else on screen.

Text begins around 55% across: a three-line sentence at about 24px, then two short paragraphs at 14px indented further right, with an asterisk hanging alone in the margin to their left. A white square card carrying a stacked two-line logo sits at the far right, top-aligned with the sentence. The whole left half of the screen stays empty.

Under a small sentence-case label, a horizontal strip of images spans the full viewport: one wide central image, about 73% of the width, flanked by narrow slivers of the previous and next slides cropped by the edges, with 10px gaps. Below, one row of 12 to 14px metadata: index number and client far left, year at centre, team and roles in a right-hand column, and an underlined project link lower left.

Full-screen off-white closing. Three centred lines of the same bold uppercase green type at about 11vw fill three-quarters of the width, with the bee and its detached shadow floating above the first line. A single line of tiny text runs along the bottom edge: credits left, three contact links separated by bullets at centre, copyright right.

steal: Start with one small tilted card on an empty page and scale it into the full-bleed hero scene, so loader and hero are the same object.
Set display type in a near-black green instead of black; it still reads as ink but ties the type to the imagery.
Let a small 3D mascot overlap giant flat type and cast a soft shadow onto it to give a purely typographic screen depth.
media: The hero is a real-time 3D interior seen through a rounded rhombus mask that starts as a 165px tip at the bottom of a blank fold and grows to cover the whole viewport by about 900px of scroll. Below: full-width project slider strips with neighbours peeking at both edges, a full-bleed 3D room as an interlude under a statement, a small 47s reel beside a left-aligned intro, and an archive index with hover previews; two fixed WebGL canvases, square-cornered frames, laptops staged on stone and steel.
motion: A blank screen, then a 14px loader line from 1.2s past 4.5s, ending on an empty fold with only the rhombus tip. Lenis with canvas-driven pinning: the rhombus grows and turns to full bleed over about 900-1800px, the 3D interlude holds over a 2616px runway while its statement lines brighten from about 20% to 100%, and display words swap between two three-line sets; the house ease is cubic-bezier(.16,1,.1,1), 43 uses, mostly at .75s and 1s.

name: Anidachi
idea: A toy brand built from one custom modular wordmark and one 3D device, both of which change colour with each full-bleed candy-coloured section.
hero: A saturated sky-blue field covering the top 92% of the viewport. The custom modular wordmark is repeated in four stacked rows, each spanning the full width inside 30px margins, drawn tone-on-tone in a slightly lighter blue that brightens row by row toward the bottom, so the name works as wallpaper. A tiny white pixel-cat mark sits top-left; a white rounded button with blue text top-right. A 3D flower-shaped toy device hangs on a carabiner from the top edge at centre, barely entered on desktop and fully visible on mobile, where it covers the pattern. A pale ice section starts at the bottom edge.
type: AnidachiDisplay is custom modular lettering: monoline rounded strokes on a square grid, unicase forms, used at 7-10vw. Body and UI in Ease, a soft rounded geometric sans, at 20px. Text is always coloured to its section, never black.
colour: #24c0fe #eff9fb #b6c814 #ff6b2b #ffffff #000000 — Each section is one flat saturated field (sky blue, ice, chartreuse, orange) with type in a single contrasting tint of the same family or white. The 3D device is recoloured to match its section.
imagery: A glossy flower-shaped handheld with cream buttons and a small black screen showing pixel-art animal characters, hung from a metal clasp. Pixel sprites also appear loose on the page and as a giant low-contrast watermark.
layout: Full-bleed colour sections of one to two screens with 30px margins. Each holds one giant display phrase at an edge, one small text block, and the 3D device crossing section boundaries. Alignment shifts section to section: centred, left column, bottom-left.

sections.description: Pale ice section. Centred: the small mascot mark and wordmark in sky blue at about 9vw, followed by a two-line statement in the rounded sans at 7vw in the same blue. Below, a left column 370px wide holds a three-line 24px lead and small paragraphs, all blue on ice; a pixel-art cat sprite stands in the right half, and a pill-outlined email field with a round arrow button ends the block.

Chartreuse full-bleed section. A title in the modular display face runs edge to edge in white at about 10vw across the top. The 3D device, recoloured olive to match, hangs from its clasp at left-centre and overlaps a diagonal ribbon of translucent rounded-square tiles, each holding a tinted character, running from lower-left to upper-right and off the edge.

Solid orange section, almost empty. A three-line 14px white paragraph sits near the top, right of centre; the bottom-left holds a two-line hyphenated phrase in the display face at roughly 9vw, white, hugging the left margin and the bottom edge. The lower edge of the device intrudes from the section above.

Ice ground with an enormous pixel-art face in a barely darker green tint as a watermark filling the frame. Lime wordmark lower-left at about 300px wide, three stacked lime links at centre, one link at right, tiny copyright beneath the logo.

steal: Repeat the wordmark as tone-on-tone rows filling the hero, stepping the tint row by row, so the brand name is the background pattern.
Give every section one saturated colour, set all its text in a single contrasting tint, and recolour the 3D product to match.
Anchor a giant two-line display phrase to the bottom-left corner of an otherwise empty colour field, with one small paragraph far away at the top.

name: Butter
idea: A video editor presented as a bunch of collectable objects: 3D keychain charms in the hero and squircle effect tiles that behave like app icons everywhere else.
hero: Soft grey vertical gradient, darker at the top, fading to near-white. Two floating light-grey rounded capsules form the nav: the left holds the script logo, five links and a kebab; the right holds Login and a black button. A 3D bunch of keychain charms (orange carabiner, black letter keycap, chrome ring, magenta disc, steel key, green script tag) hangs from the top edge at centre, overlapping the nav and stopping just above the headline. The headline is one centred line at 7.5vw in regular-weight grotesk spanning 75% of the width, with a 24px sub-line and a black rounded-rectangle button beneath. The bottom 35% is empty.
type: DieGrotesk regular at 107px for the one-line headline, near-zero tracking, mixed case; the same face at 24px and 16px below, so a 4.5x then 1.5x step. ABC Diatype for tiny labels inside product panels. The logo is brush-script lettering used as an image.
colour: #e8e8e8 #f5f5f5 #1e1e1e #0a0909 #ff3fd8 #19e319 — Grey-to-white ground with black type and black product panels. Saturated colour (magenta, green, orange, holographic pastels) appears only on 3D objects, effect tiles and the footer wordmark.
imagery: Live 3D charms with chrome and plastic materials; black editor UI panels with 24px radius; many small squircle video tiles showing halftone, glitch and type-poster effects; a full-width extruded script wordmark.
layout: 96px side margins for the nav capsules, a centred content column and very large vertical gaps between blocks. Light grey throughout, with black product panels sliding in from below; ends on a full-bleed wordmark.

sections.description: A single row of seven client logos in black spans the full width, then a long gap, then a centred three-line statement at about 32px, roughly 580px wide, with five small squircle thumbnails (app-icon sized, each a different texture or brand tile) set inline between words like emoji. Words resolve from blurred pale grey to sharp black with scroll, so the last line is still soft and tinted.

A black rounded panel about 690px wide slides up from below: a timeline with timecode, ruler ticks and a track of squircle clips, each clip a vivid texture (halftone horse, glitch stripes, red type poster). One clip is lifted out of the track, enlarged and rotated a few degrees, overlapping the panel's top edge. A second black panel shows a labelled library grid of the same tiles.

Text link columns sit at the top; below them the script wordmark is blown up to the full width and cropped by the bottom edge, drawn in solid black with a thick extruded underside in a holographic pink, blue and cyan gradient and a registered mark at its top right.

steal: Hang a cluster of 3D branded charms from the top edge so it overlaps the nav and points down at a one-line headline.
Set small squircle thumbnails inline between the words of a statement and resolve the words from blurred to sharp on scroll.
End on the script wordmark at full width with a holographic extruded underside, cropped by the bottom edge.
media: A 3D keyring about 380x340 hangs from the top edge over the centred headline, about 15% of the fold. After that video is the main medium, 45 muted looping product recordings and client clips in 32px-radius frames: 641px splits alternating sides, a dark app window that pans in from the right in a pinned section, stacked videos swapped by a tab list, and a rail of 9:16 clips bleeding off both edges; no video in the hero.
motion: About 2-2.5s of empty grey before the nav, keyring and headline arrive, the headline split into characters that fade and rise. Lenis; one 1800px pinned section slides the statement off left while the app window grows to nearly full width; word spans rise over 0.8s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1) on 100 elements, four cards stagger in at 0.2-0.5s delays, and the ground steps from #fafafa to #ededed over 1s.

name: LxL Creative
idea: A film-marketing studio's identity as two hands at once: blunt cream grotesque type and an orange looping handwritten monogram that physically overlaps the photography.
hero: Espresso-brown field. A tall portrait photo with 12px rounded corners fills the left 47% of the viewport, 20px in from the top, left and bottom. Five cream nav links sit top-right; no logo. In the right half, vertically centred, a small three-line lock-up: two lines of heavy extended caps at about 28px with an orange script line overlapping the gap between them, all centre-aligned. Along the bottom runs the wordmark: an orange handwritten monogram about 300px tall whose loops climb over the photo's lower-right corner, followed by the studio word in cream lowercase grotesque at roughly 12vw, ending flush with the right margin, baseline about 40px above the bottom edge.
type: Owners Wide, heavy and uppercase with leading near 1.0, for statements; Scribo script in orange laid over the caps as an accent line or single word; Manrope 17px for nav and body. The wordmark is a plain lowercase grotesque. Three distinct voices and a large size jump.
colour: #27201d #fdf3c4 #ff4a1c #36302d #d2e1eb #055dff — Warm espresso brown with cream type and one vivid orange-red for script, squiggles and buttons. The digest also records a pale blue and a cobalt section that the captures do not show.
imagery: Film stills, key-art posters and behind-the-scenes footage with a cinematic grade, held in frames with 12-16px rounded corners: portrait crops for stills and posters, 16:9 for video that scales to full-bleed under a dark scrim.
layout: Margins of 20px. Asymmetric splits alternate with centred statements over video. Each section holds one media object and one short text lock-up, and a thick orange hand-drawn line snakes between sections as a connector. A small logo top-left and nav top-right persist.

sections.description: A 16:9 behind-the-scenes video begins as an inset rounded card about 87% of the viewport wide, centred, then expands to full-bleed. A brown scrim fades over it and a centred eight-line statement in heavy extended caps at about 3.3vw, cream, scrolls up across it, with one word replaced by orange script set at a slight upward angle. A tiny sound toggle sits bottom-centre.

Two columns on brown. Left: a centred lock-up with an orange script word overlapping the top-left of an extended caps heading, four short lines of small centred copy and a small orange rounded button. Right: a portrait poster card about 15% of viewport width with rounded corners, a caps label and arrow along its bottom edge and more cards peeking out beneath. A thick orange squiggle emerges from behind the card and exits the right edge.

A small rounded video thumbnail with an orange play button is centred above a four-line question in extended caps, one word swapped for orange script, with an orange button beneath. The squiggle sweeps in from the left edge and loops down through the bottom of the page. The footer is only a copyright line bottom-left and two small social icons bottom-right.

steal: Lay a handwritten script line in the accent colour across two lines of heavy extended caps so the lock-up reads as print with a signature over it.
Seat the oversized logo at the bottom of the hero and let part of it overlap the photo's corner, tying the image half and the text half together.
Run one thick hand-drawn line in the accent colour behind cards and across section boundaries as the page's only connective ornament.
media: One inset portrait photograph covers 47% of the width and 96% of the height, and the wordmark bridges both halves along the bottom, so media and mark fill about 60% of the fold. Below, a 48s showreel grows from a 549x366 inset to full bleed and then sits darkened behind the manifesto, a sticky card deck runs beside a fixed text column, a full-bleed sticky still holds behind the featured projects, and a 2x2 film contact sheet cycles in place; 12px corners on cards and frames.
motion: The hero is settled at 400ms with no entrance, and Lenis runs 25 ScrollTriggers over CSS sticky stages: the video frame's width, height, position and radius scrub to full bleed, the card deck scrubs at 0.5 with each card leaving on rotation, scale and y with power4.in, nav colour flips per section over 1s, and the footer line draws on at 'top 90%'. The house curve is cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0,1), hand-drawn marks boil on 0.3s steps, and there are 11 reduced-motion rules.

name: ScreenTune
idea: The page records itself: on scroll the cream hero shrinks into a screenshot inside the app's dark editor, so the site becomes the demo material.
hero: Warm cream page with a faint peach wash. The nav is a compact centred cluster: app icon, name and three links within about 320px. The headline sits high, two centred lines in a light-weight display sans at 4.9vw spanning 42% of the width, tightly leaded. One grey line of subtext, a near-black 225px button with 10px radius, an Apple glyph and soft shadow, then a small grey note. From 52% down, a charcoal panel 940px wide with 24px top corners rises and is cropped by the fold; inside, the app's editor shows a captured notes window on a metallic backdrop and a settings sidebar. An amber glow warms its lower corners.
type: Stack Sans Headline at weight 300 for headings (70px, tracking -0.022em); Stack Sans Text for body at 16-20px in grey. Light weight at large size is the signature; section headings are set two-tone, grey then white. About four sizes.
colour: #f6f0eb #0a0a0a #1b1b1a #fcfcfb #b9794a #9cc3ea — Warm cream opening, a long near-black middle and a near-white close. The accent is light rather than hue: amber and steel-blue flare streaks glowing at panel edges.
imagery: The app's editor shown large in dark rounded panels, containing screenshots on brushed-metal and sky-blue backdrops; later, device mockups on swirling chrome wallpapers in rounded tiles. Glows and streaks of light bleed from panel corners.
layout: Centred column of about 940px. Three colour acts: cream hero, black pinned product sequence followed by wide feature panels that split text left and interface right, then a near-white section of three image-topped columns. A floating pill nav appears after the hero.

sections.description: Pinned transition: the page turns black and the entire cream hero, headline, button and panel included, is reduced to a rounded thumbnail about 245px wide glowing at centre. In the next frame that thumbnail is the captured image inside the app's editor window, now on a sky-blue padded backdrop with the settings sidebar beside it and a timeline below, under a centred two-tone heading whose first half is grey and second half white.

Stacked dark panels at full column width, about 270px tall with 16px radius, charcoal with a diagonal light streak and an amber flare at one corner. Left third: a tiny label, a two-line light-weight heading near 28px and one line of text. Right two-thirds: an inset darker pane showing a plain checklist being marked up by a cursor, with a floating toolbar pill of small icons along its bottom edge.

On near-white, a centred heading and two grey lines, then three equal columns. Each column has a 4:3 rounded tile with a device mockup (laptop, browser window, phone) floating on a swirling chrome or dark-teal abstract wallpaper; beneath it, a tiny grey category label, a two-line 20px heading and two lines of grey text, all left-aligned to the tile edge.

steal: Use the page's own hero as the sample content in the product demo: scale the first viewport down on scroll until it lands as an image inside the app interface.
Set large headlines in a light weight with tight leading, and colour the first half of a two-part heading grey and the second half white.
Replace colour accents with light: a flare streak and warm glow at the corner of otherwise flat dark panels.

name: Adam Ho, I.S.P.
idea: A portfolio treated as a self-shuffling information system: fifty oversized coloured index numbers are scattered across the layout on each load, on top of a rigorously labelled archive.
hero: White page, 8px margins. A layer of about fifty numerals at 86px (6vw) in a grotesk, each a different colour or a faint grey, is spread over the whole viewport in a rough six-column grid, overlapping everything. Beneath it: top-left a dot, the name and a three-line serif descriptor at 12px; a 200px column of small notes; top-right, filling 45% of the width, the project list set as vertical lines of text rotated 90 degrees, each tag highlighted in a marker colour under a row of coloured dots. From 36% height a hairline starts the first project: tiny labels, then square image tiles running to the right edge.
type: ABC Oracle Plus for names, notes and the 86px numerals; AS Thermal, a dot-matrix receipt face, in uppercase for descriptions and metadata; Herbik serif for small headings. Body sizes are 10 to 13px, so the only large type is the number overlay and the about paragraph.
colour: #fefefe #161616 #f5320b #ffee00 #1e8fff #ff8fd0 — White ground with black text; colour is applied as data: highlighter backgrounds on tags, a coloured dot per project, rainbow numerals. One flat orange-red block the full width closes the page.
imagery: Brand identity artefacts (logos, badges on lanyards, type specimens, posters) as square or portrait tiles with square corners, butted nearly edge to edge in a row; photography, flat graphics and line drawings mixed.
layout: Each project is a full-width band opened by a hairline and a row of tiny labels, with a narrow text column at left and three or four image tiles of equal height to the right. Bands repeat for twelve screens; an about paragraph in large grey type breaks them.

sections.description: Top-right block about 650px wide. Thirty-odd project names with their discipline tags are set as single lines rotated 90 degrees to read top to bottom, packed side by side like book spines. Each tag has its own highlighter-colour background (yellow, green, pink, lilac, red), and a row of matching 12px dots runs along the top, one per line. It is a complete index in the footprint of a banner.

A hairline, then a label row: an input code and a category in tiny grey bold at left, the year at far right in dot-matrix type. Next line: a coloured dot, the client name in serif, its tags on a highlighter background, and a one-sentence description starting at a second column. Below, tiles of equal height: a narrow column of dot-matrix text under a small serif numbered heading, then two or three large image squares reaching the right edge.

Two justified columns of grey grotesk text at about 30px with tight leading fill the full width, far larger than anything else on the page. The name at the start is black; six or seven individual words carry pastel highlighter backgrounds in green, pink, lilac and blue, and the final short sentence is fully highlighted in bright blue like a selected link.

A solid orange-red rectangle spans the full width, about 300px tall, with the header's name and dot row printed over it in darker tones. Below on white, two short stacks of links in grey 28px grotesk under 9px labels, flush left, with most of the width left empty; a small pixel-art status widget with a blue progress bar stays pinned bottom-right.

steal: Set an index as vertical lines of rotated text packed like book spines, each with a highlighter-colour tag, to fit thirty items into a banner-sized block.
Use highlighter backgrounds on single words inside a large grey paragraph as the only emphasis.
Open every project with the same tiny label row (code, category, year) above a hairline so a dense archive stays scannable.

name: Postaway
idea: A spilled pile of real vintage postcards and stamps under a huge monospaced wordmark explains the product before any copy does.
hero: Warm off-white fills the top 82% of the viewport; a flat orange band crosses the bottom 18%. The wordmark, orange uppercase monospace at ~19vw, spans margin to margin with its top edge at 18% height. About seven postcards and six postage stamps, each rotated 5 to 20 degrees with soft drop shadows, tumble across the lower two thirds: some slide behind the letters, others overlap them, and three cards straddle the off-white/orange seam. A small orange post-horn logo sits top-left; two orange mono links and an outlined pill language select sit top-right. No headline copy or button appears in the first viewport.
type: Fragment Mono only: the wordmark at 280px, weight 600, -0.01em tracking, then a centred two-line heading near 20px and 13px body in the same monospace. A fifteen-fold jump from wordmark to copy with nothing in between.
colour: #ece7e1 #ff4800 #ffffff #f5d800 #3d6ea8 — Orange on off-white up top, white on orange below; the page flips at a hard horizontal seam. Every other colour comes from the postcards and stamps themselves.
imagery: Scanned vintage postcards and postage stamps as cut-outs with paper edges and perforations intact, rotated, overlapping, with soft shadows; a mix of black-and-white, hand-tinted and saturated mid-century print.
layout: Two stacked panels only (1.6 screens). Panel one is a free collage under a full-width wordmark; panel two is a centred text stack about 480px wide on orange: heading, explainer, pill button, legal line, badge. No grid, no cards.

sections.description: An orange full-width panel continues the hero's bottom band, with the last postcards hanging over its top edge. A centred stack roughly 480px wide holds a two-line white mono heading near 20px, a two-line explanation at ~13px, a white pill button with an orange label, then a one-line legal row in tiny bold caps and a small dark badge. A faint lighter-orange diagonal gradient sweeps one corner.

steal: Let the product's raw material (scanned cards and stamps) be the hero, rotated and overlapping, instead of an interface mockup.
Interleave a collage with the wordmark, some objects behind the letters and some in front, so type and image share one depth.
Split the viewport into two flat colour fields and let objects straddle the seam to tie the hero to the call to action.

name: Samuel Räikkönen Portfolio
idea: The whole portfolio is one centred column of campaign titles; whichever title is active turns white and its film fills the screen behind the list.
hero: A dark full-bleed video fills the viewport (first frame: a deep-blue particle render of a sleeping figure). At top centre sit two 14px lines in white, the name in sans and the role in serif. At bottom centre sits a single 13px link. Between them a centred stack of project titles in a 56px serif (~3.9vw), leading near 1.1, starts at mid-height and runs off the bottom edge. The active title is pure white; all others are about 35% white so the footage shows through, and the list fades out toward the edge. Nothing is left- or right-aligned: the outer thirds of the screen carry only footage.
type: Hedvig Letters Serif regular at 56px, -0.015em, sentence case, for every project title; the same serif at 15px for body. Inter semibold 14px only for the name and one link. Effectively two sizes, a fourfold jump.
colour: #041527 #08243a #050505 #ffffff #8a97a5 — Colour comes entirely from the active film, darkened by a scrim; type is white at two opacities over a near-black base.
imagery: Full-bleed campaign films, one per project, swapping as the active title changes and heavily darkened so white serif text stays legible. No thumbnails, frames or cards anywhere.
layout: A single fixed viewport built on the centre axis only. The name is pinned at the top, one link at the bottom, and the title list scrolls through the middle like film credits while the background swaps. No sections, no footer.

sections.description: Scrolling moves the title stack upward like end credits: about seven dimmed titles sit above the active one, the white active title holds near 50% height, and that title's film plays full-bleed behind. Titles nearest the top edge dissolve under a fade mask and pass beneath the pinned name. There are fourteen entries; the list simply ends with the last title active and empty footage below it.

steal: Make the navigation the content: a centred list of evocative project titles at display size, with media appearing only for the active one.
Mark the active item with opacity alone (100% against ~35% white) and let footage show through the inactive lines.
Pin just two tiny anchors, name at top centre and one link at bottom centre, and leave everything else to a single axis.

name: Lovably
idea: Extreme restraint: one 25px sentence in an otherwise empty white viewport, then a strict four-column journal of work whose captions read as tiny headlines.
hero: White viewport, about 90% empty, on an implied four-column grid with 50px margins. Top row at 44px: the wordmark as 15px text at the left margin, a grey information link at the start of column three (the exact centre line), a 12px outlined circle at the right margin. The only statement is one line at 25px regular (1.7vw) starting on the centre line at 42% height. Between 81% and 89% height, two four-line 15px paragraphs fill columns three and four. A tiny orange down-arrow sits at the left margin beside their last line. Four thumbnail tops peek 50px above the fold, one per column. The left half is blank.
type: Scto Grotesk A regular throughout: a 25px statement, 15px body, ~11px captions with a bold lead-in phrase and grey date codes. No display size exists until the footer, where a serif wordmark image spans the full width, the only large type on the page.
colour: #ffffff #111111 #9a9a9a #e7e7e7 #e8501e — White ground, black text, grey for secondary links and dates; a single tiny orange arrow is the only accent. All other colour comes from project thumbnails.
imagery: Project thumbnails mixing interior and architecture photography with flat logo plates on solid colour. Square in most rows, taller portrait in others, square corners, ~22px gutters, one ratio per row.
layout: A strict four-column grid with 50px margins and ~22px gutters. Every row is image, then a caption block of varying length, then about 70px before the next row. The hero uses only the right two columns. A thin sticky header; no section breaks until the wordmark footer.

sections.description: Four equal columns of square thumbnails with small captions directly beneath: a bold two-to-four-word lead-in running straight into a regular-weight description of four to eight lines at ~11px, then a grey month-and-year code and, on some, a visit link with an arrow. Captions vary in length so each row's bottom edge is ragged; the next row starts on a shared top line. Some rows switch all four images to portrait.

After the last row comes a mostly empty white viewport. At its bottom the studio name appears as a black high-contrast serif wordmark stretched from margin to margin, roughly 13vw tall, with a small registered mark at its lower right. Under it a hairline and a single 10px row: copyright at left, three text links on the centre line, a privacy link at right.

steal: Start the statement and a nav link on the exact centre line of a four-column grid and leave the left half blank.
Write each caption as a bold mini-headline running straight into a regular description, so a grid of thumbnails reads like a journal.
Hold all large type back until the footer and release it as one full-width serif wordmark, the only contrast on a small-grotesk page.

name: Marina Rachello
idea: The surname is broken with a hyphen so its tail becomes a greeting, set huge in a soft bookish serif on a red field, and the page signs off with an even larger goodbye.
hero: Solid red-orange viewport with no navigation: only two tiny pale labels in the top corners (role at left, employer at right). The name starts about 15% down, left-aligned from a 3% margin, in a soft, slightly blobby bold serif at roughly 14vw. Line one, in cream, breaks the surname with a hyphen about 84% across; line two, in near-black, completes it as a greeting with an exclamation mark, leaded so tightly the lines nearly touch. Together they fill the top 55% of the screen. A right-aligned two-paragraph bio in small white sans, about 24% wide, sits in the bottom-right corner. The bottom-left is empty.
type: Averia Serif Libre bold, a soft-edged averaged serif, at about 14vw in the hero and 26vw in the footer marquee; DM Sans 18px for the bio and the tiny corner labels. Only three sizes exist, with a display-to-body jump above 10x. Mixed case, default tracking.
colour: #e84025 #2a2a2a #f3ede4 #1a1919 #d5d5d5 — Hot red-orange bookends the page as hero and footer; the work area between is flat charcoal so the project boards supply their own colour. Type is cream and near-black on red.
imagery: Project presentation boards: composed collages of UI screens on coloured grounds, plus one photo of a device in use. Landscape tiles around 16:10 with square corners, lined up in a single horizontal row with narrow gaps on charcoal.
layout: Three acts: a red type poster, a long charcoal stretch where one row of large landscape boards travels sideways with empty charcoal above and below, then a red footer. Outer margins are tight at about 3%; there are no headings between acts.

sections.description: On flat charcoal, a single horizontal strip of project boards is vertically centred with about 20% empty space above and below. Each board is roughly 62% of the viewport wide and 58% tall with 24px gaps, so one full board and the cropped edge of the next are always in view. No captions, titles or buttons accompany them; the strip slides sideways while the page scrolls for about ten screens.

A red block rises from the charcoal with a hard straight edge. A farewell phrase in the same serif at 26vw runs as one cream line far wider than the viewport, cropped at the right edge. Beneath it three small white text links with arrow glyphs are stacked and centred, and a tiny copyright line sits at the very bottom.

steal: Find a word hiding inside the name and split it across two lines with a hyphen and a colour change, so the headline is both the name and a greeting.
Park the bio as a small right-aligned paragraph in the bottom-right corner, diagonally opposite the giant left-aligned name, and leave the other two corners empty.
Bookend a neutral dark work area with the same saturated colour field and the same display face, set even larger for the goodbye than for the hello.

name: 21 Hrs On The Moon
idea: An explorable Apollo 11 landing site: a title screen where the word MOON sets behind the lunar horizon, then a draggable top-down surface map with hotspots and a mission timeline.
hero: Black starfield framed by thin bronze corner brackets; three small round icon buttons top-left. A centred composition 72% wide sits between two thin rules. The upper rule is interrupted by a small bold caps kicker; beneath it the four-letter title in bold geometric caps at 20.8vw spans the full width, light grey fading to transparent at its base. A grey cratered sphere rises from the bottom, its curved horizon overlapping the lower quarter of the letters. On the sphere: a two-line centred white sentence, with a mono-labelled mission name at far left and year at far right above the lower rule. A bracketed mono button sits centred at 82% height.
type: Futura Std Bold in uppercase at 300px with -0.03em tracking for the title, the same face near 28px for the kicker and 20px for the sentence; Akkurat Mono in tiny uppercase for labels, the button and map annotations. Roughly a 15x jump from title to sentence.
colour: #020202 #262626 #d8d8d8 #8a7361 #ffffff — Black and lunar greys with white type. A muted bronze appears only in the HUD brackets and translucent wedge markers on the map; archival photo thumbnails add small spots of colour.
imagery: A real-time 3D moon: curved horizon on the title screen, then a full-screen top-down cratered surface lit from one side. Small archival photos appear as thumbnail hotspots with bracketed corners; icons sit in outlined circles and squares.
layout: A single-screen application rather than a scrolling page: a centred title card, then a draggable map filling the viewport with hotspots at fixed coordinates. HUD brackets, icon buttons at top-left and a timeline ruler along the bottom persist throughout.

sections.description: Full-viewport top-down lunar surface in dark grey with fine crater relief. About ten hotspots are scattered over it: outlined circular icons for panoramas, each with a translucent bronze wedge showing the camera's field of view; small square icons for experiments; two photo thumbnails with corner brackets. Each has a tiny mono caps label to its right. One landmark gets a larger bold geometric caps label with a small triangle above it. A tiny mono hint sits top-centre.

Pinned along the bottom, a horizontal ruler spanning about 75% of the width: a thin baseline with short vertical ticks dividing eight equal segments, each labelled in two lines of tiny mono caps, a small triangle marking the current position and a clock readout at the left end. The current landmark's name in bold caps sits beneath it, half-cropped by the bottom edge of the screen.

steal: Let a 3D or photographic object physically overlap the bottom of giant title letters and fade the letters to transparent there, so the type sits inside the scene rather than on top of it.
Interrupt a thin horizontal rule with the small first line of the title, then close the block with a second rule carrying two labelled facts at its left and right ends.
Frame the viewport with four thin corner brackets in a muted metallic colour to turn a full-screen scene into a viewfinder.
media: The hero is all picture: a starfield and a rising moon sphere over the lower ~55%, with the title sunk into its horizon. After landing, a draggable top-down terrain map fills the whole screen, with 120x90 archival photo thumbnails as pins and translucent field-of-view wedges; no video on the surface, as footage and panoramas open from the hotspots.
motion: There is no document scroll: the first wheel step plays a landing in which the terrain lights up and the hotspots arrive in a stagger, labels after their icons, and from then on the wheel does nothing and the map is dragged instead. HUD items fade in and out on a uniform 400ms, with one opacity .3s cubic-bezier(.61,1,.88,1); no GSAP, and the page took 38s to reach network idle.

name: Transport
idea: Present a USB stick as a luxury object: one studio render on charcoal above a chrome custom wordmark, then let moody macro photography carry the rest.
hero: Flat charcoal field. Centred slightly above the midline, a cut-out render of the drive about 31% of viewport width with its steel arm swung up at 30 degrees. Under it a chrome, ultra-wide custom wordmark spans 72% of the width on one line yet is only 45px tall. Then a centred serif tagline at 2.6vw and a single row: mono spec, a dark pill showing price and sold-out state, mono spec. Logo top-left, a grey centred nav prompt, a small pill with a glowing dot top-right. Carousel chevrons sit at the far left and right edges at product height. The bottom fifth is empty.
type: Three voices: a chrome extended techno wordmark as image; Untitled Serif 400 at 38px with -0.026em tracking for taglines and body; ISO mono for specs and caps eyebrows. Section heads switch to a tight heavy Untitled Sans near 36px. Nothing exceeds 3.6vw.
colour: #1c1c1c #c8c5ba #6e6f6a #5b5d45 #f1f1ef #2d2d2d — Charcoal base with white text; colour comes only from photographs in grey-olive, concrete and amber. One section flips to dark text over a pale blurred photo.
imagery: One clean product render, then shallow-focus macro photographs of the translucent drive on cutting mats, concrete and fabric, graded olive-grey with grain. Full-bleed bands with feathered edges, plus a row of rounded cards of unequal widths.
layout: Centred hero, then full-bleed photo bands each carrying one short text group placed differently: top-left, centre-right over a card, bottom-left, centred. Band edges dissolve through heavy blur instead of hard cuts. About 160 words across eleven screens.

sections.description: Full-bleed pale out-of-focus photograph with the drive in sharp focus in the lower half. Dark text overlays the top: a heavy tight grotesk heading at about 36px, left-aligned 8% in from the edge, then three equal columns, each a tiny glyph plus mono caps label over two lines of serif copy. No cards or dividers; the photo's soft blur is the only background.

A full-width macro photo band fades out through a blurred lower edge. On charcoal beneath it, one row of four rounded-corner image cards of unequal widths (one double-width, three single) with narrow gaps, each a tightly cropped lifestyle shot in a different colour temperature. The row is cut by the viewport bottom; further down one card grows taller and pins beside a short text group.

Dark band over a concrete-wall photograph. The drive render floats at top centre, half out of frame, with a horizontal motion streak smeared across the wall behind it. Text sits bottom-left: mono caps eyebrow, heavy grotesk heading, two lines of serif. The band cross-dissolves into an olive bokeh photo holding a centred mono equation, heading and one serif line whose quantities are joined by italic conjunctions.

Two small white script-lettered badges side by side at top centre, like garment labels, with a tiny pill link beneath, then a mostly empty charcoal field. Bottom-left, three tiny stacked mono link groups; bottom-right, white card-suit icons above a two-line italic mono credit, right-aligned.

steal: Pair one centred product cut-out with a very wide, very short metallic wordmark so the logo reads as an engraved nameplate.
Give three typefaces strict jobs: serif for sentences, mono for specs and eyebrows, heavy grotesk for section heads.
Blur the top and bottom edges of full-bleed photo bands so sections melt into each other with no hard seams.

name: The Deep End
idea: The whole site is one invitation card floating over ambient footage, which shrinks into a pinned corner ticket as scattered stills scroll past.
hero: Full-bleed, dim, amber-toned video of a listening room: a modular synth and speaker at top, a person lying on a silk cushion in soft focus. Centred over it is a square-cornered panel about 55% of the viewport wide and 62% tall, a blurred brown-to-taupe wash. Inside, the three words of the title are spread along the top edge at left, centre and right in bold condensed caps. A small line-diagram logo sits below. Two left-aligned text blocks at 2.5vw in the same heavy condensed face, tightly leaded: five lines of event details, four of description. Bottom edge: credits left, an RSVP box centre, a small link right. No navigation.
type: PP Neue York extra-bold condensed is the only face, used at essentially one size, 36px, in white with very tight leading; credits drop to about 12px. Mixed case with occasional all-caps lines and a raised underlined ordinal. Hierarchy comes from spacing and position alone.
colour: #2b2216 #bda38b #c8874a #f1f1e9 #181818 — Warm browns and ambers lifted straight from the footage: dark walnut video, a taupe translucent card, then a flat tan page with honey-lit photos. White type only; no accent colour.
imagery: Low-light cinematic video and stills of people lying with eyes closed, shallow focus, amber backlight, wood panelling. Square-cornered and at very different sizes, from small thumbnails to near full-height frames, placed off-grid on flat tan.
layout: After the full-bleed opener the page becomes a flat tan field where photos are placed irregularly, one small at left, one mid-size near centre, one tall at right, with wide gaps. The invitation card stays pinned top-left. About four screens, no headings or sections.

sections.description: Flat tan background. Images sit at irregular positions and scales with no shared grid: a small landscape still about 14% wide near the left edge, a mid-sized one about 16% wide lower and nearer the centre, then a large portrait frame about 26% wide and a full viewport tall near the right. One video frame returns nearly full-bleed between them. No captions; all text lives in the pinned card, which partly overlaps the images.

On scroll the invitation panel collapses to a card pinned in the top-left corner, about half the viewport wide and 22% tall, flush with the edges. It keeps the three-word title spread along its top, the logo, five lines of date and address, and the RSVP box centred on its bottom edge. Its fill is semi-transparent taupe with a blurred dark vignette, so photos passing beneath tint it.

steal: Spread the words of a short title to the left, centre and right of a card's top edge so the name becomes its frame.
Set every line of an invitation in one heavy condensed face at one size and let line breaks and gaps create the hierarchy.
Shrink the hero card into a pinned corner ticket that keeps date, place and the RSVP button visible for the whole scroll.

name: Jesper Landberg
idea: Project screenshots become bent, rippling panels on a horizontal WebGL strip floating above a perspective grid floor in the dark.
hero: Black viewport. Four tiny bold uppercase labels sit in the corners with 77px side and 44px vertical margins: name top-left, profile top-right, a view toggle bottom-left, newsletter bottom-right. Across the middle runs a horizontal strip of project panels rendered in WebGL: the centre panel is about 47% of the viewport wide and 52% tall with rounded corners, its top and bottom edges rippling as if the sheet were flexing; neighbours are cropped by the screen edges and angled away. Each panel carries a white project title bottom-left and a round arrow button bottom-right. Below, a white-line perspective grid floor recedes to a dark horizon. The top quarter is empty.
type: A single grotesk (digest reports only 'sans'): bold uppercase corner labels at about 11px and project titles at roughly 18 to 27px with tight tracking. No headline at all; the largest type on screen belongs to the project screenshots themselves.
colour: #000000 #181818 #373637 #ffffff — Pure black stage with white micro-labels and faint grey grid lines; all colour comes from the project panels, which glow like screens in a dark room.
imagery: Website screenshots and videos used as textures on curved, wavy, rounded-corner panels in a 3D scene, with soft vignette shading at panel edges and a wireframe grid floor beneath.
layout: A single-screen stage: corner labels frame a horizontal band of panels through the vertical centre, and scroll moves the strip sideways rather than the page down. A toggle switches to a full list. On mobile the projects become a vertical stack of rounded cards.

sections.description: As the strip advances each panel bends differently: the one nearest centre faces the viewer and is largest, panels toward the edges rotate away and shrink, and all share a sine-wave distortion along their top and bottom edges. Gaps between panels are about 10px. Panels whose media has not loaded show as flat pink or starfield fills, still carrying title and arrow button.

On a 390px screen the 3D strip is replaced by a vertical feed: full-width cards with 30px side margins and about 20px radius, each roughly 300px tall, stacked with 30px gaps. The project title sits bottom-left inside the card over a dark gradient scrim, with a black circular arrow button bottom-right. The four corner labels remain fixed over the feed.

steal: Reduce all chrome to four tiny uppercase labels pinned in the corners so the work fills the stage.
Distort carousel panels with a wave tied to scroll velocity so the gallery feels like flexible sheets rather than rigid slides.
Ground a floating gallery with a faint perspective grid floor to give depth on an otherwise black screen.
media: One fixed canvas covers the screen and holds about eight project cards on a ring around the camera, each textured with a muted looping screen recording of the site; the cards fill the band from y≈220 to y≈690 edge to edge, the centre one about 670x463 (24% of the area), with neighbours bleeding off both edges over a perspective floor grid. No img or video elements on desktop.
motion: A short segmented loader, then the whole ring cuts in by 2.5s with no fly-through (load 844ms). The document does not scroll: the wheel turns the ring about one card per step in an endless loop, as a smooth inertial lerp, and fast steps put an extra wave into the card edges that relaxes when the ring stops; DOM transitions are only .15-.5s on cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1).

name: Eagle’s Nest
idea: Let the lake view do the selling: full-bleed footage of the volcano horizon with the name set as a monumental cream serif along the bottom edge.
hero: Full-bleed video of a silhouetted figure meditating before a lake and volcanoes, with no scrim. The name is set in a high-contrast cream serif, uppercase, about 15vw, spanning the full width between 34px margins and sitting on the bottom edge so it covers the lower fifth of the frame. Directly above its left and right ends sit two pairs of small white labels (what it is, where it is). Top row: a round emblem far left, eight plain text links grouped right of centre and an outlined pill button far right. A small black vertical awards tab hangs on the right edge.
type: PP Pangaia medium: uppercase at 216px for the wordmark, mixed case with uncial-flavoured alternates for section titles. PP Neue Montreal for nav and body at 16px, with a lead paragraph near 22px. Two faces and about four sizes.
colour: #fffae7 #0e2404 #3f6f8c #2d5c8a #5d9aa3 #040303 — Photography supplies lake blues and timber browns. Content sits on warm cream with deep green or lake-blue serif headings, and the footer inverts to very dark forest green with cream type.
imagery: Wide landscape video and saturated photos of the lake, bamboo structures and yoga; full-bleed for scene-setters, otherwise inset cards with a small radius. A flat teal vector map of Central America sits beside the main photo.
layout: Thirty screens alternating pinned full-bleed photographs with cream content bands. Tight 17-34px outer margins; content is left-anchored with images running to the right margin, and value chapters use centred titles. The recurring serif holds the long page together.

sections.description: A cream band slides up over the hero. A dark green serif heading at about 4vw sits top-left, followed by a three-line lead paragraph near 22px across half the width. Below, a wide landscape photo card takes about 70% of the width with a short white paragraph overlaid in its top-right corner. To its right is a narrower teal map card with one location dot, and beneath it four tiny label and value pairs, including live local time.

A large blue serif title centred on cream shrinks into a small centred label pinned just above a full-bleed photograph. The photo stays fixed while single value words appear one at a time at its centre in white serif at about 4vw, each with two lines of small centred text beneath. One image carries several sequential captions.

Very dark green field. The top row is split in three: postal address in small sans at left, the section menu as a column of serif links at about 24px starting at the centre line, and social links right-aligned at the far right. The wordmark repeats at full width along the bottom edge at hero size, caught rising letter by letter. Tiny credits sit beneath.

steal: Anchor the name at full width on the bottom edge of a full-bleed video and tuck two tiny descriptor pairs above its left and right ends.
Pin one photograph and cycle one-word captions over it instead of building a card for each value.
Place a small facts stack (elevation, temperature, live local time) beside a flat map to ground a destination.

name: Glitch&Grit
idea: Every screen is one project: two half-width footage columns with the project name stacked dead centre across their seam in a single flat pastel that changes per project.
hero: Black viewport split down its vertical centre. The left half holds a huge flat grey flower silhouette bleeding off the left and bottom edges; the right half is black with a few tiny video thumbnails drifting through. Dead centre, straddling the split, sits a two-line uppercase title in mint green, about 11vw per line, lines almost touching, spanning roughly 70% of the width. Two tiny category lines sit directly above it and a tiny 'view full project' link directly below, all in the same green. Navigation is six small bold white words pinned to the frame: three links across the top edge, the three-part studio name across the bottom edge.
type: Elza only, weight 900, uppercase, tracking -0.05em so letters nearly collide, line-height under 1. Just two sizes exist: roughly 158px project titles and 12px bold caps for nav, tags and links, a 13:1 jump with nothing in between.
colour: #000000 #999999 #9ae187 #93f1f7 #dcc8ff #fbb060 — Black ground and dark-graded footage. The only flat colour is the title lock-up, which takes a new candy pastel per project: mint, cyan, lilac, cornflower, lemon, orange.
imagery: Client film footage in two half-width columns per screen, cropped tight, graded dark, square edges, the two columns vertically offset against each other. One flat grey cut-out flower shape opens the sequence.
layout: No margins or containers. Each project is a full viewport cut into two equal media columns with one centred title lock-up. Fixed corner navigation frames every screen; fourteen screens repeat the same slide with different footage and title colour.

sections.description: Each scroll stop is a project slide. Two half-width media columns fill the viewport edge to edge and travel vertically at different offsets, so their top and bottom seams never align. Centred over the join: a two-line 11vw uppercase title in one flat pastel, with two or three 12px tag lines stacked above and a 12px 'view full project' or 'coming soon' line beneath. Title colour changes on every slide; nothing else does.

There is no footer block. The last screen is simply another project slide, and the studio name fixed along the bottom edge in three pieces (first word bottom-left, ampersand bottom-centre, last word bottom-right) does the footer's job on every screen, mirroring the three nav words fixed along the top edge at the same size and weight.

steal: Break the studio name into three words pinned bottom-left, bottom-centre and bottom-right, mirroring three nav links across the top, so the viewport frame itself is the logo.
Give each project slide one flat pastel used only for its title and tags, so a colour change is the sole signal that the project changed.
Split the viewport into two media columns that scroll at different offsets and set the title across the seam so the type stitches the halves together.
media: Media fills the whole first screen: a flat grey cut-out flower on the left half and a scatter of small thumbnails on the right that grows into a collage round the title. Then video is the main medium: each project is two full 720x900 half panes of muted, looping footage moving in opposite directions, with the title straddling the seam; about 24 pieces of footage or illustration across twelve projects.
motion: After a 10.7s load the thumbnail grid fills the right half by 1.2s and scales into a cluster by 4.5s, and Lenis then runs 40 scrubbed ScrollTriggers on empty 855px track divs: per project the left pane and half-title travel one way and the right ones the other (titles ±270px, panes ±180px), lining up only at the centre, and the scroll resets for an endless loop. Panes grow from an edge by scaleY over 0.5s, tags slide on y over 0.5s power2, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

name: bleibtgleich’26
idea: One thin vertical rule runs down the page and a tight bold grotesk sentence wraps around it, words stepping from one side of the line to the other.
hero: White page, black type. Content sits in a narrow band between 26% and 68% of the width. A 1px vertical rule drops from the top edge at 37% for two-thirds of the height. Left of it: a black blob avatar at the top, a tiny role caption at its foot. Right of it: a tiny location note at the top, the name in two lines of 90px medium grotesk at the bottom. The tagline continues below at the same size, flush to the band's left edge, running past the fold. The upper half is otherwise blank. The handle is split into two pale-grey words fixed in the bottom corners; a black menu pill sits top-right.
type: Akzidenz Grotesk Pro medium only, -0.05em tracking, line-height about 0.9. Two sizes: 90px (6.3vw) for every statement and 11-13px for captions and table rows, a 7:1 jump. Long words are hyphenated and stepped across lines on purpose.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #e4e4e4 #f2f2f2 — Black on white with no accent. Pale grey is used for the ghosted corner wordmark and a few small square tiles; tiny coloured rings inside those tiles are the only hue.
imagery: Almost none: a black blob avatar, a few 85px grey tiles each with a coloured ring, and a canvas dome of small tilted project thumbnails floating between two words.
layout: Everything hangs off one vertical axis at 37%: lines start either at the axis or one indent to its left, giving a stepped rag. Very wide white margins. Sections are separated by a full screen of white rather than rules or colour.

sections.description: A 90px sentence is typeset word by word around the vertical rule: one word ends just left of the rule, the next starts just right of it, and the following line is centred beneath both. Above the sentence a row of five 85px pale-grey squares, each with a small coloured ring at its centre, is spaced unevenly along one baseline, with a three-line 13px description under the second.

The heading first appears as one centred line near the bottom of an empty screen, then its two halves separate to the far left and far right edges at mid-height. In the gap a WebGL dome of fifteen or so small project thumbnails, mostly black and white, tilts in perspective like tiles on a sphere. Nothing else is on the screen.

The heading is broken into an ampersand alone in the left margin and two words stepped over three lines with a hyphen break and a growing indent. Below it a four-column table at 11px: year, site name, awarding body, award. Hairline rules sit under every row, columns align to the hero's band, and year groups are separated by a blank row.

The closing sentence is stepped over four lines with shifting indents, right of centre. To its left two tiny grey captions and an email address at 11px. Under it three 36px outlined circles with social initials, centred, then the handle at about 44px centred on the bottom edge with tiny legal text in the two corners.

steal: Draw one 1px vertical rule and typeset a large sentence around it, alternating words to either side so the line becomes the text's spine.
Split the logotype into two words, ghost them at about 10% grey, and fix one in each bottom corner of the viewport.
Leave the top half of the hero blank and start the name at 50% height so the headline runs off the fold and pulls the scroll.
media: No picture on the first screen, which is all type plus a small black mark. Pictures arrive later as a WebGL sphere of project thumbnails flanked by two words that slide apart on scroll, square tiles placed on separate grid cells with empty cells between them, hover thumbnails behind a text index, and one small image used as a glyph in a row of numerals; no video.
motion: A 2.5s progress counter runs although the page loaded in 1.5s, while a vertical line draws down with the role label at its tip. Lenis and 15 ScrollTriggers with nothing pinned: display lines rise by yPercent over 0.47s in-out at a 0.075s stagger, the globe's rotation is scrubbed across its 1178px block, the flanking words are pulled apart on a scrub, and underlines wipe in by background-size over 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.76,0,0.24,1).

name: Lorenzo Bocchi – Shot on iPhone
idea: Black-and-white phone photographs fly through dark 3D space as a twisting ribbon, and the viewer chooses how the archive is arranged (reel, wall, trail, drift; flow, grid, map).
hero: Pure black canvas filling the viewport. A diagonal helix of portrait photo cards runs from upper-left to lower-right: four cards near the centre are lit and legible (each about 200 by 280px, slightly rounded corners, each rotated a little further around the axis), while cards above and below fade to dark grey blanks curling away. Behind them a single word in ultra-bold condensed caps spans 80% of the width, its letters half the viewport tall, in a grey only a few points lighter than the background. Four pill-shaped control groups sit in the corners: menu label top-left, three view modes top-right, two round icon buttons bottom-left, four layout modes bottom-right.
type: GeistSans around 14px inside the pill controls is the only readable text. The giant background word is ultra-bold condensed caps roughly 440px tall, used as texture at near-zero contrast. No headings or captions.
colour: #000000 #191919 #262626 #383838 #e6e6e6 — Black and greys only; the photographs are all monochrome, so the brightest values on the page are image highlights. Controls are dark grey capsules with a black active segment.
imagery: Black-and-white travel and street photographs, all portrait, with a soft vignette, mapped onto slightly curved cards in WebGL; only cards near the focal plane are lit, the rest fall into darkness.
layout: One fixed viewport with no document flow. Content floats in the centre 50% of the screen; interface is pushed to the four corners with 16px insets, leaving edges and middle free for the image stream.

sections.description: Scrolling does not move a page; it advances the ribbon. In each frame three or four cards occupy a diagonal band through the centre, the middle one facing the viewer and neighbours rotated progressively edge-on, like prints on a spiral staircase. Cards leaving focus darken to charcoal silhouettes that continue the curve toward the top-left and bottom-right corners, so the path stays readable even when the images are not.

Navigation is four floating capsules rather than a bar. Each is a dark-grey rounded container; multi-option ones hold a black pill behind the active word, giving three view modes and four layout modes as segmented switches. On mobile the two top capsules sit side by side, the bottom ones merge into one row, and their text scales up to thumb size.

steal: Set a single giant word behind the content at two or three percent contrast so it reads as depth, not as a headline.
Light only the items near the focal point and let the rest fall to dark silhouettes that still trace the path.
Put controls in four corner capsules with a sliding active pill, keeping the whole centre free for content.

name: Obys® Experiment Space
idea: An archive of experiments as a 3D object the visitor can reshape, framed by an almost empty ruled white sheet.
hero: White field. One line of 13px text at the top with 10px margins: two view links far left, a theme pair at 9%, a clock at 83%, Contact far right. Three full-width hairlines at 9%, 18% and 27% height form an empty ruled band; on the third sit a short phrase flush left and its completion flush right. The middle 55% is a WebGL ring of about twenty flat rectangular cards seen in perspective — project screenshots, desaturated to grey except one in colour, far-side cards mirrored and faded. Bottom line: two tiny swatches left, four layout-mode words centred with the active one underlined, grey copyright right.
type: One custom grotesk (OTF Obys NG), one weight, two sizes only: 13px for every label and 94px (6.5vw) uppercase at -0.055em for the three-line stacked title and the bottom caption. Hierarchy comes entirely from that seven-to-one jump.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #686868 #dadada #b08d6a — White field, black text, hairlines in light grey. Thumbnails are desaturated and faded; only the focused card shows its real colours. A swatch toggle inverts to black.
imagery: Screenshots of the studio's experiments mapped onto flat planes in 3D, portrait rectangles of mixed sizes, square corners, greyscale and partly transparent until focused; back faces appear mirrored.
layout: A fixed frame — text nav at the top, three hairlines, controls on the bottom line — surrounds one interactive canvas. No scrolling page; scroll drives the carousel. Corners hold the small text, the centre axis holds title, thumbnails and caption.

sections.description: On scroll the ring flattens into one horizontal row of small thumbnails, about 95px wide and 230px apart, at mid-height. All are grey except the centred one, which grows 1.4× and takes full contrast. The title sits in three stacked centred uppercase lines at 94px, clipped by the top edge and sliced by the hairlines. Bottom-centre, a 94px caption with a category code and year changes with the focused item.

Layout switcher: a comma-separated list of four arrangement names on the bottom line re-flows the same cards into a ring, flower, sphere or cylinder; the active name is underlined. Two small rectangles bottom-left toggle a black or white theme. On phones the site shows only a centred two-line notice framed by four corner squares on black.

steal: Limit the type system to two sizes — 13px for every label and one 6.5vw size for title and caption — so scale contrast does all the hierarchy.
Keep every thumbnail greyscale and faded except the focused one, so colour itself is the selection state.
Offer the gallery's arrangement as a user choice through a plain comma-separated text list rather than fixing one layout.
media: One fullscreen canvas holds every project cover as a texture: in the opening state a 3D ring of covers fills a full-width band about 43% of the height, fogged at the far side; after the first wheel step it unrolls into a thin horizontal strip of seven small greyscale covers on only 5-6% of the screen, the one nearest the centre scaling to 1.5x and regaining its colour, with its caption docked at the bottom centre. No video.
motion: A black screen with a progress hairline across the middle splits open like a letterbox at about 2.5s, and the masthead lines rise into their bands after 4.5s. The wheel drives the canvas, with no document scroll: the ring unrolls, then the strip slides about one item per step with no snapping, and captions change letter by letter, outgoing letters dropping and turning grey while incoming ones rise, on transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) across 3441 pre-split characters; no reduced-motion rule.

name: Squarespace Foundations
idea: Brand guidelines presented as an orbit: six chapter tiles tilted in 3D circle a single sentence, and each one opens into a full-screen slide.
hero: Charcoal field. The site name top-left and an index link top-right, both at 24px and 40px from the edges, are the only chrome. Dead centre sits a three-line centred statement at about 26px, medium weight, roughly 30% of the width. Around it six small image tiles, each about 10% of viewport width, are spaced on an ellipse at roughly 10, 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 o'clock; each is skewed as if turned about its vertical axis so it reads as a parallelogram. Tiles show photographs, a white logo card and glyph crops. About 80% of the screen is empty. A cookie notice sits bottom-right in the capture.
type: Clarkson and Clarkson Light only. Nav, statement and slide captions all sit near 24px with -0.04em tracking; captions pair a two-digit number with the chapter name in parentheses. Effectively one size across the whole site, with no display type.
colour: #111111 #000000 #ffffff #d9d9d9 — Charcoal and pure black with white type; one slide inverts to a white field with black logo and black chrome. No accent: colour appears only inside the photographs on the tiles.
imagery: Brand assets as full-screen slides: a studio render of a sphere hovering between two lit discs, a giant white numeral with vector anchor points visible, the logo with a construction overlay. In the index they are tiny skewed tiles.
layout: A single-screen application rather than a scrolling page. Chrome is anchored to the four corners: title top-left, index top-right, slide number and parenthesised chapter name bottom-left, arrows bottom-right. The middle holds either the ring of tiles or one full-bleed asset.

sections.description: A slide fills the viewport edge to edge with one asset on black, or sits as a black panel inset about 75px from the sides on charcoal. Fixed captions in 24px white: a two-digit slide number at the far bottom-left, the chapter name in parentheses about 10% in from the left, and a pair of thin left and right arrows bottom-right. Header text remains in the top corners.

The logo slide flips the background to pure white and all chrome to black. The mark sits centred at about 15% of viewport width, overlaid by a rotated solid square that exposes its construction geometry. The same corner system applies: number and parenthesised label bottom-left, arrows bottom-right, title and index link at the top.

steal: Arrange chapter thumbnails on an ellipse around a centred sentence and skew each tile in 3D so the index reads as objects in space rather than a grid.
Use one type size for everything and give each corner of the viewport a fixed job: title, index, counter plus label, arrows.
Caption slides with a two-digit number followed by the chapter name in parentheses.
media: The fold is type only, and the first real stage is an orbit of six small skewed chapter cards round the centred sentence, about 32% of the screen. Chapters then open as full scenes at 61-79% media on desktop and 100% on the phone (a centred 3:4 portrait at 75% of the viewport height on a ground sampled from the photograph, an inset colour panel growing to full bleed, a collage of looping interface clips, one glyph scaled past the viewport with its vector nodes visible, a full-bleed 3D render), all square-cornered, with a single 12s clip.
motion: About 5s pass before anything useful: a 14vw loader line rises through a mask, then counts from 0 to 100%, then the title words rise through a line mask in sequence. Lenis is present but the page never scrolls: the wheel turns the card ring and opens chapters, the ground shifts from #111 to #000 to a deep brown over 0.6s, UI moves on cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1) at 0.5s, and big scene moves take 2s on cubic-bezier(0.645,0.045,0.355,1).

name: Milledollars
idea: The site is the reel: one full-screen film at a time inside a rounded frame, with client and title pinned to opposite ends of the horizon line.
hero: A full-viewport video inset about 14px from every edge with roughly 24px rounded corners, on a pale lilac-grey page so a thin band of page colour frames it. All text is white and about 16px. Top row inside the frame: the first half of the name at far left and the second half at far right, with a one-line tagline in a tiny tight display serif centred between them. On the vertical centre line: slide number at the far left, client name about 10% across, film title about 80% across, year at the far right. Bottom-left: a four-line stacked nav with a dot marking the current item.
type: ABC Diatype in uppercase at 16px for names and titles, with numbers and nav near 10px; Migra, a sharp display serif, appears once in the centred tagline in tiny tightly set capitals. No large type anywhere: the biggest text is 1.3vw.
colour: #e0dee1 #565857 #3f5a2f #c8891b #3d8fc4 #0c0b0a — The page is pale lilac-grey, visible only as a thin frame. Everything else is film: each slide brings its own grade, from palm green to amber, night teal, sky blue and ember orange. White type.
imagery: Full-frame footage from luxury commercials: macro foliage, an animated shopfront, liquid amber abstraction, a night street, an athlete against blue sky, a car in an orange spotlight. One per screen, uncropped, with rounded outer corners and light film grain.
layout: Not a scrolling page but a stack of full-screen slides. A fixed overlay places text at the four corners and along the horizontal midline, leaving the image centre clear. A tiny line-drawn mascot sits in the bottom-right corner on most slides.

sections.description: Each project is one full-screen slide in the same rounded frame. The midline carries four pieces of text as if it were one table row stretched across the image: a two-digit index at the far left edge, client name about 10% in, film title about 80 to 88% across, year at the far right. Scrolling swaps the footage underneath while the overlay text changes in place.

Mobile variant: the video fills the whole screen with no frame or rounded corners, cropped to a vertical slice of the footage. Chrome disappears; only three pieces of small text remain at mid-height on the left, with the index number at the edge, the film title beside it and the client name on a second line beneath, all in translucent white.

steal: Inset the full-screen video 12 to 16px with rounded corners on a pale page colour so the film looks mounted rather than bled.
Split the wordmark across the top-left and top-right corners and split client and title across the two ends of the midline, keeping the image centre empty.
Keep every label at body size; with strong footage, 16px white capitals are enough hierarchy.
media: Video is the entire content: seven project films play as silent loops inside one full-viewport WebGL canvas, framed about 14px from every edge with about 24px rounded corners on a pale lilac-grey wall, so footage covers about 97-98% of the first screen and text about 4.4%. One caption rail runs across the vertical centre over the film; no img or video elements in the DOM.
motion: A 2.5s choreography follows a 12.2s load: a tiny name lockup, a vertical reel of rounded 760x540 film cards sliding up like a strip, then one card growing into the frame. The wheel is hijacked: each step swaps to the next film by a fast cut or fade in an endless loop of seven, momentum sometimes skips two, captions rise about 2rem over .8s, and transforms run 1-1.5s on cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1) and cubic-bezier(.38,.005,.215,1).

name: 2xA Studio
idea: Computation is the aesthetic: the grid, the loader, the lettering and the body text all behave like running code rather than a finished layout.
hero: Captured in its loading state, which is itself designed. A fixed top bar and matching bottom bar in a condensed pixel-flavoured mono at 1.7vw: studio name far left, two city clocks (Athens, Amsterdam) at the one-sixth and one-third marks, three nav words flush right; socials, email and a sound toggle along the bottom. Between the bars, a pure-black panel inset about 16px is cut into four equal columns by heavy white vertical bars, each column filled top to bottom with the word LOADING repeated some 36 times in small mono. Once loaded, the panel holds a dot-and-dash wordmark spanning the full width with two small square generative canvases beneath.
type: 2XAMONOVF, a custom condensed pixel-edged mono, carries nav, labels and body at 19-24px. Helvetica appears only for the 10vw statement and project titles. The wordmark is a third voice: modular lettering built from rounded dots and dashes. Extreme jump, 10vw against 12px columns.
colour: #0f0f0f #030303 #fdfdfd #e6e6e6 #d4372c #f2cf1d — Near-black and white only for the interface; sections flip between them. Colour arrives solely inside generative canvases and project images (red marks, a yellow-pink gradient solid).
imagery: Small square live canvases: ASCII noise fields, red brush-like marks on white, a low-poly gradient solid. Project media is full-width and square-cornered, showing pixelated mosaic objects photographed on stone.
layout: A four-column grid stated literally by white bars, then reused for clocks, body columns and canvas placement. Margins about 16px. Sections flip between near-black and white; dense 12px text columns alternate with near-empty dark stretches. Fixed bars top and bottom throughout.

sections.description: White section. Four equal columns of tiny grey mono body text run the full width as texture, some lines visibly scrambled mid-decode. Over them, a statement in black Helvetica at about 10vw steps diagonally across the columns: one word top-left, one top-right, one centre, one left, the last pair right, each overlapping the body copy. A row of seven single mono words is justified across the bottom edge like a spaced-out sentence.

On the dark ground, square generative canvases about 13% of viewport width sit at irregular column positions with large black gaps between them: a white tile with red marks, a black-and-white ASCII noise field, a low-poly gradient form, an ASCII rendering of a paragraph. They read as lab specimens rather than portfolio thumbnails; nothing is captioned.

On white, the studio description sits in a narrow 250px mono column at far left, leaving three quarters of the row empty. Each project then opens with a bracketed index number and a title in small Helvetica, flush left, followed by an edge-to-edge image about 16:9 with square corners.

Dark ground; the wordmark rebuilt from rounded dots and dashes on a coarse grid, the full width and about 20% of the viewport tall, sitting directly above the persistent bottom bar. The same lettering opens the page, so the site begins and ends on one object.

steal: Design the loading state as a composition: the status word repeated in ruled columns that fill the stage.
Lay a huge display statement diagonally over columns of tiny body text, so the copy becomes texture and the statement becomes structure.
Frame the page with fixed top and bottom bars in one mono face carrying live data (two city clocks) instead of a conventional nav and footer.
media: Video is the main medium: a 16:9 reel inset 16px at the sides fills 98% of the width and 88% of the height between two fixed bars, then six generative loops sit in a gutterless quarter-width checkerboard with display words dropped into the empty cells. Eight muted looping videos with posters, each fading in over 0.5s, and a giant dot-matrix wordmark band after the hero and again on the footer.
motion: A 3.8s preloader slides the wordmark off to the right in two bands while a tagline decodes behind blue block cursors (82 split characters). Lenis then runs the checkerboard columns at different scroll speeds, smoothed by a 0.1s transform transition on 60 elements, canvas manifesto columns decode as they enter, hover fills scale in from the left over 0.3-0.6s on cubic-bezier(0,1,0,1), and a grain layer jumps on 2s steps.

name: Locker Land
idea: A dry B2B parcel-locker pitch dressed as a fairground of die-cut stickers, where the main navigation is a fan of five tilted illustrated cards.
hero: Post-red field overlaid with a faint lighter-red square grid. Small white brand lock-up top-left; a white pill button with a hard dark-red offset shadow top-right. Top-centre, a two-line sticker-style logo (cream letters, thick cream outline, small locker drawing) about 20% of viewport width. Beneath it a two-line centred white sentence at 18px; no larger headline. The lower half is a fan of five portrait cards with thick coloured frames and rounded corners: centre card upright, neighbours rotated about 8 degrees, the outer pair about 18 degrees and cropped by the viewport edges, each with a label tab overlapping its bottom edge. A two-line caption sits centred below.
