type: FF DIN Pro Condensed Black in uppercase with +0.02em tracking for the wordmark and series titles (23px); Doner, a wide bold sans, for tiny uppercase nav and meta at about 9-10px. Only two text sizes besides the wordmark; type is kept deliberately small against the art.
colour: #c76802 #2f7fc9 #2e7d3a #7a4fa0 #fafafa #bdbdbd — The interface has no colour of its own: white type over whichever painting is on screen, so each panel takes the painting's oranges, blues, greens or violets. The single-series view switches to flat light grey.
imagery: Photographed paintings in a saturated naive style, used two ways: enormous full-bleed crops showing brushwork and weave, and small complete canvases with linen edges and soft drop shadows in a horizontal row on grey.
layout: A stack of full-viewport panels, one per series, identical in structure: fixed header along the top, one label row at mid-height, nothing else. Margins are about 20px. Opening a series swaps the crop for a grey wall with one row of evenly spaced small canvases.

sections.description: Six or more consecutive full-screen panels, each a different painting cropped far tighter than its frame so a detail fills the screen. The same three-part label row sits at exactly 50% height on every panel: date range at the left edge, series title in condensed caps starting about 10% in, count of pieces at the right edge. The fixed header overlays all of them unchanged, so scrolling reads like turning plates in a book.

Flat light-grey viewport. A single horizontal row of small portrait canvases, each about 11% of the viewport wide and 24% tall, photographed with their fabric edges and a soft shadow, spaced roughly 5% apart and vertically centred; the row runs off both sides. The series label row overlaps the first canvas. About 70% of the screen is empty grey.

steal: Crop artwork far past its edges to fill the screen and keep all text under 2vw, so the image does the shouting and the type behaves like a wall label.
Run a panel's metadata along one horizontal line at mid-height: date at the far left, title a tenth in, count at the far right, repeated identically on every panel.
Contrast full-bleed immersion with a sparse detail view: tiny complete works in a single row on flat grey with 70% of the screen left empty.

name: CoMinVi
idea: A heavy-industry contractor presented with a cinematic CG mine scene and survey-style monospace annotations, then a clean white corporate report beneath.
hero: Full-bleed dark blue-black CG scene of an underground cavern: rock in the foreground, haze, and a mining truck with lit headlamps right of centre. The headline is flush left at a 32px margin, vertically centred, two lines of bold white grotesk at 56px (3.9vw), filling about 40% of the width. Top-left a small boxed logo; top-right the word 'Menu' beside a 48px outlined circle with two bars. A tiny two-line mono annotation is pinned to the truck. Bottom-right, two bordered image cards about 215x140px, each with a white label strip inside its lower edge carrying mono caps and a black triangle.
type: Helvetica Now Display, bold for the hero and medium at about 28 to 32px for long statement paragraphs with tight leading, sentence case; 16px body. PP Supply Mono in 9 to 11px uppercase for labels, stat captions and buttons.
colour: #ffffff #ebf0ed #151515 #0b0d13 #293647 #e8552b — Midnight-blue hero, then alternating white and pale sage-grey (#ebf0ed) sections with near-black text. Colour comes only from photos: orange hi-vis suits and blue headlamp beams.
imagery: CG cavern scene in the hero; dark documentary photos of miners with headlamps and orange suits in landscape crops with 4px corners; a cut-out ore rock centred inside a dotted circular ring.
layout: 32px margins. Each section opens with a large statement paragraph spanning about 70% of the width, prefixed by a small stacked mono tag, followed by a media-plus-data row. Backgrounds alternate white and sage-grey, with plenty of empty space below statements.

sections.description: Below a 32px statement paragraph, a row split roughly 48/52: a landscape photo at left with slightly rounded corners, and at right a grid of figures, two columns by three rows. Each cell has a hairline on top, a small line icon at left, a bold 36px number and a 9px mono uppercase caption under it. The body paragraph and a small black button sit further down at the 75% column.

On pale sage-grey: a statement paragraph whose words fade from black to light grey mid-sentence, prefixed by a tiny stacked mono tag (an index code over a black label). Then a three-column grid of flat white square cards with 8px gaps: a small line icon top-left, the service name at 28px bottom-left, and nothing between, so the middle of each card is empty.

White section. A cut-out photo of a rough ore rock stands centred inside a large circle drawn with short radial tick marks, like a gauge. Bottom-left, a vertical list of mineral names at 40px where the active one is black and the rest pale grey, with a tiny mono caption above the list and a chemical-symbol tag at the right edge of the ring.

steal: Pin a tiny monospace data annotation to an object inside the hero image so the picture reads like a labelled survey.
Start each section's large statement paragraph with a small two-line mono tag (index over section name) set inline as its first word.
Use small image cards in the hero's bottom-right corner as shortcuts to key pages, each with a white label strip and arrow inside the frame.
media: A real-time 3D cavern scene covers 100% of the first screen, with two small photo link cards docked bottom-right at about 15% of the width each. Below come half-grid 4:5 photographs beside stats or a short paragraph, a pinned stage with a 3D ore specimen inside a tick-mark ring, cut-out machines contained on near-black cards, and a sticky name list ending in a full-bleed photograph, all in frames with about 8px corners where the pictures sit at 1.2 scale for a scroll zoom; there is no video.
motion: No entrance was captured (the load event took 24.6s), but under Lenis long statements are split into characters (1,066) whose colour is scrubbed from pale grey to ink, headings rise over 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.5,0,0,1) on 90 spans, and the minerals section pins for five steps, each adding a fifth of dark ticks to the ring as the specimen turns. Button labels roll to a longer phrase while an arrow box slides in over .5s cubic-bezier(.32,.01,0,1).

name: Kereliott
idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

name: NORMAL IS BORING
idea: The brand name is split and half of it turned upside down: a plain sans first word top-left and a serif last word flipped 180 degrees bottom-right stay fixed while panels slide sideways between them.
hero: A white panel fills the left 80%; a full-height interior photo takes the right 20%. Top-left: the first word of the name in light geometric capitals, about 56px. Bottom-right of the white panel: an italic 'is' above the last word in bold didone, rotated 180 degrees so it reads upside down. Three small caps nav links run vertically up the panel's right edge. The 50px headline is broken into three two-line fragments on different columns and baselines: one at 21% from the left, one a line lower at 42%, one back at 21% whose last word turns bold italic didone. A seven-line 13px paragraph hangs beneath the middle fragment.
type: Izmir, a light geometric sans in capitals, for wordmark, hero fragments and 13px body; Juana, a high-contrast didone, bold italic for accent words and huge roman capitals (10-12vw and larger, cropped) for scrolling statements; Editorial New ultralight for the reversed paragraph.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #ece4da #c7d7e9 #db5c59 #1f9aa0 — White and black panels alternate with warm beige; pale blue and coral panels appear deeper in. Type stays black or white. A single teal dot acts as cursor; photos bring wood and plant tones.
imagery: Warm interior and garden photography of finished homes in natural light, wood and linen tones. Square-cornered; used as full-height strips, full-bleed panels and smaller insets laid over larger photos by about a third.
layout: Reads as a sideways journey: white, black and beige panels slide horizontally with photos and oversized words cropped by panel edges. Text fragments sit on an irregular grid; the two halves of the logo stay fixed in opposite corners.

sections.description: The photo strip from the hero grows to a full-height panel while a second, smaller interior photo slides over it, overlapping by roughly a third. To the right a white panel carries a four-line statement in didone capitals about 90px tall, set so the lines run off the panel edge and are completed only as scrolling continues. A small 12px paragraph sits under the statement's left edge.

Full black panel. A nine-line paragraph in an ultralight serif at about 32px starts 70% of the way across and runs off the right edge; its words fade from white through grey to near-black line by line as a scroll-driven reveal. A single photo of a pool at dusk, roughly 300px square, sits alone in the lower-left third. The menu pill and flipped logo invert to white.

Values panel on beige. Along the left edge a vertical ticker repeats one word in 90px didone capitals rotated 90 degrees, separated by thin eight-point asterisks. Beside it a large exterior photograph of a stone-and-glass house with a bathroom photo about half its size laid over its lower-right corner, square edges, no shadow or border.

Beige panel where the project title is set so large that single didone letters exceed the viewport height and are cropped top and bottom, acting as black shapes in the left half. In the right half a modest 300px-wide aerial photo floats with a bracketed year above and a centred serif caption and two-line descriptor below.

steal: Split a two-part brand name into opposite corners of the viewport and flip one half 180 degrees so the logo enacts the name.
Break a headline into fragments on different columns and baselines, like a stair, and hang the body paragraph under one fragment only.
Scale a project title until single letters are taller than the viewport, then float a small captioned photo beside those cropped shapes.
media: The only picture on the first screen is an interior photograph cropped to the right 20% (290px, full height), the leading edge of a pinned horizontal track that widens to about 65% on the next screen. Inside the track, overlapping pairs lay a smaller photograph over a larger full-height one, project cards widen as they reach the centre, and a photograph sits framed in a flat coral field; all 29 images have square corners and reveal by clip-path while scaling down from 1.5, and there is no video.
motion: About 2.5s of entrance: the logo, then headline characters, then body lines rising from masks (y over 0.65-0.97s power3.out at a 0.025-0.033 stagger), then the photo and nav. One section pins for +=1150% (about 10,350px) at scrub 1 and is translated sideways; photo pairs move on scrub 0.35, a statement fills line by line on scrub 0, and project cards widen over 1s power1.inOut; a dot cursor grows with a back-out overshoot the house layer does not use.

name: Rafael Derolez
idea: A portfolio as a phone carousel: a fixed text rail on the left narrates whichever phone-shaped screen is centred on the right.
hero: Dark charcoal page split by a vertical hairline at 30% width. Left rail: a 55px header row with name, slash and current section as a breadcrumb in 16px sans, plus a small cobalt ticket-shaped hire button with a perforated divider and arrow; below a hairline, four short paragraphs of 16px grey text with white links, top-aligned, leaving the lower 40% of the rail empty. Right 70%: three phone-proportioned frames with large rounded corners in a row; the centre one upright, full brightness and about 680px tall, the outer two smaller, dimmed and rotated in perspective toward the centre.
type: Suisse at a single 16px size, weight 400, for everything; hierarchy comes only from grey versus white and from the breadcrumb. The one larger setting is a bold two-word line inside the blue contact card. No display type at all.
colour: #18181b #030303 #969696 #173ded #ffffff — Zinc-black field with grey text and white for links and the active breadcrumb. Cobalt blue appears only on the hire button and contact card; all other colour comes from the app screenshots.
imagery: Phone-shaped frames with large corner radius holding app screens, a selfie and short videos; side frames are dimmed to about 40% and tilted in 3D like a cover-flow.
layout: Single viewport, no page scroll: a fixed 432px text rail with 32px padding and a media stage filling the rest. Scrolling advances the carousel and replaces the rail's text; hairlines separate rail, header and stage. On mobile the stage stacks above the rail.

sections.description: Same two-part frame. The breadcrumb's last word changes to the project name; under the header sit three tiny grey meta tags (employer, platform), then two paragraphs. On the stage the centred phone shows the product screen at full brightness while neighbours show the previous and next items dimmed and tilted, so the carousel works as both navigation and preview.

In the rail, a cobalt card shaped like a ticket with notched sides: tiny labels top-left and top-right, a large bold two-word heading, name and local time in small text, then a perforated lower strip with email at left and a copy button at right. Under it, a career list: company in white with dates in small grey on one line, role on the next, and a small arrow at the far right of each row.

steal: Use a breadcrumb (name / current item) as the only heading and update its last word as the content changes.
Show work in device-shaped frames arranged as a cover-flow, with neighbours dimmed and tilted so the next item is always previewed.
Shape the contact card like a ticket with notches and a perforated strip so the one accent-colour element feels like an object.

name: Moto Finance
idea: A metal card presented like a museum piece: lit by a single overhead light box in a black room, then orbiting through dim architectural stills.
hero: Black full-bleed 3D scene. A pale silver-lavender light panel, a trapezoid in perspective like a ceiling light box, occupies the top 20% and centre 55% of the viewport. The two-line uppercase headline, centred at 4.4vw in medium grotesk with tight leading, straddles the panel's lower edge so its first line sits half on light, half on black. In the exact centre a small metal card stands on a low plinth, only about 150px wide, surrounded by darkness. A light-grey pill button (about 250 by 52px) is centred near the bottom; the logo is top-left and a dark pill button top-right.
type: Neue Montreal only: weight 500 uppercase at 64px (4.4vw) with near-zero tracking and leading under 1.0 for headings, 20px sentence case for body, tiny caps labels in the footer. Three sizes; centred until the left-aligned footer.
colour: #080808 #edefef #c4cbd6 #e1e5e5 #2a2f3a — Black with cool silver-grey and no brand colour at all. One section inverts to pale grey-white with grey type; the only chroma is amber city lights and a blue atmosphere rim on the globe.
imagery: Rendered chrome card with an embossed profile medallion, a night-side Earth, and small dim architectural and fashion stills floating as tilted panels in 3D. Everything underexposed, cool and low-saturation.
layout: Full-viewport scenes stacked one per screen, each with a centred uppercase heading, an optional short sub-line and a pill button. One light interlude breaks the black. The footer switches to a left-aligned statement with link columns at the far right.

sections.description: Centred heading at the top with a two-line grey sub-line and a pale pill button directly under it. The lower 45% is the top arc of a night-side Earth rising from the bottom edge, about 75% of the viewport wide, with city lights and a bright blue-white rim on the upper right. Three small dark capsule labels with check icons float over and beside the globe at staggered positions, like status notifications.

A dark 3D room: about twelve small photo panels (roughly 70 by 90px, each tilted at its own angle, heavily dimmed) arranged in two loose rows across the full width, receding with blur. The card stands edge-on in the centre, much larger, catching a specular highlight. Later the card faces front at top-centre and a centred two-line heading with a pill button sits under it.

A pale grey-white band. Two tall columns of currency amounts in mid-size light-grey sans, one at a quarter and one at three-quarters of the width, each fading to white at top and bottom like slot-machine reels, with the centre rows darkest. Between them, three short centred lines of small black text. The bottom edge of the band reveals a dark photograph.

steal: Let a headline straddle the edge of a light shape so one line is half on light and half on dark.
Show the product very small in a large dark space in the first viewport, then let it grow as the page scrolls.
Use vertically scrolling columns of real-looking figures, faded at both ends, as a quiet backdrop for a three-line statement.
media: An 11s hero video of a CG metal card on a plinth covers the whole first screen and holds on its last frame. Then a pinned WebGL globe in the lower half under centred text, a 3D card centred in a depth cloud of small photo tiles dimmed to 30-40%, full-bleed sticky photographs with text docked in opposite corners, and a photo strip sitting on an index list; all low-key and desaturated, photos meeting the near-black ground through 200-300px fades, 0px radius.
motion: The intro ends in about 1.2s as the camera pushes in and the headline, nav and button arrive (load 9.9s), and Lenis then runs 32 ScrollTriggers: the globe pins for 2.5 viewports at scrub 1, the card turns in 3D across its section, the theme inverts to pale grey with the nav colour following, and benefit rows scrub in one by one. Lines rise by yPercent over 0.65s power3.out and leave over 0.45s power2.in, and headings rise from a blur over 1s power2.inOut.

name: The state of the gallery
idea: A year-in-review told as a flight over a glowing particle landscape, where each statistic or pick is a single word floating in 3D space.
hero: The desktop capture caught the loader: a blue-black screen with a faint dot grid, a 4px acid-yellow progress bar across the top edge, the small logo centred at the top, and a percentage counter at 13.9vw (200px) in thin pale blue-grey grotesk anchored bottom-left. The loaded hero, seen on mobile, splits the title in two: the first two words top-left and the last three bottom-right at the same giant size, with a centred uppercase paragraph between them, all over a full-bleed terrain of olive-green haze and yellow particles. Tiny capital labels occupy all four corners.
type: Overused Grotesk only, regular weight: display words at 5 to 14vw in pale blue-grey with a faint lilac sheen, small parenthesised counts set as superscripts beside them, and 10px uppercase captions and corner labels. Two sizes and no bold.
colour: #08090d #515721 #b9c6cd #e6f21a #c8b9ee — Blue-black ground; the olive-to-acid-yellow glow of the particle field is the single colour. Type is cool pale grey with a lilac tint, and the yellow loader bar is the brightest element.
imagery: A procedural landscape of soft olive fog ridges with thousands of yellow-white points streaming toward the horizon in perspective; later, a curved floor of small tilted white tiles standing for catalogued sites. No photographs.
layout: One pinned canvas with a text overlay. Four corner labels stay fixed; each scroll step puts a single word or name at the centre with a one-line caption beneath it in the lower third. Nothing else appears on screen.

sections.description: Full-bleed particle terrain. One category word is centred at about 5vw in pale iridescent grotesk, with its count in parentheses set small and raised at the word's top-right like a superscript. A single-line uppercase caption at 10px sits centred roughly 20% below. Behind the word the particles briefly cluster into the shape of a large numeral. Corner labels are unchanged.

A top-pick slide: a tiny uppercase label above, then the pick's name centred at about 5vw and partly occluded by the scene. Below it dozens of small white rectangular tiles lie on a curved, receding floor grid, some flat and some tilting up toward the camera, growing larger toward the bottom edge of the viewport. A one-line caption sits under the name.

steal: Split a title in two and pin the halves to opposite corners, top-left and bottom-right, at the same giant size with the supporting paragraph centred between them.
Attach a count to a big word as a small parenthesised superscript at its top-right instead of building a stat card.
Make the loading percentage the first giant typographic element, anchored bottom-left under a full-width accent progress bar.
media: One fixed WebGL canvas is the only surface: a particle landscape covers 99% of the first screen with the title straight on it, and as you travel the particles leave the ground to form numerals, a figure, floating screenshot cards and a tile-grid panel, while streams of thumbnail tiles fly low between beats. No img or video elements.
motion: A percentage preloader is still at 89% at 4.5s, though the load event fired at 2.1s; after it the wheel is captured, each step easing the camera forward to the next beat, with text-free fly-through steps between them (5 of 13 screens show only terrain). Characters rise with a stagger, transform and opacity over 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) on 704 spans, 0.42s for secondary lines, and counts pop in with an overshoot from 0.6 to 1.08 to 1.

name: Aevion
idea: One photoreal drone flies down the whole page through a white space organised only by hairlines and very light type.
hero: The first capture is the preloader: a white field with a tiny mono percentage counter dead centre. The loaded hero is white with a hairline-thin top bar: logo and a descriptor left, a credit and a live GMT clock in the middle, a small grey menu chip right. A pale blue-grey gradient panel fills the top 40% inside 12px margins. A white 3D drone hovers at centre, straddling a full-width hairline; a vertical hairline drops from it to the bottom edge. The headline is only 24px, two lines, far left, sitting on the horizontal rule with its second sentence greyed; a scroll cue sits far right on the same line.
type: Switzer in light weight (300) with -0.033em tracking for everything from the 24px headline to a single word at 16.7vw; protoMono at 12px in caps for bracketed labels and legal lines. Slate and pale grey mixed within one sentence. Four sizes.
colour: #fdfdfd #eef1f3 #24363f #a3abb0 #d5d9db — White on white with dark slate type and a paler grey for unrevealed words. The only tint is a faint blue-grey wash in the hero and the teal glint of the drone's lens. Cool.
imagery: A single white-and-grey quadcopter rendered live, with motion-blurred rotors, shown from front, three-quarter and side as it moves; often cropped by the right edge. Supporting graphics are hairline arcs and circles like a technical drawing.
layout: 12px page margins, content hung on a few full-width and half-width hairlines. Each screen holds one idea: a statement, a word, an object. Text stays left or lower-right while the drone travels between them. Nineteen screens of mostly white.

sections.description: White screen with a vertical hairline at 50% and a horizontal one near the bottom. Left half: a four-line statement at about 3vw in light grotesk, each word either dark slate or pale grey as a scroll-linked reveal passes through it. Right half: the drone in three-quarter view, cropped by the right edge and crossing the vertical rule.

A single noun set at 16.7vw in slate, top-left, the largest type on the page. A tiny mono label with a bullet sits far left at mid-height; a numbered chip sits top-right. The drone overlaps the right side at mid-height, and beneath it a 24px two-paragraph spec block occupies the right half, its later words still ghosted.

Landing diagram: the drone hovers above a drawing made only of hairlines: a large semicircular arc, a small circular target on the baseline, vertical dividers creating three bays, and a bracketed mono label above the target. Nothing else is on screen; the object and the drawing carry the whole frame.

Bracketed mono labels at both ends of a hairline, then a two-column row: a question at left, an answer plus a small square-cornered slate button at right. Below right, two short link lists in 12px; studio logo bottom-left; a mono legal line across the bottom edge.

steal: Use one hairline cross (a horizontal plus a vertical rule) as the only layout furniture and let the product render straddle it.
Set a single noun at 16vw as a chapter title and keep all explanatory copy at 24px, with nothing in between.
Reveal paragraphs word by word from pale grey to dark slate tied to scroll, so unread text stays visibly ghosted.
media: Every product view is real-time 3D: one fixed WebGL canvas carries the drone, centred at about 42% of the width inside an inset 1392x812 pale panel with a giant blurred wordmark behind it, then moves to the right half, then above a semicircle gauge, then inside a flat pale panel, while the HTML scrolls round it. The only photographic colour is one muted 8s clip filling the right half of a split.
motion: A numeric preloader counts for about 4.5s, then the page wipes up from the bottom by clip-path over 1670ms on a spring-shaped linear() ease, the ghost wordmark sharpens from a 200px blur over 2020ms, and the caption letters de-blur at a 50ms stagger. Lenis with two long pins (about 3.9 and 6.8 viewports) that step through three states each, swapping the drone's pose; statements scrub from grey to ink word by word, and buttons move over 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1).

name: hiroto-sato
idea: The portfolio's navigation is one 3D street pole: a traffic light, name plate, convex mirror and arrow signs carry the name and the links, and scrolling walks you around it.
hero: The captured first frame is a black preloader with one line of small tracked uppercase text centred. Once loaded the page is white: a glossy 3D signal pole runs the full height slightly right of centre, about a quarter of the width, carrying a yellow traffic light, a yellow name plate, a round mirror reflecting a tiny room, and a blue arrow sign. Top-left, a 9px grey role label sits above the name in roughly 36px uppercase grotesk. Top-right, four tiny uppercase links stack right-aligned. Bottom-left, three small label-over-value columns sit under short hairlines. Everything else is empty white.
type: Helvetica Neue LT Pro only, all uppercase. The name at about 36px medium is the largest HTML text; everything else is 9–10px in grey or black. The expressive lettering lives on the 3D signs: condensed black on yellow, slanted white on blue.
colour: #ffffff #d0d0d4 #f3e11d #2853e6 #0a0a0a #ff4a3c — White page and black micro-type; all colour is confined to the 3D object in road-sign primaries (signal yellow, sign blue, one red lamp) plus chrome reflections.
imagery: One real-time 3D object in glossy toy plastic and mirror chrome, cropped by the top and bottom of the viewport, lit flat on white with no ground shadow; the mirror holds a second miniature scene.
layout: One fixed viewport with 20px margins. Text is parked in three corners at tiny sizes, leaving the middle to the object. Scrolling does not move the page; it rotates the pole so different signs face the camera.

sections.description: Scroll states instead of sections: the corner text stays put while the pole turns. One state shows the back of the traffic light with a white sign bearing a blue arrow for the contact link; another brings the name plate edge-on with the mirror reflecting sky; another returns to the front with the blue archive arrow sweeping across the lower third. Each sign is a link target and is cropped boldly by the frame.

steal: Turn navigation into one physical object from the real world (signage, a control panel, a shelf) and let scroll rotate it instead of moving the page.
Keep all HTML text tiny and monochrome in the corners so a single saturated 3D object owns both the colour and the scale.
Hide a miniature scene inside a reflective surface of the hero object as a reward for looking closely.
media: One fixed WebGL canvas covers the whole viewport, but the visible subject is a single chrome signpost about 42% of the width and the full height on pure white, so roughly 35-40% of the pixels carry image; footage and project art play as textures on its round sign. No img or video elements on the home page.
motion: A loading word scrambles into random capitals, then a black curtain with a curved lower edge lifts at about 2.5s and the sign's text decodes into the job title by 4.5s. There is no page scroll: each wheel step snaps the signpost round to its next face in an endless three-face loop, the lamps change and the labels re-scramble, all on one curve, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), at .18s for colour and opacity and .26-.62s for transforms, with no reduced-motion rule.

name: Specia1ne
idea: One thin blue vertical line runs the full height of the page at 60% of the width, and every section hangs off it like entries on a spine.
hero: Type only on warm off-white. Header: wordmark left, the word 'Menu' with a four-square blue icon right, a hairline beneath, 56px side margins. A mono index label (blue number, slash, one word) sits 90px under the rule. The headline follows in four left-aligned lines of bold grotesk at 100px (7% of viewport width) with leading under 1.0, the longest line reaching 90% of the width. A two-line grey 18px paragraph sits beneath. A single 1px blue vertical line crosses the whole viewport at 60% width, straight through the headline. Bottom-left: a blue square with mono location and clock. Bottom-right: a two-line bold link wrapped in blue square brackets.
type: Geist bold at 100px for the hero, about 44px bold for section heads, 26 to 44px semibold for list entries, 16px body. Geist Mono at 11 to 14px for index labels, tags and status lines. Zero tracking on the headline; four clear steps of scale.
colour: #f2f1eb #1d39f5 #141412 #6f6e69 #ffffff — Warm off-white and one saturated cobalt. Blue starts as a hairline, bracket and small square, then takes over a whole section as a flat field with white text, then returns as one button block.
imagery: No images at all. Visual interest comes from the spine line, small numbered square chips, square brackets and flat colour fields.
layout: 56px margins. Every section opens the same way: mono index label, two-line bold heading at left, a short right-aligned note at far right. Content then aligns to the vertical line: titles right-aligned against it, descriptions starting just after it, rows split by hairlines.

sections.description: Full-bleed cobalt section. White heading top-left, a right-aligned note top-right, mono counters in the corners. Five project rows about 125px tall, split by faint hairlines: each project name in 44px bold is right-aligned to end just left of the vertical line, a small white numbered square sits on the line, and a mono uppercase category starts just right of it. The active row is brighter and gains a description, an arrow at far right and mono tags at far left.

The same spine layout on off-white: four capability names in 30px semibold right-aligned to the line, blue numbered squares on the line, one-line descriptions to its right, hairlines between rows. The list closes with a mirrored pair of captions either side of the line, each under a tiny blue mono label, joined by a bracketed blue square on the line. A blue block wipes upward over the section as a transition.

A nearly empty section: heading at left, note at right, then a short segment of the vertical line capped by tick marks with tiny mono labels at its top and bottom. At its midpoint the studio name sits right-aligned on the left of the line, a bracketed blue square on the line, and a two-line caption on the right. It is a diagram of one sentence, with most of the screen blank.

Heading at left, note at right, then a single flat blue rectangle about 480px wide and 195px tall, centred on the vertical line rather than on the page. Inside: a bold white phrase in square brackets and a mono line with an underlined email address. A hairline footer row beneath carries mono legal links at left and the location with a clock at right.

steal: Run one 1px coloured vertical line through the whole page at an off-centre position and align lists to it: names right-aligned on one side, descriptions on the other, a numbered square on the line.
Introduce the accent as a hairline and a bracket, then let it take over one entire section as a flat field.
Wrap calls to action in square brackets in the accent colour instead of drawing a button.

name: Fynza
idea: Bookings are drawn as avatar dots whose orange flow lines merge into a single vertical spine, which then runs down the page as the axis for the partner list, the cash-flow timeline and the step cards.
hero: Warm grey ground with a fine white dot texture and a peach gradient bleeding down from the top edge. A floating white pill navbar 80% wide holds the logo left and a language switch plus outlined and orange pill buttons right. Centred stack: a white pill badge with overlapping partner-logo dots, a two-line extra-bold uppercase headline at 4.2vw in slate navy with two words in orange, two lines of grey 18px text, an orange pill button. Around the button five round avatar photos with small booking labels sit at staggered heights across the full width; thin orange curves, two dashed, flow down from each and converge at bottom centre.
type: Golos Text only: weight 800 uppercase at 60px for every section headline with slight negative tracking, 18px regular grey body, about 24px semibold for card titles, tiny uppercase captions. A wide extended logo wordmark. Roughly four sizes; hierarchy relies on weight and colour.
colour: #edecea #ffffff #f4bba8 #f2561d #3f4f6e #1a2e7a — Warm grey and white with peach gradients fading in at section tops and bottoms; orange carries buttons, flow lines and highlighted headline words; one deep royal-navy slab near the end.
imagery: Round avatar photos, partner logo discs, sunny travel photographs inside rounded cards with white UI snippets floating on top, and illustrated vintage postage stamps tilted and scattered around the final call to action.
layout: Centred container of about 1150px; every section opens with a small white pill label and a two-line uppercase headline. A single orange vertical line runs through the page centre linking hero, logo list, timeline and step cards. Sections alternate grey, peach fade and one navy slab.

sections.description: Directly under the hero the converged orange line becomes a vertical spine and partner brands hang off it in two columns: logo then name on the left, name then logo on the right. Rows are separated by dashed horizontal rules with small orange dots where they cross the spine. There is no heading, so it reads as a continuation of the hero diagram.

Problem timeline on the centre spine: small rounded-square chips labelled by week sit on the line. Events alternate left and right, each joined to its chip by a dashed horizontal line ending in a small coloured amount tag (red for outflow, green for income), with a bold label and two lines of grey text. A red-tinted rounded note sits on the spine as the conclusion while the background fades to saturated peach.

Three large white rounded cards stacked on the spine, each a two-column split that alternates sides: on one side an orange numbered disc, a three-line semibold title and a small grey paragraph; on the other a rounded travel photograph with a white UI card or a cluster of logo discs floating over it. The orange line passes behind the gaps between cards.

Dotted peach-to-white field with a centred two-line uppercase headline, one word in orange, and an orange pill button. Six illustrated vintage travel stamps and round stickers are scattered around it at slight rotations, three above and three below, some tucked under the navbar. A tiny two-line legal footer sits directly underneath, centred, with no separate footer band.

steal: Turn the hero illustration's lines into a page-long spine: let the curves converge at the fold and continue as the axis for the next section's list and timeline.
Show the customer's own unit of value (a booking with name, party size and price) as small avatar chips instead of a dashboard screenshot.
End on a themed sticker scatter (illustrated stamps at varied tilt) around the last call to action rather than a plain coloured band.

name: Colonia Zacamil
idea: The sentence is the layout: 'FLY TO ___ ZACAMIL' runs as one full-width line, with a strip of drone video filling the gap where a word would sit.
hero: Warm off-white field with no navigation at all. One line of black ultra-condensed capitals about 13vw tall sits on the vertical centre and runs edge to edge with 28px side margins: 'FLY', a wide gap, 'TO', then a rounded-corner strip of aerial video exactly as tall as the letters and half the viewport wide, then 'ZACAMIL'. A tiny mono bracket label sits above the last word. About 150px lower, a small black pill button with a white dot-in-circle at its right end is centred. Two centred lines of 24px serif sit near the bottom edge. The top third is empty.
type: Heathergreen, an ultra-condensed regular-weight sans, in capitals at 187px; Reckless Neue serif at 24px for the caption; Roboto Mono for the button and bracket label. Three faces, each used once, with roughly an 8:1 jump and no tracking adjustments.
colour: #ebe6e0 #000000 #3d4633 #8d8a84 #4d8fa3 — Warm putty paper with pure black type and button. The only colour on the page is inside the video strip: tree greens, roof greys and one patch of teal.
imagery: Top-down drone footage of housing blocks and trees, cropped to an extreme letterbox near 5:1 with 14px rounded corners and used as a word inside the headline; on mobile it becomes a 2:1 block between two headline lines.
layout: Single viewport, no scroll captured. Everything hangs on the central axis: full-width headline line mid-screen, button below, caption at the foot. About 80% of the screen is bare paper. On mobile the sentence stacks into three bands: words, video, word.
steal: Replace a word in the headline with a media strip cut to the cap height, so the picture is read as part of the sentence.
Use three type voices once each (ultra-condensed display, soft serif caption, mono button) instead of one family in many sizes.
On mobile, restack the same sentence as word / image / word at full width rather than shrinking the single line.

name: /zeroz Brand Site
idea: A single supplement pouch floats in a green-lit 3D room, and bursts of white light act as the scene changes between short statements.
hero: The captured first viewport is a white light bloom mid-transition; the settled hero appears one frame later. A dark green 3D room with a hexagonal ceiling lamp fills the screen. A green pouch, about 35% of viewport height, floats tilted at dead centre with a white tablet beside it. The headline is split around it: two centred lines above and two below at 5.6vw in regular Helvetica Now, partly overlapping the pouch. Large thin parentheses bracket the product, and tiny three-line labels sit far left and far right at the same height. Wordmark top-left, four links top-centre, a small white store tab pinned top-right, a Japanese tagline bottom-centre.
type: HelveticaNowDisplay Regular for Latin headlines at 80px, centred, no tracking; Tazugane Gothic Regular and Medium for Japanese at about 18px with wide letter-spacing. Regular weights only, so scale and white-on-green contrast do the work. The footer wordmark is custom slashed lettering spanning the full width.
colour: #1f3a26 #00a852 #ffffff #455a48 #111312 — Everything is one green: dark and smoky in the 3D room, saturated flat green in the footer and store tab. White appears as light itself, blooming to fill the screen between scenes.
imagery: Real-time 3D pouch and tablet in a fogged green room with a hexagonal spotlight and floor glow; full-bleed canvas, no photographs visible, soft volumetric light and heavy lens bloom.
layout: A pinned full-screen canvas driven by nearly fifty screens of scroll; text arrives as short centred statements inside discs of white light. Slim fixed nav. Only the footer becomes a flat layout, with a logo left, a link column near centre and a giant wordmark.

sections.description: The room stays in place while a soft-edged white disc, about 45% of viewport width with a wide feathered falloff, opens at centre where the product hung. Inside it sits a three-line centred statement in dark grey: wide-tracked Japanese on lines one and three, a quoted Latin phrase in light grotesk on line two, all around 18 to 20px. The green floor glow and ceiling lamp remain visible around the disc.

Between scenes the pouch dissolves into a ball of light at centre: thin radial streak lines fly outward, the hexagonal lamp flares overhead, and the tablet remains as the only solid object, drifting to the lower right of the glow. The nav wordmark and store tab switch from white to green as the background brightens.

Flat saturated green block one viewport tall. Parent-company logo top-left in white, a five-item link column starting just right of centre, an underlined store link top-right. The bottom half is the wordmark with its leading slash, in white, scaled to run from the left edge to the right edge at about 28% of viewport height. A single line of legal links sits beneath it at 10px.

steal: Split a four-line headline into two lines above and two below a centred product, letting the object interrupt the sentence.
Use a feathered disc of white light as the text container instead of a card.
End the page on a flat field of the brand colour with the wordmark scaled edge to edge.
media: One fixed WebGL canvas covers the fold and renders the whole story: a dark green room in one-point perspective with a glowing ceiling panel, a tilted pouch and tablet at about 23% of the width bracketed by the split headline, a light disc that becomes the text page, a burst of the logo and photographs, and about 20 lifestyle photos as skewed cards on a 3D ribbon round a chapter title. DOM video appears only in the closing link index, eight short loops stacked on portrait pictures.
motion: A light burst comes first (the page took 19.5s to load), then the product with its headline by 2.5s and the nav by 4.5s, and Lenis then drives the fixed canvas through long sticky runways (10,152px for the opening): the camera dollies into the ceiling light, the manifesto advances one line at a time in a reading spotlight, and the photo ribbon arcs over the top as the ground goes from dark green to white to mint. The house ease is cubic-bezier(.3,.26,.38,1), 67 uses, mostly at 0.3-0.5s, and staggered rises step by 40ms per index.

name: Elva
idea: The entire page is staged inside one oversized phone: the headline lives on the phone's screen while a huge out-of-focus echo of the same words drifts behind it.
hero: Near-black grainy field. A phone outline about half the viewport wide stands centred, its top at 16% of the height and its lower half cropped by the bottom edge. Its screen shows a warm close-up of a smiling freckled face lit yellow from the right. The headline sits inside the screen, centred, white, three lines at roughly 64px with a two-line 18px sub-line. Behind the phone the same sentence repeats at about 8.5vw, blurred with colour fringing, dim grey, spanning the full width. Corners: rounded outlined logo chip top-left, glassy action bar top-right, small credit chip bottom-left, dot button bottom-right.
type: Neue Haas Grotesk Display only, regular weight, sentence case, tracking -0.03em so letters nearly touch, white. Headlines 64 to 104px, sub-lines 16 to 18px, chips 16px. The same face is reused at 8.5vw as a blurred, colour-fringed background layer.
colour: #090908 #151413 #393938 #d99a1c #362619 #ffffff — Soft black with film grain; the only colour is the amber-yellow light inside the phone photo, which bleeds faintly into the dark around the device. White text, grey blurred echo.
imagery: One warm, shallow-focus portrait (video) seen only through a phone-shaped frame with a thin light outline and realistic side buttons; heavy grain; round app icons overlaid at the top of the screen.
layout: A single centred column the width of the phone; outside it the page is empty black except for four small chips pinned to the corners. The phone stays fixed for all 2.8 screens while its inner text and the blurred backdrop change.

sections.description: The phone frame stays pinned and centred, slightly lower so its full top bezel shows. The on-screen statement is replaced by a longer five-line sentence at about 100px, centred and wider than the phone. The giant blurred echo text slides vertically behind the device, level with the headline in one frame and sinking below the bottom edge in the next, acting as a parallax layer.

Still inside the phone screen: feature names set as centred headings at about 80px, each followed by a two-line 12px description and a tiny square arrow icon, stacked vertically and scrolling through the screen area like an app feed. The portrait remains behind as a darkened backdrop. In the capture several states overlap, so headings collide with the previous statement.

steal: Put the hero headline on the screen of an oversized, bottom-cropped device so the product frame doubles as the text container.
Repeat the headline behind the main object at several times the size, blurred with colour fringing, as a depth layer instead of a gradient.
Pin four tiny chips to the four viewport corners (logo, action, credit, toggle) and leave out all other chrome.

name: Tara
idea: Two pastel circles, mint for saving and pink for spending, stand for the app's two accounts and recur as icon, inline dot, section colour and card gradient.
hero: Off-white field with no navigation, only a small bold wordmark top-left. The left column is vertically centred and starts about 8% in: a two-line headline in a wide heavy grotesk at roughly 6vw with tight leading, a grey one-line subhead beneath, then a pill-shaped email field about 400px wide with a black pill button nested inside its right end. The right half holds a 3D pair floating on the page colour: a mint-to-pink gradient bank card tilted about 30 degrees, overlapping a perspective-tilted phone showing a balance screen. Two small award badges are stacked on the right edge. Roughly half the viewport is empty.
type: Herokid Wide at weight 600 with -0.04em tracking for headlines, regular-width Herokid for everything else. Sentence case in the hero, all-caps for the scroll statements. Roughly 86px headline against 14px body, with a mid size of about 24px for centred explainer lines.
colour: #f8f8f8 #0a0a0a #c3edce #f8c7c9 #ffffff — Near-white base with black type. Mint and pink appear only as the two account colours: first as small circles, then as full-screen section fields and a soft glow behind the footer wordmark.
imagery: 3D bank card and tilted phone mock-ups carrying app screens, floating without a container on the page colour; later a straight-on phone on a flat mint field. Simple line icons inside solid pastel circles.
layout: Twenty screens of scroll but very little per screen: one centred object or statement per viewport with large empty margins. A wordmark top-left and a tiny pill button top-right persist. Full-bleed pastel fields mark the two product chapters; a row of four white cards closes.

sections.description: A pinned, nearly empty viewport where a single mint circle holding a line icon sits upper-centre with a pink circle peeking from behind it. On scroll the pink circle slides out to sit beside the mint one, overlapping slightly, each with its own icon, and three centred lines of roughly 24px text appear beneath explaining the two accounts. Nothing else is on screen.

A chapter-title screen: two words of heavy uppercase at about 5vw, centred and stacked on two lines, with a mint dot the height of the capitals sitting inline after the first word like punctuation. The dot is the same circle from the previous scene, so the colour carries its meaning straight into the full-mint section that follows.

Full-viewport mint field. A small eyebrow and a bold product name are centred near the top. Below, a straight-on phone mock-up stands just right of centre, and a short right-aligned bold claim with two lines of small text sits to its left, level with the phone's lower third. Text and phone hug the centre line, leaving both outer thirds empty.

After four white rounded cards and a repeated centred email pill, the footer is one row of small links and then the wordmark set enormous, around 45vw wide and cropped by the bottom edge. It is white on the off-white page and becomes visible only through blurred pink and mint glows placed behind the letters.

steal: Assign each product concept a colour and a shape early (two pastel circles), then reuse it as bullet, inline punctuation dot and full section background.
Nest the call-to-action button inside the email field's pill so the form reads as one object.
Set the footer wordmark in the page's own background colour and reveal it only with soft coloured glows behind the letters.

name: Realevate
idea: The site is a board you zoom out of: the home screen with its slogan marquee becomes one tile beneath four tall colour-coded category cards.
hero: White field, all type navy. Top row about 8% down: one link far left, an extended-caps wordmark centred, one link far right. Across the vertical middle a two-word slogan repeats as a marquee at about 15vw in medium weight, cropped by both edges; a square photograph about 19vw wide sits dead centre on top of it, hiding the letters behind. Lower third: a two-line centred subhead near 24px and, beneath it, a thin-outlined rectangular tag in tiny extended capitals. Bottom-left a copyright line; bottom-right an outlined rectangular button beside a solid navy square menu button.
type: Google Sans medium at 218px with -0.02em tracking for the marquee and roughly 16-24px for interface text. Monument Extended in small spaced capitals for the wordmark and price tag. Card titles are rotated 90 degrees and read bottom to top.
colour: #ffffff #1e2a5e #e1e2ea #3a664f #2c1a2e #1c1b1e — Navy on white with no other interface colour in the hero. The overview sits on pale lavender-grey and gives each category a flat card colour: navy, forest green, aubergine, near-black.
imagery: Glossy architectural renders of sea-view terraces, resorts and towers. One perfect square in the hero; landscape crops fill the bottom third of each category card. Square corners, full saturation, no grade.
layout: A one-screen site with two states. Home is symmetrical: corners hold small utilities, the centre holds marquee and image. The overview is a four-column row of tall cards with equal gutters and a scaled-down live copy of the home screen centred beneath.

sections.description: Pale lavender-grey ground with four equal portrait cards in a row, roughly 1:2 in proportion, about 20px apart with generous outer margins. Each card is a flat colour block for its top 70% and a photograph for the bottom 30%. A small monogram sits top-left; the category name runs vertically up the right side in white at about 28px; a two-line descriptor in tiny white text sits bottom-left of the colour block, just above the image.

Centred below the card row, spanning the middle two columns, sits a miniature of the home screen: a white rectangle with the tiny nav row, the slogan marquee still running and the square photo in the middle, cropped by the viewport's bottom edge. It acts as a live thumbnail of where the visitor came from and a way back.

steal: Run a giant slogan marquee through the middle of the viewport and park a square image on top so the words are read as they pass around the picture.
Build category cards as a tall colour block over a short photo, with the title rotated up the right edge.
Keep utilities in the four corners (two links top, copyright bottom-left, action pair bottom-right) and leave the sides empty.
media: A white screen led by type: a single centred 272px square photograph covers about 9% of the viewport and works as a window laid over a running marquee line, the words passing behind it. The preloader cycles property photographs through the same square so the load hands off without a cut; in the selection state, photographs fill the bottom 30% of four tall colour-block cards; five images in the home state, no video.
motion: About 2.2s of preloader: a navy screen with the square flipping through photographs and a counter climbing, then the ground turns white around the square and the details arrive last in a stagger. There is no document scroll: the first wheel step shrinks the home screen to about 44% below the four category cards, and the slogan marquee loops every 14.06s at about 43px/s; cards transition transform and filter over 0.8s cubic-bezier(.18,.13,0,.99), buttons wipe their fill over 0.75s, and there are 5 reduced-motion rules.

name: Typewave
idea: A plugin about type scales sold on a near-black page where flat saturated fields (orange, lime, blue) act as stages for the plugin's own dark interface.
hero: Near-black field. Nav row at the top: pixel-block logo and wordmark left, four plain links centred (one carrying a tiny lime tag), a cream rectangular button with a Figma glyph right. The headline sits centred around mid-height: three lines at about 6.7vw, medium weight, off-white, with the third line recoloured pale lime. Below it a three-line 18px paragraph held to about 45% of the width, then a small cream button repeating the nav action. About 150px lower, the top edge of a flat orange slab, 70% of the viewport wide with barely rounded corners, peeks over the fold; it holds the plugin window.
type: Roobert throughout: weight 500 for the 96px headline with slight negative tracking, 16-18px body, 28px card headings, about four sizes in all. Sentence case everywhere; the only emphasis device is recolouring one headline line.
colour: #0f0f0e #191918 #e6e3da #f88616 #e4f283 #1463ff — Warm near-black ground with cream text. Orange, lime and electric blue never colour paragraphs; they only fill the rectangles behind product screenshots and the matching step-number chips.
imagery: Dark plugin windows with a soft drop shadow, floated centred on flat saturated rectangles (orange, lime, blue, one pink); the rectangles are near square-cornered and inset inside a slightly lighter dark card.
layout: Centred hero, then a 1000px container of full-width dark cards, each split one-third text and two-thirds colour stage. Export features alternate text and tile left to right. A small two-button bar stays pinned bottom-centre.

sections.description: Three stacked cards in a slightly lighter black, each about 1000 by 350px. Left third: a 16px square number chip in the card's accent colour at the top, a three-line 28px heading under it, and a grey 12px paragraph pushed to the card's bottom edge, leaving a tall gap between. Right two-thirds: a flat colour rectangle inset 16px with the dark plugin window centred and shadowed on it. Cards differ only by hue: lime, orange, blue.

Between demo blocks a single left-aligned sentence at about 36px sits alone on black with some 300px of space above and below. Its words light up from dark grey to cream one after another as you scroll, so mid-capture the sentence trails off into the background. The pinned two-button bar is the only other element on screen.

Export options as alternating rows. One side: a square colour tile (lime, then orange) holding a code-panel screenshot. Other side: a 24px heading, a five-line grey paragraph and a row of three or four small monochrome tool logos. Tile and text swap sides on each row, and the tiles are staggered vertically so one row's tile overlaps the next row's text band.

steal: Stage dark UI screenshots on flat saturated rectangles instead of on the page background, so the colour does the branding and the UI stays legible.
Pin the paragraph to the bottom of a tall card and the heading to the top so the gap between them becomes the card's composition.
Colour-key each step: the number chip and the stage behind the screenshot share one hue and nothing else on the card uses it.

name: Humanoid Index
idea: A catalogue of humanoid robots as a single-screen instrument: spin a wheel of names and one specimen appears on a plain card, ready to compare.
hero: A white, app-like screen with no headline. Top centre: a small segmented pill control with three categories and grey counts. Dead centre: a pale-grey rounded card about 400 by 455px holding one cut-out robot; above its top-left, a tiny maker logo with name, year and company at 13px; below it, a pill toolbar of four line icons. To its right, a paler empty card with a plus button labelled 'Compare'. Left of the card, a vertical wheel of robot names: the selected one black at 20px, the rest shrinking, fading and tilting along an arc. At the far left, mid-height: a logo glyph, a grid toggle and two credit lines.
type: Geist Sans Regular only, between 12 and 20px with -0.04em tracking. Hierarchy comes from grey value and opacity rather than size or weight; the selected name at 20px is the largest text on the page. No display type at all.
colour: #ffffff #f9f9f9 #1c1c1c #9b9b9b #f1b80e — White page, off-white cards, black and grey text. All colour arrives through the robots themselves, such as one yellow model.
imagery: Cut-out product shots and renders of robots, full figure, centred with even padding on identical off-white rounded cards, held at one scale and stance so models compare like specimens. A grey two-blob skeleton shows while loading.
layout: One fixed viewport with no sections: centred card, compare slot to its right, name wheel to its left, controls parked at top centre and far left. Roughly 60% of the screen is empty white. Scrolling changes the selection, not the position.

sections.description: The index is a wheel picker rather than a grid: about nine names are stacked vertically to the left of the card, right-aligned on a shallow arc. The active name is full black at 20px; neighbours step down in size, fade to light grey and tilt progressively, as if on a drum. Scrolling rotates the drum and swaps the card image, and the line above the card updates with the maker's logo, year and company.

On mobile the layout becomes a horizontal card carousel: a white rounded card nearly the full viewport tall holds the robot, the next card peeks about 30px at the right, and a bottom sheet with a drag handle carries a maker icon, the model name at about 28px with the year in grey beside it, the company beneath and a position counter right-aligned.

steal: Replace a thumbnail grid with a vertical wheel of names whose items shrink, fade and tilt away from the selection.
Hold every catalogue item at the same scale and stance on an identical off-white card so differences read instantly.
Keep all text between 12 and 20px and build hierarchy from grey values, leaving the object as the only large thing on screen.

name: Uni
idea: The product lives in the laptop notch, so the page's navigation is a black notch and the hero is a laptop outline whose notch opens into the app.
hero: White page with the hero as a rounded-corner panel inset 24px on all sides, filled with a grainy pastel gradient (pink-peach centre, sky blue down the right edge, orange lower-left). A black pill 300×44px sits top-centre like a laptop notch, holding only the app icon; it is the entire nav. Centred below: a hand-scrawled caps eyebrow, a two-line 48px (3.3vw) headline, two white pill download buttons side by side, one line of tiny grey reassurance. The bottom 40% is a thick black outline of a laptop screen, 960px wide, cropped by the fold, its notch expanded into a dark input bar playing the demo.
type: Instrument Sans 500 at 48px with -0.025em tracking for headings; Geist 16px for UI and 12–13px captions. Eyebrows are hand-scrawled marker capitals, irregular and tilted. Only three sizes on the page; the headline is just three times the body.
colour: #ffffff #fbdad6 #fce6db #aacbec #f9a070 #000000 — Colour lives only in the hero's grainy pastel gradient; below it the page is white and #fbfbfb with black text. Buttons are near-white pills; the notch is the single black mass.
imagery: No photos. A laptop reduced to a thick black rounded outline frames a looping screen recording of the notch UI; eight line icons below. The gradient has visible film grain.
layout: Everything on the centre axis. The laptop frame's side strokes continue down the page as hairline rules, so the mockup becomes a 960px content column holding tabs, an icon grid and an FAQ. Three short sections, generous white space, minimal footer.

sections.description: Directly under the device a segmented pill control with three tabs switches the demo. Then a hand-scrawled two-word eyebrow, a centred 32px heading, and a four-by-two grid of thin line icons, each with a two-line 12px centred caption. No cards, borders or backgrounds — just icons on white with about 100px between columns, all inside the hairline-bounded column.

A #fbfbfb band inside the same column. The heading straddles the band's top edge. One rounded, hairline-bordered container holds nine rows separated by hairlines; each row has a 12px medium question at left and a thin plus sign at right. Beneath, a two-line micro footer centred: Roman-numeral year, tiny wordmark, a three-word credit, two legal links.

steal: Shape the navigation like the product's own hardware habitat (here a black notch pill) so the nav itself demonstrates the product.
Extend a device mockup's side strokes down the page as hairline rules so the mockup becomes the content column.
Use a hand-scrawled marker eyebrow above a clean grotesk headline to add one human note to a system-clean page.

name: Smallbits
idea: The icon set is the page: a full-viewport wall of the product with one docked card holding every word.
hero: The whole viewport is a black field tiled with white pixel icons, each drawn about 50px on a 112px pitch, nine rows deep; alternate rows shift half a cell so it reads as a brick pattern, and icons at the edges are cropped. There is no header. A white square-cornered card, 795×170px, is docked bottom-centre: a two-line 24px semibold sentence left, a black rectangular button right, a row of five grey links below. A third-party badge floats top-right. This single screen is the entire page.
type: Inter 600 at 24px, -0.02em, for the one sentence; Inter 16px semibold grey for links and button. Nothing exceeds 1.7vw — the pixel icons, not type, are the display element.
colour: #000000 #ffffff #9a9a9a #ff6154 — Strict black and white: white icons on black, black text on a white card, grey for secondary links. The only colour is the coral third-party badge.
imagery: About ninety visible pixel icons, each an 8×8 bitmap drawn at 50px in pure white with hard edges, tiled full-bleed and cropped at the viewport edges.
layout: One viewport, no scroll. A staggered icon grid fills the frame edge to edge; all words live in one docked card. On mobile the card becomes a full-width white block with a full-width button.

sections.description: Mobile restack, the only other state. The icon wall drops to five columns filling the top 73% of the screen; the card becomes a full-width white block at the bottom with the sentence on three lines at 18px, a full-width black button 78px tall, and five grey links spaced evenly on one line.

steal: Make the product the wallpaper: tile the full viewport with the assets at large size and skip a hero image entirely.
Offset alternate rows by half a cell so a regular grid reads as a pattern rather than a table.
Compress all copy, the CTA and the footer links into one docked card so the page never needs to scroll.

name: Madie
idea: A burgundy-and-cream bakery brand in which the madeleines themselves, cut out like specimens, become the menu.
hero: A dark, warm photograph (iced coffee with a logo sticker and a glazed madeleine on a wooden counter, burgundy tiles behind) fills a rounded-corner frame inset 20px from every edge on a cream page; the subject sits right of centre. In the left column, starting 42% down: a small star-rating line, then a three-line uppercase headline at 5vw in a heavy geometric sans, the first two lines outline-only and the third solid cream, a three-line paragraph, and a row with a pink pill button and an underlined text link. Top-left: menu icon and script logo. Top-right: a three-language pill toggle. Bottom-right: a circular text badge.
type: Dazzle, a heavy geometric uppercase, for headlines at 72px, used both solid and as an outline stroke; Cottorway, a slightly wide geometric sans, for 14px body and for a light italic accent word. A brush-script logo. Tracked capitals near 10px for labels.
colour: #f6efe6 #3d0012 #5c0a23 #ff99d3 #160b0a #e8a530 — Cream and deep burgundy alternate by section across wavy boundaries. Bubblegum pink is reserved for buttons, the active filter pill and carousel arrows; the product cut-outs supply every other colour.
imagery: A moody warm-graded hero photo; individual madeleines shot from above and cut out with soft shadows as small menu thumbnails; white line drawings (dog in beret, cafe table); rounded photo cards stacked at a tilt; a map redrawn in burgundy.
layout: Centred intro, a left-anchored story block on burgundy, then a two-column menu inside a container about 60% of the width. Section edges are curved waves rather than straight lines. Rounded frames and a sticky header with filter pills recur throughout.

sections.description: Cream field, everything centred. A tiny tracked-capitals label flanked by two short rules, then a two-line heading: the first line outlined uppercase in burgundy at about 4.5vw, the second a lowercase light italic of the body sans, solid. Three short paragraphs at 13px follow in a column about 45% wide. The section ends in a burgundy wave rising from the bottom, with a white line-drawn dog perched on the curve.

Burgundy field patterned with a faint tone-on-tone repeat of the logo. Left: a white line illustration, a three-line paragraph with bold phrases, two round pink arrow buttons and a slide counter. Right: a stack of portrait photo cards with rounded corners, the top one tilted a few degrees and the others fanned behind it. The bottom edge curves back to cream.

A sticky row of three pill filters beside the logo, the active one filled pink. Each category has an outlined uppercase label at left, an item count at far right and a hairline beneath. Items run in two columns: a 60px cut-out madeleine at left, then a bold uppercase name and a two-to-three-line italic description; some carry a tiny best-seller note or a pink allergen tag. No prices and no boxes.

Deep burgundy. The left two-thirds is an interactive map restyled entirely in burgundy and pink with rounded corners, the script logo as its pin and a small address card overlaid bottom-left. The right third is a rounded outlined panel listing opening hours, phone and email under tiny capital labels, plus two social icons. The script logo, large and white, is centred below, followed by a tracked-capitals legal line.

steal: Set a headline with its first lines as outline strokes and the last line solid, so emphasis falls on the final phrase without a size change.
Replace the stock map with one restyled in the brand's two colours and use the logo as the pin.
Build the menu from small cut-out product photos beside bold names and italic notes in two columns, with no cards.

name: ARCHIV
idea: A waitlist page as a museum plinth: one cut-out everyday object at a time, centred on off-white beneath a heavy serif wordmark.
hero: Off-white single screen with no scroll. A heavy high-contrast serif wordmark in black caps sits top-left at a 56px margin, about 410px wide (28% of the viewport) and 80px tall. Opposite, top-right at the same margin, one line of 14px sans description aligns with the wordmark's top. Dead centre, one photographed object (a painted wooden pepper mill about 140px wide and 440px tall) stands on a barely visible lighter rounded square with a soft contact shadow; other objects replace it in turn. Below, a centred 11px grey line, then a white rounded email field 236px wide with a circled arrow inside its right end. Roughly 80% is empty.
type: The wordmark is drawn lettering in a heavy display serif with tight spacing, cap height about 5.5vw. All live text is Helvetica Neue regular at 14px and about 11px, black or grey. Two text sizes only; the contrast is wordmark against near-invisible interface text.
colour: #f1efec #000000 #ffffff #d9261c #e8a317 #7a7a75 — Warm off-white field, black wordmark, a white input; all colour arrives through whichever object is showing (red and yellow mill, tan leather, blue cap).
imagery: Studio cut-outs of single everyday objects in three-quarter view with a soft grounded shadow on matching off-white, each scaled to similar visual mass and centred, one at a time, no frame.
layout: One fixed viewport with four elements: wordmark top-left, description top-right, object in the exact centre, form bottom-centre. Margins of 56px, no rules, nav or footer. On mobile the wordmark centres and the description disappears.

sections.description: The central object rotates through unrelated things (pepper mill, sling chair, sticker-covered hydrant, layered iced drink, record player, baseball cap), each photographed in the same light and replaced in place within a zone roughly 250-300px square. Shadow direction and visual weight stay constant, so the object is the page's only variable and no carousel controls are needed.

Beneath the object, a centred line of 11px grey text, a 30px gap, then a white field about 236 by 52px with 12px radius: light grey placeholder at left and a 26px circle-outlined arrow as the submit control inside the right end. No button label, border or shadow; the field is the only pure white on the page, which marks it as the one interactive thing.

steal: Build a pre-launch page from four elements only (wordmark top-left, one-line description top-right, a single centred object, an email field) and leave the rest of the screen empty.
Cycle one consistently lit cut-out object in the same spot to show range without adding a grid or carousel controls.
Make the email field the only pure-white element on an off-white page, with submit as a circled arrow inside it rather than a labelled button.

name: BEIGE FORCE
idea: A game's cast presented as a bitmap type specimen: black pixel glyphs in a ruled grid on a mustard field, each given a blandly fashionable first name.
hero: Flat mustard yellow with fine grain fills the viewport. A one-line mono header spans the width with 28px margins: credit left, title flanked by lightning glyphs centre, a quote and a help link right, with a black hairline under it. Two 14px mono text columns start at the second of four grid columns; a pixel-font PLAY! button with a white-and-black double border sits in the fourth. From one third down, a four-column grid of square hairline-bordered cells fills the width, each holding one large black pixel glyph and a small centred name. A narrow strip on the right edge shows the game's blue and magenta screen.
type: Monaspace Neon mono at 14px for every word of text, regular and bold only; Kongtext bitmap face at 36px for the button and the mobile lock-out heading. The real display type is the grid of hand-built pixel glyphs roughly 190px tall.
colour: #e1ac10 #0b0b0b #2c3e9e #e6157f #4a97db — One warm mustard field with black ink only. A sliver of royal blue and hot magenta at the right edge hints at the game, and the mobile lock-out screen flips to flat sky blue.
imagery: Pixel-art icons and letters (sailboat, saucer, insect, building, capitals, punctuation) drawn as black squares with visible gaps between pixels, one per cell, centred. No photographs.
layout: A fixed frame: header rule, intro band, then a strict four-column grid of equal square cells that scrolls inside the frame while header and copyright stay put. Text obeys the same four columns; outer margins are 28px.

sections.description: The roster grid: four columns by many rows of identical square cells separated by 1px black lines, no gutters. Each cell centres a single glyph about 55% of the cell width, assembled from small black squares with hairline yellow gaps so the pixel grid shows, and a one-word caption in 14px mono centred near the bottom edge. Letters, symbols and tiny pictograms alternate without hierarchy, like a bitmap font specimen sheet.

Narrow screens get a full-bleed sky-blue lock-out card instead of the site: a two-line bitmap heading in near-black, centred slightly above the middle, with a seven-line centred mono paragraph beneath written in mock-military voice asking the visitor to return on a keyboard device. No navigation, no links, the same grain texture.

steal: Draw icons as pixels with visible gaps on the page's background colour, so the artwork and the ruled layout grid look like one system.
Set every word in one monospaced size and let weight and underlines carry the hierarchy, saving the bitmap face for a single button.
Let a strip of the next screen's contrasting colours peek in at one viewport edge to promise something behind the page.

name: Mat
idea: The app's scrapbook cut-outs invade the page itself: stickers interrupt the headline and a green cutting mat is both brand and container.
hero: Cream field, no navigation or logo; everything is centred. At 14% of the height a small tan caption with a cut-out camera to its left. Then a three-line lowercase headline in extra-bold rounded sans at 86px (6vw) in dark green, spanning 68% of the width, with four image cut-outs set inline at letter height: ransom-note letters spelling the name, a green cutting mat, a glass of matcha and a phone. Below, a green rectangular button with 4px radius, a faint grid texture and a soft drop shadow, carrying an apple sticker; then a two-line user count flanked by two fern leaves as a laurel. The bottom quarter is empty.
type: Nunito ExtraBold, lowercase, -0.05em tracking at 86px for the headline, and regular or italic at 16 to 24px for copy, centred. A cursive script signs the founder's note; a monospaced face (Writer) appears only in underlined footer links.
colour: #f4f1e8 #03372a #018c70 #0e3b2c #b9ab82 — Cream paper and a family of greens: near-black green type, mid-green button, deep green mat panels. All other colour comes from the photographic stickers scattered on the mats.
imagery: Photographic cut-outs with white die-cut borders (duck, apple, camera, lips) scattered on dark green cutting-mat panels with grid lines and ruler ticks; a phone mock-up cropped by the panel's bottom edge.
layout: A short centred page in a 1150px column: headline, one wide mat panel, three text columns, a narrow centred letter, then two full-bleed marquee rows of collage tiles and a three-line footer. Generous cream gaps separate every block.

sections.description: A wide panel with rounded corners, dark green with a fine lighter grid and numbered ruler ticks around its edge like a cutting mat. A phone stands at centre, cut off by the panel's bottom edge. A dozen photographic stickers with white die-cut outlines are scattered around it at different rotations and sizes, none overlapping the phone. Beneath the panel, three text columns each start with a small cut-out object where an icon would be.

A founder's letter in a centred column about 520px wide: a small circular avatar, then four short paragraphs of italic rounded sans in dark green at about 16px, each two or three lines and separated by a full blank line, with a cursive signature in green as sign-off. There is no heading and no box, only the letter floating in cream space.
