Two full-bleed rows of landscape collage tiles, each about 320 by 150px with small rounded corners on the dark green mat ground, separated by 10px gaps. The rows are offset from one another and run off both page edges, moving in opposite directions. Each tile is a different user arrangement of stickers, so the strip works as proof without captions.

steal: Interrupt the headline with photographic cut-outs sized to the letter height, including the product name spelled in ransom-note letters.
Give a container the texture of a real object from the product's world, here a cutting mat with grid and ruler ticks, instead of a flat card.
Use small photo cut-outs with die-cut white borders where feature icons would go.

name: OhhMyDesign
idea: The whole page pretends to be an open design-tool canvas floating in a blue sky: a pixel ruler across the top, selection handles on elements and a labelled multiplayer cursor.
hero: Full-bleed blue sky with blurred clouds. A 30px ruler strip spans the top with ticks every 100px, logo at left, a scroll-percentage chip and live clock at right. Beneath it float three white pills: availability at left, a centred nav with a dark active item, an email at right. Centre stack: a translucent proof badge with selection handles on its corners; a two-line headline in ultra-condensed heavy capitals about 150px tall and 50% of viewport width, filled with a vibrating orange-and-navy dot pattern; a mono orange label; two lines of grey 19px text in a dashed selection box; an orange and an outlined button. Mono captions occupy both bottom corners.
type: Headline in ultra-condensed heavy capitals (largest text 16.5vw), pattern-filled on desktop, solid navy and orange on mobile. Hanken Grotesk for body and buttons, Bricolage Grotesque bold for section heads, Space Mono in small tracked uppercase for labels. Four voices is a lot.
colour: #58a7e6 #a7d4f2 #ffffff #0e1822 #f0531c — Sky blue behind everything, white cards on top, navy for text and the footer, orange for buttons and highlights. Orange against blue supplies the complementary clash the headline exploits.
imagery: An illustrated soft-focus cloud sky as constant backdrop; laptop mockups of client sites on coloured sets inside thick white-framed rounded cards; small UI vignettes (chat thread, stat tiles). Nothing is full-bleed except the sky.
layout: Centred column about 1280px wide. Section titles in bold capitals, centred, with a small paper-note caption beneath; content sits in white rounded cards floating on the sky. The ruler strip stays fixed; the footer is a navy slab with rounded top corners.

sections.description: Bento of white and navy rounded cards on the sky. Top-left, a wide white card with a large orange quote mark, a two-line bold statement whose second line is orange, grey copy and a mono footer line. Top-right, a navy card listing three large figures with orange plus signs, each row ending in a right-aligned mono label. Below: outlined capability chips, a dark live-status tile, a tools card and a small review card.

Process told as a fake team chat. A centred capitals heading and a beige sticky-note caption, then one white rounded window about 780px wide with a channel-style title bar and avatars. Inside, messages alternate between a blue and an orange avatar, some with file-attachment chips, and each stage is announced by a thin orange mono divider line numbered 01 to 04. The last message shows a typing indicator.

Work carousel of large rounded cards about 760px wide, each with a thick white frame, a dark laptop render filling it, and a bottom strip carrying a dot, the project name and three tiny outlined tags. Neighbouring cards are cropped by the viewport edges and faded. Below: a row of dash-shaped pagination marks with the active one orange, and two small square arrow buttons.

Navy slab with rounded top corners rising over the sky. A mono file-name label top-left, a round up-arrow top-right; then the email address as a 60px bold link with an orange arrow, an orange button and availability dot beneath, three small link columns at right. The bottom half is the wordmark at full container width, about 280px tall, white with an orange first letter, on a dashed baseline.

steal: Borrow design-tool chrome as decoration: a ruler strip with a live scroll percentage, corner handles on one element, a labelled cursor.
Explain the process as a chat thread with numbered divider lines between stages instead of three icon cards.
End with the wordmark at full container width inside a slab with rounded top corners that rises over the page background.

name: Glide Typeface
idea: The page background is one grainy sky that passes from midday blue through sunset pink to a starry night as you scroll down the résumé.
hero: Full-viewport grainy gradient: saturated sky blue at the top fading through pale pink to warm amber at bottom-left, with soft diagonal cloud streaks. A translucent white pill navigation bar about 62% of the viewport wide floats centred at the top, name at its left and five links at its right. The name is centred at about 33% height in a tight italic display serif at 6.7vw on one line. Beneath it: a two-line sans introduction at roughly 2vw, a white pill button with a blue dot and blue label, then an underlined text link. The lower 35% of the screen is empty gradient.
type: editorialOld italic at 96px with -0.02em tracking for the name and section headings, and upright in a narrow cut for one large pull statement; Inter 18px for body, nav and buttons. About a 5:1 jump from display to body. Sentence case, four sizes.
colour: #3d9be9 #e8d9d7 #f3d5b8 #6f86d6 #e7b9c4 #1f4a5a — The gradient is the palette: blue to peach, periwinkle with white streaks, pink dusk, then deep teal night. Text flips from near-black to white as it darkens; cobalt is the accent.
imagery: No photographs. A full-bleed blurred sky gradient with diagonal cloud streaks and a visible film-grain overlay runs behind the entire page; small white star dots appear in the final night section.
layout: One narrow centred column, 45-60% wide, over a continuous background with no section boundaries or colour blocks. Blocks alternate between centred headings with pill buttons and left-aligned text. Experience is a left-rail timeline with glass cards; the footer is a five-column link list.

sections.description: A four-line statement in large upright serif at about 3.5vw, left-aligned inside the centred column, white over the periwinkle part of the sky. It is caught mid-reveal: the first words are fully opaque, the next few half-transparent, the rest at roughly 15% opacity, so the whole paragraph shape is visible before it fills in. Nothing else shares the viewport.

Vertical career timeline. A thin line at the far left of the column carries white-ringed blue dots, each paired with a date range in serif at about 1.6vw. To the right of each dot, a wide frosted-glass card with a 1px light border and rounded corners holds the company name in italic serif, the role in smaller italic, and one line of sans description. Cards are spaced about 150px apart over the pink dusk gradient.

Night sky in deep teal, lightening toward the bottom and scattered with tiny white star dots. A centred italic heading, a three-line centred paragraph and a pale pill button occupy the upper half. Below a faint hairline, five columns of small white links with bold column titles; the first column holds the name and location.

steal: Tie one long background gradient to page position so the palette tells time: day at the hero, dusk mid-page, night with stars at the footer, flipping text from dark to light on the way.
Lay visible grain over a blurred gradient with diagonal streaks so it reads as photographed sky rather than a CSS gradient.
Reveal a large statement word by word on scroll while keeping upcoming words at about 15% opacity, so the paragraph's full shape is present from the start.

name: Belen Jones
idea: The whole portfolio is one screen: a slowly turning 3D box skinned with project footage behind a floor-to-ceiling list of outlined client names.
hero: One viewport, no scroll. A flat pastel field (periwinkle on load) with a large black-edged 3D box, about half the viewport wide, rotating right of centre; each face shows a project film still. Over everything, nine project names are stacked flush-left from top edge to bottom edge in an ultra-bold extended sans at 7.6vw, caps, drawn as thin outlines only, lines almost touching; the active name is filled solid. Two small white pill buttons sit top-right; a two-line mono location and clock bottom-right. On first load only the box is visible, drifting in from the right with its texture mirrored, before the list appears.
type: Monument Extended Ultrabold caps at 109px with line-height near 0.95, drawn as a 1px outline and filled only for the active item. Roboto Mono in tiny caps for buttons, location and time. Two sizes in total, about 10:1.
colour: #c3cbe5 #141414 #efd3da #e6dccd #cfd3cb #f9d2bf — A flat pastel background that swaps per project (periwinkle, pink, sand, sage, peach) against the black box and dark outline type. The footage supplies the saturated colour.
imagery: Campaign and music-video stills mapped as textures onto the faces of a rotating WebGL cuboid with black edges; images skew in perspective and blur while turning. No flat images anywhere.
layout: A single fixed screen. The type column sits flush to the left edge with about 10px margin and fills the full height; the 3D object occupies centre-right behind the type. Utility items are pinned to the right-hand corners.

sections.description: The list is the navigation. Hovering a name fills that line solid (dark, or with a clipped piece of footage showing through the letters), swaps the page background to that project's pastel, and turns the box to a face carrying the matching film still, enlarged to roughly 45% of the viewport. All other names stay as hairline outlines drawn over the box.

Mobile variant: the list is dropped. A hairline-bordered bar across the top is divided into four cells with mono caps labels for back, name, contact and next. Below it a single portrait video frame about 57% of the width is centred on the pastel field with large empty space above and below; projects advance one at a time.

steal: Set a project list as outline-only giant caps over the media and fill just the active line, so the list is both navigation and texture.
Map project stills onto the faces of one rotating box so changing project is a turn of the object, not a page change.
Assign each project its own flat pastel background and cross-fade the whole field on hover.

name: Tiny Computer Co.
idea: A software studio presented as a plain text log: one serif sentence, then monospace notes with dates in a narrow left column, and nothing else.
hero: Near-black viewport. Everything hangs on a left margin of about 5%. A small serif wordmark sits 10% from the top; there is no navigation at all. The headline, two lines of off-white serif at 7.5vw with tight leading, starts about 27% down and spans only the left 44% of the width. One line of 18px monospace follows a full headline-line below it. The right half and the bottom 40% of the viewport are completely empty: no button, no image, no rule.
type: A custom text serif at weight 400 with -0.02em tracking for the 108px headline and the small wordmark; sohneMono at 18px with very open line spacing for everything else. Two sizes only, a six-times jump; below the hero, hierarchy comes from underlines and grey dates.
colour: #111111 #eeeeee #8a8a8a #1c1c1c — Near-black ground, off-white text and mid-grey for dates and placeholders. No accent colour; the only colour on the page is inside the single product screenshot.
imagery: One product screenshot only: a dark app window with large corner radius showing a sidebar and a masonry of image thumbnails, about 70% of viewport width, starting slightly left of the text margin.
layout: A single left column roughly 40% of the viewport wide; the right side stays empty for the whole page. Blocks are separated by a three-dash mono divider instead of rules. Lists pair a left text line with a short right-aligned date. About four screens.

sections.description: A wide dark app-window screenshot, then in the narrow column a five-line mono paragraph that opens with the underlined product name. Below it the waitlist is written as a sentence: label text followed on the same line by a borderless input shown only as grey placeholder. Two changelog lines follow, each prefixed with an arrow and ending in a grey right-aligned date.

A dated log of one-sentence notes: each entry is one or two lines of mono text at left with a grey day-month date flush to the right edge of the column and a blank line between entries; some entries are underlined as links. It ends with an underlined all-entries link with an arrow. No headings, numbers or bullets.

After a three-dash divider come two mono lines only: a two-word sign-off and an email address followed by a solid block cursor, left-aligned with a tall empty band beneath. There is no link row, no logo and no copyright; the page simply stops.

steal: Confine the whole page to a left column under half the viewport and leave the rest empty, with no nav or buttons.
Write the signup as an inline sentence with a borderless placeholder input instead of a boxed form.
Pair one large serif headline with monospace at a single size for all other text, using right-aligned grey dates as the only secondary rhythm.

name: WeekSync
idea: The page is a paper coupon: a dotted cut line with a scissors icon frames the viewport, and on scroll the navigation rail is cut free while the rest of the sheet tilts and falls away.
hero: Taupe-grey field wrapped by a black dotted rounded-rectangle border inset 16px from every edge. A left rail about 26% wide holds, centred on its own axis, a small black logo glyph at the top, a two-line mono tagline and a text link in braces; four nav labels, each under a small empty circle, stack at the bottom of the rail. A scissors icon sits on the bottom dotted line where rail meets main area. The main area carries one four-line statement in medium grotesk at 3vw, flush left and flush top, ending in the first quarter of the height. The remaining three quarters are empty.
type: Inter Medium at 43px with -0.05em tracking is used once, for the opening statement. Everything else (nav, card copy, counters, FAQ) is Red Hat Mono at 12 to 19px, centred in cards, with braces and italic underlines as state marks.
colour: #cdc8c2 #000000 #f8f6f3 #dfe296 — Flat warm grey ground with black ink throughout. Cards alternate off-white and a pale acid yellow-green, the only colour, which appears solely as a card fill.
imagery: Loose black brush-and-ink cartoons of anthropomorphic calendars, charts and buildings, scratchy and energetic, each placed alone in the centre of a pale yellow-green near-square card with large rounded corners.
layout: A dotted-outline rail stays pinned in the left quarter for the whole page; content scrolls in the remaining three quarters as a two-column grid of near-square cards with 8px gaps, then becomes a single mono list for FAQ. Section titles are only tiny mono labels.

sections.description: Scroll transition after the hero. The single dotted frame splits along a new vertical dotted line at the rail edge as the scissors travel up it; the right-hand piece of the sheet then rotates a few degrees and drops out of view, leaving the rail as its own dotted rectangle. The rail stays pinned while the first row of cards rises from the bottom edge into the vacated area.

Two-column checkerboard of near-square cards about 510px wide with 24px corner radius and 8px gutters. An off-white card holds three centred lines of 13px mono copy with a small '1 of 3' counter beneath; its neighbour is a yellow-green card with one ink cartoon. The next row flips the order, so text and drawing swap sides all the way down. No icons, titles or buttons inside cards.

FAQ as a plain mono list across the right three quarters: a tiny centred label, then questions at 14px, each preceded by a small hollow circle with about 35px between rows. The open item gets a filled dot, an italic underlined question and an indented three-line answer. No dividers, boxes or chevrons; the same hollow and filled circles mark the active item in the rail.

steal: Give the page a physical metaphor that also does layout work: a dotted cut line frames the viewport, then separates the nav rail on scroll.
Alternate text-only and illustration-only cards in a checkerboard, flipping sides each row, instead of packing icon, title and copy into every card.
Use hollow and filled circles as the only state marker for both navigation and accordion items.

name: The Tuscan Journey Begins
idea: A bag campaign told as a painted train journey: you enter through a ticket-shaped title card hung inside an illustrated vintage carriage, with the bag resting on a suitcase.
hero: A full-viewport painted train compartment, edged by a rough ochre brush-stroke border like a torn canvas. In the upper middle sits an olive-green card about 64% of the width and 42% of the height, slightly rotated, with notched ticket corners and a darker offset copy behind it. Inside, cream type: a small letterspaced first word, two lines of bold extended capitals at 6.4vw staggered left and right with a hard dark drop shadow, a small last word, and one line of bold 16px copy. A cream scalloped button overlaps the card's lower edge; a sound prompt sits bottom-centre and a round music toggle bottom-left.
type: Nimbus Sans Extended Bold in capitals at 92px with a hard offset shadow for the two title words, stepped horizontally; tiny capitals at about 0.3em tracking above and below; Nimbus Sans Bold at 16 to 20px for copy. One family, three sizes.
colour: #472913 #464f16 #29180a #8a5a2b #e4e0cf #c9a15a — Tobacco browns and ochre fill the scene; one olive-green card holds the text in cream. The same green recurs on the striped bag, tying the product to the title card.
imagery: A digitally painted vintage carriage interior with visible brush texture: leather seats left and right, a suitcase carrying the striped green bag at lower left. Full-bleed, but inside a ragged painted edge instead of a clean rectangle.
layout: Single screen, no scroll captured. A centred stack of title card, button and sound prompt over a symmetrical one-point-perspective scene whose window sits directly behind the card. One utility control is tucked bottom-left. The mobile shot shows the card unfolding before its text appears.
steal: Mask a full-bleed scene with a ragged brush-stroke edge so the viewport reads as a painting rather than a screen.
Put the title on a physical object in the scene's own palette (a ticket with notched corners and an offset shadow copy) instead of floating text on a scrim.
Stagger two headline words horizontally and bracket them with tiny letterspaced first and last words to make a lockup out of a sentence.
media: A painted 3D train compartment covers the whole first screen inside a ragged brushed border fixed over the viewport, with a flat olive placard about 65% of the width and 45% of the height laid over it like a sign and a die-cut badge button below. Oversized painted layers of 2183-3187px wait off-screen to sweep in; no video.
motion: An olive loader with an extruded word gives way to the painted world by 1.2s, then the controls, and the title card last at about 2.5s (load 7.6s), after which nothing scrolls: the eight settled screens are identical apart from a slow idle float of a few pixels on the card. Panels enter with transform over 1s cubic-bezier(.05,.7,.1,1) at 0.55s and 0.63s delays, two layers 80ms apart, and leave over .6s on a sharp ease-in; there are 10 reduced-motion rules.

name: Oimachi
idea: A studio homepage that behaves like a dense dashboard: work, posts, experiments and testimonials tiled edge to edge with 8px gutters instead of spaced-out sections.
archetype: other: left statement over media row with posts sidebar
hero: Charcoal ground (#181818) with only 8px side margins. Top-left: a round logo, then five tiny black rectangular chips with bold white 13px labels; top-right a contact chip and a theme toggle. The headline starts at the left margin about 160px down: two lines of light grotesk at 52px (3.6vw), tight tracking, with one word in italic serif. From 280px to the bottom edge runs a three-part row: two tall images butted together (each about 535x610px: a hand holding a phone on black, a man in a printed tee) and a 330px sidebar of blog posts, each a bold 14px title, two grey truncated lines and a small-radius thumbnail.
type: Aeonik throughout: light 52px for the headline, regular 20 to 24px for mid-page statements, bold 13px for nav chips and post titles, 12px grey captions. Single words switch to an italic serif inside headings. The scale is deliberately small; nothing exceeds 3.6vw.
colour: #181818 #070707 #2a2a2a #ffffff #ff4a2b #8a8a8a — Charcoal ground with black chips and white text, unchanged from section to section; colour arrives only through work thumbnails in orange-red, purple and green. A light-mode toggle exists.
imagery: Client work as photographs, UI shots, brand graphics and generated explorations; rectangles with 4px corners in tight 4:3 strips and a masonry of mixed aspect ratios, each with a tiny caption.
layout: 8px margins and 4 to 8px gutters everywhere. Short three-line statements at about 22px are indented to the 33% or 66% column and act as section breaks between tightly tiled image grids. Text columns stay narrow; images take two-thirds of the width.

sections.description: Rows divided by hairlines, each about 120px tall. The left third holds a small client icon, the name in 12px bold and the sector in grey at the top, with a two-line 11px description pinned to the bottom of the row. The right two-thirds holds three equal 4:3 thumbnails with 4px gaps. Above the list a three-line statement at 22px sits at the 66% column with a text link far right.

A statement at the 66% column introduces a dense masonry of experiments: around twenty tiles in six uneven columns with 4px gaps, sizes from 90px squares to a 280x160px feature tile, mixing screenshots, posters, renders and textures. Every tile has a 10px caption beneath in the form 'Name / Type'. No hover chrome is visible; it reads like a contact sheet.

Two wide video stills side by side, each cropped to a shallow band about 95px tall, showing a person mid-interview. Under each: a black square play chip, a small company icon, then the name in bold 12px and the role in grey. There is no quotation text at all; the testimonial is the video.

Four equal columns headed at 20px, each a list of 11px grey links prefixed by a tiny coloured square icon. Below, a large white circle logo with a black rounded square inside at far left, a two-line 20px question at the 33% column, and a small white booking chip with email and phone set inline beside it.

steal: Shrink page margins and gutters to 8px and tile media edge to edge so a portfolio reads as a working dashboard rather than a brochure.
Put a live blog or news sidebar inside the hero next to the showreel, so the first screen proves the studio is active.
Style nav links as tiny solid rectangular chips sitting directly in the page corner instead of in a bar.
media: A muted, looping reel of brand work covers about 51% of the first screen (75% of the width, 68% of the height) in a black well beside a rail of three 16:9 news thumbnails. Below: third-split rows with a label column on the left and three 3:2 tiles on the right two thirds, half-and-half video testimonials, an 8-column masonry of mixed ratios with small captions, and a text panel beside a photo stack; 34 images and 17 videos, client work supplying all the colour on near-black.
motion: There is no preloader and only the reel cuts after 400ms; a single ScrollTrigger scrubs the news rail at 0.8 so it drifts as the hero leaves, with no smooth-scroll library and no pins. Cards grow an outline over 0.5s on an ease-out-quint, images move over 0.6-0.8s on cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), links fade colour over 0.2s, and 33 skeleton shimmers (1.2s) hold space while media loads, with no reduced-motion rule.

name: Artem Taradash
idea: A designer's CV compressed into one newspaper-like band at the top, after which oversized product renders and project artefacts speak at full scale.
hero: White page with 20px margins. Top-left are three small black rectangular tags with white text (name and two links). Below them a three-line statement at about 3vw in regular-weight grotesk fills the first third, left-aligned. To its right, starting at the very top edge, run two narrow columns of 12px text, then a third column listing clients one per line, and in the far top-right a circular portrait about 200px wide with a white hand-lettered word across the face. This text band ends by a quarter of the height. Below it a huge cut-out vehicle render bleeds off the bottom, with a project card at right.
type: One family, Diatype, in regular weight throughout. Three sizes: about 43px for statements and project titles, 12.4px for all running text, about 11px for tags. Tight leading, sentence case, no bold and no capitals; hierarchy comes from size alone.
colour: #ffffff #111111 #f7f9fb #1c4fd8 #f0a23a — Strictly black on white for the frame. All colour arrives with project material: an orange-to-blue gradient, a cobalt zigzag pattern, warm photography.
imagery: Product renders cut out on white and shown very large, interface screenshots with a small corner radius, a full-width studio photo with a circular logo overlaid, and textile-pattern fields running margin to margin. Scale varies sharply between projects.
layout: A loose six-column grid with 20px margins; small text blocks hang from column lines beside very large images. Each project is arranged differently, and there are no dividers or section backgrounds, only white space and jumps in scale. The tag nav stays fixed top-left.

sections.description: Each project pairs one oversized visual with a small caption cluster. In the first, a cut-out product render fills the left 60% and bleeds off the edge. The right third stacks a landscape screenshot with slightly rounded corners, then a row holding a tiny label and two-line title at about 3vw on the left and a five-line 12px description on the right.

A row of three: a round black watch-face mock-up about a quarter of the width, a wide rectangle filled with a horizontal blue, violet, orange, blue gradient with a tiny tick scale beneath it, and a narrow text column at far right with label, three-line title and two short paragraphs. Circle, rectangle and text share a top line.

A cobalt-and-white zigzag textile pattern runs margin to margin for more than a full viewport height with only a two-line caption beneath it at left. Before it, a black-backed mosaic of pattern samples and report-cover mock-ups sits beside two narrow text columns. The pattern is given a section to itself with no mock-up frame.

Closing row on white: a tiny label, then a four-line sentence at about 3vw in the left third; a small square portrait at the two-thirds mark; to its right a short question with two underlined links below. All three hang from the same top line with empty space between them.

steal: Put bio, client list and portrait in one compact multi-column band at the top so the first scroll is already work.
Use solid black rectangular tags with white text as the only navigation chrome.
Let one project artefact (a pattern, a gradient) run full width for a whole screen with a two-line caption instead of framing it in a mock-up.

name: Sobha Privy Collection
idea: Luxury homes sold by restraint: a black sculptural render and a script-over-capitals title, then white pages where interior images grow and overlap huge serif capitals as you scroll.
hero: Full-bleed near-black video of a glossy black sculptural form, wide curved bands catching thin highlights, filling the frame at very low contrast. A centred two-line title about 46% of the width: a formal script phrase at about 6.9vw, then a line of light roman serif capitals at about 6vw directly beneath, wider than the script. Nothing else in the middle. Corners only: a two-line hamburger with a menu label top-left, a small serif wordmark with a micro subtitle top-centre, a text link top-right, a circled down-arrow bottom-left, and bottom-right a greyscale 3D-map thumbnail about 17% wide with a numeral and a two-line label.
type: TT Ramillas in light uppercase for display (up to 7.9vw) paired with the formal script Altesse for two- or three-word accent phrases that overlap the capitals; TT Commons Pro at 13px for nav, eyebrows and body. A very large jump from 100px display to 13px text.
colour: #010101 #ffffff #d8cdbd #8a7862 #1a1919 — Black hero, then pure white pages with near-black type. Warmth comes only from the beige, cream and bronze interiors in the renders. No accent colour anywhere.
imagery: Architectural interior renders in cream and bronze (double-height dining halls, lounges, marble pool rooms) in tall portrait and near-square crops, square corners, arranged in groups of different sizes that scale with scroll. The hero is an abstract black sculptural render.
layout: Centred, symmetrical compositions (heading over a three-image group) alternate with asymmetric ones (large left-aligned capitals with images offset right and lower-left). A very long scroll-driven page of about 48 screens, with pinned image scaling between text moments.

sections.description: White section, centred. A two-line micro eyebrow in tracked capitals, then a two-line heading in light serif capitals at about 2.6vw. Below it a triptych: a tall centre image about 23vw wide at 3:4, flanked by two shorter images set lower, their tops about 30% down the centre image and their outer edges touching the viewport sides. On scroll the centre image scales up and the side images rise toward its top.

Pinned scaling group: the same three renders rearranged so the centre image is about 26vw wide and roughly 30% taller than its neighbours, which hang from a common line a little below its top and are cropped by the left and right viewport edges. Gaps are under 1vw. The fixed header stays above, its logo sitting on top of the image.

Statement with overlap: five lines of light serif capitals at about 5.5vw, flush left on a 1% margin, filling the left 55%. A grey script phrase overlaps the end of the last line and runs into a tall image occupying the right 25% from mid-height to the bottom. A second, small image about 12vw wide sits lower left under the text. Mid-transition frames show the capitals rising letter by letter from behind a baseline mask.

steal: Pair one short phrase in formal script with a line of light serif capitals beneath it, letting the script overlap the capitals or run into an adjacent image.
Arrange three images as a tall centre flanked by two lower ones cropped by the viewport edges, then scale the centre up on scroll.
Keep the hero to a near-black, low-contrast render with all controls pushed to the four corners so the centred title is the only bright thing.
media: A WebGL black ribbon covers the whole first screen behind the centred slogan, with a 240x140 map clip docked bottom-right (about 2.6%). Later: a centre portrait that grows from about 620 to 760px wide as it rises, a triptych with the flanking pictures cropped by the viewport edges, a picture sliding under the last lines of a statement, full-bleed night-skyline video interludes, a curved WebGL carousel pinned under a title and long pinned horizontal galleries; 28 images and 9 muted loops, square corners.
motion: After a preloader of about 1s the title drifts up a few pixels and settles by 2.5s, and Locomotive smooth scroll then scrubs nearly everything by transform as a continuous lerp: pictures move faster than text, each section slides over the previous one, and the three-worlds chapter pins a curved carousel and horizontal tracks for about 23,000px. 187 spans rise over 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.29,0.52,0.5,1) and 114 fade over 1s cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1), the stylesheet's main curve (32 uses).

name: CoffeeTech®
idea: Present an industrial roaster maker like a design brand: one enormous three-word statement on black, with the machine withheld until the first scroll, where it emerges from the dark.
hero: Near-black viewport with nothing but type. A centred three-line headline, one word per line, in Inter Medium at about 15vw with tight tracking; the first line starts a third of the way down and the last runs to within 35px of the bottom edge, its widest word spanning roughly 70% of the width. Cream letters; no subhead, no media, no hero button. Navigation is one quiet row: logo with a terracotta mark at left, four text links centred, then a filled terracotta 'Products' button with a grid icon, an outlined contact button and a language dropdown at right. The top third stays empty.
type: Inter throughout at weight 500. Display lines at 216px with -0.07em tracking and leading near 0.95 against 14px body, a jump of about 15 times. Secondary headlines near 10vw, intro paragraph around 26px. Section labels are tiny and wrapped in square brackets.
colour: #0d0e13 #e5e2dd #f3ece2 #c8603d #262629 — Blue-black and warm putty-grey sections alternate; cream type on dark, near-black on light. Terracotta appears only on the logo mark and the primary button.
imagery: Studio shots of roasters: a black machine barely lit against black after the hero, then white and black machines as cut-outs on pale-grey tiles. One warm founder portrait with a signature overlapping its edge; macro bean photos in small-radius cards.
layout: Outer margins of about 70px. A centred type poster on top, then an offset two-column intro, then a product grid pushed into the right two-thirds with its bracketed label alone in the left third. Oversized left-flush headlines open and close the lower page.

sections.description: Warm putty-grey band entered through a hairline. A portrait about 290px wide with 8px corners sits in the left third; a scrawled signature overlaps its bottom-right corner and spills onto the background. A seven-line paragraph at about 26px, medium weight, roughly 510px wide, begins at the horizontal midpoint, followed by a small underlined text link. No heading; the right quarter and the gap between the two elements stay empty.

A headline at roughly 10vw is flush to the left edge and clipped by the right, like a slow marquee. Below, a tiny bracketed label sits alone in the left third; the right two-thirds hold a two-column grid of pale-grey tiles about 400px wide with a small radius, each with a centred machine cut-out, the model name beneath and a tiny outlined pill for its category. The grid closes with a 64px underlined 'see all' text link with an arrow.

Back to blue-black. A cream contact headline at about 10vw sits hard against the left edge, far larger than anything near it. Underneath, the terracotta logo mark is enlarged to about 140px at left; four narrow link columns in small grey text run from 28% to 85% of the width; a pill-shaped back-to-top button sits at far right, with a thin legal row at the bottom.

steal: Let a three-word headline at about 15vw be the entire first viewport and withhold the product until the first scroll.
Photograph a dark product on a background matching the page colour so it appears to emerge from the page rather than sit in a box.
Overlap a handwritten signature onto the corner of a portrait so an about block feels signed rather than laid out.
media: The fold is type only; one scroll later a full-bleed low-key photograph of the roaster on matching black covers 76% of the screen, so the object floats out of the dark as the second beat of the hero. Below: a portrait with a signature over its edge, product renders contained on tinted tiles in a 2x2 grid, three 4:5 macro ingredient cards with the label docked bottom-left, and a blog slider; 25 images, no video, about 12.5px corners on card media.
motion: No entrance at all: the 400ms frame already matches the settled one. No smooth scroll, pins or sticky elements; a model scale-in keyframe over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.36,.18,0,.99) with a 1.5s glow grows the roaster into place, link underlines wipe in by clip-path over 2.5s, overlay panels slide in over 0.8s, and the most common duration is 0.3s.

name: Shelf
idea: Saves scattered across a dozen places are funnelled into one searchable shelf, shown literally by tumbling source chips and a panel edge that narrows to a point.
hero: An off-white panel sits inside a 12px warm-grey page frame. A compact floating nav about 880px wide: logo left, three links and a lime waitlist button right. Centred stack: a small grey pill badge with a sparkle icon, then a two-line headline in General Sans Semibold at about 5.8vw with tight tracking, one word of which sits on a lime rounded-rectangle highlight; a two-line grey subhead; an email field with its button nested inside one rounded outline, 460px wide. From 75% down, the top of a bordered app window rises, and a larger search bar holding a half-typed query overlaps it with a soft shadow.
type: General Sans Semibold for headings (84px hero, 40 to 50px section heads, -0.03em); Switzer for everything else at 14 to 20px, mostly mid-grey. About four sizes. The one flourish is a headline word set on a coloured block.
colour: #fbfbf9 #f2f1ed #1b1b19 #9ee86f #e9e9e6 — Warm off-whites and soft charcoal with one lime green: the nav button, the highlighted word, small tags and a full-colour closing block.
imagery: Vector mock-ups of the app: a bordered window with sidebar and save cards, an enlarged search field, tiny wireframe thumbnails in step cards. No photography. Angled pill chips with small source icons act as illustration.
layout: Centred column inside large rounded off-white panels separated by the grey page frame. Mostly stacked heading-plus-subtext blocks, one left and right split, one narrow accordion column. Panel edges are shaped: one ends in a shallow downward chevron.

sections.description: A centred heading and two-line subtext are partly covered by about nine grey pill chips, each naming a save source with a small icon, rotated at random angles as if dropped. The panel's bottom edge is a shallow V pointing down at centre; from its tip a thin vertical line descends about 80px to a second centred heading, subtext and an empty search field, so the layout itself draws a funnel.

A rounded white panel split in two. Left, from a 10% inset: a small lime tag with icon, a two-line heading at about 50px and two short grey paragraphs, vertically centred. Right, from 53% to 90%: three stacked rounded grey cards about 130px tall, each with a white thumbnail tile at left (a tiny wireframe or the logo) and at right a black numbered dot, a bold one-line title and a line or two of grey text.

A lime rounded block about two-thirds of the width, flanked by narrower lime blocks at left and right separated by 14px gaps, as if cropped from a row. Inside, left-aligned and vertically centred: a 40px heading, two lines of small text and a white email field with the button nested in it. A one-line footer sits on a white strip below.

steal: Shape a section's bottom edge into a chevron and run a hairline from its tip to the next heading, turning 'many into one' into layout.
Overlap an enlarged, half-typed search field onto the product window so the hero shows the key interaction rather than a whole screenshot.
Frame the page as rounded panels inside a slightly darker margin so sections read as stacked sheets.

name: Midnight
idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

name: Plastic
idea: A plain, quiet app page given one physical object: a photographed vinyl record cropped by the top-right corner of the viewport.
hero: Pale grey page with no navigation, only a bold wordmark with a small orange-red caps descriptor beneath it at top left (80px margin). A photographed black vinyl record with an orange-red label is cropped by the top-right corner, showing a quarter disc about 360px wide and tall, with an orange wire stand poking out below it. The headline is centred slightly above the middle in two lines at 74px (5.2vw), about 37% of the viewport wide, followed by a two-line 17px sentence and two black store badges side by side. Lower down, an award mark and a laurel-framed rating sit centred; the bottom fifth is empty.
type: Archivo only. Headline weight 500, sentence case, tight leading, 74px against 17px body, about a 4.4x jump. Feature headings near 30px in two colours, a much larger heading in the dark section (digest peak 12vw), and tiny tracked caps in the footer.
colour: #f5f5f5 #d5d5d5 #090d0e #171615 #e0441c — Greys and near-black with one orange-red accent taken from the record label; it colours the logo descriptor and the first line of each feature heading. One near-black section breaks the light page.
imagery: Phone mockups with real app screens (album-cover grids, a camera view) sit inside mid-grey rounded panels and are cropped by the panel edge. The hero uses a cut-out photographed record with a soft shadow; album art supplies the colour.
layout: Centred hero, then feature rows on a wide container: a tall grey panel on one side and a short text block vertically centred on the other, sides swapping per row. A dark full-width section with offset white cards follows, then a narrow FAQ column and a sparse footer.

sections.description: Each feature is a two-column row. One column is a mid-grey rounded panel about 540px wide and 720px tall containing a phone mockup pinned near the top, with the next phone's top edge peeking in at the panel's bottom. The other column holds a two-line heading, first line orange-red and second near-black at the same size, over a three-line grey paragraph, vertically centred. The panel side alternates left and right.

A near-black full-width section opens with a large centred white heading. Below it, white rounded cards of different sizes are placed off-grid at staggered horizontal positions: one holds an album-cover collage with a record sliding out, with a bold white caption and a grey line beneath it on the dark ground; another is a small data card listing collection fields as label and value rows.

A left-aligned column about 480px wide, offset toward the page centre and headed by a bold short title. Six questions in small bold text are separated by hairlines, each with a plus sign at the right edge. A generous empty gap follows before a footer of three tiny caps link groups spread left, centre and right, small legal notes, and a pipe-separated caps link row.

steal: Crop one photographed physical object by a viewport corner so the hero has a subject without a centred mockup.
Set two-line feature headings at one size with the first line in the accent colour and the second in ink.
Drop the nav entirely on a one-page app site: wordmark plus a one-line descriptor top left, store badges directly under the headline.

name: Brikken+Co
idea: The studio name set as large as the viewport allows over visible column guides, with a concrete 3D logo object as the single sculptural image.
hero: Warm light-grey page with six faint vertical column guides running full height. The studio name in black neo-grotesk, sentence case with a superscript trademark, spans edge to edge at about 19vw, hard against the top with 45px side margins. First paint shows nothing else. Then the lower half fills: a hexagonal ring logo rendered as speckled concrete, about 280px wide, sits right of centre, cropped by the bottom edge, its lower third glowing cobalt; a three-line 22px statement and a small cobalt rectangular button in mono caps sit bottom-left; a small dark video thumbnail with a play button sits bottom-right. No navigation until you scroll.
type: PP Neue Montreal medium only. Wordmark at about 19vw, statement text 22px, a large about paragraph near 40px in mid-grey, tiny wide-tracked caps for nav, buttons and section labels, and pixel-style mono caps labelling image frames in the dark section.
colour: #eeece9 #000000 #0009f2 #ffffff #ff4a1c #8f8778 — Warm grey paper and black type with a single cobalt used for the button and the glow on the 3D logo. Full-width black panels interrupt for showreel and case imagery, with one orange tile.
imagery: A concrete-textured 3D logo render, looping showreel video (a glowing green prompt bar, a monochrome fashion portrait) and black particle-flow artwork. Square corners, hard rectangular crops; media grows from thumbnail to near full width.
layout: Six visible columns with 45px outer margins. Small labels sit in column one and large text starts in column two. Light sections with a lot of empty paper alternate with near-full-width black media panels; a white floating nav bar appears centred at the top after the hero.

sections.description: Showreel: the hero's small video thumbnail scales up on scroll into a black panel about 520px wide, then near full width, anchored to the right four columns, square-cornered, with a small square play button at its centre. Above it floats a compact white nav bar (about 285px wide, 4px radius) centred at the top: two tiny tracked caps links, the wordmark in the middle, two more links.

Black full-width panel overlaid with a sparse grid of small plus-shaped registration marks. Images sit inside thin white outlined frames of different sizes that overlap each other; each frame carries its caption as white pixel-mono caps on a black tab breaking the frame's bottom edge. One tile is solid orange. The frames appear to slide sideways as a pinned sequence, ending with a single portrait and a lone play button.

On the grey ground, a tiny tracked caps label sits in the first column while a statement paragraph at about 40px starts in the second column and runs to the right margin. The paragraph is set in pale grey, apparently darkening to black word by word as the reader scrolls. No image and no button accompany it.

Each project is one image at full column width, square corners, roughly 16:7: here white particle contours on black with the client name in pixel type at the top. Underneath, left-aligned across the first three columns, the project name at 20px and a five-line description at 13px. The right half below the image stays empty.

steal: Leave the layout's column guides visible as hairlines down the whole page and align every text block and image edge to them.
Put captions on a tab that interrupts the image frame's border, in a contrasting pixel or mono face.
Tint one part of a neutral 3D object with the brand colour as a glow, so the accent appears in the image and on exactly one button.

name: The State of Software Delivery in Healthcare
idea: A survey report told as a short scroll of oversized serif statistics, with a constellation of connected points standing in for the data set.
archetype: other: centred title over constellation canvas
hero: A full-viewport field of very dark aubergine-brown with no navigation or logo. A canvas draws about 150 small pale dots joined by hairline segments at low opacity, spread over the whole area like a star chart. On the centre axis, starting at 30% of the height: a year in bold 15px sans inside a 60px outlined square, then a three-line serif title at 58px (4vw) occupying only 30% of the width, then three lines of 16px sans in white. Some letters of the title are drawn in a coarser pixel-stepped cut of the same face. There is no button and nothing touches an edge.
type: Redaction, a Times-like serif with bitmapped alternate grades, at regular weight for headings (40 to 58px) and for statistics at up to 23vw; single letters switch to the pixelated grade. Cosmica sans at 12 to 16px for body, an extreme numeral-to-caption jump.
colour: #1f1313 #f4f3ef #ffffff #f2b632 #3a2c2c — Sections alternate between a warm near-black and a paper off-white, with type inverting to match; the only hue is a mustard yellow used for the bars of one chart.
imagery: No photographs. Canvas-drawn networks of dots and hairlines: a full-screen field in the hero, then small tangled clusters or loose scattered points parked in the right margin of later sections.
layout: After the centred cover everything is flush left at a 6% margin in a column no wider than half the page, leaving the right side for a small canvas figure. Dark and light bands alternate, each holding one claim and one or two statistics.

sections.description: On the dark band, two statistics side by side in the left two-thirds: serif numerals about 200px tall with the percent sign set as a superscript a third of that size, and beneath each a two-line caption in 12px sans flush with the numeral's left edge. Below, a five-row horizontal bar chart: right-aligned grey labels, 2px mustard bars on a faint full-width track, values at the far right.

Paper-coloured band. A one-line serif claim at 40px, two lines of small text, a large gap, then a single figure about 335px tall (23vw) in near-black with a superscript percent sign, its three-line caption tucked beneath at 12px. The right half is empty except for a five-point constellation the size of a thumbnail. One number owns the whole screen.

Dark band with loose scattered dots. A serif heading and four lines of small text flush left, then a white rectangular button 250px wide with square corners and a long arrow, next to an underlined text link. The footer follows on the same field: a small logo at left and two short text blocks with serif subheads to its right.

steal: Set a statistic at 20vw or more in a text serif with a superscript percent sign and a 12px caption, one number per screen.
Swap single letters of a heading into a bitmapped grade of the same typeface for texture without adding a second font.
Shrink the hero's background motif to a thumbnail-sized figure in the margin of later sections to keep continuity.

name: Michael Pumo
idea: A freelance design engineer's page as a calm dark split, words on one side and a plain full-height portrait on the other, with a small panel that lets visitors restyle the site.
hero: Exact 50/50 vertical split with no nav bar. The left half is near-black with 80px padding: a small pill with a green dot top-left; at mid-height a three-line headline in light-weight 46px sans (about 3% of viewport width), a two-line grey 18px paragraph and a white pill button 195px wide; at the bottom two lines of tiny grey text with salmon underlined links. The right half is a full-height studio portrait, head and torso against a grey wall, cropped by the viewport on three sides and meeting the dark half on a hard vertical edge. Nearly half the left panel is empty.
type: Saans throughout. Headline is light (300) at 46px with -0.044em tracking; statements about 30px; body 18px; captions 12px. Hierarchy comes from grey versus white rather than weight. One huge 'Aa' specimen (13.5vw) appears inside a settings card.
colour: #111111 #000000 #968779 #ffffff #ff7a7a #b6f09c — Near-black cards on black with white and mid-grey text. A salmon-coral marks links and project labels; a pale green dot signals availability. Warm greys enter through the portrait.
imagery: Portrait photography: the author against a grey wall, and project shots of people that fill the right half of each card edge to edge. Muted natural grade; cards have about 6px rounded corners.
layout: Dark cards on a black page with 80px side margins. Rhythm alternates card clusters (a three-column bento, stacked project cards, a four-up row) with open text sections where a small grey label sits above a large two-paragraph statement.

sections.description: Three-column bento of dark cards straight after the hero, widths roughly 23/50/23. Left card: a salmon four-line statement, tiny grey copy, a white pill button and, at the bottom, the date with a ticking clock in larger digits. Centre card: one client quote at about 22px with name, role, pagination dots and arrows. Right: two stacked service cards, one with a row of square tool icons, one with a wordmark graphic. A row of dimmed client logos follows.

Project cards stacked vertically, each a wide dark card split 50/50: the left half has a salmon project name near the top, a five-line description at about 22px set lower, and a small white pill button; the right half is a photograph filling the card height. As you scroll, the next card slides up over the previous one, which dims and recedes, so the set reads as a deck.

Row of four equal dark cards that act as site controls. One shows a huge 'Aa' cropped by the card top, one four overlapping circles in coral, green, black and white, one a coral sound-wave glyph, one an outline map of Australia. Each has a short title and two lines of grey copy inviting the visitor to switch typeface, palette, ambient sound, or flip the page upside down.

steal: Drop the nav bar and give the hero's text panel three anchors: status pill at the top, statement in the middle, contact links at the bottom.
Offer visitors a row of cards that restyle the site (typeface, palette, sound, orientation) as a demonstration of front-end skill.
Reveal a long statement by turning its words from grey to white with scroll, so one paragraph can hold a full screen.

name: Neuropelvic Surgery
idea: A specialist surgical practice made approachable through translucent amber-glass 3D renders of nerves and robot arms on clinical white.
hero: White page. A full-width header boxed by a 1px grey border: line-drawn logo left, six text links centred, an outlined pill ending in a black circular arrow button right. Below, from a 90px left margin: a two-line headline at ~5.6vw, tight tracking, top at 30% height; a four-line 18px paragraph about 520px wide; two pill buttons at 75% height, one outlined and one orange gradient, each ending in a black circle with a chevron. Right half: a soft-edged translucent amber 3D render of braided nerve fibres, about 40% wide, dissolving into white. At the far right, a vertical 01 to 04 slide index beside a thin rule.
type: Aspekta only. Headlines at weight 500, 81px, -0.05em tracking and leading near 0.95; body 18px medium, also tightly tracked. Three sizes: 81px heads, ~22px list and card titles, 14 to 18px text. No uppercase and no secondary face.
colour: #ffffff #121212 #ff5900 #f5f5f5 #ffb347 — White with near-black type; orange appears only in the 3D renders, the primary button and a footer that fades from white into full orange. One dark teal photo band carries the contact prompt.
imagery: Amber glass-like 3D renders (nerve strands, a surgical robot) floating on white with dissolved edges, alongside conventional operating-theatre photographs in square-cornered cards and one dark full-bleed scrimmed band.
layout: 90px margins; headings run full size from the left while their content is indented to the right half or a narrower block. Sections alternate render-plus-list, accordion, two-card row, full-bleed photo band and gradient footer under a sticky boxed header.

sections.description: Two columns on white. The left 40% holds an amber glass 3D render of a multi-armed surgical robot, centred and unframed. The right 45% holds a vertical list of seven procedure names at ~22px, each row about 55px tall and separated by a hairline; the top row is black and the rest light grey, implying the active row drives the render beside it.

A two-line headline at ~5vw runs from the left margin across the full width. Beneath it the accordion is indented to start at about one third of the width and ends at the right edge of the content block: six questions at ~22px, each with a chevron at the far right and a hairline below. Nothing else shares the screen.

A full-bleed photograph of a masked surgeon under a heavy teal-black scrim, about one viewport tall. A white two-line heading at ~4.5vw sits in the lower-left third with three lines of small copy and a white pill button beneath it. The following white section slides up over the photo's bottom edge with rounded top corners.

The white page background fades vertically into saturated orange over roughly 250px. On the orange: a large line-drawn logo at left, three small link columns (navigation, social, two addresses) starting at mid-width, then a hairline and a one-line legal row in black with items at left, centre and right.

steal: Commission one material for all renders (translucent amber glass) so the 3D objects carry the brand colour on an otherwise white page.
Pair an outlined pill with a solid circular arrow button inside it for every action, so buttons are recognisable at any size.
Fade the page background into a full brand-colour gradient for the footer instead of cutting to a dark block.

name: Mammut Studios
idea: A friendly studio pitch in rounded colour panels, with the scribble logo enlarged as a tone-on-tone shape behind a heavy centred headline; well made but conventional.
hero: A pale-blue panel with large rounded corners is inset 16px from the white page and fills the viewport. Top-left inside it, a small black scribble logo; top-right, three text links and a dark rounded button with a white dot. Centred at about 20% height sits an outlined pill label directly above a three-line extra-bold grotesk headline at 7vw with tight leading, about 40% of the width. A three-line grey paragraph follows. Behind the text, the logo's humps are enlarged as lighter-blue shapes rising from the bottom edge to 70% height. Bottom-left: a boxed count of open slots with a short caption; bottom-right: an outlined scroll pill.
type: PP Mori only. Weight 800 at 100px with -0.02em tracking for the hero, medium for section headings (about 44px) and card captions (about 20px), regular 18px body. The footer wordmark jumps to 11.5vw in bold. Sentence case; no uppercase anywhere.
colour: #dbe8fb #ffffff #140018 #e7f1fd #efe4f6 — Powder blue and a very dark aubergine alternate as rounded panels on a white page; text is aubergine rather than black. No bright accent, only lilac tints in work cards.
imagery: Client work as photos and mock-ups (printed tote, plated dish, billboard, a UI prompt box) in rounded-corner cards of differing aspect ratios, staggered in two columns. Client logos run as a monochrome strip.
layout: Sections are full-width rounded panels inset 16px from the viewport, alternating blue, aubergine and bare white. Inside each, a small dot-label sits at the left and the main block starts about 35% across. Work breaks into a staggered two-column masonry.

sections.description: Dark aubergine rounded panel. A tiny bullet-dot label sits at the far left; the content column starts about 37% across with a three-line heading in pale lilac at roughly 3vw, two short grey paragraphs, then three stacked text links, each prefixed by a parenthesised index number, separated by 40px gaps. The left third stays empty apart from the label.

The base of the dark panel is a single row of seven client logos in pale lilac, evenly spaced, with the first and last fading out toward the panel edges. The panel's bottom corners are rounded where it meets the white page, so the strip reads as the closing edge of the about block rather than a section of its own.

On white: a left-aligned heading with a two-line grey intro, then a staggered two-column masonry. Cards differ in width and height, and the columns are deliberately misaligned vertically, the right one starting lower. Each card has rounded corners, a tiny outlined dot-pill category tag under the image and a one- or two-line caption at about 20px. Some cards are flat lilac panels holding a floating UI fragment.

Dark aubergine rounded panel: the availability badge repeated at top-left, the email address as plain text at about 2.5vw, a thin row with copyright, live local time, social links and a back-to-top link, and finally the studio name in bold at 11.5vw spanning the panel's full inner width, its baseline nearly touching the bottom edge.

steal: Inset every full-width section 16px from the viewport as a rounded panel so the white page shows as a thin frame between colour changes.
Enlarge the logo mark into a tone-on-tone shape rising from the bottom of the hero instead of adding an image.
Put a scarcity cue in the hero's bottom-left corner: a small boxed number of open slots with a short plain caption beside it.

name: Atlas by WorkOS
idea: Give the AI agent a body: a glossy white toy robot that peeks over every product demo and changes costume section by section.
hero: White page, everything centred. The desktop capture caught the top 40% blank mid-animation; the mobile shot shows the full stack. Small logo lockup, then a two-line semibold headline at 5.8vw with tight tracking, a three-line 18px sub and a black pill button carrying a chat-app icon. Below, a 3D-rendered white robot about 20% of viewport width, shown from the chest up with a dark blue screen face. Its torso is cut off by a demo panel rising from the bottom edge: 75% of the width, large rounded top corners, blue-to-lavender gradient frame, a translucent bar of four scenario tabs (the active one a white pill) above a mock chat window.
type: InterDisplay 600 at 84px, -0.02em, for the hero; section heads about 40px in the same face with tight leading; Inter 18px body. Lato appears inside the mock chat UI to mimic the host app. Sentence case, no caps labels.
colour: #ffffff #fafafa #2f6bff #b9a8f5 #e2336b #0b1a4a — White ground, black text. Colour is confined to thick gradient frames around demos (blue to lavender, then blue, red and magenta) and the robot's glowing blue visor.
imagery: A glossy white toy-like robot mascot rendered in 3D, cropped at the chest or peeking from the bottom edge, with costume variants; mock chat conversations in white rounded windows set inside thick saturated gradient frames.
layout: Centred hero and closing, with alternating text-left/media-right and media-left/text-right rows between. Demos live in 75%-width rounded panels. Sections are separated by white space alone; one band shifts to a faint grey.

sections.description: A mock chat window about 75% of the viewport wide, with channel sidebar and message thread, wrapped in a 12px frame filled with a vertical gradient running blue to red to magenta, rounded corners. The frame is open at the top where it joins the tab bar. Below it, three plain columns: a small black glyph, a bold 13px title and three lines of grey text.

Two-column row. Left: a two-line bold heading about 40px and a four-line paragraph in a 230px column. Right: the robot seated behind an open silver laptop, with thirty or so small app icons floating in a loose arc above its head, shrinking and fading toward the edges. A lot of white around it; no container or card.

Team-building band on faint grey. Five robot busts in a tight overlapping row, each with a different visor colour and accessory (headphones, hoodie, coat), centred. The heading sits directly under them at about 60px, overlapping their shoulders, then a three-line centred sub. Beneath, a wide gradient-framed panel splits into a chat column and a card showing one costumed robot.

Three gradient-framed rounded cards in a row, each a cropped UI snippet with a numbered bold caption and three lines of text under it. Centred below: a black pill button with an app icon and a tiny underlined link. The robot then rises from the page bottom, chest-up and centred, with the copyright and footer links tucked to its left and right.

steal: Let a mascot be cropped by the top edge of the product demo so character and UI read as one object.
Frame product mock-ups in a thick saturated gradient border instead of a shadow, keeping the page itself pure white.
Re-dress the same 3D character per section (laptop, starry visor, costumes) to give a standard feature sequence a through-line.

name: Cipher
idea: The showreel as a slowly turning wreath: a dozen film stills overlap in an elliptical ring around a tiny emblem on a black screen, with almost no text.
hero: The first capture is the preloader: a black screen textured with a fine grid of grey dots that thins out towards the right, the wordmark top-left and a tiny copyright glyph dead centre. Once loaded, the black screen holds a ring of about fourteen landscape film stills, each roughly 10% of the viewport wide, overlapping one another around an ellipse about 35% of the width; the centre is empty except for a 20px white emblem. The wordmark, about 11% wide, stays top-left. Four 9px uppercase links are split: one at the horizontal centre, three at the far right. A partner mark sits bottom-right. There is no headline.
type: Favorit only, and only at about 11px: uppercase nav links with slight tracking. The custom wordmark, with a macron and a schwa among its letters, is the sole large letterform. No headline and no body copy; one type size on the page.
colour: #070604 #ffffff #c9a45a #2f55c8 #c96a1e — Near-black ground with white micro-type. All colour comes from the stills: gold, cobalt blue, orange, garden green, plus one black-and-white frame.
imagery: Stills from fashion, beauty and fragrance films in 3:2 landscape crops, square-cornered and unframed, layered so each overlaps its neighbour by about a third. No captions or titles on them.
layout: A single non-scrolling stage. Navigation is pushed to the corners at tiny size and the ring of stills occupies the middle third; over half the screen is empty black. Scrolling rotates the ring instead of moving the page.
steal: Arrange work thumbnails as an overlapping elliptical ring with an empty centre, and bind scroll to rotation instead of vertical travel.
Shrink all text to one 11px uppercase size and let a custom wordmark be the only large type.
Give the preloader its own texture (a dot grid fading across the screen) rather than a spinner or percentage.
media: There is no document: one fixed canvas holds every picture as a texture, a ring of overlapping 16:9 film stills (about 240x135, overlapping their neighbours by 20-40%) round a tiny emblem, covering about 62% by 69% of the viewport, with the tiles themselves on 35-40% of the area and warm black between. No video elements; at least 35 distinct stills cycle through the ring.
motion: The dot-grid loader with a spinning chrome letter is still up at 4.5s. After that the wheel turns the ring instead of the page, sliding new stills in along the circular path with no fade or mask; nav letters roll on hover, and the few CSS transitions are transform .45s cubic-bezier(.83,.12,.35,.96) and opacity .2-.3s.

name: Viewport
idea: The page is drawn inside a glowing blue rounded frame: the product's own viewport icon scaled up to the size of the browser window.
hero: Black page with a fixed rounded-rectangle frame inset 18px from every edge: a 4px bright-blue border with roughly 40px corner radius; all content scrolls inside it. Top-centre, an 800px-wide dark nav capsule with a thin border: blue rounded-rectangle icon and wordmark at left, four 16px links, a blue rounded button at right. The headline is one centred line at 70px (4.9vw), medium weight, off-white, at about 35% of the height; beneath it two centred lines of 18px text, a blue button with an Apple glyph, and a 14px note. From 71% down an app window 1130px wide is cut off by the frame; a blue glow fills the bottom.
type: 'ritual', a compact grotesk with slightly quirky forms, medium weight, tracking -0.03em, for headings at 70px and about 44px; the system UI font at 18px for body and 14px for notes. The last word of some headings is tinted blue.
colour: #070709 #090d14 #14171d #519dfc #1632b7 #f2f0e8 — Blue-black ground and slate cards with one cornflower-blue accent used for the frame, buttons, an accent word per heading and a saturated blue gradient that swells at the bottom of the page.
imagery: Screenshots of the app's own window and timeline, cropped into cards; the demo content inside them is a vivid cobalt-and-orange butterfly and flower poster with pixel serif type, the only warm colour on the page.
layout: Centred column about 1130px wide inside the frame. Sections are centred headings followed by dark rounded cards: a two-up, then a wide text-left and UI-right card, then a pricing card. Uniform vertical spacing; every block is a rounded rectangle.

sections.description: A centred three-word heading at about 44px with the last word in blue. Below, two equal dark cards side by side with a 12px gap and 16px radius; each has a 24px heading and four lines of 14px grey text at top-left, and a product-UI crop filling the bottom half, bleeding to the card's lower edge on a blue gradient panel. A third, full-width card follows with text in the left 45% and a UI crop on the right.

One wide dark card split in two. Left 55%: a heading, one grey line, then a small label and seven bullet lines at 13px. Right 45%: an inset panel with a 3px glowing blue border that echoes the page frame, holding the price at 56px with the old price struck through beside it, two lines of copy, a blue button and two fine-print lines. A centred gift-code link sits below.

The background becomes a saturated blue gradient filling the lower frame. A repeat of the download button and note sits on it, then a black rounded card inset about 30px from the frame: logo at top-left, a newsletter field with a square arrow button below it, two small link columns at right, and a hairline above a copyright row with two round social icons.

steal: Wrap the whole page in a fixed, product-coloured rounded border so the browser window itself becomes the product's icon.
Echo that frame at small scale on the single most important card (the price panel) so the brand device marks the conversion point.
Let the demo content inside product screenshots carry a contrasting, vivid palette so the UI chrome can stay dark and quiet.

name: Uncle Rudy
idea: A grumpy cartoon uncle who insults you is the brand; his stickers and roast notifications carry the page.
hero: Black page. Nav at 72px margins: icon and name left, two underlined links right. Centred at 23% height: a small grey line, a two-line white headline at 64px (4.4vw) semibold, a blue pill App Store button. The lower half holds a 430px-wide iPhone mock on the centre axis, cropped by the fold, showing a cartoon grumpy man on an orange sunset with a tilted speech bubble. Die-cut sticker illustrations with thick white outlines are scattered at angles around it: googly eyes and a purple disc cut by the side edges, a large flame overlapping the phone, a tilted slogan label. Three dark notification cards stack left, tucked behind the phone.
type: System sans (-apple-system) at weight 590, 64px, -0.03em for the headline; ui-rounded 18px for body and links; 28px section heads; 11px card captions. Sticker lettering is hand-drawn. The footer name is set near 35vw as texture.
colour: #000000 #171717 #ffffff #0a6cf5 #f26a1b #7b3fa0 — Black page, white text, cards in #171717. Colour comes from the stickers and phone screen — orange, flame red, purple — plus one iOS-blue pill button repeated as the only CTA.
imagery: Flat cartoon character with thick outlines, reused as die-cut stickers with white borders at random tilts; iPhone mockups with real UI; small dark cards holding single icons. Stickers overlap devices and get cropped by edges.
layout: Centred headings over device mockups, then a four-column bento of dark rounded cards with 6px gaps, then a full-screen footer. Stickers break the symmetry by overlapping and bleeding off the sides. Five screens in total.

sections.description: Centred 28px heading with a grey subline. Three phone mocks in a loose row at different sizes — the left showing a camera view of a handwritten list. Below, two feature titles side by side in which a UI glyph replaces part of the word: viewfinder brackets around one, a waveform inside the other; tiny grey captions and the blue pill follow.

Four-column bento of #171717 rounded cards with 6px gaps. One tall card scatters six sticker poses of the character; small square cards hold one icon and a two-word caption; wide cards hold a notification mock or mini UI. Captions are 11px, centred at the card bottom. A blue pill sits centred under the grid.

Full screen. The app name is set on two lines at about 35vw in #171717 on black, cropped by the edges, a barely visible backdrop. Centred over it, a large die-cut sticker of the character's head with a tilted speech bubble. Bottom row: studio credit left; blue pill, three social icons and legal links right.

steal: Give the product a drawn character and reuse it as die-cut stickers (thick white outline, random tilt) scattered around the hero and cropped by the viewport edges.
Use real in-product copy — here insulting push notifications — as the hero's supporting text instead of a feature paragraph.
Replace part of a feature title with the UI glyph it names, such as viewfinder brackets or a waveform.

name: April Leihuanani Evangelista
idea: A travel scrapbook on black: torn paper, passport stamps, pins and tape frame the portrait and biography of a marketer whose brand is being well travelled.
hero: Near-black page with 20px margins. Nav in 16px uppercase condensed grotesk: a small square portrait thumbnail beside a two-line name far left, three links centred, a contact link far right. Centred below is a paper collage about 43% of viewport width and 45% of its height: a white-bordered portrait photo held by a pink pushpin over torn notebook paper, a crumpled pink sheet, a passport-stamp scrap and a strip of clear tape. Under the collage, all centred: one line of condensed serif at about 30px, the name in uppercase condensed serif at 58px, and a small underlined uppercase link. A faint hairline closes the viewport.
type: A condensed high-contrast serif (digest 'lgwy') for the name, section titles up to 10.6vw and card headings; a condensed grotesk for nav, 12px body and uppercase micro-labels. The manifesto paragraph switches from grotesk roman to serif italic mid-paragraph. About five sizes.
colour: #101010 #f1eeea #e3c8cf #b9d3f0 #c9905e #8a9a4a — Near-black ground with off-white type and no UI accent. Colour comes only from paper ephemera and photos: dusty pink, sky-blue note paper, cork tan, stamp reds and blues. Warm overall.
imagery: Warm lifestyle portraits presented as bordered prints, postage stamps and tilted snapshots; cut-out paper ephemera with soft drop shadows (boarding pass, ID card, postcards, binder clip) layered on a cork clipboard. Service photos are landscape insets inside outlined cards.
layout: Tight 20px side margins. Sections alternate: centred collage, a full-width large-type paragraph with four small columns beneath, a centred corkboard, a giant centred section word flanked by tilted photos, then full-width outlined cards that stack over one another.

sections.description: A full-width paragraph at about 2.2vw in condensed grotesk that changes to serif italic for its final sentence; one phrase is ringed by a dashed oval, and a blue paper scrap and a stamp-framed photo overlap the text. A tiny uppercase label sits above. Beneath, four equal columns of 12px text, each opening with a bold run-in phrase, with no cards, icons or dividers.

A tan corkboard graphic about 75% of viewport width, centred on black, with a metal clip at its top edge. Pinned to it: an ID-card mock-up, a sky-blue note carrying the heading in mixed italic and uppercase serif plus body text, a boarding pass, postcards and a tilted cream note listing client names in serif. Pieces overlap, rotate a few degrees and cast soft shadows.

A one-word title in uppercase condensed serif at about 10vw, centred, with small tilted snapshots either side. Then full-width cards with 1px light-grey outlines and slight corner radius on black: tiny uppercase category label top-left, two-line serif heading at about 2.5vw, a parenthesised number in the same serif top-right, a short paragraph, rows of small outlined rectangular tags, and a landscape photo bottom-right.
