Each card sticks and the next slides over it.

steal: Build the hero portrait as a paper collage (bordered print, torn sheets, stamp scrap, pin, tape) centred on black so the torn edges do the framing.
Switch a manifesto paragraph from sans roman to serif italic partway through and ring one phrase with a hand-drawn dashed oval.
Number stacked service cards with parenthesised serif numerals in the top-right corner and let each card slide over the last.

name: IZANAMI
idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.
media: A misted forest photograph covers the whole first screen under drifting cloud layers, with text on about 0.2% of the area. Then a pinned full-screen architectural scene dollies forward while overlapping collages of two or three photographs at different widths pass over it, rows pair a text column at about 28vw with a portrait flush to the right margin, and the fog band returns as a bookend; about 11 photographs, one WebGL canvas, no video.
motion: A warm near-black screen with the tagline already in place until about 2.5s, then a fog bank creeps in from the lower right and the chrome fades in by 4.5s; load took 7.2s. Lenis with three sticky sections scrubs the scene as the forest darkens and the camera sinks into the pavilion, photographs move at different rates, and headline lines fade in one by one; two cloud layers loop on 100s linear translates, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

name: Deeo Studio
idea: The studio's four letters as huge extruded iridescent 3D blocks tumbling across a black stage, with a quiet ultralight serif statement underneath.
hero: Near-black viewport. Four extruded 3D letters, each roughly 45-60% of the viewport tall, are scattered at different depths and tilts across the top 80% of the screen: one cropped by the top-left corner, one lower and left of centre, a larger one upper-right, the last cropped by the right edge. Faces are dark glass; edges catch lilac, orange and holographic rainbow light. Over them runs a slim nav: bold caps wordmark top-left at a 60px margin, three small caps links (one with a tiny yellow tag) and an outlined rounded button top-right. Bottom-left, a light serif headline at about 72px begins and is cut by the fold after two lines.
type: PP Editorial New Ultralight for the statement headline at about 5vw; PP Neue Montreal Book, Medium and Bold for nav, caps labels and project titles; Inter 14px body. A bold Neue Montreal line reaches 160px (11.1vw) lower on the page. Light serif against bold grotesk is the pairing.
colour: #0d0d0d #ffffff #b79cf0 #ff5a1f #f5f5f5 #f0e68c — Near-black page with white type; colour comes from iridescent lilac, orange and rainbow reflections on the 3D letters and from each case-study thumbnail's own palette. The digest records one light grey section.
imagery: Extruded glassy letterforms with holographic edge light on black; case studies as square-cornered wide video thumbnails in each client's colours on a two-column grid; one tilted old snapshot in the footer.
layout: Side margins of 60px. After the hero come a small left-aligned paragraph and a caps label, then a work list that opens with one full-width thumbnail and continues as two columns with staggered vertical offsets. Every item repeats the same caption row. The footer is centred.

sections.description: The serif headline finishes just below the fold at top-left. Beneath it sits a four-line 17px grotesk paragraph in a column only about 190px wide (13% of the viewport), left-aligned at the margin, followed by roughly 120px of empty black and a tiny caps section label. The right three-quarters of the screen stay completely empty.

The first project is a single thumbnail running margin to margin; the rest sit in two columns with a 14px gutter, the right column offset vertically so thumbnails never align in rows. Under each thumbnail: project name in 16px medium at left with a line of tiny grey caps disciplines beneath, and a small outlined rounded button right-aligned on the same row. Square image corners, no card containers.

A tilted, slightly warped 1990s snapshot with a year caption overlaps giant block letters of the studio name set in dark grey barely lighter than the background, each letter several hundred pixels tall. Below, a centred row of five small links and a single centred line of the light serif at about 28px with a tiny speaker icon.

steal: Render the studio name as separate 3D letters at different depths and tilts, cropped by the viewport edges, instead of a flat wordmark.
Pair the loud hero object with an ultralight serif statement at bottom-left and a deliberately tiny, narrow paragraph, leaving most of the next screen empty.
Caption every work thumbnail with the same two-ended row: name and disciplines left, small outlined button right.

name: estacion venenta
idea: Unstyled-browser typography at headline size sitting on top of a live 1-bit dithered landscape of converging tracks.
archetype: other: plain-text masthead over dithered canvas
hero: White page, 20px margins. The top line, in 78px regular Helvetica (5.4vw) flush to the left edge, carries the project name, a small circular glyph, then two underlined links at the same size spaced out to the right edge: name and navigation are one line of type. Beneath it two lines at about 46px describe the project, with a stamp-sized red thresholded portrait inline after each composer's underlined name. A band of empty white follows. From 51% of the height to the bottom, edge to edge, a black-and-white ordered-dither canvas draws thick lines converging on a vanishing point at the horizon.
type: System Helvetica at regular weight, lowercase name, default black underlines on links: the browser's defaults, deliberately enlarged. Two sizes only, 78px and about 46px; no bold and no small text anywhere.
colour: #ffffff #000000 #8a8a8a #e63a1f — Pure black on pure white, including the dithered canvas, which uses two tones only and reads as grey from a distance; the single colour is the red of two tiny portrait icons.
imagery: A full-width canvas rendered as coarse 1-bit ordered dither: a perspective plane with heavy black bands running to a horizon, different in every frame. Two tiny red high-contrast face cut-outs act as inline glyphs.
layout: A single screen with no scroll: text block top-left, canvas across the lower half full-bleed, a gap of white between them. On mobile the links stack under the description and the dither cells become visibly coarser.

sections.description: The lower half of the only screen is the content: a canvas spanning the full width with no margin, its top edge an irregular horizon. The ground plane is filled with a dot pattern that gets denser toward the bottom, ordered dithering standing in for a gradient, and is crossed by five to eight solid black bands that fan out from the vanishing point and shift position from frame to frame.

steal: Set the site name and the navigation in the same oversized line of type so the header is the hero.
Use ordered dithering on a canvas to get tone and depth from two colours only.
Place stamp-sized duotone portraits inline in a sentence as glyphs next to people's names.

name: Leedlime
idea: A lead-finding tool dressed in oil-painted green landscapes: every product screenshot floats on a thick-brushed pastoral painting.
hero: The page sits in a 1240px frame marked by two full-height vertical hairlines 100px from each viewport edge. A 64px nav inside it: logo left, four links centred, log-in and a black button right, hairline beneath. Below, a 50/50 split. Left: a three-line serif headline at 72px (5% of viewport width) starting 150px below the nav, a three-line 20px grey sans paragraph, a black rounded button with a double outline, and two tick-marked notes. Right: an impasto mountain painting filling the half edge to edge and 810px tall, with two overlapping product panels in frosted rounded frames centred on it. A black band begins at the bottom edge.
type: Newsreader regular for headings (72px hero, about 40px sections) with -0.02em tracking; Inter for everything else at 16 to 20px. Tiny tracked uppercase labels above section headings. Serif accounts for only about 10% of the text.
colour: #f9f8f6 #161412 #d7d9bc #6f8f58 #ffffff #b5ee4c — Warm off-white with near-black buttons and text. Green comes almost entirely from the paintings; a lime logo mark and pale green tick chips echo it. One black band interrupts.
imagery: Oil-painting landscapes with heavy brush texture (mountains, cottages, orchards) as backdrops; clean white product UI panels float on them inside translucent rounded frames. Paintings are square-cornered and run edge to edge within the framed column.
layout: Everything lives between two vertical hairlines, with horizontal hairlines closing sections, which gives a ruled-sheet feel. Section heads alternate centred and left-aligned. Painting-backed panels alternate with plain white card grids.

sections.description: Centred tiny label and a two-line serif heading, then three equal cards in a row. The top 60% of each card is a painted landscape crop with one small white UI fragment centred on it (a URL field, two match rows, a message composer). The painting fades to white at its lower edge, and the bottom of the card holds a centred one-line title and two lines of grey copy.

Centred serif heading with a black button, then a painted sky and meadow spanning the full framed column and about 1.2 screens tall. A large white rounded app window with a thick translucent border sits on it, inset about 30px from the painting's sides, showing the dashboard and its sidebar. The painting stays visible as a frame above, beside and below the window.

Footer on off-white: logo with a two-line description and two small social icons at left, three link columns under tiny uppercase labels at right, a status-dot line and a small copyright row. Beneath it the page ends on a full-width strip of painted farmland about 250px tall that fades upward into the page colour, so the footer dissolves into landscape.

steal: Float clean white UI panels on a heavily textured painting inside a translucent rounded frame, so screenshots gain atmosphere without decorating the UI itself.
Run two full-height vertical hairlines down the page, keep all content between them and close sections with horizontal rules.
Finish the footer with a strip of landscape that fades upward into the page colour.

name: Is That Pigeon a Fed?
idea: A deadpan parody of a surveillance-agency case file that 'investigates' uploaded pigeon photos, with a cut-out pigeon standing in the middle of the headline.
hero: Black viewport. A header strip above a full-width hairline holds a bird logo with an acronym, a two-line agency name in tiny mono caps, and a classification label at far right. A cut-out pigeon stands dead centre, 20% of the width and 65% of the height. The bold mono uppercase headline at 5.6vw is split around it: two words left and one right on line one, a single letter left and the final word right on line two, outer edges on a 12% margin. Small mono copy sits lower-left; lower-right has an orange crosshair cue and a dashed warning box. A second hairline and a circled arrow close the block.
type: A bold monospace (custom upload) in uppercase at 80px for the hero and the same family at 12-14px for every label and line of copy. The tool panel switches to a tight heavy grotesk in caps for its drop-zone heading. Two display sizes and one micro size.
colour: #000000 #d5d5d0 #ffffff #ff4a1c #7a4a8c — Black blocks alternate with a putty-grey graph-paper panel. Type is off-white; one orange-red marks interactive cues (crosshair, arrow, status). The pigeon's purple-green neck is the only other colour.
imagery: One sharply lit, front-facing, symmetrical pigeon cut out on black, used as the central object. Otherwise vector details only: faint bird-footprint trails wandering across the closing section, a crosshair and a warning triangle.
layout: Three full-width blocks: a black hero bounded by two hairlines, a putty-grey ruled tool panel split about 58/42 into drop zone and status readout, and a black closing block with centred text, ended by a marquee credit strip. Fixed-size build; mobile shows the desktop layout scaled down.

sections.description: Upload tool styled as a paper form under a mono title bar. The left 58% is a drop zone covered by a square graph grid with a centred two-line heavy grotesk caps heading, a tiny mono label above and a file-type hint below. The right 42% is a ruled readout: status line, a large percentage beside a thin progress bar, three numbered step cells, a log area, and a wide grey disabled button.

Black block with centred mono text: a two-line bold caps sign-off, a bold sentence, a dimmer sentence, then a dashed-border box containing two lines in orange-red. Trails of small grey bird footprints cross the background diagonally from different corners, with an occasional print tinted red. A boxed strip at the bottom repeats the design credit as a mono marquee.

steal: Split a two-line headline around a centred cut-out object so the words frame it left and right and the object reads as part of the sentence.
Carry a fiction through the interface chrome: header as agency letterhead, sections as case-file panels, status labels and dashed warning boxes in place of marketing copy.
Use faint wandering footprint trails as the only decoration on an otherwise empty dark section.

name: AlterG Resources
idea: A corporate energy site organised by visible blueprint guide lines, with the logo's trapezoid-and-arch geometry reused as frosted facets over landscape photos and as repeat-pattern bands.
hero: White page with pale-blue vertical guide lines about 30px inside each edge and a horizontal hairline under the 74px header. Header: logo at left, two links and a square-cornered outlined button at right. Centred between 17% and 30% height, a two-line headline at 4.2vw in regular-weight grotesk, first line mid-grey, second near-black. A two-line centred paragraph follows, then a rectangular outlined button with a smaller boxed green diagonal arrow inside its right end. From 57% height to the fold, a landscape photo inset to the content width shows desert rock under cloud, overlaid with thin white lines and frosted-blur panels shaped as trapezoids and an arch.
type: Sequel Sans regular at 60px with near-zero tracking for headlines, split into a grey phrase and a black phrase; Inter 17px for body and UI. Section headings drop to about 28px and card labels to 11px. Sentence case, about five sizes, no bold display weight.
colour: #ffffff #3a668f #1b370e #bfd1e1 #222222 #22b14c — White with pale-blue hairlines at the top; the team section turns steel blue and the closing band deep forest green. Green also marks the arrow icon; a brown-and-white pattern band ends the page.
imagery: Wide landscape photographs of desert rock, alpine meadow and canyon with square corners, inset to the column; the hero image carries frosted geometric facets and fine white lines. The team appears as studio headshots on white in a tight grid.
layout: Content sits between two full-height vertical guide lines, with horizontal hairlines at section breaks, like a drafting sheet. The hero is centred; later sections put text in a left column and a three-column grid of cards or portraits at right. Pattern bands from the logo shape mark colour changes.

sections.description: Split section. The left 45% has a two-tone heading (grey phrase, then black phrase) at about 28px at the top and a small two-line paragraph pushed to the bottom of the block. The right 55% is a 3x2 grid of square-cornered white cards with a pale-blue 1px border. Each card is mostly empty: a small outlined icon box with a tiny coloured corner dot at top-left and a one- or two-line 11px label at bottom-left.

Three landscape photographs side by side at equal width with 8px gaps and square corners, each a tall 5:6 crop, spanning the content column. Directly beneath, a pale band filled with a faint outlined repeat pattern of the logo's trapezoid shapes acts as a divider before the page turns blue.

Steel-blue section with thin lighter guide lines continuing through it. A small heading at the left; to the right, a three-column grid of portrait cards with 8px gaps. Each card is a studio headshot on white with a dark gradient caption bar across its bottom fifth holding the name in white, the title in smaller grey, and a small social icon at the right. Group sub-labels with a coloured dot sit in the left gutter beside a thin rule.

A deep-green band crossed by thin bright-green lines that outline a large trapezoid, then a white footer repeating the header (logo, one-line description, links, outlined button), and finally a full-width band of the logo motif repeated as a brown-and-white woven pattern on pale blue.

steal: Draw the layout grid: keep two full-height vertical hairlines at the content margins and horizontal hairlines at section breaks, in a pale tint, so plain sections still feel constructed.
Overlay logo-derived shapes on a photograph as frosted-blur facets with thin white outlines instead of placing the logo itself.
Set a headline in one weight and size but two tones, first sentence mid-grey and second near-black, to create emphasis without bold or colour.

name: Amanda Guo Design
idea: Text behaves like wet ink: serif titles and links blur and bleed until attention sharpens them, over a plain crop-marked project grid.
hero: Charcoal page, 32px margins. The top-left holds the bio as three short paragraphs of 16px bookish serif in a column about 450px wide (31% of the viewport), followed by three stacked links whose letters are visibly blurred, and a mono date line. The remaining two thirds of the upper viewport are empty except two tiny mono toggles top-right. At 57% down, two small mono view buttons, then a three-column project grid begins: each cell marked by thin L-shaped corner brackets, a blurred serif title, mono caps tags with square bullets and a 16:10 image, cropped by the fold. There is no headline anywhere.
type: Macaulay, a slightly bold bookish serif, at 16px for all prose and project titles; DM Mono around 11px caps for tags, toggles and dates. Largest text is 1.1vw, so hierarchy is carried by face change and blur, never by size.
colour: #1c1c1c #efece2 #014538 #000000 #e8e6e1 — Charcoal ground with warm off-white text and hairlines; all colour comes from project thumbnails. A light-mode toggle inverts it. Neutral, slightly warm.
imagery: Project thumbnails at a uniform 16:10: photography, flat logo lockups on solid fields, type specimens, device mock-ups. Square corners, inset in cells with even gutters; some blur until focused.
layout: 32px outer margin, bio pinned top-left, then a strict three-column grid with about 35px gutters. Cells are delimited by corner brackets and plus-shaped crosshairs at intersections, like printer's crop marks. The last row is left incomplete; no footer.

sections.description: Three-column grid of identical cells. Each cell: a 16px serif project title top-left, softly blurred until hovered; a row of one or two mono caps tags, each preceded by a small filled square; then a 16:10 image filling the cell width. Thin L-brackets mark the outer corners of each row and small crosshairs mark gutter intersections. Two tiny bordered mono buttons above the first row switch between grid and list.

The bio doubles as the header. A 450px column of serif text at body size, paragraphs separated by one line space, ends with three plain stacked links rendered out of focus as if ink had spread into paper, then a mono timestamp. Top-right, a text toggle that switches the ink effect off and a small light-mode button in an inverted mono chip.

steal: Apply a soft blur to link and title text that clears on hover, so interactivity is signalled by focus instead of colour or underline.
Mark grid cells with corner brackets and gutter crosshairs in place of full borders.
Skip the headline: run the bio at body size top-left and let two typefaces, a bookish serif and a mono, carry all hierarchy.

name: Sand Studio
idea: The stickers being sold are peeled off and scattered around the page, then reused as inline emoji inside the manifesto text.
hero: White page. Small two-line logo top-left, dark pill button top-right. Centred at the top: a grey 24px label, a 48px medium-weight title and a dark pill button, all within the first 30% of the viewport. Below them a product photo of a clear sticker bag with a black header card, about 25% of the width, stands upright in the centre down to 90%. Eight die-cut stickers with white borders and soft drop shadows are scattered across the left and right thirds at varied sizes (80 to 190px) and tilts, none overlapping the bag or each other.
type: Figtree throughout: 48px medium for the product title, 20 to 24px for card headings, and a manifesto set at about 80px regular weight with leading near 1.1. Sentence case; no caps except inside sticker artwork.
colour: #ffffff #2b2926 #f3f1ee #c7b3a0 #ef4467 #e4fcb4 — White ground with warm charcoal text and buttons. Colour comes from the stickers and one bento of tan, raspberry, lime and pale-blue cards; the footer is warm charcoal.
imagery: Flat vector stickers with thick white die-cut borders and soft shadows, a studio photo of the bagged kit, a few tilted polaroid-style snapshots, and a rendered turntable widget in the footer.
layout: Four screens: a centred hero with scattered objects, one bento block on a pale warm-grey band, a full-screen centred manifesto, and a dark footer revealed under the white page's rounded bottom corners. Margins of about 80px.

sections.description: On a pale warm-grey band under a small centred label, four rounded cards. A tall tan card on the left spans both rows with a tick list and a product photo bleeding off its bottom. Top-right: a raspberry card with white text and a laptop corner, and a lime card with a two-line heading and three oversized pixel-style key glyphs. Bottom-right: a wide pale-blue card with text left and tilted snapshots overlapping its right edge.

Full white viewport. A small centred label, then a seven-line centred statement at about 5.6vw, regular weight, spanning 80% of the width. Six small sticker graphics are set inline between words like emoji, at roughly cap height. On entry the whole block is pale ghost-grey and darkens to charcoal as it scrolls into view.

Warm charcoal block; the white page above ends in large rounded bottom corners. Left: one line of white 20px text, an external link with arrow, four cream circular social buttons in a row and a tiny copyright. Right: a square silver card about 135px with a rendered turntable, a green-labelled record decorated with the stickers and a small caption naming the playlist.

steal: Scatter the product's own pieces around a centred pack shot, each with a die-cut border and soft shadow, leaving the centre column clear.
Drop small brand graphics inline between words of a large statement so they read as custom emoji.
Reveal a long statement by scrolling it from ghost grey to full ink instead of sliding it in.

name: Desktop.fm
idea: A single 3D compact disc spins in a grey void while green laser beams bounce off it, and the whole interface is one small device-like widget docked at the bottom.
hero: Flat cool-grey viewport with no nav. A 3D compact disc about 27% of viewport width floats just above centre, tilted in perspective, its label side printed with a white italic wordmark, two small emblems and a tagline. Six or seven thin mint-green laser lines cross the whole viewport at steep diagonals and meet at glowing points on the disc. Docked at bottom centre is a light-grey rounded widget about 280px wide: a top row with a round info button, a dotted meter and a toggle switch, a centred bold 28px wordmark, and a full-width charcoal rounded button with label left and chevron right.
type: System UI stack (-apple-system) at weight 800, 28px, with -0.036em tracking for the wordmark and a 16px bold button label; a touch of monospace on the info glyph. The disc carries an italic wide grotesk logo. Only two text sizes on the page.
colour: #bec2c5 #dadadb #2d2d2d #3cf58a #9aa0a3 — One cool grey for the whole field, a lighter grey widget and a charcoal button; mint-green lasers are the only colour, with faint cyan iridescence on the disc's data side.
imagery: Real-time 3D compact disc with a frosted label side and an iridescent data side, turning freely; neon laser beams drawn as straight lines reflecting off it across the full viewport.
layout: One screen with nothing to scroll. The object sits in the upper centre, the control widget is docked at bottom centre, and the remaining area is empty apart from laser lines running edge to edge.

sections.description: The only interface block is a 280px rounded-rectangle widget styled like a hardware control: light grey body with a soft shadow, a top strip holding a circular info button, a row of seven tiny dots like a level meter and a physical-looking toggle at right; a centred wordmark; then a dark rounded bar button spanning the widget. It stays fixed while the disc turns behind it.

steal: For a waitlist page, show one rotating 3D object tied to the product's metaphor and reduce the interface to a single docked widget.
Use straight neon lines that cross the full viewport and converge on the object to activate empty space without adding content.
Style the signup as a small hardware panel (toggle, meter dots, bar button) instead of a form.

name: Depo Budget App
idea: Budgeting reduced to one daily number, dressed in neo-brutalist sticker graphics: flat primaries, thick black outlines and a hard offset shadow on every box.
hero: Saturated blue field with a faint grid of 100px squares. A 72px header holds a white wordmark left and a black store badge right, above a 3px black rule. Left column, starting 7% in and vertically centred: a cream box with black border holding one line of uppercase mono, a two-line white headline in very heavy grotesque at 5.3vw, two lines of 20px white copy, and a coral button with black border and hard offset shadow. Right of centre: an illustrated phone tilted about 4 degrees, 24% of the width and nearly full height, thick black outline, star stickers on two corners. A lime marquee strip closes the bottom.
type: Archivo Black at 76px with -0.025em tracking for headings (white on colour, black on cream), DM Sans at 16 to 20px for copy, and a system monospace in small capitals for labels and amounts. About a 4:1 jump; three faces.
colour: #1769e7 #f6eedf #c8e832 #7c3aed #3cbdb1 #ff5c40 — Each section takes a different flat fill: blue, cream, purple, teal, blue again, then a black footer. Lime, coral, amber and red fill cards and buttons; black outlines hold it together.
imagery: Flat vector phone frames with thick black outlines showing simplified app screens in the page palette, light and dark themes alternating; four-point star stickers as decoration. No photography.
layout: Content sits in a 1230px container with 105px margins. Sections are full-width colour blocks separated by 3px black rules; each opens with a left-aligned heavy heading and one line of copy, followed by a row of outlined cards or phones. The rhythm is uniform.

sections.description: Cream section. A left-aligned heading and one line of copy, then four equal cards in a row with 16px gaps, each a different flat colour (amber, red, teal, lime) with a 2px black border and a 4px hard offset shadow. Inside each: a mono index number top-left, a bold label, one line of copy, a black hairline, then an amount in mono with a tiny uppercase caption.

Purple section. A white one-line heading spans the container with a single line of copy beneath, then four phone screens in a row at equal width, alternating light and dark app themes, each in a thick black rounded frame. The phones run about a screen tall; a one-line white caption is centred under each at the bottom of the section.

Teal section. A small amber mono label in a bordered box sits above a black heavy heading and one line of copy. Below, a three-by-three grid of white cards with black borders and hard shadows; each card is one short row with a line icon at left, a bold title and a single line of small grey copy. Cards are about 100px tall with 20px gaps.

steal: Give each section its own flat saturated fill and separate them with a 3px black rule, so colour does the sectioning.
Apply one physical rule to every box (2px black border plus 4px hard offset shadow, no blur) so buttons, cards and phones read as one kit.
Show the product's core number as an oversized figure in a lime card rather than as a screenshot.

name: Spotify Wrapped Party
idea: A desktop holding screen built as a poster lockup: a heavy extended title on black bars pierced by oversized lime year numerals, beside an op-art block of concentric rings.
hero: Warm off-white field with a small brand glyph top-centre, a speaker icon top-right and no navigation. The lockup sits just above centre across 48% of the width: two lines of white ultra-extended heavy sans, each on its own black bar, interleaved with lime slanted condensed year numerals roughly 350px tall that weave in front of and behind the bars, outlined in thin black. A square 30% of the width, flush to the left edge, holds black-and-white concentric rings centred off-canvas. A thin black scribble line loops across the screen. Below: three centred lines of 20px bold copy, a 120px QR code, eight tiny footer links.
type: The lockup is drawn artwork: an ultra-wide heavy sans for the title against tall slanted condensed numerals, an extreme width contrast. Live text is SpotifyMix bold at 20px, centred, and SpotifyMixNarrow near 10px for footer links.
colour: #efefea #292929 #94c80d #ffffff — Off-white, near-black and a single acid lime used only for the year numerals. Everything else, including the ring block, is strictly black and white.
imagery: Flat vector graphics only: a cropped square of concentric rings like a record or radar, hairline scribble curves, and the typographic lockup. No photos. Elements overlap in clear front and back layers.
layout: Single screen, no scroll. A centred column of lockup, instruction, QR code and legal links, with one asymmetrical counterweight: the ring block bleeding off the left edge. Mobile keeps the stack and moves the rings to the right, behind the lockup.
steal: Interleave two type styles of opposite width (ultra-extended title, tall condensed numerals) so one threads in front of and behind the other.
Seat each headline line on its own solid bar sized to that line, turning text into blocks that can be layered.
Balance a centred stack with one hard-edged pattern block bleeding off a single side.

name: Lama Lama
idea: An agency site dressed as a system console: a dot-matrix dithered video ground, bracketed monospace labels and a stack of floating utility widgets around plain grotesk statements.
hero: Captured before the text loaded: the viewport is a near-black (#1a1c1c) field filled with a full-bleed video rendered as a fine dot-matrix dither in dark greys, from which a silhouetted figure and a room barely emerge. Per the digest the headline is three left-aligned lines of bold uppercase grotesk at 72px (5vw), tight tracking, in cream. Later frames show the fixed chrome: a dark bar about 470px wide pinned top-centre holding a pixel logo, a tiny mono section label and a hamburger, and at top-right a stack of small labelled widget rows, the first with a face thumbnail and a contact label.
type: Suisse Int'l in two voices: bold uppercase at 48 to 72px with tight tracking for headings, medium sentence case at about 32px for statements and 20px body. Sometype Mono in 9 to 10px uppercase for every label, tag and button, usually wrapped in square brackets.
colour: #1a1c1c #222423 #f9f4eb #8a8a8a #000000 — Greenish near-black ground from top to bottom with warm cream text and no accent colour. All colour comes from small project thumbnails, which read as bright chips against the dark.
imagery: Background video converted to a two-tone dot-matrix dither; client work shown as strips of small square-cornered thumbnails roughly 95x65px to 100x100px in full colour and mixed crops; white client logos.
layout: 20px side margins; statements occupy the left half or start at the mid-line, with mono labels pushed far right. Sections are separated by hairlines and large empty dark bands. A fixed top-centre bar and a right-hand widget stack overlay everything.

sections.description: A list of full-width rows about 90px tall divided by hairlines. Each row: project name at 16px flush left; at about 19% a pair of tiny bordered mono tag chips; at 43% a small '( + )' marker; on the right a strip of three or four small colour thumbnails whose starting x position shifts from row to row and which run off the right edge. A small grey button sits centred under the list.

Bold uppercase heading at about 48px flush left, then a row of three small outlined mono buttons with arrows, then a 28px paragraph held to the left 45% of the width. Lower right, three narrow columns, each headed by a bracketed mono label, list services in 12px text. Lower left, a one-line prompt followed by a black phone-number chip with a face thumbnail.

A bracketed mono label sits alone at far left above a hairline. Some 80px lower, seven white client logos are spaced evenly across the full width on one line, with roughly 150px of empty dark above and below, making a very tall and almost empty band.

A two-line bold uppercase call at about 64px flush left with a phone chip beneath it; at the mid-line a bracketed label, two short lines of 14px text and two outlined mono buttons. A hairline, then a single row of mono meta (headcount, city, coordinates, socials) closes the page.

steal: Run background video through a dot-matrix dither in two dark greys so it gives texture and movement without competing with text.
Make the fixed top bar a narrow centred block whose monospace label rewrites itself to name the current section.
Show each case in a list row as a strip of tiny thumbnails that starts at a different x per row and bleeds off the right edge.
media: A full-bleed 13s muted video under a WebGL pixel mosaic that dissolves to reveal it covers the first screen. Then each list row carries a right-aligned strip of small thumbnails bleeding off the right edge (two ratios, 3:2 and 4:5, at one height, five of them muted loops), a fixed dithered-photo canvas shows through one section window, client logos run as a marquee, and small portrait preview clips open in a corner dock; 32 images, 14 videos, square corners.
motion: Black with a tiny mark until past 4.5s, then a full-screen mosaic of grey squares dissolves into the hero video and the chrome fades in after the content. A custom transform scroller: statements reveal line by line through masks, thumbnails fade from grey blocks to the picture as their row enters, the nav label rewrites itself with a character scramble at each new section, and the corner dock adds one teaser per section; all motion is script-driven, with one reduced-motion rule.

name: LIKOVA
idea: A stepped white mask carrying the wordmark gives way to a single dusk render of the building, which the page then travels down from sky to street.
archetype: other: stepped-mask wordmark over full-bleed render
hero: The top 28% of the viewport is white. Its lower edge is stepped: across the left half the white continues 100px further down, forming a tab that holds the wordmark in wide-tracked geometric capitals, about 72px tall and 510px wide, at a 30px left margin, with a small round arrow button in the tab's bottom-right corner. Everything else is a full-bleed dusk render of the office block rising from the bottom edge, veiled in deep navy at first and brightening on load. A two-line uppercase tagline at about 20px floats two-thirds across at mid-height. Header: a two-line menu icon far left, three tiny uppercase items at right.
type: TT Norms Pro only. The wordmark is regular-weight capitals with very wide letterspacing; all other text is uppercase at 11 to 20px, medium weight, slightly tracked. One large capital letter in a hairline box is the only other big glyph.
colour: #0d1226 #ffffff #2f3f73 #d8c49a #e3e6eb — White and deep navy only. The render's dusk sky is graded to the same navy, so the warm facade lighting becomes the single accent. Cool overall.
imagery: One architectural CGI of a glass-and-fin office block at blue hour, full-bleed and pinned; scrolling pans from sky down to street level with cars and pedestrians. No frames or corners: the image is the page background.
layout: No conventional sections in the captured stretch: a pinned full-bleed render with small text blocks docking at fixed positions (a hairline box left of centre, a caption at the right third, a navy tab bottom-left). 20px edge margins; over 50 screens of scroll for about 500 words.

sections.description: Over the pinned render, a hairline portrait rectangle about 350px wide sits left of centre, holding a tiny uppercase label and one large capital letter for the building class; its lower part passes behind the building, so the architecture occludes the overlay. At the right third, a four-line uppercase caption at about 12px is flush-left. The wordmark has shrunk into the header beside the menu icon.

At street level the render fills the viewport and a solid navy rectangle rises from the bottom-left corner, half the viewport wide and about 140px tall, mirroring the hero's white tab in the opposite corner and colour. It holds a two-line uppercase caption at its left and a small white circular button at its right end; the rest of the frame is uninterrupted image.

steal: Step the boundary between a white band and a full-bleed image so the logo sits in a tab cut into the picture rather than on top of it.
Sandwich overlay text and hairline frames between the sky and the building layer so the architecture passes in front of them.
Grade the image's sky to the exact brand navy so masks, tabs and picture merge without visible edges.
media: A full-bleed dusk render covers about 80% of the first screen under a stepped white slab carrying the wordmark and nav, and a fixed WebGL scene sits behind every captured screen. Later pictures enter with stepped clip-path edges (123 clip-path rules): text layered between sky and a cut-out of the building, a 50/50 pair with a 20px gutter and a third picture staggered below, and full-bleed renders replacing one another; 10 images, two background loops, square corners.
motion: A WebGL cube preloader whose counter reaches 100% by 1.2s but whose card stays past 4.5s while its stepped corners shift. Locomotive smooth scroll: the slab shrinks into a 50px header strip over 1s while the render glides up like a camera descending, words rise from translateY(110%) inside masks over 1200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.74,0.22,0.99), and the fixed 3D model shows one figure per screen as the camera orbits. cubic-bezier(.7,0,.3,1) appears 102 times; there is no reduced-motion rule.

name: Britt Taylor
idea: A freelance designer's page carried by one hand-made cut-paper illustration language, from the desk scene that opens it to the envelope that closes it.
hero: Almost no text. A cream page with the name set small in a soft serif top-left and a solid black square hamburger top-right. Everything else is one flat cut-paper illustration filling about 90% of the viewport and rotated a few degrees clockwise: a bird's-eye view of a designer at a laptop on a navy desk, sitting on a yellow rug with a blue striped fringe, surrounded by scissors, a kettle, a bonsai and a cat. The illustration bleeds off the bottom edge and nearly touches both sides. The headline only arrives one scroll later, centred, under a small spot illustration.
type: Inter Display bold with tight tracking for the statement; Averia Serif Libre, a soft slightly blurred serif, for the name, the 90px light menu, italic accents and the testimonial. Service list in uppercase bold white. About five sizes; body 16px.
colour: #f7f4ed #2f4c9c #2978f3 #f0cc40 #0e9c6c #ff5a26 — Cream ground with a fixed set of flat poster colours (navy, bright blue, yellow, green, vermilion, black) confined to illustrations, underlines and two solid panels. Warm overall.
imagery: Flat cut-paper vector illustration with wobbly scissor-cut edges and no outlines or shading; one hero scene, small spot motifs between sections, an illustrated envelope footer. Project screenshots appear only in a rounded-card carousel.
layout: Narrow centred column on cream with wide margins; sections separated by generous empty space rather than rules. Illustration blocks alternate with short text blocks; one carousel breaks the column and bleeds off both sides; solid colour panels are about 540px wide with rounded corners.

sections.description: Centred column about 380px wide. A small confetti-like spot illustration, an italic serif greeting acting as an eyebrow, then a four-line statement in tight bold grotesk at roughly 40px in which the job title and the closing words switch to light italic serif; the first italic phrase carries a hand-drawn green squiggle underline and the last fades to grey. A second spot illustration (a figure holding a banner overhead) closes the block.

Under an italic serif heading with a red hand-drawn underline, a plain two-column list: six client names in 14px sans, each with a small chevron at the right end of its half-column, about 56px row spacing, no rules and no thumbnails. Directly beneath, a long centred testimonial set entirely in italic serif at about 20px.

A horizontally scrolling row of project cards (about 4:3, 12px radius, 14px gaps) that bleeds off both edges of the viewport; a small illustrated motif and tiny client credit float centred above it. Cards mix flat illustration tiles with dark site screenshots, so the row alternates colour and density.

The footer is an object: a blue rounded tab holding the email address forms the flap, and a yellow envelope body about 500px wide opens beneath it with a V-shaped cut revealing a dense cut-paper bouquet. Credit and email sit in tiny type in the envelope's bottom corners. A services list in stacked uppercase white on a blue rounded panel precedes it.

steal: Open with one oversized, slightly rotated illustration and almost no text; hold the headline for the second screen.
Turn the footer into an object (an open envelope with the email on its flap) instead of a link grid.
Underline one italic serif phrase inside a bold sans statement with a hand-drawn squiggle in a palette colour.

name: Billow
idea: A conventional product page softened by a cloud motif: the logo's cloud silhouette is blown up and blurred into a blue stage for the app.
hero: Centred stack on near-white. Nav inside a 1230px container: cloud logo left, four links centred, outline Log in and navy pill right. A small outlined pill badge, then a two-line title-case serif headline at 6.4vw with -0.05em tracking in deep navy, a three-line 18px paragraph whose opening phrase sits on a pale-blue highlighter block, a glossy blue gradient pill button and an 11px reassurance line. The bottom third is a huge blurred cobalt-to-cyan cloud silhouette, the logo enlarged to full width, with the top of a white app window rising from the fold and a handwritten note with a scribbled arrow at its right corner.
type: Lastik, a high-contrast display serif, regular weight, title case, -0.05em tracking at 92px so letters nearly touch; reused at 28-40px for section and card titles. Open Runde, a rounded Inter variant, for body at 15-18px and all UI. About a 5x jump.
colour: #fcfdff #0b1f33 #0077fe #eaf5fb #22c4ff #e5e8ea — White and very pale blue with deep navy text and one electric blue for the button and the cloud glow, which shades to cyan at its edges. Sections never change ground. Cool.
imagery: Light-mode app screenshots, large, with edges and lower halves dissolving into the page; cropped UI fragments inside cards with one element sharpened and lifted. Soft cloud and sky washes behind sections.
layout: 1230px container, centred hero, then a repeating module of heading, short copy and a large faded screenshot. One three-card row. Soft blue cloud washes replace hard section breaks; about twelve screens.

sections.description: Centred pill eyebrow and two-line serif heading, a short centred paragraph, then three equal cards (about 400px wide, 1px pale border, 12px radius, faint blue glow at the top). Each card's upper 55% is a cropped, softened fragment of product UI with one sharp element popped forward (a blue chip, a figure, a tooltip); below, a serif card title and three lines of centred grey text.

Repeated feature row: a two-line serif heading at about 28px on the left whose second line is a paler slate-blue, a two-line paragraph on the right starting at the 55% mark, then a full-width app screenshot whose sides and lower part dissolve into the white page rather than sitting in a frame. Faint cloud texture drifts behind.

A three-column checklist of features with round blue tick bullets, unreleased items greyed and tagged with tiny chips, and a blue gradient pill button beneath, all over a soft photographic sky wash. The footer continues on the same wash with an app-icon tile and three link columns under serif headings.

steal: Enlarge the logo silhouette to full width, blur it heavily, and use it as the coloured stage behind the product screenshot.
Mark the opening phrase of the sub-headline with a pale highlighter block instead of bolding it.
Let product screenshots dissolve into the page at their edges rather than boxing them in a browser frame.

name: Ayush Halder Portfolio
idea: A designer's page staged like an artboard: a white business-card block and a white nav card float over cinematic footage, with a pixel ruler along the viewport edge.
hero: Sepia-graded footage of a fire ritual fills the viewport with no scrim. At top centre a white square-cornered card 525px wide (36% of the viewport) holds two rows split by a hairline: an announcement link, then two text links left, a signature logo centre and two social icons right. At dead centre floats a second white rectangle about 390 by 225px laid out like a business card: an italic serif opener, two role titles in bold grotesk with a brown-to-tan gradient fill split by a tall slash, a small tan square bottom left, the name bottom right. A three-line centred white statement sits above a tick-marked ruler labelled every 100px.
type: Geist in medium to bold weights at small sizes with tight tracking; the digest finds nothing above 2.3vw. An italic display serif is dropped in for single words and the card's opener. The logo is a scanned signature; sidebar labels are about 12px.
colour: #f5f3f1 #1e1e1e #ffffff #bdbda6 #a9734a #25160d — Warm off-white page with black text after a dark, fire-orange video hero; colour comes only from photographs. The role titles use a brown-to-tan gradient fill that echoes the footage.
imagery: Moody film-style street and interior photographs fill large landscape cards with small-radius corners; product UI screenshots or a white logo are inset on top of each photo at its centre rather than shown bare.
layout: After the centred hero, a two-column case list: a fixed text index in the left 15% and tall landscape cards stacked in the remaining width with about 40px gaps. The floating nav card and a top ruler stay fixed throughout.

sections.description: Left: a fixed vertical list of eight project names in 12px text, about 45px apart with a small dash between each; the one in view turns black while the rest stay grey. Right: one landscape card per project, roughly 1140 by 740px, each a full-bleed photograph with either a white logo mark centred on it or a white panel of UI inset at about 70% of the card width. The client name sits small at the card's bottom-left.

Two rows on off-white, each introduced by a small grey label in a narrow left column: employer wordmarks in black spread across three columns, then award credits set as a logo plus two lines of tiny text enclosed by laurel brackets. Wide blank space separates the rows; no cards, borders or backgrounds are used.

A two-line prompt, first line grey and second black at the same size, above a single white field about 520px wide with a small label at its top-left, placeholder text at the bottom and an arrow at the right edge. The footer below is three label and value rows (site, social, contact) set to the right, with the postal address far left in grey.

steal: Float a small white business-card rectangle at the centre of full-bleed footage instead of setting the headline directly on the video.
Show UI work as a panel inset on an atmospheric photograph, one large card per project, rather than bare screenshots on grey.
Run a tick-marked pixel ruler along a viewport edge as a quiet nod to the design tool.

name: Digital Original XR
idea: Scrolling puts the headset on you: a white VR headset rises from the bottom of the hero, turns to show its lenses, and the page dissolves into the 3D gallery it is selling.
hero: Pale lilac-white field fills the viewport. Logo (a small rainbow pixel square plus bold letters) top-left; one text link and a black pill button top-right. A vertically centred stack: an outlined pill badge in tiny caps, a one-line headline at 5vw spanning about 57% of the width, two lines of supporting text, then a black pill and a white outlined pill side by side. Behind, heavily washed-out gallery walls with artworks recede in perspective at the far left and right edges. A white VR headset rises from the bottom edge at centre, cropped at half height, with a small 'scroll for more' pill sitting on it.
type: Neue Montreal throughout, weight 500, sentence case, tracking -0.025em. Headline 72px over 16-18px body, a secondary heading tier near 32px and tiny all-caps pill labels: four sizes, one family, no second face.
colour: #f1f0f6 #ffffff #171717 #aeb7c2 #e0733a #46b6c4 — Cool lilac-tinted white everywhere with black pills. The only saturated colour is the orange and teal painting inside the 3D gallery, so the artwork itself carries the accent.
imagery: Rendered video: a white headset on a seamless pale backdrop, then a grey gallery room with a pink-haired avatar seen from behind facing a wide landscape painting. Full-bleed first, later inset as a rounded-corner panel.
layout: Everything hangs on one centre axis with wide empty margins. Full-viewport pinned 3D scenes alternate with narrow centred text blocks (about 45% of the width), then an accordion FAQ in a centred column and a closing call-to-action card.

sections.description: Pinned full-viewport sequence. The hero's headset grows and rotates until its dark lens interior faces the viewer and fills the upper half of the frame. The next frame is inside the gallery: a full-bleed grey room, a large landscape painting on the far wall, side paintings angled in perspective at both edges, an avatar walking in from the left foreground, and a small black pill caption under the painting naming artist and work.

Centred heading at about 2.3vw with one grey line beneath and a two-option segmented pill toggle (icon plus label each, the active one white). Under it the same gallery scene is now contained in a rounded rectangle about 66% of the viewport wide, avatar small and centred, so the earlier immersive view becomes a framed preview that the toggle switches between modes.

A frosted white rounded card at centre holds the pill badge, a repeat of the headline and the two pill buttons. Two large gallery walls with paintings flank it in steep perspective, converging toward the card, and blurred copies of the art bleed through the card's glass at its left and right edges. A one-line footer of small links sits beneath.

steal: Let the product object bridge hero and first section: crop it at the hero's bottom edge, then scale and rotate it on scroll until it becomes the doorway into the demo scene.
Shrink a full-bleed immersive scene into a rounded framed panel in the following section so one asset serves as both spectacle and interface preview.
Flank the closing call-to-action card with two large images set in steep perspective so they read as walls converging on the button.

name: Woblo
idea: The landing page is inspected by its own product: the headline wears the extension's selection box, element-size tag and colour-palette tooltip.
hero: Off-white page, slim top bar within a roughly 1030px column: logo and three links left, one blue link right. A tiny mono proof line sits above a two-line centred headline at about 3.9vw, enclosed in a blue selection rectangle with pale-blue fill and a black tag at its top-left giving element name and pixel size. One word is swapped for a blue brush-script sticker with a white outline; a cursor with a name flag trails the last word. A white palette tooltip (five swatches, a contrast score) overlaps the grey subtext. Two pills follow, then a rounded browser screenshot cropped by the fold with a floating play pill.
type: Inter at weight 500 with -0.03em tracking for headings (56px) over 14-18px Inter body; Geist Mono for proof lines, hex codes and measurement tags. One brush-script word used as a sticker. The footer wordmark jumps to about 22vw in a heavy lowercase sans.
colour: #fbfbfb #101013 #0f7fff #e5eef7 #ff7a1a #22e08a — Near-white and near-black with one interface blue for selection states and the primary button. A pink-to-orange gradient marks the popular plan, and only the footer wordmark breaks into orange, green, pink and purple blocks.
imagery: Screenshots of the extension's side panel docked to a browser showing a well-known product page, plus tiny interface vignettes inside feature cards. Rounded corners, a blue abstract backdrop behind the main screenshot.
layout: Narrow centred column of about 1030px on a 1440 viewport. Centred two-line section headings with one grey line under each, followed by card grids: three-column bento, three pricing cards, a three-column review masonry, a single-column accordion. A small pill stays pinned bottom-centre.

sections.description: Three-column grid of white cards with hairline borders and small radius. The top half of each card is a pale grey well holding a miniature working specimen of the feature: a button with a cursor, a swatch row with contrast badge, an 'Aa' type scale, file-type chips, a token list, a markdown snippet. A bold one-line title and two grey lines sit below. A last row of two wider cards has solid pale-blue lower halves and a mono hint line.

Three equal cards. Each has a tinted header strip carrying the plan name (grey for the outer plans, a pink-orange-violet gradient with a small 'most popular' note for the middle), a black rounded-square icon, one grey line, a large price with a small per-month suffix, a full-width pill button (glossy blue only in the middle card), then a checklist with filled circular ticks.

A centred closing headline reuses the script sticker and scatters three coloured multiplayer-cursor name flags around the button. Then a small link row, and the wordmark at about 22vw: each lowercase letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle (black, orange, green, pink, purple), the rectangles being different heights and butted together like stacked blocks.

steal: Annotate your own headline with the product's overlay interface (selection box, element-size tag, tooltip) so the hero doubles as the demo.
Fill the top half of each feature card with a miniature working specimen of the feature instead of an icon.
Build a footer wordmark from letters knocked out of butted solid colour blocks of unequal height.

name: Protip Marketing
idea: A PR agency as a loud pop poster: hot pink and cyan fields, black outlines, sticker buttons and social-video clips used as wallpaper.
hero: A cream header bar 78px tall above a black rule: a wide high-contrast serif wordmark at left, a segmented group of four outlined uppercase tabs right of centre with a dot marking the active one, a language toggle and outlined pill at right. Below, video fills the rest edge to edge as three vertical panels, two of a street-style clip and one product shot. Top-left over the video, two lines of 22px white text and a pink pill button with black outline. Bottom-left, a two-line uppercase bold headline at 96px (6.7vw) in cream sits on the bottom edge and runs across two-thirds of the width, over the footage.
type: Uncut Sans Bold in uppercase with -0.04em tracking for every heading, from the 96px headline to 24px service titles; Uncut Sans Medium for lists at about 18px. The logo is a wide didone-style serif, enlarged to full page width in the footer.
colour: #ff70cf #189bdc #f8fff0 #000000 #ffffff — Flat fields swap by section: cream header and contact, hot pink services, cyan portfolio and footer. Black handles all type, outlines and rules; there are no tints or gradients anywhere.
imagery: Vertical social-media clips and flash-lit fashion or product photos in portrait crop, square corners with a 1px black outline; in the hero they tile as full-height panels behind the headline.
layout: Full-width colour bands with 24px margins. In services a giant section word stays pinned top-left while a column in the right half scrolls image-plus-list blocks. The next section enters as a tilted cyan slab from the bottom-left, breaking the horizontal rhythm.

sections.description: Hot pink field. The section name stays pinned top-left at about 96px uppercase bold. In the right half each service is a block: an uppercase bold title at 24px, then a portrait photo 170px wide with black outline, and to its right a list of five or six items, each prefixed with a black asterisk and separated by hairline rules. A small white outlined pill button, rotated about 15 degrees, overlaps the photo's left edge like a sticker.

Section transition: the portfolio arrives as a cyan parallelogram rising from the bottom-left corner, its top edge tilted about 15 degrees, with its title in 64px black uppercase set along the slope. Cream image cards tilted to the same angle follow beneath. While it rises it covers the pinned pink section, so two saturated fields meet on a diagonal instead of a horizontal line.

Cream band split by a vertical black rule at 51%. Left: three form fields drawn only as uppercase labels with a hairline under each, the message area tall, and a small black pill submit at bottom-right. Right: label-left, value-right rows separated by hairlines, then four pink circles with black outlines holding social icons across the column. Underneath, a cyan footer band shows the serif wordmark enlarged to the full page width.

steal: Bring the next section in as a tilted slab of flat colour with its title set along the slope, instead of a horizontal edge.
Rotate a small outlined pill button and let it overlap a photo's edge so the call to action reads as a sticker.
Build a contact block from nothing but uppercase labels and hairlines, then end on the wordmark stretched to full width on a flat colour.

name: GoodGoodGreat®
idea: A five-chapter manifesto set as full-justified uppercase blocks, each with one small image buried inside the paragraph like a highlighted patch.
archetype: other: small centred wordmark on empty black
hero: A pure black viewport containing nothing except the studio's name, one word, set dead centre at roughly 49% of the viewport width and 6% of its height. The letters are a rounded geometric sans drawn on a canvas as stacked horizontal scanlines, so each glyph looks sliced into about ten white stripes; a tiny registered mark sits at the baseline on the right. There is no navigation, no tagline, no button and no scroll cue: about 97% of the screen is empty black.
type: Body as display: a default system grotesk in uppercase at ~3.1vw, regular weight, full-justified with visible word-space rivers and leading near 1.1. Inter for 11px labels. The wordmark is a drawn scanline geometric. Two sizes only.
colour: #000000 #ffffff #19b5d8 #4a4a4a — Black and white only; colour enters solely through the small photographs (a cyan portrait backdrop, a red magazine cover) set inside the text blocks. Unread words sit in dark grey.
imagery: One small portrait-ratio photo or cut-out object per chapter (a portrait, a magazine cover, a silver coin, a news still), about 12% of the viewport wide, centred within the paragraph and layered with the text.
layout: Each chapter is one full-viewport black screen with a single justified paragraph spanning margin to margin, vertically centred, a tiny chapter label top-left and a counter top-right. Five such screens, then two email lines and a cropped wordmark.

sections.description: Full-viewport black screen. A six-line uppercase paragraph at ~3vw, justified to both margins (about 48px each side), sits at mid-height. A portrait-ratio photograph roughly 170px wide is centred horizontally inside the block and spans its full height; the white text runs straight across it. Words not yet reached by scrolling stay blurred and dark grey. A spelled-out chapter label sits top-left and a two-digit counter top-right, both around 11px.

After the last chapter comes a tall empty black gap, then two email addresses in ~14px uppercase, stacked and centred. Beneath them the scanline wordmark returns, enlarged to the full viewport width and cropped by the bottom edge so only the top two thirds of the letters show. No links, no legal row, no columns.

steal: Set manifesto copy as one justified uppercase block per screen and reveal it word by word from blur as the reader scrolls.
Embed a single small image inside the paragraph's footprint with the text running over it, instead of placing media beside the copy.
End on the wordmark at full viewport width, cropped by the bottom edge, echoing the small centred one that opened the page.

name: George Wood
idea: A designer's site as a narrow status panel on a solid cobalt field: live time, weather, current track and recent films sit beside the client list.
archetype: other: narrow left info-panel on a single colour field
hero: Grainy cobalt-blue viewport. All content lives in a 640px column pinned to the left edge (44%), closed by a faint vertical hairline; the right 56% is empty blue. Top row: a 60px rounded avatar, the name in white 14px semibold with the role in pale blue beneath; at right the city, local time and temperature, then a square outlined settings button. A hairline-bounded ticker strip follows with a tiny caps label and a scrolling track title over a faint waveform. Three short white 14px paragraphs, then seven client rows split by hairlines: name left, outlined award pills beside some, a site link right (struck through on four).
type: Inter only, at 14px for nearly everything (the largest text is 1vw): semibold white for names, regular pale blue for secondary lines, 11px tracked caps for strip labels. There is no headline; hierarchy comes from weight, opacity and rules.
colour: #0038ff #1344f7 #ffffff #a9bcff #3a64ec — One cobalt blue for everything, with white and pale-blue text and lighter-blue hairlines; even the film posters are tinted into blue monotone. A faint noise texture softens the flat field.
imagery: Only a small avatar and a row of six film posters, each recoloured as a blue monotone so it sits inside the field. No project images at all.
layout: A single 640px left-pinned column divided by horizontal hairlines into strips: header, ticker, bio, client table, two-up testimonial cells, poster row, footer line. Internal padding is 16px. The rest of the desktop viewport stays empty.

sections.description: Seven full-width rows inside the column, each about 46px tall and separated by a hairline. At left, the client name in white semibold, on some rows followed by an outlined pill naming an award count. At right, a pale site link with a north-east arrow; where the site is offline the link is struck through rather than removed, so the list keeps its full length.

A two-cell row divided by vertical hairlines. Each cell holds a long quote in 13px white, then the author's name and title bottom-left and the company logo bottom-right in pale blue. The second cell is cut off by the column edge to signal horizontal scrolling; two small arrow buttons sit in bordered squares underneath at the left.

A strip labelled in tiny tracked caps with an external link at its right end, then six portrait film posters in a row, all converted to blue-and-white monotone with a thin lighter border. Under each poster: a truncated title, the year and a five-star rating in about 10px. A final hairline row carries the year at left and a social handle at right.

steal: Flood the page with one saturated colour and recolour every image as a monotone of it so nothing breaks the field.
Strike through dead links instead of deleting them; it shows history honestly and adds texture to a list.
Add small live data strips (local time, weather, now playing, recently watched) to make a text-only profile feel inhabited.

name: near
idea: Show the real account dashboard immediately under a plain promise; there is no visual idea beyond a mint glow and a ruled page frame.
hero: White page framed by two hairline vertical rules 80px in from each side. Logo top-left inside the frame, a lone log-in link top-right. The headline starts 18% down, left-aligned: two lines of medium-weight geometric sans at 4.2vw spanning 40% of the width. Under it a two-line grey 18px sub, then a black rounded button with a grey reassurance line beside it. The right half of the upper hero is empty. At 60% down a green-dot demo label, then a dashboard screenshot with a thick dark rounded bezel spans the full frame width and is cropped by the fold. A mint-green glow rises behind it from the bottom corners.
type: Figtree only. Headline 500 weight at 60px with -0.025em tracking; section heads drop to about 36px; body 14 to 18px in grey. A modest 4:1 jump, sentence case throughout, no caps labels.
colour: #ffffff #262626 #00ec97 #171717 #eaeaea — White and charcoal sections alternate. Mint green is the one accent, used as large gradient fields behind UI widgets, in the closing band and on small icons. Cool overall.
imagery: Live-looking dashboard and swap widgets in dark and white rounded panels, placed on mint gradient blocks, plus a row of round crypto coin logos. No photography or illustration.
layout: Everything sits inside a 1280px frame drawn with hairline verticals; sections are divided into ruled cells, with bands of a faint plus-sign pattern as spacers. A left-aligned heading plus sub opens every section. White, dark, white, mint rhythm.

sections.description: Inside the ruled frame: heading and one-line sub top-left, then a two-column block. The left column is a vertical list of six feature titles separated by hairlines; the open one has a pale grey fill and a three-line description, and two carry small green status text. The right column is a flat mint-green panel the full height of the list with a dark rounded swap widget floating in it.

Charcoal band divided by hairlines into three equal cells aligned to the page frame. Each cell holds a 28px white numeral top-left with a tiny grey caption under it and a lot of empty cell around. Directly beneath runs a full-width strip of faint plus signs on the same charcoal, a textured spacer before the page returns to white.

A mint-green band fading lighter toward the top holds a left-aligned 32px heading, one line of dark sub and a black rounded button, all in the left third. It bleeds into a charcoal footer: logo and two-line description left, three short link columns right, and the wordmark repeated enormous and barely lighter than the background across the bottom.

steal: Draw the page container as two visible hairline verticals and align every cell divider to them, so the grid itself is the decoration.
Put a short grey reassurance sentence inline to the right of the primary button instead of a second button.
Use a strip of faint plus-sign pattern as a spacer band between sections in place of empty padding.

name: TRIONN
idea: A dark WebGL stage where the studio's angular logo floats as a wireframe among black shards the visitor can blast; the copy is secondary to the toy.
hero: Near-black canvas with dark angular shards drifting and a wireframe 3D logo mark, about 30% of the width, floating at centre in barely lighter grey. Top-left: small logo. Top-right: a mute icon, a white pill button and an outlined menu pill. The headline sits flush left directly under the logo: two lines of light-grey grotesk at 6.3vw with -0.06em tracking, reaching 42% across. Bottom-right, a 235px-wide block: a hairline-bordered two-cell box (globe icon with founding year, a two-line uppercase claim) above three lines of 16px copy. Bottom-centre, two lines of tiny uppercase instructions with emoji. Bottom-left, a small circle scroll cue.
type: Familjen Grotesk regular at 90px with very tight -0.06em tracking for headlines, rising to about 9vw capitals in the marquee; Neue Haas at 16px for copy; Martian Mono in tiny capitals for link labels. Text is pale grey rather than white.
colour: #0b0b0b #d0d0d0 #ffffff #c3c3c3 #ff6a1a — Almost entirely black and pale grey. A small orange glow on one shard and two emoji are the only warm notes. One section flips to light grey through horizontal bars.
imagery: Real-time 3D: the logo as extruded wireframe and solid black slabs, scattered shards and thin streak lines in very low contrast; later a tilted semi-transparent card with a project image floating on a pale gradient.
layout: Full-bleed stage with 36px margins. Text blocks are pinned to corners, large statements sit left or right of centre, and tiny uppercase captions hang at column edges. Twenty-eight screens of pinned scenes, a full-width marquee, a light interlude, then a dark footer.

sections.description: A four-line statement at about 4.5vw starts 55% across the screen with a first-line indent of roughly 60px, in pale grey that fills in word by word from dim to bright. A tiny uppercase section label sits alone at the far left on the first line's height. Beneath, two small captions at opposite ends of the text block: a three-line uppercase motto left, a three-line sentence right, then an underlined mono link.

Marquee and wipe. A single line of capitals at about 9vw crosses the full width and runs off both edges, words separated by small plus signs with wide gaps; the 3D logo slab stands behind it and a glowing orange facet pokes between two words. The line becomes the seam of a transition: stacked horizontal pale-grey bars of varying thickness sweep up the screen and invert the page to light.

Light-grey gradient screen, empty except for a centred two-word heading near 40px in dark grey with two tiny centred lines beneath, placed in the lower middle. Below and left, a tilted semi-transparent card carrying a project image floats in perspective as it enters from the bottom edge. The nav pills invert to dark for this section.

Dark again. Top-left a tiny uppercase line, then a two-line 40px question. Right column: two mono uppercase link rows, each on its own hairline with an arrow at the end, then contact and social in small two-column lists. The bottom third is the wordmark at full width, drawn only from horizontal scanlines of varying length so it reads as a faint striped ghost.

steal: Pin small supporting blocks to the viewport corners (a bordered two-cell fact box bottom-right, an instruction bottom-centre) so the headline can sit alone top-left.
Indent the first line of a large statement and start the block right of centre, leaving a tiny section label alone at the far margin.
Draw the footer wordmark from horizontal scanlines of varying length instead of solid letters.
media: A fixed WebGL canvas covers the fold: a 3D logo mark about 11% of the width and half the height at the centre, with fine orbit lines reaching every edge and all the copy in the corners. Later come three-up stat cards alternating photo, numeral and photo, a section title facing a project card before a horizontal track of 720px columns, a pinned smoke-and-stone scene that smashes a stacked type list, and a giant wordmark across the foot, the pictures with about 4-6px corners and no video anywhere.
motion: No preloader: the mark's beams fly in from the edges with an orange flare while the hero's last word dissolves letter by letter with a blur, settled in about 3s (network idle near 16s). Lenis with 4 pins: the mark explodes behind the about statement and reassembles behind the marquee, the statement fills from #434343 to #d8d8d8 word by word, vertical scroll drives the project track sideways, and a stone falls through the services words whose letters scatter and fall; colour flips run 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) on 160 elements.

name: Flowjam
idea: A persistent frosted sidebar card holds the pitch and buttons while a soft-serif content column scrolls past it; beyond that there is no idea stronger than proof by logos and videos.
hero: Grainy off-white page. A tall rounded card about 26% of the viewport wide is pinned at the left and runs off the bottom; frosted over blurred pink and yellow flowers, it holds the logo, a two-line serif tagline, a short blurb and two pill buttons in hot pink and charcoal. The main column starts 32% from the left: a hot-pink pill badge, a three-line serif headline at 4.2vw, then a paragraph whose first sentence is grey and the rest black. A lone charcoal pill button floats far right at mid-height. Below: a heart icon with a proof line, then the top of a four-column logo grid with dotted borders.
type: Gelica throughout: a soft, slightly bulbous serif at regular weight, 60px headline with tight -0.05em tracking, 16 to 19px body, down to about 9px in the sidebar. One family for everything including buttons keeps the tone warm but flattens the difference between labels and prose.
colour: #f8f8f6 #e7e8e4 #1c0f1f #ff4fe0 #0c0c0c #7b3ff2 — Warm paper white with grain, near-black aubergine text and one hot-pink accent used for the badge and primary button; a purple heart appears once. The footer flips to black.
imagery: Rounded-corner video thumbnails of founders talking to camera and product UI clips, each with a small round play button bottom-left; monochrome client logos in a dotted-line grid; blurred floral blobs behind the frosted sidebar.
layout: A fixed 26% sidebar card at left for the whole scroll; content occupies one column to its right, split into two for video tiles and four for logos. Sections are separated by whitespace only. The footer is a rounded black panel that still leaves the sidebar in place.

sections.description: Four-column grid of client logos drawn with faint dotted cell borders, each cell roughly 240px wide and 115px tall with the logo centred in dark grey monochrome. Sixteen or more logos over four rows, no captions. Above it, a centred line with a purple heart glyph and a sentence whose first word is black and the rest grey serves as the heading.

Two-column grid of video cards. Each card has a header row with the client name in 14px serif and a one-line result in tiny grey beneath it at left, and a small outlined pill link at right; then a 16:9 thumbnail with about 10px radius and a round play button over its bottom-left corner. Cards are divided by hairlines rather than boxes, and some thumbnails are flat type frames instead of photos.

A rounded black panel inset from the page edges, sitting right of the sidebar. Its background is a short phrase repeated in dark-grey serif at about 5vw, rows offset so the words tile like wallpaper. Centred over it: a two-line white serif headline at about 2.5vw and a small stat line. The lower third holds the logo at left and four narrow columns of tiny text.

steal: Pin a narrow card with logo, one-line pitch and both actions beside the scrolling content, so the call to action never leaves the screen and no top nav is needed.
Set one sentence of a paragraph in grey and the rest in black to rank two claims without changing size or weight.
Tile a short phrase as dark-on-black wallpaper behind the footer headline.

name: The Watch
idea: A single 3D watch is the only actor: it holds centre stage and turns, flips and finally explodes into parts while giant product-name letters slide behind and in front of it.
